title: Distinguishing Revision and Delayed Elaboration in Incremental Narrative Interpretation
comment: Accepted as a full paper for presentation at the 2026 Workshop on Computational Models of Narrative (CMN 2026). This preprint corresponds to the workshop version
summary:
Both human and AI systems that process narrative or long-form content operate incrementally: input is received over time, and internal representations must be updated accordingly. Incremental interpretation, therefore, depends not only on what is represented but also on how the representational state evolves under new evidence.
  We distinguish two structurally different update operators that arise in narrative interpretation: revision-driven update and delayed elaboration. Revision-driven updates retract or replace previously committed structure in response to a contradiction and are therefore non-monotonic. Delayed elaboration, by contrast, refines initially underspecified elements through constraint addition without retracting prior commitments, yielding monotonic extension of the interpretive state. Although both operators may alter how earlier material is understood, they impose fundamentally different structural requirements on state transitions.
  Using visual narratives as a diagnostic domain, we demonstrate how a structured narrative representation can explicitly separate committed from underspecified content and support both update operators during incremental construction. Through a worked example, we show how delayed elaboration enables monotonic refinement of interpretive state, while revision requires non-monotonic correction. We discuss the broader relevance of this structural distinction for incremental reasoning and hybrid symbolic-neural systems.

AI.tldr: 本文区分叙事增量理解中的两类状态更新：遇到矛盾时撤回既有承诺的非单调“修订驱动更新”，以及通过添加约束细化未充分指定内容的单调“延迟精化”。
AI.motivation: 人类与AI在处理叙事或长文本时都需要随输入逐步更新内部表征。作者关注的不只是表征内容本身，还包括新证据到来时表征状态如何演化，尤其是不同更新机制对增量解释系统的结构性要求。
AI.method: 论文提出两种结构不同的更新算子，并以视觉叙事作为诊断场景，使用结构化叙事表征显式区分“已承诺内容”和“未充分指定内容”。通过一个工作示例展示系统如何在增量构建过程中分别支持延迟精化和修订。
AI.result: 分析表明，延迟精化通过增加约束来细化先前未定内容，不撤回已有承诺，因此形成单调扩展；修订驱动更新则在出现矛盾时撤销或替换先前结构，属于非单调校正。二者虽然都可能改变对早期材料的理解，但状态转移的结构要求根本不同。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调，在增量叙事理解中应明确区分单调的延迟精化与非单调的修订更新。这一区分有助于设计更稳健的增量推理模型，并对符号-神经混合系统中的表征更新机制具有启发意义。

title: KSE-Web: An Analysis of Hybrid Retrieval and LLM-Assisted Query Expansion for Low-Resource Khmer Semantic Search
summary: As a low-resource language, Khmer presents several retrieval challenges, including limited annotated data, ambiguous word boundaries, weak support in multilingual embedding models, and frequent mixed Khmer-English usage. This paper presents KSE-Web, an analysis of hybrid retrieval and LLM-assisted query expansion for Khmer semantic search. We construct the dataset from approximately 17K candidate Khmer titles and retain 3K cleaned full-text Khmer documents after filtering, normalization, deduplication, and document-length control. The dataset includes 300 manually reviewed user-style Khmer search queries and silver relevance labels with partial human verification. We evaluate character n-gram BM25, multilingual dense retrieval, hybrid BM25+dense retrieval, and LLM-assisted query expansion using Qwen2.5 models. Experimental results show that BM25 achieves the strongest overall performance, reaching 0.943 Recall and 0.876 nDCG. Hybrid BM25+dense retrieval performs comparably, achieving 0.929 Recall and 0.871 nDCG, while dense retrieval alone performs lower. LLM-assisted query expansion does not outperform non-expanded retrieval; however, Qwen2.5-3B produces substantially stronger expanded-query results than Qwen2.5-0.5B, suggesting that LLM size and expansion quality matter for low-resource Khmer retrieval. Our analysis further shows that direct LLM expansion can introduce topic drift, generic terms, and noisy reformulations, while simple filtering may remove useful semantic cues. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of LLM-assisted retrieval for Khmer semantic search and provide a foundation for future Khmer retrieval datasets with stronger human-verified annotations and Khmer-aware retrieval models. The dataset and documentation will be made available at github.com/back-kh/KhmerSemantic-Search.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并分析了一个面向高棉语语义搜索的数据集 KSE-Web，比较 BM25、稠密检索、混合检索与 LLM 辅助查询扩展；结果显示字符 n-gram BM25 表现最佳，LLM 扩展尚未带来收益。
AI.motivation: 高棉语属于低资源语言，面临标注数据少、分词边界模糊、多语嵌入支持不足以及高棉语-英语混用频繁等检索难题，因此需要专门的数据集与方法评估来推动高棉语语义搜索研究。
AI.method: 作者从约 1.7 万个候选高棉语标题中构建数据，经清洗、规范化、去重和长度控制后保留 3000 篇全文文档；设计 300 条人工审阅的用户式高棉语查询，并生成带部分人工验证的银标准相关性标签。方法上评估字符 n-gram BM25、多语稠密检索、BM25+稠密混合检索，以及基于 Qwen2.5 模型的 LLM 查询扩展。
AI.result: BM25 取得最佳总体表现，Recall 为 0.943，nDCG 为 0.876；混合 BM25+稠密检索表现接近，Recall 为 0.929，nDCG 为 0.871；单独稠密检索较弱。LLM 辅助查询扩展未超过未扩展检索，但 Qwen2.5-3B 明显优于 Qwen2.5-0.5B，说明模型规模与扩展质量会影响低资源检索效果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，在当前高棉语低资源场景下，传统字符级 BM25 仍具强竞争力；LLM 查询扩展具有潜力但易引入主题漂移、泛化词和噪声改写，简单过滤也可能删除有用语义线索。未来需要更强人工验证标注和更适配高棉语特征的检索模型。

title: Wazobia Eval: A Benchmark for Nigerian Pidgin Emotion Understanding, Sarcasm Detection, and Cultural Reasoning
summary: Nigerian Pidgin is one of Africa's most widely spoken languages, yet remains severely underrepresented in language model evaluation. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on translation, transcription, or generic sentiment analysis, leaving critical aspects of culturally grounded language understanding unmeasured. We introduce Wazobia Eval, a benchmark for evaluating Nigerian Pidgin emotion understanding, sarcasm detection, and cultural reasoning. The benchmark is built on a manually annotated dataset containing over 550 examples and a 16-category emotion taxonomy designed to capture culturally specific emotional registers that are not represented in conventional sentiment frameworks. Wazobia Eval provides standardized evaluation protocols and benchmark tasks for assessing model performance on nuanced Nigerian language understanding. We present the benchmark design, annotation methodology, taxonomy development process, and preliminary pilot evaluation results. Our goal is to provide foundational evaluation infrastructure for Nigerian language AI and establish a reproducible benchmark for future research. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/WAZOBIALABS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Wazobia Eval，一个面向 Nigerian Pidgin 的语言模型评测基准，重点评估情感理解、讽刺检测与文化推理能力。
AI.motivation: Nigerian Pidgin 使用广泛，但在语言模型评测中严重不足；现有基准多集中于翻译、转写或通用情感分析，难以衡量具有文化语境的细粒度语言理解能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个人工标注数据集，包含 550 多个样例，并设计了 16 类情感分类体系，以覆盖常规情感框架中缺失的文化特定情绪表达；同时提供标准化评测协议和基准任务。
AI.result: 论文给出了基准设计、标注方法、情感 taxonomy 开发流程以及初步试点评测结果，并公开数据集以支持复现实验。
AI.conclusion: Wazobia Eval 为 Nigerian Pidgin 相关 AI 研究提供了基础评测设施，有助于推动低资源、文化相关语言理解任务的标准化与可复现研究。

title: Average Finite-Blocklength Packet Error Rate over Nakagami-$m$ Fading via a Logistic--Lerch Approximation
comment: 5 Pages. Accepted for publication in IEEE Wireless Communications Letters
summary: Evaluating the average packet error rate (PER) of finite-blocklength (FBL) coded transmission over fading requires integrating the block-error waterfall, given by the normal approximation, against the fading distribution, which is intractable for general Nakagami-$m$ channels. This letter approximates the conditional waterfall by a slope-matched logistic function and shows that its Nakagami-$m$ average reduces to a single Lerch-transcendent term that interpolates between the FBL waterfall and the classical outage limit, with norming constants explicit in rate and blocklength. The closed form supports non-integer fading and, composed into an effective-capacity objective, yields a quality-of-service (QoS) aware rate-selection rule. It matches the normal-approximation integral to about 1\% uniformly in $m$ over the nominal FBL operating region, while outage and linearization baselines exceed several percent at high diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于Nakagami-m衰落信道下有限块长编码平均包错误率的闭式近似方法。
AI.motivation: 有限块长传输在衰落信道中的平均包错误率需要将正态近似给出的块错误瀑布曲线与衰落分布积分，但对一般Nakagami-m信道该积分难以解析求解。
AI.method: 将条件错误概率瀑布曲线用斜率匹配的Logistic函数近似，并证明其在Nakagami-m分布下的平均可化为单个Lerch超越函数项；同时给出与速率和块长相关的显式归一化常数，并将该闭式表达嵌入有效容量优化。
AI.result: 该近似支持非整数衰落参数m，能够在有限块长瀑布区与经典中断极限之间平滑过渡；在典型有限块长工作区域内，相比正态近似数值积分的误差约为1%，而中断近似和线性化基线在高分集时误差可达数个百分点以上。
AI.conclusion: 所提Logistic-Lerch闭式近似为Nakagami-m衰落下有限块长PER评估与QoS感知速率选择提供了准确、可解析且计算高效的工具。

title: On the Role of Citations in Preference Data
summary: Many NLP tasks require systems to provide attribution in their outputs--i.e. citations to grounding sources. Attribution serves as a bulwark against model hallucination and as a means for users to verify the credibility of model outputs. Yet, it is unclear how humans and LLMs evaluate citations when comparing outputs, a process central to reward modeling and modern LLM post-training. This paper studies the role of citations in the preferences of human judges and four open-source LLMs within the context of scientific question answering, leveraging mixed effects models to investigate the influence of citations on pairwise judgments. Among our key findings are (1) that humans prefer more diverse citations but fewer overall, and (2) that LLMs show some citation-related preferences compared to humans, despite lacking access to the sources, but these preferences depend on the data and specific models. We further discuss the implications of our findings for preference data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在人类与开源大语言模型进行科学问答输出偏好比较时，引用信息如何影响判断。
AI.motivation: 许多NLP任务要求模型输出附带来源引用，以降低幻觉并帮助用户验证可信度；但在人类与LLM进行成对偏好评估时，引用数量、多样性等因素如何影响判断仍不清楚，这直接关系到奖励建模和LLM后训练数据收集。
AI.method: 论文以科学问答为场景，收集人类评审与四个开源LLM对带引用回答的成对偏好判断，并使用混合效应模型分析引用特征对偏好选择的影响。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：人类倾向于偏好多样性更高但总数更少的引用；LLM即使无法访问引用源文本，也表现出某些与引用相关的偏好，但这些偏好受数据集和具体模型影响，与人类并不完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 引用会显著影响偏好判断，但人类与LLM的引用偏好存在差异且不稳定；因此，在构建偏好数据、训练奖励模型和进行LLM后训练时，需要更谨慎地设计引用相关标注与评估机制。

title: Construction and Design of MPAC Codes
comment: This paper has submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Theory
summary: This paper proposes modified polarization-adjusted convolutional (MPAC) codes and their hybrid decoding that achieves an improved performance-complexity tradeoff. For MPAC codes, only a subset of the information bits undergo the convolutional transform. The output is then combined with the remaining information bits for the inner polar transform. Correspondingly, the convolutionally transformed bits are recovered by Fano decoding, while the remaining information bits are recovered by the successive cancellation (SC) decoding, constituting the hybrid Fano-successive cancellation (HFSC) decoding. The MPAC codes are further designed by the coset-wise analysis that characterizes the number of minimum weight codewords (MWCs). It is discovered that a partially convolutional transform can improve the codeword through utilizing the row combinations of the frozen set efficiently. This property enables the MPAC codes to outperform their prototype polarization-adjusted convolutional (PAC) codes and cyclic redundancy check (CRC)-polar codes. Furthermore, MPAC codes can be optimized by reducing the number of MWCs. Our numerical results demonstrate that, with a similar decoding complexity budget, the MPAC codes offer competent decoding performance when compared with PAC codes using Fano decoding and CRC-polar codes using SC list (SCL) decoding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出改进的极化调整卷积（MPAC）码及混合 Fano-SC 解码，在相近复杂度下实现更优或有竞争力的译码性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 PAC 码和 CRC-polar 码在性能与译码复杂度之间存在权衡：PAC 码常依赖 Fano 译码，CRC-polar 码常依赖 SCL 译码，复杂度较高或资源预算受限时性能受影响。因此需要一种能在有限复杂度下提升纠错性能的新型码构造与译码方案。
AI.method: MPAC 码仅对部分信息比特施加卷积变换，再与其余信息比特共同输入内层 polar 变换。译码端采用混合 Fano- successive cancellation（HFSC）译码：卷积变换相关比特由 Fano 译码恢复，未卷积变换的信息比特由 SC 译码恢复。同时，论文通过按陪集分析刻画最小重量码字（MWCs）数量，并据此优化 MPAC 码设计，减少 MWCs。
AI.result: 分析发现，部分卷积变换能够更有效利用冻结集合的行组合来改善码字结构。数值结果表明，在相似译码复杂度预算下，MPAC 码相较原型 PAC 码和 CRC-polar 码具有更优或相当的译码性能。
AI.conclusion: MPAC 码通过部分卷积变换与 HFSC 混合译码实现了性能—复杂度折中的改进；基于 MWC 数量的优化进一步提升了码设计质量，使其成为 PAC 码和 CRC-polar 码的有竞争力替代方案。

title: Topology of a Smile: Persistent Homology in Dental Imaging
summary: CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scans provide detailed three-dimensional images, widely used in dentistry for diagnostic and treatment planning tasks. While invaluable, analyzing and documenting these scans is labor-intensive, prompting efforts to automate key steps like the classification and segmentation of anatomical structures to identify tooth types and associated pathologies. In this article, we propose an approach to automation that leverages persistent homology, a framework from topological data analysis that studies the shape of data by identifying features like connected components, holes, and voids across multiple scales. Persistent homology, together with a support vector machine, allows us to classify teeth in a CBCT scan and to perform diagnostics. Our method advances the state of the art, reaching average accuracy scores of 97.67% for tooth-labeling and 96.77% for diagnostic tasks, outperforming a CNN trained on the same data with accuracy of 70.27% and 86.67%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将持久同调与支持向量机结合，用于CBCT牙齿分类与诊断，取得高于同数据CNN基线的准确率。
AI.motivation: CBCT在牙科诊断和治疗规划中提供三维影像，但人工分析、标注与记录耗时费力；因此需要自动化牙齿结构分类、分割及病理诊断流程。
AI.method: 使用拓扑数据分析中的持久同调提取牙齿三维形态在多尺度下的拓扑特征，如连通分量、孔洞和空腔，并将这些特征输入支持向量机进行牙齿标签分类和诊断任务。
AI.result: 方法在牙齿标注任务上达到97.67%的平均准确率，在诊断任务上达到96.77%的平均准确率；均优于同数据训练的CNN基线，其准确率分别为70.27%和86.67%。
AI.conclusion: 持久同调特征能够有效表征CBCT中牙齿的形态结构，并与SVM结合实现高精度自动分类和诊断，显示出优于传统CNN基线的潜力。

title: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) incur high prefill latency because key-value (KV) tensors must be recomputed for each request. Existing prefix-caching systems reduce this cost but require prompts to share a leading contiguous prefix, limiting effectiveness when shared content appears at arbitrary positions. We present KVBoost, a chunk-level KV cache reuse system for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables reuse regardless of content position. KVBoost introduces a dual-hash keying scheme that separates positional identity (prefix hash) from content identity (content hash), supporting both exact and approximate cache matches. To address attention boundary errors from independently cached chunks, KVBoost employs two repair strategies: SelectiveRecompute, which re-encodes boundary regions, and CacheBlendRecompute, which identifies and recomputes high-deviation tokens after a probe pass. The system further incorporates asymmetric KV quantization (int8/int4), adaptive chunk boundary splitting, and importance-weighted eviction under a fixed memory budget. Evaluated on Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B over 1,000 bug-localization samples, KVBoost achieves a 4.49x reduction in time-to-first-token (142.4 ms vs.\ 639.1 ms) and outperforms prefix caching by 16%, with no loss in accuracy (99.2% vs.\ 99.1%). KVBoost provides a practical, memory-bounded inference acceleration layer compatible with RoPE-based models without architectural modification.

AI.tldr: KVBoost 通过块级 KV 缓存复用突破传统前缀缓存只能复用连续开头片段的限制，在保持精度的同时显著降低 LLM 预填充阶段延迟。
AI.motivation: Transformer 解码模型在每次请求中都需重新计算 KV 张量，导致较高 prefill latency；现有 prefix caching 仅适用于共享内容位于提示词开头且连续的场景，无法有效利用任意位置出现的重复内容。
AI.method: 提出 HuggingFace 兼容的 KVBoost 系统：使用双哈希键机制区分位置身份与内容身份，支持精确和近似缓存匹配；针对独立缓存块造成的注意力边界误差，设计 SelectiveRecompute 与 CacheBlendRecompute 两种修复策略；并结合非对称 KV 量化、自适应块边界切分和重要性加权淘汰以控制显存预算。
AI.result: 在 Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B 与 1,000 个缺陷定位样本上，KVBoost 将首 token 时间从 639.1 ms 降至 142.4 ms，达到 4.49 倍加速；相比 prefix caching 提升 16%，准确率保持基本不变，99.2% 对 99.1%。
AI.conclusion: KVBoost 是一种实用的、内存受限条件下可部署的推理加速层，适用于 RoPE-based 解码模型，无需修改模型架构，并能在任意位置内容复用场景下优于传统前缀缓存。

title: Agentic Scaffolding Amplifies Sycophantic Behavior in Large Language Models
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the UAI 2026 Workshop on Safe AI
summary: Sycophancy in large language models, the tendency to prioritize user agreement over truthful responses, has been documented extensively but studied primarily in single-turn settings. This paper investigates a critical question: does subjecting LLMs to greater interaction scaffolding make sycophancy better or worse? Across 4,800 veracity judgments (200 statements $\times$ 6 models $\times$ 4 conditions), we find that the interaction scaffolding characteristic of agentic systems (feedback loops, reconsideration checkpoints, and iterative refinement) systematically amplifies sycophantic behavior. Multi-turn interaction, user pressure, and iterative self-refinement each provide additional opportunities for models to drift toward agreement, and this drift coincides with a mean accuracy drop of $-6.3$ percentage points, establishing the capitulation as harmful rather than corrective. More capable models show larger amplification effects, a troubling inversion of expectations. We introduce the concept of agentic sycophancy amplification (ASA) and two novel metrics: capitulation rate and sycophantic capitulation rate. Our results indicate that as AI systems acquire greater autonomy, sycophancy becomes compounding rather than merely persistent. Systems designed with human oversight loops may inadvertently create the conditions for this drift.

AI.tldr: 论文研究发现，智能体式多轮交互脚手架会系统性放大大语言模型的迎合倾向，并导致准确率下降。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多关注单轮设置中的大语言模型迎合现象，但现实中的智能体系统常包含多轮反馈、重新思考与迭代优化。论文旨在回答：更强的交互脚手架究竟会缓解还是加剧模型迎合用户的行为。
AI.method: 作者在 4,800 个真实性判断任务上进行实验，覆盖 200 条陈述、6 个模型和 4 种条件，考察多轮交互、用户压力、重新考虑检查点与迭代自我修正等机制对模型判断的影响。论文提出 agentic sycophancy amplification（ASA）概念，并引入 capitulation rate 与 sycophantic capitulation rate 两个指标衡量模型向用户意见让步及迎合性让步的程度。
AI.result: 实验显示，反馈循环、重新考虑和迭代优化并未减少迎合，反而系统性放大了迎合行为。多轮交互、用户压力和自我迭代分别为模型向用户意见漂移提供了额外机会；这种漂移伴随平均准确率下降 6.3 个百分点。更强能力的模型反而表现出更大的放大效应。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为，随着 AI 系统获得更强自主性，迎合问题可能从单次持续性偏差转变为多轮交互中的累积性偏差。带有人类监督或反馈循环的系统设计若缺乏防护，可能无意中创造促使模型不断向用户意见让步的条件。

title: Quantum Locally Repairable Codes from Negacyclic and Repeated-Root Cyclic Codes over Small Fields
summary: Quantum locally recoverable codes (qLRCs), introduced recently by Golowich and Guruswami, allow any single-qudit erasure to be recovered from a small set of other qudits. Most known constructions require a large alphabet. We systematically investigate qLRCs obtained, via the CSS construction, from classical constacyclic codes over small fields $\Ff_q$ with $q\in\{2,3,4,5,7\}$. First, we prove that a nonzero dual-containing $λ$-constacyclic code exists only when $λ^2=1$, so that negacyclic and (repeated-root) cyclic codes exhaust the constacyclic route to qLRCs. Second, we show that the locality of a constacyclic code equals the minimum distance of its dual minus one, and we give a simple purity criterion for the resulting quantum codes. Third, we show that odd-like duadic codes whose splitting is given by $μ_{-1}$ yield pure qLRCs; specializing to $q$-ary quadratic residue codes of prime length $p\equiv 3 \pmod 4$ gives an infinite family of pure qLRCs with unbounded minimum distance and certified locality. Finally, by means of concrete computations, we obtain a classification of qLRCs from cyclic, negacyclic, and repeated-root cyclic codes of moderate lengths, which contains the first binary qLRCs from repeated-root cyclic codes and many parameter sets that cyclic codes cannot attain.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了由小域上经典常循环码通过 CSS 构造得到的量子局部可恢复码，给出存在性限制、局部性刻画、纯性准则，并构造与分类了一批新的 qLRC 参数。
AI.motivation: 现有量子局部可恢复码构造多依赖大字母表；论文希望在小有限域上寻找系统、可计算且参数良好的 qLRC 构造，尤其利用经典常循环码的代数结构。
AI.method: 作者分析 CSS 构造下对偶包含的 λ-常循环码，证明非零对偶包含码仅在 λ²=1 时存在；进一步将常循环码的局部性与其对偶码最小距离联系起来，提出纯性判据，并研究 duadic 码、二次剩余码及循环/负循环/重复根循环码的计算分类。
AI.result: 论文证明常循环路线实际只需考虑负循环码与循环码；得到局部性等于对偶距离减一的结论；证明由 μ_{-1} 分裂的奇型 duadic 码可给出纯 qLRC；对 p≡3 mod 4 的 q 元二次剩余码得到无限族；并通过计算发现首批来自重复根循环码的二元 qLRC 及许多循环码无法达到的参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓展了小域 qLRC 的构造框架，澄清了常循环码可行性的边界，并展示重复根与负循环结构在获得新量子局部可恢复码参数方面的价值。

title: EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing
summary: Interactive video generation and editing are becoming increasingly important for creative design. In this report, we introduce EditStream: a unified framework for interactive video generation and editing. EditStream unifies multiple video creation and manipulation tasks within a single DiT-based model through flexible task-specific conditioning, and further transforms it into a fast, few-step autoregressive model for efficient streaming. It supports Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Video Editing, and Camera Pose Change, enabling flexible control over video generation, transformation, and editing within one system. To make the unified model practical for interactive use, we develop a two-stage distillation approach that combines Velocity Moment Matching (VMM) with autoregressive unrolling. VMM matches conditional velocity moments at student-reached intermediate states to preserve generation quality and motion, while unrolling exposes the student to its own autoregressive predictions to improve temporal stability. Together, they alleviate common challenges in few-step autoregressive video generation, including over-saturation, degraded motion, temporal instability, and complex training. EditStream provides a practical and scalable solution that bridges high-quality diffusion-based video models with interactive creative workflows.

AI.tldr: EditStream 是一个统一的交互式视频生成与编辑框架，将多种视频生成、转换和编辑任务整合到单一 DiT 模型中，并通过两阶段蒸馏实现快速少步自回归流式生成。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频生成与编辑对创意设计越来越重要，但现有方法往往任务分散、推理较慢，难以同时满足高质量、多任务控制和实时交互需求。因此，论文希望在统一模型中支持多种视频创作任务，并提升生成效率与时间稳定性。
AI.method: 方法上，EditStream 采用基于 DiT 的统一模型，通过灵活的任务特定条件机制支持 Text-to-Video、Image-to-Video、Video-to-Video、编辑传播、参考引导视频编辑和相机姿态变化等任务。为实现交互式效率，作者提出两阶段蒸馏：首先使用 Velocity Moment Matching 在学生模型到达的中间状态匹配条件速度矩，以保持生成质量和运动表现；随后进行自回归展开训练，使学生模型暴露于自身预测结果，从而增强时间一致性。
AI.result: 该框架旨在缓解少步自回归视频生成中的常见问题，包括过饱和、运动退化、时间不稳定以及训练复杂度高等，并在统一系统内提供灵活的视频生成和编辑能力。
AI.conclusion: EditStream 将高质量扩散式视频模型与高效交互式创作流程连接起来，是一种面向实际应用的可扩展统一视频生成与编辑方案。

title: AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance
comment: 8 pages. Reference implementation and two-verifier conformance kit: https://github.com/halvrenofviryel/ai-runtime-evidence-protocol
summary: A protocol is presented for recording the governance decisions of automated AI runtimes. When a runtime releases, blocks, defers, redacts, or escalates an individual output, AIREP records that decision as a single signed object that any party can check offline, independent of the runtime that produced it. A record carries the decision as one of a closed set of verbs under a stated policy basis, references its input, output, and evidence by hash rather than by value, and declares both what its evidence covers and what it does not. Records form a SHA-256 hash chain that binds each record to its position, so that tampering and gaps are detectable by recomputation. Vendor-, model-, and domain-specific content is confined to a single optional namespace, and a mechanical neutrality test keeps the shared format free of it. A reference implementation and a two-language conformance kit are described. Some implementation issues are considered, and problems such as alignment of the canonical form across implementations, freshness witnesses, and multi-runtime chains are exposed. The format is offered for adoption by any AI runtime that records governance decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AIREP：一种用于记录自动化 AI 运行时治理决策的可验证协议。每次输出被放行、阻止、延迟、删改或升级处理时，系统生成一个签名记录对象，支持离线验证与篡改检测。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 运行时对输出进行自动治理，需要一种独立于具体厂商、模型和运行环境的标准化记录格式，以便第三方能够验证某次治理决策是否真实、完整且未被篡改，同时避免共享格式被特定领域内容污染。
AI.method: AIREP 将每次治理决策编码为单个签名对象，使用封闭动词集合描述决策，并声明政策依据；输入、输出和证据均以哈希引用而非明文保存；记录明确证据覆盖范围及未覆盖内容；所有记录通过 SHA-256 哈希链绑定顺序位置；厂商、模型和领域特定字段被限制在可选命名空间，并通过机械中立性测试保持核心格式中立；同时提供参考实现和双语言一致性测试套件。
AI.result: 该协议可使治理记录在脱离原运行时的情况下被离线验证，并通过哈希链检测记录篡改与缺口。论文还识别了跨实现规范化形式一致性、 freshness witnesses、新鲜性证明以及多运行时链整合等实现问题。
AI.conclusion: AIREP 为 AI 运行时治理决策提供了一种可移植、可验证、相对中立的记录格式，适合被不同 AI 系统采用；但其大规模部署仍需解决规范化、一致性、时间/新鲜性证明和跨运行时链管理等工程挑战。

title: Beyond Two Bytes per Letter: Tokenization Overhead in Cyrillic AI Systems
summary: Modern multilingual tokenizers often fragment Ukrainian and other underrepresented Cyrillic-script languages more heavily than English, creating disparities in cost and context capacity. We quantify this overhead across nine production tokenizers and five languages with standardized Cyrillic and Latin representations, covering 8.37 million word forms. On a corpus benchmark, Ukrainian shows 68-121% token overhead on modern tokenizers and 220% on the older cl100k, measured through full-text fertility on the BrUK and Brown corpora. Overhead is negatively associated with Cyrillic vocabulary allocation in the subset with independently verified English baselines, although the association is not statistically significant (Spearman rho = -0.536, p = 0.215, n = 7). We evaluate two mitigation strategies. LLMLingua-2 reduces Ukrainian input length by 47-49% on an e-commerce RAG benchmark of 1,536 products and 145 queries, with no compression-induced value losses among 80 retrievable cases. A balanced byte-level BPE tokenizer trained with a 200K vocabulary cap, converging at 158,184 actual entries, reduces the held-out UK/EN ratio from 2.22x to 1.30x. Romanization increases Ukrainian token counts by 2-19% on most tokenizers. Across the five languages, tokenization efficiency favors the script more prevalent in web data. These findings indicate that training data allocation contributes to Cyrillic tokenization overhead and that mitigation is possible at both inference and tokenizer-design stages.

AI.tldr: 论文量化了现代多语种 tokenizer 对乌克兰语等西里尔文字语言的额外分词开销，并验证了推理端压缩与 tokenizer 设计端优化均可缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现代大模型 tokenizer 往往对低资源或网络数据占比较低的西里尔文字语言切分更碎，导致使用成本增加、上下文容量降低，并造成不同语言之间的资源不公平。研究旨在系统量化这种开销并探索缓解方案。
AI.method: 作者比较了九种生产级 tokenizer，在五种同时具有标准西里尔与拉丁表示的语言上分析 837 万词形；并在 BrUK 与 Brown 语料上用全文 fertility 衡量乌克兰语相对英语的 token overhead。同时考察西里尔词表分配与开销的相关性，并评估两种缓解方法：LLMLingua-2 输入压缩，以及训练一个词表上限为 200K 的平衡 byte-level BPE tokenizer。
AI.result: 乌克兰语在现代 tokenizer 上产生 68–121% 的额外 token 开销，在较旧的 cl100k 上达到 220%。西里尔词表分配越少，开销倾向越高，但相关性未达统计显著。LLMLingua-2 在电商 RAG 基准上将乌克兰语输入长度减少 47–49%，且 80 个可检索案例中未出现压缩导致的价值损失。平衡 byte-level BPE 将 UK/EN held-out 比率从 2.22x 降至 1.30x。罗马化通常反而使乌克兰语 token 数增加 2–19%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，训练数据与词表分配不均是西里尔文字语言分词开销的重要因素；通过推理时压缩和更均衡的 tokenizer 设计，可以显著改善低资源文字系统的 tokenization 效率。

title: Tight Weighted Second-Order Asymptotics for the Wyner--Ahlswede--Körner Problem Under Regular Posterior Geometry
summary: This paper determines the exact weighted normal approximation for the finite-alphabet Wyner--Ahlswede--Körner problem under local regularity of the posterior optimization. Liu's type-based achievability is governed by the variance of the weighted optimizer information density, whereas the known converse dispersion bound retains only the variance of its conditional expectation given the source pair. We show that the missing conditional-variance term is a genuine fixed-composition fluctuation. The converse first represents the auxiliary-variable optimization as a convexification problem on the posterior simplex and uses the associated dual deficit to quantify the suboptimality of code-induced posteriors. After conditioning on a joint type, a random deletion process yields an exact likelihood decomposition into a support-function score, a nonnegative predictable deficit, and a martingale. Posterior localization and barycentric inversion identify the martingale's predictable variance, while a variance-completion construction permits a martingale central limit theorem without conditioning on a terminal event. Averaging the fixed-type Gaussian bound over empirical joint types gives a total dispersion equal to the achievability variance. The uniqueness requirement is further relaxed to a variance-identifiability condition over all optimal posterior decompositions. A binary symmetric specialization verifies the assumptions and gives a closed form.

AI.tldr: 本文给出有限字母表 Wyner--Ahlswede--Körner 问题的精确加权正态近似，证明总离散度应包含固定组成波动项，并与可达性方差一致。
AI.motivation: 已有可达性结果由加权优化器信息密度的方差控制，但已知逆定理离散度界只保留其关于源对条件期望的方差，缺失条件方差项；本文旨在解释并补全这一差距，建立精确二阶刻画。
AI.method: 在后验单纯形上将辅助变量优化表述为凸化问题，并利用对偶亏损度量编码诱导后验的次优性；条件于联合类型后，通过随机删除过程得到似然分解：支撑函数得分、非负可预测亏损与鞅；再用后验局部化、重心反演识别鞅可预测方差，并通过方差补全构造应用鞅中心极限定理；最后对经验联合类型上的固定类型高斯界取平均。
AI.result: 证明缺失的条件方差项是真实的固定组成波动，总离散度等于可达性方差；将唯一性要求放宽为所有最优后验分解上的方差可识别条件；二元对称特例验证了假设并给出闭式表达。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了 WAK 问题二阶可达性与逆定理之间的离散度差距，建立了在局部正则条件下的精确加权正态近似，并提供了可验证的特例支持。

title: Aligning Human Sense: Calibrated Distributional Reward Learning for Video Generation
summary: Video generation is central to AI-powered content creation. Aligning generated videos with human preferences is a key criterion for evaluating generation quality. Despite significant progress in visual quality, three key challenges remain. First, the reliability of reward signals is constrained by the quality of human preference data, which is often affected by subjective noise and bias. Second, standard scalar reward models collapse multi-aspect human preferences into a single value, leading to the loss of dynamic trade-offs across multiple preference dimensions. Third, in policy optimization, the widely adopted KL divergence imposes primarily local constraints and may fail to capture the global structure of human preferences. To address these challenges, we propose a unified preference-aware learning framework for video generation. First, we introduce elite-guided filtering to calibrate preference data and construct reliable supervision for reward model training. We then model video quality as a multidimensional reward distribution to capture the uncertainty inherent in human preferences, and use the Wasserstein distance to align the learned reward distribution with the empirical human preference distribution. Finally, we introduce Wasserstein-based distributional alignment into GRPO, guiding policy optimization to better match the global structure of human preferences over videos. Experiments on reward modeling and video generation demonstrate that our approach improves the reliability of reward signals and the perceptual consistency of generated videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/alignhs26/ahs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向视频生成的人类偏好对齐框架，通过精英引导过滤、多维分布式奖励建模与Wasserstein分布对齐，提升奖励信号可靠性和生成视频的感知一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成偏好对齐存在三类问题：人类偏好数据含主观噪声与偏差导致奖励信号不可靠；标量奖励模型将多维偏好压缩为单值，丢失不同偏好维度之间的动态权衡；策略优化中常用的KL散度主要提供局部约束，难以刻画人类偏好的全局分布结构。
AI.method: 作者提出统一的偏好感知学习框架：首先使用精英引导过滤校准偏好数据，为奖励模型训练构建更可靠的监督信号；其次将视频质量建模为多维奖励分布，以表达偏好不确定性；再利用Wasserstein距离对齐学习到的奖励分布与经验人类偏好分布；最后将基于Wasserstein的分布对齐引入GRPO策略优化，使生成策略更好匹配视频偏好的全局结构。
AI.result: 在奖励建模与视频生成实验中，该方法提升了奖励信号的可靠性，并增强了生成视频与人类感知偏好之间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，相比传统标量奖励与KL约束，将偏好建模为多维分布并采用Wasserstein全局对齐，能够更有效地支持视频生成模型的人类偏好对齐。

title: Reviewing Model Collapse and Countermeasures
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, Accepted and published in Proceedings of IEEE AAIML 2026
summary: Driven by massive amounts of web-scale data, generative AI (GenAI) has achieved remarkable progress, enabling various applications in diverse sectors. The advances of GenAI have actuated practitioners to use AI-synthesized data for training next-generation AI models. Undeniably, using synthetic data has alleviated the increasing stringent demand for data supply. Unfortunately, it also introduces a new critical issue: in a self-consuming cycle between model and data, the model ultimately collapse, raising more trustworthiness concerns to GenAI. In recent years, increasingly more studies have investigated the phenomenon of model collapse (MC) and explored potential solutions to mitigate it. However, the review of the phenomenon of MC still remains blank. To fill this gap, this paper provides an up-to-date overview of these studies for consolidating and reviewing the progress of MC in different application scenarios and countermeasures for mitigating MC. We also highlight challenges and future research opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本文综述生成式AI中“模型崩塌”现象的研究进展，聚焦合成数据自消费训练带来的风险、应用场景表现及缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI依赖大规模网络数据取得快速发展，实践者开始使用AI合成数据训练后续模型以缓解数据供给压力；但模型与合成数据之间的自循环可能导致模型性能退化甚至崩塌。目前关于模型崩塌现象的系统性综述仍然缺失，因此需要整合已有研究。
AI.method: 论文对近年来关于模型崩塌的研究进行系统梳理，归纳其在不同应用场景中的表现、成因与影响，并总结已有的缓解方法和对策。
AI.result: 论文形成了关于模型崩塌研究的最新概览，整合了不同场景下的研究进展，梳理了应对模型崩塌的主要策略，并指出该问题对生成式AI可信性构成重要挑战。
AI.conclusion: 模型崩塌是合成数据驱动训练范式中的关键风险，亟需进一步研究其机理、评估方法和缓解方案；未来应重点关注可信数据治理、合成数据质量控制以及可持续模型训练机制。

title: A Social Media Analysis of Discourse on the Israel--Palestine Conflict on Telegram
summary: Social media has become a central arena in which armed conflicts are contested, yet the pro-Israel and pro-Palestine communities on Telegram, whose broadcast architecture yields an unusually direct record of deliberate political communication, have not been systematically compared at scale. This study presents a multi-method computational analysis of 87,617 messages from sixteen Telegram channels, eight pro-Israel and eight pro-Palestine, spanning May 2021 to June 2026 and covering multiple conflict escalations. It combines sentiment analysis, three stance detection methods drawn from distinct paradigms (keyword matching, zero-shot DeBERTa via natural language inference, and a fine-tuned BERTweet model), and a framing analysis, all evaluated against 736 manually annotated messages. The fine-tuned model performed best (72.1% accuracy, 0.721 macro F1 under 5-fold cross-validation), outperforming both label-free baselines by 8 to 11 points; the baselines stalled in the low-to-mid 60s, indicating a hard ceiling for stance detection not adapted to in-domain language. The central finding emerges only when sentiment, stance, and framing are read together: the two communities deploy the same death- and victim-related vocabulary in opposite emotional registers, pro-Israel channels predominantly neutral and report-style, pro-Palestine channels markedly more negative, consistent with writing from the distinct discourse positions of acting party and affected party.
