title: Optimal Condition Numbers in Low-Rank Positive Semidefinite Matrix Sensing
summary: In this paper we focus on the stability of positive semidefinite matrix sensing maps $Φ_{\mathcal{A}}(X)=(\langle A_i,X\rangle)_{i=1}^m$ where $A_i\succeq 0$, $X\succeq0$ and $\operatorname{rank}(X)\le r$. We introduce the bi-Lipschitz constants of $Φ_{\mathcal{A}}(X)$ and define the global condition numbers as the ratio of upper and lower Lipschitz constants. We give deterministic universal lower bounds for these condition numbers, that depend only on the rank $r$ and on the underlying field. We then investigate the random rank-one Gaussian measurements and show that our lower bounds on condition numbers are asymptotically sharp, and therefore the random rank-one Gaussian measurements are asymptotically optimal. As an application, we derive the stability guarantees for an $\ell_1$-residual PhaseLift-type estimator at the optimal sampling scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究正半定矩阵感知映射的稳定性，提出双 Lipschitz 常数与全局条件数，并证明确定性下界；随机秩一高斯测量渐近达到该下界，从而在条件数意义下渐近最优，并用于推导最优采样尺度下 PhaseLift 类估计器的稳定性保证。
AI.motivation: 低秩正半定矩阵恢复与相位恢复等问题依赖测量映射的稳定性。已有研究关注采样复杂度和恢复算法，但对正半定测量映射在全局双 Lipschitz 稳定性意义下的内在条件数极限及最优性刻画仍需明确。
AI.method: 作者定义正半定矩阵感知映射在秩不超过 r 的正半定矩阵集合上的上下 Lipschitz 常数，并以二者比值定义全局条件数；随后建立只依赖秩 r 和底层数域的确定性通用下界；进一步分析随机秩一高斯测量模型，证明其条件数下界渐近紧致；最后将该稳定性框架应用于 ℓ1 残差 PhaseLift 型估计器。
AI.result: 论文得到正半定矩阵感知映射全局条件数的普适下界，并证明随机秩一高斯测量在渐近意义下达到这些下界，因此在该稳定性指标下是渐近最优的。同时，在最优采样尺度下给出了 ℓ1 残差 PhaseLift 型估计器的稳定恢复保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从条件数和双 Lipschitz 稳定性的角度揭示了正半定低秩矩阵感知的基本极限，说明随机秩一高斯测量不仅采样有效，而且在稳定性上具有渐近最优性，并为相位恢复类方法提供理论支撑。

title: AI Visual Inspection for Garment Production
summary:
The garment manufacturing industry is under increasing pressure to improve product quality, reduce costs, and accelerate digital transformation toward Industry 4.0. One of the most challenging quality-control activities is sewing-line inspection, where defects such as broken stitches and skipped stitches are difficult to detect consistently through manual inspection. Human-based inspection is often affected by fatigue, subjective judgement, and inconsistent performance, resulting in defect leakage, rework, and reduced production efficiency.
  This study presents the development and validation of an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based visual inspection system for garment sewing-line quality control. The system utilizes Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect sewing defects and was initially trained using black fabric and black sewing thread samples. Experimental testing was conducted on black, red, dark green, light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow fabrics. The results demonstrated successful detection of jump sewing-line defects on black, red, and dark green materials, while performance limitations were observed for broken sewing-line defects and fabrics with significantly different visual characteristics, including light blue, silver, and fluorescent yellow colours. These findings indicate that model accuracy is strongly influenced by the diversity of training data and the ability to generalize across different fabric and thread colours.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并验证了一种基于CNN的服装缝纫线视觉缺陷检测系统，用于提升缝纫线质检的自动化与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 服装制造业面临提升质量、降低成本和推进工业4.0转型的压力；传统人工缝纫线检测易受疲劳、主观判断和一致性不足影响，导致漏检、返工和效率下降。
AI.method: 研究构建AI视觉检测系统，采用卷积神经网络识别缝纫缺陷；模型初始训练数据来自黑色面料与黑色缝线样本，并在黑色、红色、深绿色、浅蓝色、银色和荧光黄色面料上进行实验测试。
AI.result: 系统能较好检测黑色、红色和深绿色材料上的跳线类缺陷；但对断线类缺陷以及视觉特征差异较大的浅蓝色、银色和荧光黄色面料表现受限。
AI.conclusion: 模型性能高度依赖训练数据的多样性；若要实现跨面料、跨颜色的稳定泛化，需要扩充训练样本并增强模型对不同织物和线色视觉特征的适应能力。

title: AI Learning and Conceptual Transfer in the Game of Hidden Rules
summary: This report summarizes the work conducted on the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR), focusing on reinforcement learning agents trained to infer hidden rules from trial-and-error feedback, representation design, rule difficulty analysis, transfer learning, generalization, and pseudo-bot-assisted human learning analysis. The report focuses on the Transformer-based A2C framework, Feature-Centric and Object-Centric representations, experimental findings, and classification of human learning data.

AI.tldr: 该报告研究“隐藏规则游戏”中的强化学习智能体如何通过试错反馈推断规则，并分析表示设计、规则难度、迁移泛化及人类学习数据分类。
AI.motivation: 探索智能体在仅有反馈信息的环境中学习和推断隐藏规则的能力，同时利用计算模型辅助理解人类学习过程。
AI.method: 采用基于 Transformer 的 A2C 强化学习框架，比较 Feature-Centric 与 Object-Centric 表示；进行规则难度分析、迁移学习与泛化实验，并用伪机器人辅助分析人类学习数据。
AI.result: 摘要表明报告总结了多类实验发现，包括不同表示方式对学习效果的影响、规则难度差异、迁移与泛化表现，以及对人类学习数据的分类结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将强化学习、表示学习和人类行为分析结合起来，为研究隐藏规则推断和人机学习机制提供了系统性实验框架。

title: Mitigating Bias in Large Vision-Language Models via Counterfactual Ensemble Decoding
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks; however, they often inherit social biases from their training data, resulting in biased behavior when processing portraits from different social groups. Existing debiasing approaches typically compare token probabilities between the original and biased generations during decoding, but they are fundamentally limited by their reliance on a single, stereotyped viewpoint and fail to account for the diversity of social perspectives. Inspired by the social science principle that diversity fosters fairness, we propose Counterfactual Ensemble Decoding (CED), a novel framework that constructs multi-group counterfactual perspectives within the visual representation space and integrates them during decoding to promote equitable model behavior. CED first performs counterfactual steering in the visual space by identifying semantic directions associated with each social group and generating counterfactual representations along these directions, thereby offering diverse perspectives that disrupt stereotypical narratives. During decoding, CED locates the decoder layer exhibiting the greatest divergence among these perspectives and ensembles their token distributions using uncertainty-aware weights, prioritizing high-confidence tokens from different groups to yield a more balanced probability distribution that guides fairer generation. Extensive experiments on three social bias evaluation benchmarks demonstrate that \tool achieves substantial improvements over leading baselines, reducing bias by up to 47.97% across scenarios involving occupations, descriptors, and persona traits. Moreover, CED also preserves the core capabilities of the original model with minimal degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Counterfactual Ensemble Decoding（CED），通过在视觉表示空间构造多群体反事实视角并在解码时集成其分布，以降低大型视觉语言模型在肖像相关任务中的社会偏见，同时尽量保持原模型能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 虽表现优异，但会继承训练数据中的社会偏见；既有去偏方法多依赖单一刻板视角下原始生成与偏置生成的 token 概率比较，难以覆盖多样化社会视角，因此公平性改进受限。
AI.method: CED 首先在视觉空间中识别与不同社会群体相关的语义方向，并沿这些方向生成多组反事实视觉表示；随后在解码过程中定位不同反事实视角之间分歧最大的解码层，并使用不确定性感知权重对各视角 token 分布进行集成，优先融合高置信度 token，形成更均衡的生成概率分布。
AI.result: 在三个社会偏见评测基准上，CED 相比领先基线取得显著改进，在职业、描述词和人格特质等场景中最高可降低 47.97% 的偏见，同时对原模型核心能力仅造成轻微退化。
AI.conclusion: CED 表明，在视觉表示空间引入多群体反事实视角并进行不确定性感知集成，是缓解 LVLM 社会偏见的一种有效且相对低损的解码阶段方法。

title: Secure Wireless Information Transfer and Energy Harvesting in HAPS-Based Network
summary: High-altitude platform station (HAPS) serves as a promising enabler for wide-area connectivity of low-power wireless devices, particularly in remote and underserved regions. However, the strong line-of-sight characteristics of HAPS links increase the risk of eavesdropping, while the limited energy budget of ground devices remains a major operational constraint. In this work, we propose a secure wireless information and energy harvesting framework for HAPS-based networks in the presence of spatially distributed eavesdroppers. The proposed system integrates friendly jamming and power transfer nodes equipped with null-steering capability antennas, such that they not only degrade the reception quality at eavesdroppers but also act as additional radio-frequency energy sources for legitimate users. A time-switching wireless information and power transfer architecture is adopted at the user side. Under this framework, we derive tractable expressions for the joint rate-energy coverage and the average secrecy rate using stochastic geometry tools. Numerical and Monte Carlo results validate the developed analysis and reveal key design trade-offs among the time allocation factor, null-steering-zone radius around each user, and jammer transmit power. In particular, the results show that properly coordinated null-steering jamming can simultaneously support secure communication and adequate wireless power transfer, while an appropriate choice of system parameters, such as time allocation factor and jamming power, is required to balance harvested energy, communication reliability, and secrecy performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向高空平台站（HAPS）网络的安全信息传输与无线能量采集框架，通过协同友好干扰、能量传输和零陷波束控制，在存在空间分布窃听者的场景下提升保密性能并保障低功耗用户能量供给。
AI.motivation: HAPS 可为偏远或覆盖不足区域的低功耗无线设备提供广域连接，但其强视距链路容易被窃听，同时地面设备能量受限，因而需要同时兼顾通信安全、可靠性与能量可持续性的设计。
AI.method: 提出集成友好干扰与功率传输节点的安全无线信息与能量采集框架；这些节点配备具备零陷控制能力的天线，在削弱窃听者接收质量的同时为合法用户提供射频能量。用户侧采用时间切换式无线信息与能量传输架构，并利用随机几何推导联合速率-能量覆盖概率和平均保密速率的可处理表达式。
AI.result: 数值分析和蒙特卡洛仿真验证了理论推导，并揭示了时间分配因子、用户周围零陷区域半径以及干扰发射功率之间的关键权衡。结果表明，合理协调的零陷友好干扰可同时支持安全通信和充分的无线能量传输。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明，在 HAPS 网络中通过联合设计友好干扰、能量传输、零陷区域和时间切换参数，可以在采集能量、通信可靠性与保密性能之间取得平衡，为低功耗广域安全连接提供有效方案。

title: Few-Shot Cross-Dataset Adaptation for Tuberculosis Detection Using DenseNet
summary: Tuberculosis (TB) is one of the most common and dangerous bacterial ailments. Every year, it causes a large number of deaths worldwide. Although many deep learning models can detect tuberculosis from chest X-rays quite accurately, severe domain shift across datasets makes the task challenging. Different imaging protocols, patient demographics, and equipment across domains make the task of generalization difficult. In real-world settings, a model may perform well on one dataset but show a noticeable drop in performance when tested on another. In this work, we address this domain adaptation challenge through a few-shot scaling study. A controlled cross-dataset evaluation is presented in this paper using TBX11K as the source domain and the Mendeley TB dataset as the target domain. It is investigated how varying the number of target samples affects model performance under three training regimes: frozen backbone adaptation, full fine-tuning of a source-pretrained DenseNet121 model, and training from scratch. The results indicate that the model can perform well even with limited data and can achieve 98.36\% accuracy with just 75 labeled samples per class. The adaptation curves demonstrate how fine-tuning effectively mitigates domain shift. These findings establish full fine-tuning of pretrained models as a highly effective and practical strategy for mitigating domain shift in low-resource clinical deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文研究胸部X光结核病检测中的跨数据集域偏移问题，发现少量目标域标注样本结合源域预训练模型全量微调即可显著恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在单一胸片数据集上表现较好，但由于成像协议、设备和人群差异，跨数据集泛化性能下降；临床低资源场景需要一种仅依赖少量目标域标注样本的实用适配策略。
AI.method: 以TBX11K为源域、Mendeley TB数据集为目标域，进行受控跨数据集评估；比较三种训练策略：冻结骨干网络适配、对源域预训练DenseNet121进行全量微调、以及从零训练，并系统改变每类目标域样本数量以绘制few-shot scaling曲线。
AI.result: 实验显示，即使目标域标注数据有限，模型也能取得较好表现；使用每类75个标注样本时准确率达到98.36%。适配曲线表明全量微调能有效缓解域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 源域预训练模型的全量微调是一种高效且实用的低资源临床部署策略，可在少量目标域标注数据下改善结核病胸片检测的跨域泛化能力。

title: LitReview Arena: Evaluating Literature Review Agents with Battle-Style Peer Review Platform
summary: Literature reviews are essential to scientific progress, but rigorously evaluating automatically generated reviews remains difficult because many aspects of research utility depend on expert judgment rather than reference-overlap metrics. We introduce LitReview Arena, a battle-style evaluation platform with a structured protocol tailored to literature review quality: domain experts with AI paper-writing experience compare anonymized drafts, are matched to topics within their expertise, and provide dimension-wise outcomes over five literature-review-specific criteria. From this protocol, we collect approximately 3k expert judgments, each containing five dimension-wise outcomes, and show that even the strongest current systems win only 23.0% of decisive matches against human drafts on overall utility, while agentic LLMs such as Sonar Deep Research substantially outperform base language models by over 60%. We further find that existing LLM-as-a-judge methods are substantially misaligned with human experts (Spearman's rho=0.467), especially on synthesis-heavy criteria such as paper structure and research suggestions. Using the collected preference data, we provide an expert-calibrated evaluator, LitJudge, which improves alignment to Spearman's rho=0.78, comparable to inter-expert consistency; code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/VanellopeAsher/LitReview-Arena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LitReview Arena，用专家对战式评测来评估自动生成文献综述，并基于约 3k 条专家偏好数据训练/校准 LitJudge，使其与专家判断显著更一致。
AI.motivation: 自动生成文献综述的质量难以用传统参考重叠指标衡量，因为综述的研究价值、结构组织、综合能力和研究建议等高度依赖领域专家判断。现有 LLM-as-a-judge 方法与专家评价存在明显不一致。
AI.method: 构建 LitReview Arena：由具备 AI 论文写作经验的领域专家，在其专业主题内对匿名综述草稿进行成对比较，并按五个文献综述专属维度给出结果；收集约 3k 条专家判断。进一步利用这些偏好数据训练/校准专家对齐评估器 LitJudge。
AI.result: 当前最强系统在总体效用上对人类草稿的决定性对局胜率仅为 23.0%；Sonar Deep Research 等 agentic LLM 相比基础语言模型性能提升超过 60%；现有 LLM 评审与专家一致性较低，Spearman’s rho=0.467，尤其在结构和研究建议等综合性维度上偏差明显；LitJudge 将一致性提升至 rho=0.78，接近专家间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，高质量文献综述评测需要专家校准的、维度化的偏好评估协议；当前自动综述系统仍显著落后于人类，但 agentic 方法更具潜力。LitReview Arena 和 LitJudge 为后续自动文献综述系统的评测与改进提供了公开基准和工具。

title: Agentic Security: A Systematization of Tools, Failure Modes, and Design Laws for LLM-Driven Penetration Testing
summary: Agentic security uses large-language-model (LLM) agents to plan, dispatch, and interpret security tools. As these systems move from demonstrations to deployed products, practitioners repeatedly encounter the same operational failures. We systematize these failures through a hands-on evaluation of ten widely used static, dynamic, cloud, orchestration, and AI red-teaming tools for unattended pipelines. We introduce a four-dimensional Integration Friction Index that separates one-time engineering cost from recurring organisational, legal, and maintenance cost. We then derive quantitative regularities that explain recurring failure modes. Modelling an agentic security system as stochastic LLM policies wrapped by a deterministic mediator, we show that long-lived sessions lose resident evidence with phase count, while short-lived sub-agents extend the usable horizon according to the compression ratio between raw evidence and its summary. We show that a two-stage verdict cascade multiplies scorer likelihood ratios, but provides little benefit when scorer errors correlate. We show that treating unevaluable outcomes as attack failures biases downstream measurements toward evasive and severe responses. We formulate planner-versus-worker model routing as a knapsack problem and derive a closed-form execution cap for heavy-tailed tools, eta* = alpha v/c. Finally, we show why scope and budget enforcement cannot be delegated to system prompts: prompts do not constrain what actually executes. Inspectra, our implemented platform, serves as a worked instantiation, with mechanisms labelled shipped, partial, or planned, including those that did not work.

AI.tldr: 本文系统化分析了LLM代理式安全系统在无人值守工具流水线中的集成与运行失败模式，并提出度量框架、理论模型与平台实现。
AI.motivation: 随着基于大语言模型的安全代理从演示走向真实部署，实践者反复遇到工具集成、证据保持、评分可靠性、结果偏差、模型路由和执行约束等操作性问题；论文旨在将这些经验性失败模式形式化、量化并给出工程指导。
AI.method: 作者对十类常用静态、动态、云、编排和AI安全评测工具进行实操评估，提出四维Integration Friction Index区分一次性工程成本与持续组织、法律和维护成本；同时将代理式安全系统建模为随机LLM策略与确定性中介器的组合，推导会话证据丢失、子代理摘要压缩、两阶段裁决级联、不可评估结果偏差、规划器/执行器模型路由背包问题及重尾工具执行上限等规律。
AI.result: 论文得到多项定量规律：长会话会随阶段数丢失常驻证据，短生命周期子代理可按原始证据与摘要压缩比扩展可用范围；两阶段评分器在误差独立时可放大似然比，但误差相关时收益有限；将不可评估结果视为失败会使测量偏向规避性和严重响应；模型路由可表述为背包优化；重尾工具存在闭式执行上限 eta* = alpha v/c；单靠系统提示无法保证范围和预算约束。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献在于把代理式安全系统的常见部署故障从零散经验转化为可度量、可建模、可实现的工程原则。Inspectra平台作为实例展示了已实现、部分实现和计划机制，也报告了无效机制，强调可靠部署需要确定性执行约束、明确的工具治理和量化的成本/收益建模，而不能依赖提示词约束。

title: Average-Radius List-Decodability of Random Linear Codes
summary: We prove that for every prime power $q$ and every $p \in (0, 1-1/q)$, a random $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear code of rate $1 - h_q(p) - ε$ is $(p, C_{p,q}/ε)$-average-radius list-decodable with probability at least $1 - q^{-Ω(n)}$, i.e., for every center $y \in \mathbb{F}_q^n$, the $C_{p,q}/ε$ codewords closest to $y$ have average fractional Hamming distance at least $p$ from $y$. This extends a similar result for (standard) list-decoding due to Guruswami, Håstad, and Kopparty (2010) to the stronger average-radius guarantee, with the same $O(1/ε)$ list size. For average-radius list-decoding, such a result was previously known only for binary linear codes (Guruswami, Li, Mosheiff, Resch, Silas, and Wootters, 2021) and for general (non-linear) random codes over arbitrary alphabets (Elias, 1991).

AI.tldr: 本文证明随机有限域线性码在接近 q 元熵界的码率下，以高概率满足平均半径列表译码，且列表大小为 O(1/ε)。
AI.motivation: 已有随机线性码的标准列表译码结果可达到 O(1/ε) 列表大小，但更强的平均半径列表译码保证此前仅在二元线性码或一般非线性随机码中已知；本文旨在推广到任意素数幂 q 的线性码。
AI.method: 研究随机 F_q-线性码，在码率设为 1-h_q(p)-ε、误差半径 p∈(0,1-1/q) 的条件下，证明对任意中心 y，距离 y 最近的 C_{p,q}/ε 个码字的平均相对汉明距离至少为 p，并给出高概率界。
AI.result: 对每个素数幂 q 和合法 p，随机 F_q-线性码以至少 1-q^{-Ω(n)} 的概率是 (p, C_{p,q}/ε)-平均半径列表可译码的，达到与标准列表译码相同的 O(1/ε) 列表大小。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将随机线性码的强平均半径列表译码保证从二元情形扩展到任意有限域字母表，表明随机线性码在接近列表译码容量处仍具备最优量级的列表大小。

title: Measuring Gender Representation in Animated Films
summary: Animated films--often developed with an audience of children in mind--are an important vector for enculturation, and empirical work that has examined the representation of gender at scale in these films has largely focused on counting the gender composition of the cast rather than deploying a more fine-grained instrument (such as assessing the visibility of those characters in overall screentime). In this work, we develop a computational pipeline for recognizing animated characters in these films, and use it to test several hypotheses about gender representation in a corpus of 224 popular animated movies. We find that while the overall representation of female characters in animated films largely tracks with those of live-action films (over the period 1980-2025), we see stark differences between the representation of human characters (much greater representation among women and girls) and non-humans (largely male). Contrary to past work on Disney, we do not see female characters declining in antagonist roles in animated films, and characters who are women and girls are much more likely to share scenes together than their live action contemporaneous counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建动画角色识别的计算流程，用于大规模衡量224部热门动画电影中的性别呈现，发现女性角色总体比例接近真人电影，但在人类与非人类角色、反派角色及女性角色同场互动方面呈现出动画电影特有差异。
AI.motivation: 既有关于动画电影性别呈现的实证研究多集中于统计演员/角色性别构成，缺少对角色可见度（如总体银幕时间）等更细粒度指标的规模化分析；而动画电影面向儿童并具有文化社会化影响，因此需要更精细、可扩展的测量方法。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个用于识别动画电影角色的计算管线，并将其应用于224部热门动画电影语料，围绕1980—2025年间性别呈现、角色类型（人类/非人类）、反派角色以及女性角色共同出现场景等假设进行检验。
AI.result: 研究发现：动画电影中女性角色总体呈现趋势大体与同期真人电影相近；人类角色中女性/女孩代表性更高，而非人类角色显著偏男性；与部分既有迪士尼研究不同，女性反派角色并未呈下降趋势；女性/女孩角色之间共同出现场景的概率高于同期真人电影。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，动画电影的性别呈现不能仅通过总体角色比例理解，角色可见度、角色类型与互动结构揭示了更复杂的表征模式；计算化角色识别为动画电影文化表征研究提供了可扩展工具。

title: SchemaRouter: Field-Aware Tool Routing for Efficient Heterogeneous Agentic RAG
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, benchmark, and fixtures: https://github.com/JDeun/SchemaRouter_research
summary:
Heterogeneous agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly orchestrate external APIs, internal databases, vector stores, and graph stores. Exposing all tool descriptions to an LLM agent, or selecting tools only by vector similarity, causes two costly failures: over-fetching, which increases payload size, token use, and latency, and under-fetching, which omits fields needed to answer the query.
  We present SchemaRouter, a lightweight routing layer that represents tools, endpoints, parameters, response fields, domain concepts, units, provenance, and license policies as a schema graph. Given a query, SchemaRouter emits an executable tool plan specifying which tools to call and which fields to retrieve. A small LLM extracts intent, concepts, and source constraints, while field selection is deterministic over the graph through intent-group projection and concept-field matching with an alias layer.
  On a materials-science benchmark of 110 queries, SchemaRouter achieves answer accuracy of 0.71, matching fetch-everything within overlapping confidence intervals and exceeding prompt-all's 0.66, though their intervals overlap. It uses 227 retrieved-context tokens versus 2,066 for fetch-everything and achieves 2.7x lower end-to-end latency than prompt-all. It also obtains the best tool-exact rate of 0.93 and parameter validity of 1.0. SchemaRouter grounds provenance and license information in 62 percent of answers, compared with approximately 0 percent for all baselines.
  We also find that minimizing selected-field count is counterproductive: it reduces answer accuracy to 0.56 with negligible token savings, while recall-preserving projection restores top accuracy. SchemaRouter improves efficiency, schema-size-independent scaling, and verifiable provenance/license-grounded answering at competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: SchemaRouter 是一种面向异构 agentic RAG 系统的轻量级路由层，通过模式图进行工具规划与字段选择，在保持竞争性答案准确率的同时显著降低检索 token 与延迟，并增强来源与许可信息可验证性。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 代理若向 LLM 暴露全部工具描述，或仅基于向量相似度选择工具，容易出现过度获取与获取不足：前者增加上下文负载、token 成本和延迟，后者遗漏回答所需字段，影响准确性与可靠性。
AI.method: 论文提出 SchemaRouter，将工具、端点、参数、响应字段、领域概念、单位、来源与许可策略表示为 schema graph。查询到来时，小型 LLM 负责抽取意图、概念和来源约束；随后通过意图组投影、概念—字段匹配和别名层，在图上确定性选择工具、参数和字段，输出可执行工具计划。
AI.result: 在 110 个材料科学查询基准上，SchemaRouter 答案准确率为 0.71，与 fetch-everything 在重叠置信区间内相当，高于 prompt-all 的 0.66但置信区间重叠；检索上下文仅 227 tokens，而 fetch-everything 为 2,066；端到端延迟比 prompt-all 降低 2.7 倍；tool-exact 达 0.93，参数有效性为 1.0；62% 答案包含来源与许可依据，基线约为 0%。此外，单纯最小化字段数会使准确率降至 0.56，且 token 节省很小。
AI.conclusion: SchemaRouter 表明，基于 schema graph 的召回保持型字段投影比简单字段最小化更有效，可在不显著牺牲准确率的前提下提升 RAG 工具调用效率、降低延迟，并支持随 schema 规模扩展的路由与可验证的来源/许可约束回答。

title: CyrillicQA: The Influence of Phonetically Encoded Secret Language on LLM Performance
comment: 4 pages, in English; 4 pages, in German (original); German version originally published in: Rüdian, S. (2026). Prompt-Engineering in Education (1st ed., pp. 39-42). Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21413892
summary: Due to the selection of their training data, large language models (LLMs) perform best on standard-language inputs from languages using the Latin alphabet with large speaker populations, while disadvantaging other language varieties. Nevertheless, they can also be a versatile tool for preserving precisely such endangered languages. But do they also possess the necessary creativity and capacity for abstraction to decode phonetically encoded language the same way humans do?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨大型语言模型是否具备像人类一样解码语音化编码语言的抽象与创造能力，尤其关注其在弱势或濒危语言保护中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 由于训练数据选择偏向使用拉丁字母、标准语体且使用人口较多的语言，大型语言模型在其他语言变体上的表现较弱；但这些模型也可能成为保护濒危语言的工具，因此需要评估其是否能处理非标准、语音化编码的语言输入。
AI.method: 摘要未给出具体实验方法，但研究问题暗示可能通过向大型语言模型提供语音化编码文本，并考察其解码、理解或还原能力，与人类处理类似输入的能力进行比较。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅提出核心问题：大型语言模型是否具备足够的创造性和抽象能力来解码语音编码语言。
AI.conclusion: 从摘要看，论文旨在评估大型语言模型在非标准语言输入和濒危语言保护场景中的能力边界，尤其是其对语音编码语言的泛化、抽象和创造性处理能力。

title: Soft GRAND under Channel Switching and Drift
summary: Under channel switching or drift, the posterior used to order soft GRAND queries can differ from the matched correction posterior, which can increase rank and finite-budget decoding error. We bound log query rank by matched posterior self-information plus positive log-posterior mismatch; exact random-subset collision probabilities yield GRANDAB error bounds. For switching among memoryless channels with capacity-achieving uniform input, a state-path mixture yields vanishing error uniformly over admissible paths below the minimum constituent capacity when log path-class size is sublinear. For drift, pilot refresh bounds mismatch and yields the continuous minimizer of a tracking upper bound. Generalized-Gaussian BPSK experiments evaluate both.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在信道切换或漂移导致软 GRAND 查询排序所用后验与匹配纠错后验不一致时的有限预算译码性能，并给出秩与误差界。
AI.motivation: 软 GRAND 依赖后验概率对噪声/查询进行排序；当信道发生切换或漂移时，排序后验与真实匹配后验可能失配，从而提高查询秩并增大有限预算译码错误率。论文旨在刻画这种后验失配对译码复杂度和可靠性的影响，并设计可保证性能的处理方式。
AI.method: 作者将对数查询秩上界分解为匹配后验自信息与正的对数后验失配项；利用精确随机子集碰撞概率推导 GRANDAB 误差界；针对在多个无记忆信道间切换且均匀输入容量可达的场景，构造状态路径混合模型；针对漂移场景，通过导频刷新控制后验失配，并优化跟踪上界。
AI.result: 在路径类别大小对数为次线性增长时，状态路径混合方法可在低于最小组成信道容量的速率下，对所有允许状态路径实现一致的消失误差；漂移场景中，导频刷新给出失配控制并得到跟踪上界的连续最小化解；广义高斯 BPSK 实验验证了相关界和方法。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明后验失配可被显式纳入软 GRAND 的秩与误差分析；通过路径混合和导频刷新，可在信道切换与漂移下保持可证明的可靠性与有限预算性能。

title: Boosting Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering with Structured Context Reasoning
comment: Accepted by ICME 2026. Source code is available at https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/SCoRe
summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering aims to answer questions about an image by integrating external knowledge with visual and textual information. Recent approaches often rely on in-context learning to prompt Large Language Models (LLMs) with multimodal context in a zero-shot or few-shot manner. However, we observe that directly concatenating heterogeneous visual descriptions and retrieved knowledge into long, unstructured prompts often degrades reasoning performance, due to both excessive irrelevant context and the lack of explicit relational structure. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based Structured Context Reasoning (SCoRe) framework that infers both explicit and implicit relationships for prediction. SCoRe consists of three stages: Context Acquisition, which generates diverse visual notes and retrieves explicit knowledge via an efficient two-stage multimodal retrieval strategy; Context Selection, which filters relevant visual, explicit, and implicit knowledge using LLM-guided selection; and Context Compression, which performs Relational Logic Distillation (RLD) to transform raw text into explicit entity-relation triplets. These relational triplets serve as a concise and structured prompt for final answer prediction. Extensive experiments on the OK-VQA and A-OKVQA benchmarks demonstrate that SCoRe consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCoRe：将视觉描述与外部知识筛选、压缩为结构化实体-关系三元组，以提升知识型视觉问答推理效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于上下文学习的方法常把异构视觉描述和检索知识直接拼接成长提示，导致无关信息过多、关系结构不清晰，从而削弱大语言模型的推理能力。
AI.method: SCoRe 包含三阶段：上下文获取，生成多样视觉笔记并通过两阶段多模态检索获得显式知识；上下文选择，利用 LLM 筛选相关视觉、显式与隐式知识；上下文压缩，通过关系逻辑蒸馏将原始文本转化为实体-关系三元组，并作为最终预测的结构化提示。
AI.result: 在 OK-VQA 和 A-OKVQA 基准上的实验显示，SCoRe 持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、筛选后的关系上下文比长而无序的多模态提示更适合知识型视觉问答，可有效提升 LLM 的推理与回答准确性。

title: RIACT: A Responsible AI System for Personalized Study Habit Tracking and Early Burnout Signal Detection in University Students
comment: 11 pages. Also available on EdArXiv: https://doi.org/10.35542/osf.io/94hr5_v1
summary: Student burnout is highly prevalent in higher education, with reported rates ranging from 12% to over 70% and consistently exceeding those of the working population - yet it is typically identified only retrospectively, after academic decline has already occurred. A contributing factor is that students have little structured visibility into their own study behaviour, and existing productivity tools record activity without interpreting it. This paper presents RIACT (Record, Insight, Analyze, Coach, Track), a web-based application that combines structured study session logging with a hybrid AI architecture to surface personalized insights and early burnout signals. Students log sessions by location and time; the system computes net focus time by accounting for breaks, detects burnout signals through transparent, deterministic rules operating on week-over-week behavioural comparisons, and uses a large language model - constrained to a fixed output schema - to contextualize patterns and generate personalized recommendations. The design embeds responsible AI principles throughout: warnings are governed by auditable rules rather than model judgement, all output is framed as an observation rather than a diagnosis and data collection is limited to self-logged behavioural fields. We describe the system's design rationale, situate it within the literature on student burnout and explainable AI in education and propose an evaluation framework for validating its behavioural signals against established burnout instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RIACT，一个面向高校学生的网页应用，通过结构化学习记录、规则化早期预警与受约束的大语言模型建议，帮助学生识别学习行为变化和潜在倦怠信号。
AI.motivation: 高校学生倦怠发生率高，且通常在学业表现下降后才被发现；学生缺乏对自身学习行为的结构化可见性，现有效率工具多停留在活动记录层面，缺少解释和预警能力。
AI.method: 系统要求学生按地点和时间记录学习会话，扣除休息后计算净专注时间；用透明、可审计的确定性规则进行周际行为比较以检测倦怠信号；再用固定输出模式约束的大语言模型解释行为模式并生成个性化建议，同时限制数据收集范围并避免诊断性表述。
AI.result: 论文主要呈现系统设计与设计依据，说明其如何输出个性化洞察、早期预警信号和建议；同时提出将行为信号与既有倦怠测量工具进行验证的评估框架，但摘要未报告实证实验结果。
AI.conclusion: RIACT 展示了一种兼顾可解释性、责任式 AI 与个性化反馈的学生倦怠早期识别方案；其有效性仍需通过后续实证评估验证。

title: Forgotten in Weights, Recovered by Tools: Agentic Tool Unlearning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tool-augmented agents, where responses can depend on tool calls and external observations rather than model parameters alone. This creates an evaluation mismatch for LLM unlearning: previous unlearning methods may suppress direct parametric recall, but an agent can still recover the same forget target through tools such as web search, retrieval, or database lookup. We identify this failure mode as tool-mediated recovery and study agentic tool unlearning, which aims to reduce both parametric recall and tool-mediated recovery while preserving normal tool use for retained knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose Agentic Tool Unlearning (ATU), a two-stage framework. The first stage applies parametric knowledge unlearning to suppress direct recall, while the second stage performs trajectory-level reinforcement learning in simulated tool-augmented environments to penalize target-seeking tool behavior and final-answer leakage. Experiments on RWKU and MUSE across different LLM architectures show that ATU achieves a better balance between target forgetting and retained utility, making unlearning more robust under tool-augmented agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文指出工具增强型LLM智能体会通过外部工具恢复本应遗忘的信息，提出ATU框架同时抑制参数记忆与工具介导恢复，并保持正常工具使用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法主要关注模型参数中的直接记忆抑制，但在智能体部署场景中，模型可借助搜索、检索、数据库查询等工具重新获取遗忘目标，导致评估与真实应用存在不匹配。
AI.method: 提出两阶段Agentic Tool Unlearning（ATU）：第一阶段进行参数知识遗忘以降低直接回忆；第二阶段在模拟工具增强环境中进行轨迹级强化学习，惩罚面向遗忘目标的工具调用行为和最终答案泄露，同时保留对非遗忘知识的正常工具使用。
AI.result: 在RWKU和MUSE数据集及不同LLM架构上的实验表明，ATU在目标遗忘与保留知识效用之间取得更优平衡，并能降低工具介导的信息恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将LLM遗忘问题扩展到工具增强智能体场景，证明仅做参数遗忘不足以保证部署安全性，ATU可提升遗忘方法在实际智能体应用中的鲁棒性。

title: Entropy of Bernoulli Measures Conditioned on Affine Subspaces and a Problem of Ancheta--Massey
summary:
A textbook result in information theory is that linear encoders achieve the entropy for lossless compression of Bernoulli source with parameter $p$. For lossy compression, however, linearity is known to incur strict suboptimality compared to the rate-distortion function. Massey asked whether the optimal rate for linear encoding is achieved simply by compressing a fraction of the bits linearly and losslessly and estimating the rest by zero \cite{Massey1978}. For $p=\frac12$, Ancheta answered this question affirmatively \cite{Ancheta1978}. This note extends Ancheta's result to all $p<\frac12$.
  The key argument is to bound the entropy of the posterior distribution conditioned on an affine subspace in terms of its marginals. The proof was discovered by GPT-5.6 Sol in an interactive process guided by the author. The purpose of the present note is to communicate a simplified version of this proof and to make connections with the existing literature on coding theory and spin glass theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究伯努利源有损压缩中线性编码的最优率问题，将 Ancheta 对 p=1/2 的结论推广到所有 p<1/2。
AI.motivation: 线性编码在无损压缩中可达到熵界，但在有损压缩中相对率失真函数存在严格次优性；Massey 提出线性有损压缩的最优策略是否等价于对一部分比特做线性无损压缩、其余置零估计。
AI.method: 核心方法是对给定仿射子空间条件下的后验分布熵进行上界估计，并将其与边缘分布联系起来；证明还与编码理论及自旋玻璃理论中的相关结果建立联系。
AI.result: 证明了对所有 p<1/2，线性编码的最优率由“压缩一部分比特并将剩余比特估计为零”的简单策略达到，从而推广了 p=1/2 情形的已有结果。
AI.conclusion: 该短文给出了 Massey 问题在 p<1/2 情形的肯定回答，并通过简化证明阐明了线性编码有损压缩的结构性最优策略。

title: DesignAgent3D: Interactive 3D Scene Editing via Designer-like Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Text guided 3D scene editing provides an intuitive interface for modifying reconstructed environments, but remains difficult because natural language design requests are often semantically underspecified and must be grounded in cluttered 3D scenes. Existing methods typically formulate the task as one-shot conditional generation from a single prompt, failing to resolve ambiguous user intents or achieve precise spatial grounding. Consequently, they suffer from severe object localization drift, tracking failure under occlusions, and the notorious multi-view "sticker effect." To overcome these limitations, we present DesignAgent3D, an interactive multimodal agentic framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a designer-like Plan-Perceive-Act paradigm. The agent first plans by interacting with the user to clarify underspecified design goals, then perceives by grounding the intended edit to specific objects or regions in the 3D scene, and finally acts by applying controlled visual modifications while preserving scene consistency. The edits are further integrated into the underlying 3D representation, supporting persistent and multi-view consistent novel-view rendering. Extensive experiments across both NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting backbones demonstrate that DesignAgent3D significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, delivering superior semantic intent alignment, impeccable spatial localization accuracy, and high-fidelity multi-view consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DesignAgent3D，将文本引导的 3D 场景编辑重构为交互式多模态智能体流程，以提升语义理解、空间定位与多视角一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动 3D 场景编辑方法多依赖单次提示的一步式条件生成，难以处理自然语言设计意图中的语义欠明确问题，也难以在复杂、杂乱的 3D 场景中实现精确 grounding，导致对象定位漂移、遮挡下跟踪失败以及多视角“贴纸效应”等问题。
AI.method: 提出 DesignAgent3D，一个采用 Plan-Perceive-Act 范式的交互式多模态 agent 框架：先通过与用户交互澄清模糊设计目标；再将目标编辑定位到具体 3D 对象或区域；最后执行受控视觉修改，并将编辑结果集成回底层 3D 表示，以支持持久化、多视角一致的新视角渲染。
AI.result: 在 NeRF 和 3D Gaussian Splatting 两类 3D 表示骨干上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有先进基线，在语义意图对齐、空间定位准确性和多视角一致性方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: DesignAgent3D 通过引入交互式规划、场景感知定位和一致性编辑执行，有效缓解文本引导 3D 编辑中的意图歧义、空间漂移和多视角不一致问题，是一种更接近真实设计流程的 3D 场景编辑框架。

title: There Is No Neutral Harness: Modern LLM Leaderboards Are Manufactured by Config-Fragile Items
summary: Multiple-choice benchmarks fix the questions and the correct answers, but not the harness: the order of the options, the wording of the prompt, and whether a language model's answer is read from generated text or from per-option likelihoods. Work on this harness sensitivity reports it as aggregate score variance, leaving unexamined which items the variance falls on and whether they are the items that separate one model from the next. We treat the evaluation harness of large language models (LLMs) as an independent variable and resolve its effect to single items. We introduce the \textit{fragility grid}: 12 open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs from 4 families answer the same 3{,}679 items from 4 benchmarks (ARC, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA) under 26 equally defensible harness configurations, recording one correctness bit for every model, item, and configuration. The comparison is matched, since the items, the weights, and the greedy decoding stay fixed while only the harness varies. Under the grid a model's score is a band rather than a point: gemma4-31b scores between 31 and 89 percent depending only on the harness. Three results follow. On the items that two adjacent models both answer stably the pair is tied, and config-fragile items carry 95.7 percent of a pair's gap on average. Four of the 12 models reach rank one under some configuration, so the harness selects the winner. Item discrimination, the property that benchmark-compression methods maximize, correlates with fragility at 0.28 (95 percent CI 0.25 to 0.30), so compression keeps the fragile items rather than removing them. The scoring choice, not the option order that protocols usually fix, is the load-bearing axis. We release the per-item records and the analysis script, from which every number regenerates on a CPU in seconds, and we position the fragility grid as a check a leaderboard can run before it reports an order.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大语言模型多选题评测结果高度依赖评测设置；通过逐题分析发现，模型排名差异主要由对评测配置敏感的脆弱题目贡献，且评分方式是最关键因素。
AI.motivation: 现有多选基准通常固定题目和标准答案，却没有固定评测harness，如选项顺序、提示词措辞、答案读取方式等。既有研究多以总体分数方差描述这种敏感性，未揭示哪些具体题目导致方差，以及这些题目是否正是区分模型排名的关键。
AI.method: 作者将LLM评测harness作为独立变量，提出fragility grid：使用12个开源指令微调LLM，覆盖4个模型家族，在ARC、HellaSwag、MMLU、TruthfulQA的3679个相同题目上，测试26种合理的评测配置；保持题目、模型权重和贪婪解码固定，仅改变harness，并记录每个模型-题目-配置的正确性比特。
AI.result: 模型得分不是单点而是区间，例如gemma4-31b仅因harness变化得分可从31%到89%。相邻模型在双方稳定作答的题目上基本持平，配置脆弱题平均贡献模型差距的95.7%。12个模型中有4个可在某些配置下排名第一，说明harness会决定赢家。题目区分度与脆弱性相关系数为0.28，因此基准压缩方法可能保留而非剔除脆弱题。评分方式比选项顺序更关键。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为排行榜在报告模型顺序前，应进行逐题级别的harness脆弱性检查。fragility grid可作为诊断工具，帮助识别评测结论是否由配置敏感题目驱动，从而提高LLM多选基准评测的可信度。

title: Automating Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via TRIAD: From Context Extraction to Validated Dataset Generation
comment: Accepted at the 19th International Natural Language Generation Conference (INLG 2026)
summary: Recent advances in LLMs and the adoption of RAG systems in industry have created a need for domain-specific question-answer datasets that can assess RAG performance on proprietary data. Existing datasets, such as HotpotQA, challenge current RAG systems on Wikipedia-based knowledge, but they cannot be transferred directly to domain-specific settings. A comprehensive evaluation of RAG system quality requires both multi-hop queries and unanswerable questions. This paper introduces TRIAD, a three-stage automated dataset generation approach. First, it generates question--answer (QA) pairs for the domain-specific knowledge base of a RAG system. Second, a validator checks each QA-pair in a feedback loop. Third, the QA pairs are extended with relevance-labeled context documents for downstream evaluation. We evaluate this approach against the established MuSiQue and HotpotQA datasets. The results show that the generated dataset exhibits similar performance trends across different RAG setups, while human validation indicates that the questions are suitable for evaluating a domain-specific RAG system. The code used to generate the dataset and all validation results are available in our GitHub repository(https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/triad).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TRIAD，一种面向领域专有知识库的三阶段自动化问答数据集生成方法，用于评估 RAG 系统表现。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 与 RAG 在工业场景中的应用增加，亟需能够评估专有领域数据上 RAG 性能的问答数据集；现有如 HotpotQA、MuSiQue 等主要基于通用知识，难以直接迁移到领域特定场景，且评估需要覆盖多跳问题和不可回答问题。
AI.method: TRIAD 包含三个阶段：首先基于领域知识库生成 QA 对；其次通过验证器在反馈循环中检查并改进 QA 对；最后为 QA 对扩展带相关性标签的上下文文档，以支持下游 RAG 评估。
AI.result: 与 MuSiQue 和 HotpotQA 的对比评估显示，TRIAD 生成的数据集在不同 RAG 设置下呈现相似的性能趋势；人工验证表明其问题适合用于领域特定 RAG 系统评估。
AI.conclusion: TRIAD 能自动生成面向专有领域知识库的高可用评估数据集，为 RAG 系统在行业场景中的质量评估提供了可复用方案，并公开了代码与验证结果。

title: React or Predict? A Spectral Rule for Wireless Threshold Detection
summary: A wireless sensor must alert a remote monitor before a monitored process crosses a safety threshold; an alarm arriving afterward may be too late. The sensor can react to its current estimate or predict ahead and trigger earlier, but the value of such lookahead is not obvious. In some systems it creates an early-alarm opportunity unavailable to the current test, while in others it cannot cross the alarm boundary. This letter gives a practical three-stage rule for deciding when to predict. First, an algebraic spectral test decides at design time whether lookahead is structurally useful: it is redundant exactly when the threshold direction is a left-eigenvector of the dynamics with a non-negative eigenvalue. Second, a closed-form channel decomposition shows that deeper prediction becomes more valuable as the channel degrades, because longer lead windows permit more pre-crossing transmission attempts. Third, simulations show that large gains also require retained prediction magnitude; oscillatory dynamics amplify the benefit through rotation, and a two-sensor setting reveals a sensing-channel tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无线传感器告警中“是否应进行前瞻预测”的判定问题，并提出三阶段实用规则。
AI.motivation: 监测过程越过安全阈值前，远端监控器必须及时收到告警；若告警滞后则可能失效。传感器可基于当前估计触发，也可预测未来提前触发，但前瞻预测在不同系统中的实际价值并不明确。
AI.method: 提出三阶段分析框架：首先用代数谱测试在设计阶段判定前瞻是否结构上有用；其次通过闭式信道分解分析信道退化时深度预测的价值；最后利用仿真考察预测幅值保持、振荡动力学、以及双传感器场景下的感知—信道权衡。
AI.result: 当前测试的冗余条件被精确刻画为：阈值方向是系统动力学的左特征向量且对应非负特征值。信道越差，较深前瞻因提供更长的越界前传输窗口而越有价值。仿真显示，大收益还依赖预测幅值的保留；振荡系统会通过旋转效应放大收益，双传感器设置揭示了感知质量与通信信道之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 前瞻预测并非总有价值，其有效性取决于系统谱结构、信道可靠性和预测动态特性。该文给出可操作的设计准则，用于判断何时值得在无线告警系统中采用预测触发。

title: WorldMind: Decoupled Game World Model for State-Aware NPC Behavior
summary: Game world models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in generating visually coherent and action-controllable gameplay videos. However, non-player character (NPC) behavior in existing models is either implicitly entangled with video generation or explicitly prescribed through external control signals. Consequently, a game world model has to jointly understand the state, plan the NPC's response and render its visual outcome, limiting its ability to produce responsive and state-aware NPC behavior. The challenge lies in the lack of an explicit interface for state-grounded decision-making. To this end, we introduce WorldMind, to our knowledge the first decoupled framework for state-aware NPC behavior in game world models. WorldMind separates interactive world modeling into four layers: an Understanding Layer that constructs a compact state from generated frames; a Decision Layer that reasons over the compact state to plan the NPC's next action; a Control Layer that translates the actions into temporally aligned conditions; and a Generation Layer that synthesizes their visual outcomes. By reconnecting layers in a closed interaction loop, WorldMind grounds NPC behavior in the evolving game state. We further introduce BOSS-140K, a dataset of gameplay videos paired with rich internal game states, together with an agent that automates the collection at scale. Experiments on BOSS-140K demonstrate reliable compact state reconstruction and mechanics-grounded planning, with WorldMind preferred over the baselines in approximately 70% of pairwise comparisons for its more tactically appropriate and coherent NPC behavior. Project page: https://teawhite.cn/worldmind_projectpage/

AI.tldr: WorldMind 提出一种解耦式游戏世界模型框架，使 NPC 行为能够基于演化中的游戏状态进行显式决策，并在 BOSS-140K 数据集上表现优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏世界模型虽能生成视觉连贯、动作可控的游戏视频，但 NPC 行为通常与视频生成隐式耦合，或依赖外部控制信号显式指定，导致模型需要同时完成状态理解、NPC 规划和视觉渲染，限制了其生成响应式、状态感知 NPC 行为的能力。核心问题是缺少面向状态驱动决策的显式接口。
AI.method: 论文提出 WorldMind，将交互式世界建模拆分为四层：理解层从生成帧中构造紧凑状态；决策层基于紧凑状态推理并规划 NPC 下一步动作；控制层将动作转换为时间对齐的条件信号；生成层合成对应视觉结果。各层通过闭环交互重新连接，使 NPC 行为持续锚定于动态游戏状态。同时提出 BOSS-140K 数据集，包含游戏视频及丰富内部游戏状态，并配套自动化采集代理。
AI.result: 在 BOSS-140K 上，实验显示该方法能够可靠重建紧凑状态，并进行符合游戏机制的规划。在成对比较中，WorldMind 约 70% 的情况下优于基线，生成的 NPC 行为更具战术合理性和连贯性。
AI.conclusion: WorldMind 通过显式分层与闭环状态反馈，缓解了 NPC 决策与视频生成耦合的问题，为游戏世界模型中的状态感知、响应式 NPC 行为建模提供了有效框架；BOSS-140K 也为后续研究提供了可扩展的数据基础。

title: Spyre-Accelerated Retrieval-Augmented Generation on IBM LinuxONE: A Cloud-Native Architecture for Secure, High-Throughput Enterprise AI Inference
summary:
Running large language models inside enterprise environments has always bumped up against a practical wall: the data lives in one place, the AI horsepower sits somewhere else, and moving sensitive records between the two creates real headaches around latency, security, and regulatory exposure. IBM's Spyre accelerator PCIe inference card built for LinuxONE and the broader IBM Z family changes that equation.
  In this paper we lay out a six-subsystem RAG architecture that runs entirely on IBM LinuxONE, using Spyre for generative inference, the Telum II on-chip accelerator for lightweight classification tasks, and Red Hat OpenShift for container orchestration. Every piece of the pipeline from query intake through vector retrieval, prompt assembly, LLM inference, compliance filtering, and response delivery stays within a single LinuxONE system, so sensitive data never has to leave the hardware perimeter.
  We walk through the design choices behind each subsystem, dig into the Spyre compilation and serving stack, explain how LinuxONE's Secure Execution technology extends confidential-computing guarantees to AI workloads, and benchmark the architecture against cloud-GPU and on-premises alternatives. Early analysis points to end-to-end RAG latencies under two seconds and up to a 20x reduction compared to off-platform inference, all while keeping the strong encryption and auditability posture that regulated industries actually need.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种完全运行在 IBM LinuxONE 上的六子系统 RAG 架构，通过 Spyre 推理卡、Telum II 片上加速器与 OpenShift 编排，实现企业敏感数据不出硬件边界的低延迟生成式 AI 推理。
AI.motivation: 企业部署大语言模型时常面临数据与算力分离的问题，导致敏感数据跨环境传输，引发延迟、安全、合规与审计风险。论文旨在探索一种将 RAG 全流程部署在企业级主机环境内的方案，以满足受监管行业对数据驻留、加密和可审计性的要求。
AI.method: 论文设计了一个六子系统 RAG 架构，覆盖查询接入、向量检索、提示词组装、LLM 推理、合规过滤和响应交付。系统运行于 IBM LinuxONE，使用 Spyre PCIe 加速卡进行生成式推理，使用 Telum II 片上加速器执行轻量分类任务，并通过 Red Hat OpenShift 进行容器编排。同时讨论 Spyre 编译与服务栈，以及 LinuxONE Secure Execution 对 AI 工作负载的机密计算支持。
AI.result: 初步分析显示，该架构可实现端到端 RAG 延迟低于 2 秒；相比平台外推理，延迟最多可降低 20 倍。同时，系统保持了 LinuxONE 环境中的强加密、审计能力和数据边界控制。
AI.conclusion: 该方案表明，在 LinuxONE 内部完成 RAG 全流程能够在降低延迟的同时增强安全性与合规性，适合金融、保险、医疗等高度监管场景中的企业级生成式 AI 部署。

title: Evidence-State Reliability Under Controlled Degradation: Parser-Validity Divergence in a Multi-Stage LLM Pipeline
comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/NaimurRahmanR/evidence-state-reliability
summary:
Multi-stage LLM pipelines can remain structurally valid even when evidence available to downstream stages becomes incomplete, compressed, or conflicting. This paper introduces and operationalizes Evidence-State Reliability (ESR), an evaluation layer concerned with whether intermediate evidence remains sufficiently complete, grounded, internally consistent, and usable for a stage's assigned function. ESR is evaluated separately from parser validity, which measures structural conformance.
  We evaluate the framework using GLM-5.2 on 60 sanitized base cases under four evidence conditions: clean, compressed-lossy, partial-dropout, and noisy-conflicting. Each condition was processed through decision, audit, and escalation stages. The design comprised 720 planned and ledgered calls, with 713 retained, sanitized execution rows.
  Across nine matched degraded-minus-clean condition-stage comparisons, all operational stage-success estimates were negative, and all 95% bootstrap intervals remained below zero. All nine parser-validity point estimates were positive, although the three partial-dropout intervals included zero. Among parser-valid degraded audit outputs, degradation detection was 1.0 in each degraded condition, while false-assurance rates remained non-zero; among parser-valid degraded escalation outputs, recovery was 0.0 in every degraded condition.
  The results show a bounded reliability-layer divergence in the evaluated pipeline: structural conformance can improve directionally while evidence-sensitive stage success deteriorates under the same controlled intervention. They also separate detection of degraded evidence from recovery. The conclusions are limited to the evaluated model configuration, pipeline design, selected sanitized cases, scoring procedure, and single scaled run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估 Evidence-State Reliability（ESR）作为多阶段大语言模型流水线的证据可靠性评估层，发现结构有效性可能提升，但证据敏感的阶段成功率在证据退化时下降。
AI.motivation: 多阶段 LLM 流水线即使输出结构合法，下游阶段所依赖的中间证据也可能不完整、被压缩丢失、相互冲突或不可用；仅评估解析器/格式有效性不足以反映真实任务可靠性。
AI.method: 作者定义并操作化 ESR，用于衡量中间证据是否足够完整、有依据、内部一致且能支持当前阶段功能。使用 GLM-5.2，在 60 个清洗后的基础案例上构造 clean、compressed-lossy、partial-dropout、noisy-conflicting 四种证据条件，并通过 decision、audit、escalation 三个阶段评估；计划 720 次调用，保留 713 条清洗执行记录。
AI.result: 九个退化条件相对 clean 的匹配比较中，所有阶段成功率差值均为负，且 95% bootstrap 区间均低于零；解析器有效性点估计均为正，但 partial-dropout 的三个区间包含零。退化 audit 输出中，退化检测率为 1.0，但仍存在非零虚假保证率；退化 escalation 输出中，各退化条件下恢复率均为 0.0。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在该评估流水线中存在可靠性层面的分离：结构合规性可方向性改善，但证据敏感的阶段成功率会随证据退化而下降；同时，检测证据退化不等于能够恢复。结论受限于所用模型配置、流水线设计、清洗案例、评分方法和单次规模化运行。

title: Deep Learning-Based Multi-User Communication Design for Dense IoT Networks: Interference-Aware Finite-Blocklength Communication and Preliminary MIMO Extensions
summary:
Dense IoT networks require reliable communication despite limited spectrum and substantial multi-user interference while maintaining manageable receiver complexity. This work introduces a deep-learning-based end-to-end multi-user communication design for interference-limited finite-blocklength IoT scenarios, focusing on short and medium blocklengths.
  We extend a prior 2-user SiameseNet transceiver framework to accommodate 2, 4, and 8 users, leveraging learned redundancy for interference suppression and noise robustness. Compared to conventional non-orthogonal access baselines, our method demonstrates strong Block Error Rate (BLER) performance across various scenarios without resorting to joint detection; the per-user decoder scales roughly linearly with the number of users.
  Further, we examine the robustness under interference mismatch and unequal interference strengths, critical for practical deployments with heterogeneous devices. The Latent-space analysis reveals that the learned codeword distance increases as the effective per-user rate decreases, corroborating with the observed BLER improvements. In addition, we also present preliminary results for a 2X2 MIMO setup under fixed-channel CSIT and CSIR, indicating potential for extending the framework to IoT gateways with multiple antennas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向有限块长、干扰受限密集 IoT 场景的深度学习端到端多用户通信设计，可扩展到 2、4、8 用户，并在不使用联合检测的情况下取得较好 BLER 性能。
AI.motivation: 密集 IoT 网络频谱受限、多用户干扰强，同时终端或接收机复杂度需要可控；传统非正交接入方案在有限块长和多用户干扰条件下性能与复杂度难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将已有 2 用户 SiameseNet 收发机框架扩展至 2、4、8 用户，通过端到端学习形成具有冗余的编码表示，以增强抗干扰与抗噪能力；采用按用户解码器而非联合检测，并分析干扰失配、非均等干扰强度、潜在空间码字距离以及初步 2×2 MIMO 固定信道 CSIT/CSIR 设置。
AI.result: 相较传统非正交接入基线，所提方法在多种短/中等块长场景下表现出较强 BLER 性能；每用户解码器复杂度随用户数近似线性增长；当有效单用户速率降低时，潜在空间码字距离增大，与 BLER 改善相一致；2×2 MIMO 初步结果显示扩展潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明深度学习端到端多用户收发机可在有限块长 IoT 干扰场景中以较低接收复杂度实现可靠通信，并具备对实际部署中干扰变化和多天线网关扩展的潜在适应性。

title: Text-Guided Visual Dependency Graph Learning with Cross-Modal Attention Priors
summary: Estimating interpretable conditional-dependence structures from multimodal visual-linguistic features remains largely unexplored. We propose CM-GLasso (Cross-Modal Graphical Lasso), a framework that bridges vision-language representation learning and sparse Gaussian Graphical Models. CM-GLasso introduces three key components: (i) a text visualization strategy that renders class-attribute descriptions as images and processes them through the same SigLIP-2 vision encoder as natural images, yielding prototype-indexed patch-level attention footprints in a shared feature coordinate system; (ii) a cross-attention distillation mechanism that condenses high-dimensional patches into a small set of semantic graph nodes, whose attention-footprint similarities yield cross-modal structural priors for non-uniform L1 penalization; (iii) a joint ADMM formulation that estimates shared and class-specific precision components within a single convex objective, avoiding the need to first estimate and then decompose separate class-wise graphs. The learned sparse graph topologies directly support a parameter-free, precision-based classification rule and a lightweight topology-aware segmentation head. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that CM-GLasso achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong feature-based and task-specific baselines. Under the matched controlled protocol, it attains the highest average classification accuracy (91.97%) and the highest segmentation mIoU among the controlled baselines on VOC (74.75%) and ADE20K (64.01%), while also yielding explicit sparse conditional-dependence graphs with common-specific decomposition.

AI.tldr: CM-GLasso 将视觉-语言表示与稀疏高斯图模型结合，用于从多模态特征中学习可解释的条件依赖结构，并在分类与分割任务上取得较优表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型通常具备强表征能力，但对多模态特征之间可解释的条件依赖结构建模不足；尤其是如何从图像与文本属性描述中估计可解释、稀疏且可用于下游任务的图结构，仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 提出 Cross-Modal Graphical Lasso 框架：首先将类别-属性文本描述渲染为图像，并与自然图像共同输入 SigLIP-2 视觉编码器，获得共享坐标系下的 patch 级注意力足迹；其次通过跨注意力蒸馏将高维 patch 压缩为少量语义图节点，并利用注意力足迹相似性构造跨模态结构先验以实现非均匀 L1 惩罚；最后采用联合 ADMM 优化，在单一凸目标中同时估计共享与类别特异的精度矩阵成分。
AI.result: 在八个基准数据集上的实验显示，该方法相较强特征基线和任务专用基线具有竞争力或更优表现；在受控协议下，平均分类准确率达到 91.97%，并在 VOC 和 ADE20K 上分别取得 74.75% 与 64.01% 的最高分割 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: CM-GLasso 能在保持任务性能的同时学习显式稀疏的条件依赖图，并提供公共-特异结构分解，使视觉-语言特征的关系建模更具可解释性和下游可用性。

title: Hate Speech Classification In Roman Urdu: A Comparative Study On Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning And Prompt Engineering
summary: Due to the widespread accessibility of the internet and social media, toxic and hateful con-tent has grown exponentially, causing significant distress and negative societal impacts. Ro-man Urdu, a low-resource language used in Pakistan and among Urdu-speaking communities worldwide, presents additional challenges because of its informal grammar, inconsistent sen-tence structures, and multiple variations in word spellings. This research aims to identify the most effective techniques for hate speech classification in such low-resource settings with limited data. To address this, the study investigates and compares the latest approaches, in-cluding prompt tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using LoRA, and prompt en-gineering, under various experimental configurations. To achieve this objective, four exper-iments were designed. The first experiment involved direct inferencing with LLMs without any fine-tuning, to evaluate how well these models understand Roman Urdu in a zero-shot setting, especially given limited data. The second experiment utilized parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) with LoRA, which updates only a small subset of parameters, thereby reducing computational cost. The third experiment explored prompt tuning with both mixed and manually crafted prompts, using very small sets of training examples relative to the entire dataset, making it computationally efficient as well. Finally, the fourth experiment applied prompt engineering through zero-shot and few-shot learning, relying solely on care-fully designed instruction prompts for classification without further training.
