title: Can LLMs Truly Forget? Revealing Unlearning Gaps Through Adversarial Evaluation
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of targeted training data from a model while preserving its remaining capabilities, but evaluating whether such information has truly become inaccessible remains challenging. Existing benchmarks primarily assess unlearning under clean, non-adversarial queries, leaving open whether information that appears forgotten can still be recovered through strategic prompting. We address this gap through a unified evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuning-based unlearning methods on TOFU using Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, followed by an adversarial robustness evaluation of methods that perform strongly under standard metrics. We introduce Attack Success Rate (ASR), an LLM-as-judge metric that measures the fraction of adversarial responses whose leakage score exceeds $0.2$, and evaluate recovery across eight attack suites. Our results reveal a substantial gap between clean-query forgetting and adversarial robustness. Although several fine-tuning-based methods achieve Forget Quality above $0.91$, targeted information remains recoverable with ASRs between $72.8\%$ and $84.3\%$, close to the $87.5\%$ ASR of the unprotected base model. In contrast, clean multilingual reformulations yield only $2.95\%$ measured leakage. A manual audit further finds agreement between binary ASR decisions and human factual assessments in seven of ten cases, indicating that ASR provides a useful, though imperfect, signal of behavioral recoverability. These findings show that strong standard-metric performance alone is insufficient to establish robustness after unlearning and motivate adversarial stress-testing as a complementary component of unlearning evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，机器遗忘方法在标准干净查询下看似有效，但在对抗性提示下仍可能大量泄露被遗忘信息，因此仅依赖常规指标不足以证明遗忘的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘旨在移除目标训练数据对模型的影响，同时保留其他能力；然而，现有评测多基于非对抗性查询，难以判断被遗忘信息是否真的无法通过策略性提示恢复。
AI.method: 作者在 TOFU 基准上使用 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，对提示式与微调式遗忘方法进行统一评估；随后对标准指标表现较好的方法进行对抗鲁棒性测试。提出 Attack Success Rate（ASR），利用 LLM-as-judge 判断对抗响应泄漏分数是否超过 0.2，并在八类攻击套件上评估信息恢复情况。
AI.result: 多种微调式方法在标准 Forget Quality 指标上超过 0.91，但目标信息仍可通过对抗攻击恢复，ASR 达到 72.8% 到 84.3%，接近未保护基模型的 87.5%。相比之下，干净的多语言改写仅产生 2.95% 的测量泄漏。人工审计显示，ASR 的二元判断与人类事实评估在 10 个案例中有 7 个一致。
AI.conclusion: 标准遗忘指标的高分并不意味着模型在对抗场景下真正鲁棒；机器遗忘评估应加入对抗性压力测试，ASR 可作为有用但不完美的行为可恢复性信号。

title: Compressed sensing matrices from orthogonal spaces over finite fields of odd characteristic
comment: 23 pages. The paper has been accepted by JAA
summary: In this paper, we construct deterministic matrices from subspaces of orthogonal spaces over finite fields of odd characteristic and investigate their applicability to compressed sensing. The construction is based on incidence relations among three types of subspaces, yielding families of matrices with explicitly computable dimensions and coherence. Using coherence-based estimates, we establish sufficient conditions under which these matrices satisfy the Restricted Isometry Property for prescribed sparsity levels. We also provide numerical comparisons with DeVore's deterministic construction to illustrate the trade-off between the number of measurements, coherence, and sparse recovery guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文基于有限域上奇特征正交空间的子空间关联关系，构造确定性压缩感知矩阵，并分析其维度、相干性与RIP条件。
AI.motivation: 随机矩阵虽常用于压缩感知并具有良好理论性质，但在存储、复现和硬件实现方面存在成本；因此需要具有显式结构、可计算参数和可验证恢复保证的确定性测量矩阵。
AI.method: 作者从有限域正交空间的若干类型子空间出发，利用三类子空间之间的关联关系构造0-1型确定性矩阵；进一步显式计算矩阵规模与相干性，并通过基于相干性的界推导满足限制等距性质（RIP）的充分条件。
AI.result: 得到一族参数可显式计算的确定性测量矩阵，并给出在给定稀疏度下满足RIP的充分条件；数值实验将其与DeVore确定性构造比较，展示测量数、相干性和稀疏恢复保证之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明有限几何中的正交空间子空间关联结构可用于设计压缩感知确定性矩阵，具有明确理论参数和一定恢复保证，但其优势需结合测量规模、相干性以及与已有构造的比较来评估。

title: ViTexSZ: Heterogeneous Vision-Text Knowledge Distillation for EEG Seizure Detection
summary: Automated seizure detection from electroencephalography (EEG) is essential for continuous neurological monitoring, particularly for subclinical epileptic seizures that may exhibit only subtle electrographic changes. Existing time-series methods are often designed for fixed EEG channel configurations, thereby limiting their applicability to heterogeneous EEG recordings with irregular channel layouts. Although visual and language modeling offer promising alternatives, aligning heterogeneous EEG representations with clinical semantics remains challenging. We introduce ViTexSZ, a heterogeneous Vision-Text knowledge distillation framework for EEG seizure detection. ViTexSZ converts EEG recordings into structured waveform images and introduces a query-based multi-channel alignment module that maps source-dependent visual features into a unified token space. A heterogeneous teacher further integrates the aligned EEG representations with clinical prompts through a multimodal large language model, associating high-level clinical semantics with seizure-related evidence. Vision-text knowledge distillation then transfers the teacher representations to a lightweight student during detection. Experiments on four EEG seizure datasets demonstrate the generalizability of ViTexSZ across both subclinical and general seizure detection scenarios, achieving the highest accuracy on all datasets and relative improvements of up to 12.9% over the second-best baselines, showing its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出 ViTexSZ：一种面向异构 EEG 癫痫发作检测的视觉-文本知识蒸馏框架，将 EEG 转为波形图像，并通过多通道对齐与多模态教师模型提升跨数据集泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 时间序列检测方法通常依赖固定通道配置，难以适配通道布局不规则、来源异构的 EEG 记录；同时，将异构 EEG 表征与临床语义有效对齐仍具挑战。
AI.method: ViTexSZ 将 EEG 记录转换为结构化波形图像；设计基于查询的多通道对齐模块，将源相关视觉特征映射到统一 token 空间；构建异构教师模型，利用多模态大语言模型将 EEG 表征与临床提示融合；再通过视觉-文本知识蒸馏将教师表征迁移至轻量级学生模型用于检测。
AI.result: 在四个 EEG 癫痫发作数据集上验证，ViTexSZ 在亚临床和一般癫痫检测场景中均表现出良好泛化性，并在所有数据集上取得最高准确率，相比次优基线最高相对提升 12.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将 EEG 波形视觉化、多通道统一对齐、临床语义引导和知识蒸馏结合，可有效提升异构 EEG 癫痫检测的准确性与泛化能力。

title: The Abstention Protocol: RCA for Clos Fabrics
comment: Presented at Usenix OSDI 2026. 17 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables
summary:
Root cause analysis (RCA) in large datacenter networks is challenging because telemetry is noisy, partial, and asynchronous. Score-based approaches degrade under these conditions, often yielding unstable or incorrect attributions.
  We present \textsc{CoreSec}, a production RCA system that replaces weighted fusion with a PAM-style abstention algebra. Telemetry agents are composed using control flags that yield deterministic decisions and explicit abstention when evidence is ambiguous. CoreSec combines this algebra with topology-aware configurations that capture failure surfaces across Clos fabrics and converge monotonically as evidence accumulates.
  Deployed at hyperscale, CoreSec provides stable and explainable RCA behavior across diverse environments without retuning. Our experience shows that structured composition with abstention forms a practical foundation for automated RCA in real-world cloud networks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoreSec：一种用于大规模数据中心网络根因分析的生产系统，用 PAM 风格的“弃权代数”替代传统加权融合，以在噪声、缺失、异步遥测下获得稳定、可解释的 RCA 结果。
AI.motivation: 大规模数据中心网络中的遥测数据通常存在噪声、观测不完整和时间异步等问题，传统基于评分或加权融合的 RCA 方法在这些条件下容易退化，产生不稳定或错误的根因归因。
AI.method: CoreSec 使用 PAM-style abstention algebra，将多个遥测代理通过控制标志组合起来，使系统在证据充分时给出确定性判断，在证据含糊时显式弃权；同时结合拓扑感知配置，建模 Clos 网络结构中的故障影响面，并在新证据累积时保持单调收敛。
AI.result: 在超大规模生产环境部署后，CoreSec 在不同网络环境中无需重新调参即可提供稳定且可解释的根因分析行为。
AI.conclusion: 结构化组合与显式弃权机制能够作为真实云网络中自动化 RCA 的实用基础，相比传统评分融合更适合处理不可靠遥测环境。

title: Mitigating Database Leakage in RAG Systems with Keyword-Grounded Fact Substitution
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for combining large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge sources. However, RAG systems remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, which may mislead the retriever or generator to expose sensitive database contents. To address this issue, we propose KFS-RAG, a defense that mitigates information leakage by reformulating the retrieved context. Specifically, our method first identifies a small set of influential keywords from the retrieved context via an attention rollout plus a causal perturbation mechanism. These keywords are then used to guide an auxiliary LLM to generate a compact set of keyword-grounded facts from the retrieved passages. Finally, the original context is substituted with these curated facts, ensuring that the generator operates on sanitized evidence rather than the raw retrieved text. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that KFS-RAG significantly reduces the risk of database leakage under injection attacks while maintaining response accuracy and relevance. This work highlights a practical pathway toward building secure and trustworthy RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KFS-RAG，通过将检索到的原始上下文改写为由关键事实组成的净化证据，降低 RAG 在提示注入攻击下的信息泄漏风险，同时保持回答质量。
AI.motivation: RAG 将大语言模型与外部知识库结合，但在提示注入攻击下，检索器或生成器可能被诱导泄露数据库中的敏感内容。现有 RAG 流程直接使用原始检索文本，增加了信息暴露面，因此需要一种在不显著损害准确性和相关性的前提下减少泄漏的防御机制。
AI.method: KFS-RAG 首先利用 attention rollout 与因果扰动机制，从检索上下文中识别少量对生成结果有影响的关键词；随后使用这些关键词指导辅助 LLM 从检索段落中生成紧凑的、以关键词为依据的事实集合；最后用这些经过筛选和重构的事实替代原始上下文，使生成器基于净化后的证据而非完整原文进行回答。
AI.result: 实验表明，KFS-RAG 在提示注入攻击场景下显著降低数据库泄漏风险，同时仍能保持较好的回答准确性与相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明，对检索上下文进行关键词驱动的事实重构是一种实用的 RAG 安全增强路径，可在安全性与任务性能之间取得较好平衡，有助于构建更可信的 RAG 系统。

title: Breakdown of Edgeworth Expansion in Finite-Blocklength Regime and Exact Absorption via $q$-Deformation
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Extended version of the paper accepted for ISITA 2026. The concise version will appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: This paper addresses the structural breakdown of the Edgeworth expansion in the finite-blocklength (FBL) regime, where conventional asymptotic approximations yield unphysical negative probabilities in the deep-tail region. We propose a $q$-deformed framework that resolves this inconsistency by replacing additive polynomial perturbations with a geometric deformation of the information density space. Motivated by the linearization of nonlinear dynamics, we prove that dynamically scaling the $q$-logarithmic parameter exactly absorbs the third-order skewness while preserving global nonnegativity. We establish a universal asymptotic matching, demonstrating that the framework encapsulates higher-order asymptotic scales. Numerical results confirm that the proposed method matches the state-of-the-art precision of the Cornish-Fisher bound without the risk of negative probabilities. The framework offers a robust and computationally stable foundation for evaluating operational limits in ultra-reliable communications such as 6G and URLLC.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种 q-变形框架，用于修复有限块长场景中 Edgeworth 展开在深尾区域产生负概率的结构性问题，并保持高精度与非负性。
AI.motivation: 传统 Edgeworth 渐近展开在有限块长（FBL）深尾区域可能给出非物理的负概率，影响超可靠通信场景下操作极限评估的可信性与稳定性。
AI.method: 作者以非线性动力学线性化为启发，用信息密度空间的几何变形替代加性多项式扰动；通过动态缩放 q-对数参数，精确吸收三阶偏度项，同时证明全局非负性，并建立与高阶渐近尺度的普适匹配关系。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法在精度上可匹配 Cornish-Fisher bound 等先进方法，同时避免负概率问题，具备更好的计算稳定性。
AI.conclusion: q-变形框架为有限块长和超可靠通信中的概率尾部近似提供了稳健、非负且高精度的替代方案，适用于 6G、URLLC 等场景下的操作极限评估。

title: BIMScript: Material-Aware Structured Scene Programs for BIM Ingestion
comment: Project Page: see https://bimscriptworld.github.io/BIMScript/ ; to be published in ECCV 2026 TwinWorld Workshop
summary: Structured-language models such as SceneScript reconstruct a scene as a short program of parametric commands, an inherently editable and semantically explicit representation. We ask three questions that stand between such models and their most compelling application, automated ingestion of existing buildings into BIM tools, studied here on synthetic scans: \emph{what} is the scene made of, \emph{how fast} can it be produced, and \emph{exactly where} is each element. BIMScript answers all three within one grammar. First, we extend the layout language with per-element \emph{material} and \emph{condition} attributes, supervised by a vision-language-model material-passport corpus we build over 100k synthetic scenes (1.9M pseudo-labeled elements), and route image appearance to the material tokens through a lifted-feature point encoder. Second, we show that autoregressive decoding of these programs is dominated not by compute but by kernel-launch and host-synchronization overhead, and remove it with an output-exact CUDA-graph decoder (1.9 vs 6.4\,ms/step, $3.4\times$) plus a grammar-parallel, tolerance-verified draft-and-verify scheme that exploits the deterministic entity schema. Third, we address the model's 5cm token-grid granularity with training-free geometric snapping and a hybrid discrete--continuous decoder head that regresses a sub-bin offset, and measure how much of the residual error each recovers. Because each command maps one-to-one onto a native Revit object, we validate direct ingestion into a BIM authoring tool end to end with a working add-in and its IFC4 export, and the same program's language form is designed to support LLM-driven, sustainability-aware reasoning over the built asset.

AI.tldr: BIMScript 将场景重建为可编辑、语义明确的结构化程序，并同时扩展材料/状态识别、加速自回归解码、提升几何定位精度，以支持建筑扫描到 BIM/Revit 的端到端导入。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化语言模型可用参数化命令重建场景，但要用于既有建筑自动导入 BIM，还需回答三个关键问题：场景由什么材料和状态的元素组成、生成速度是否足够快、每个元素的几何位置是否足够精确。
AI.method: 论文提出 BIMScript：在布局语法中加入逐元素 material 与 condition 属性；构建基于视觉语言模型的 material-passport 语料，覆盖 10 万合成场景与 190 万伪标注元素；使用 lifted-feature point encoder 将图像外观信息路由到材料 token；通过输出精确的 CUDA-graph 解码器减少 kernel 启动与主机同步开销，并结合 grammar-parallel draft-and-verify；采用训练-free 几何 snapping 与混合离散—连续解码头回归子网格偏移，以缓解 5cm token 网格粒度限制。
AI.result: 系统在解码效率上从 6.4 ms/step 降至 1.9 ms/step，约 3.4 倍加速；几何 snapping 与连续偏移回归分别恢复部分残余定位误差；每条命令可一一映射为 Revit 原生对象，并通过插件完成 BIM 工具导入与 IFC4 导出验证。
AI.conclusion: BIMScript 将语义属性、快速生成和精确定位统一到同一语法框架中，使结构化场景程序更接近可实际用于建筑信息模型自动生成的形态，并为后续基于语言模型的可持续性分析与资产推理提供结构化基础。

title: Retrieval-grounded robot program generation and simulation-based correction via Model Context Protocol
comment: Accepted by CIE53; to appear in the CIE53 Proceedings, Khalifa University, Abu Dhabi, UAE, October 20-23, 2026
summary: Flexible manufacturing requires industrial robots to be reprogrammed rapidly as product variants change. This paper presents a language-model-based workflow that generates, validates, and iteratively corrects ABB RAPID robot programs from natural language task descriptions. A dual-stream retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline grounds code generation in verified technical documentation and production templates, reducing domain-specific errors produced by ungrounded language models. A custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connects the language-model client directly to ABB RobotStudio for automated code upload, simulation execution, and diagnostic feedback. The evaluation combines a 30-query retrieval benchmark, scoped code-generation checks, and RobotStudio case studies in a simulated pickand- place manufacturing cell. The simulation loop exposes execution failures that static and semantic checks alone cannot catch, including suction release-height errors, unreachable placement targets, and configuration-dependent recovery motions. The results show how RAG and MCP can connect grounded code generation with executable feedback from industrial robot simulation software, while reducing but not eliminating expert setup and final supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于语言模型的工业机器人编程工作流，可从自然语言任务描述生成、验证并迭代修正 ABB RAPID 程序。
AI.motivation: 柔性制造中产品变体频繁变化，工业机器人需要快速重编程；传统人工编程成本高、周期长，而未接地的语言模型容易产生领域错误。
AI.method: 构建双流检索增强生成（RAG）流程，将代码生成 grounded 在已验证技术文档和生产模板中；开发自定义 MCP 服务器，把语言模型客户端连接到 ABB RobotStudio，实现自动代码上传、仿真执行和诊断反馈；通过检索基准、代码生成检查和仿真案例进行评估。
AI.result: 系统在模拟取放制造单元中发现了静态与语义检查难以捕捉的执行问题，如吸盘释放高度错误、放置目标不可达、依赖构型的恢复运动问题；RAG 与 MCP 降低了领域错误并提供可执行反馈。
AI.conclusion: RAG 与 MCP 可有效连接 grounded 代码生成和工业机器人仿真反馈，提升机器人程序生成与调试效率，但仍无法完全替代专家设置与最终监督。

title: LëtzCross: A Cross-Lingual Page-Level Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval over Luxembourgish Documents
summary: Recent page-image retrievers such as ColPali have improved retrieval over visually rich documents, yet little is known about how they behave in cross-lingual, low-resource settings. We introduce LëtzCross, a benchmark for cross-lingual page-level retrieval over Luxembourgish PDF documents, with document pages indexed as images and queries provided in English, French, German, and Luxembourgish. The benchmark combines text-focused QA pairs with visually grounded QA pairs, covering both textual and visual retrieval needs in PDF-based RAG. We use LëtzCross to compare OCR-based text-only retrievers with ColPali-style page-image retrievers and find that the latter perform better across query languages in this system-level comparison. We also examine single-language and multilingual fine-tuning. Fine-tuning transfers across query languages, with French yielding the highest mean performance on Luxembourgish queries among the single-language settings. In the multilingual setting, including Luxembourgish gives the strongest results and substantially improves retrieval for Luxembourgish queries.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出 LëtzCross：面向卢森堡语 PDF 的跨语言页面级检索基准，用于评估图像化页面检索器与 OCR 文本检索器在低资源跨语言场景下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有页面图像检索器（如 ColPali）在视觉丰富文档检索中表现较好，但其在跨语言、低资源语言环境中的行为和有效性仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 构建 LëtzCross 基准：将卢森堡语 PDF 页面作为图像索引，查询语言覆盖英语、法语、德语和卢森堡语；数据包含文本型 QA 与视觉依据型 QA。基于该基准比较 OCR 文本检索器与 ColPali 风格页面图像检索器，并评估单语言与多语言微调策略。
AI.result: 系统级比较显示，ColPali 风格页面图像检索器在多种查询语言上优于 OCR 文本检索器。微调具有跨查询语言迁移能力；单语言微调中，法语对卢森堡语查询的平均表现最好。多语言微调中，加入卢森堡语取得最强结果，并显著提升卢森堡语查询检索性能。
AI.conclusion: LëtzCross 为低资源跨语言 PDF-RAG 页面检索提供了评测基础；页面图像检索方法在该场景下具有优势，而包含目标低资源语言的多语言微调对提升本语言查询效果尤为关键。

title: Exact Rate Exponent Tradeoff for New Classes of Distributed Hypothesis Testing Problems
summary: We characterize the exact rate--exponent tradeoff for new classes of one-way distributed hypothesis testing problems by demonstrating that a recent upper bound, derived via the auxiliary-receiver technique, coincides with known lower bounds. We achieve this by relaxing the upper bound on the type-II error exponent into a form that shares the same inner functional as Han's lower bound, differing only in the outer rate constraint. Furthermore, we prove that this upper bound is tight for testing against dependence and for the doubly symmetric binary source (DSBS) with crossover probabilities $κ_0$ under the null hypothesis and $κ_1$ under the alternative hypothesis, provided $0 < κ_1 \leq κ_0 < \frac12$. The characterization of the exact error exponent for the DSBS source holds for every communication rate $R \geq 0$.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了一类单向分布式假设检验问题的精确通信速率—错误指数权衡。
AI.motivation: 单向分布式假设检验中，通信速率受限时可达到的II类错误指数是核心问题；已有辅助接收者技术给出上界，Han给出下界，但二者是否一致、哪些源模型可精确表征仍不清楚。
AI.method: 作者将基于辅助接收者技术得到的II类错误指数上界进行松弛，使其与Han下界具有相同的内部泛函形式，仅在外层速率约束上存在差异；随后针对testing against dependence和DSBS模型证明上下界重合。
AI.result: 证明该上界对testing against dependence以及零假设交叉概率为κ0、备择假设交叉概率为κ1且0<κ1≤κ0<1/2的DSBS源是紧的；对DSBS源，在所有通信速率R≥0下得到精确错误指数。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过统一并匹配上下界，给出了若干新类别单向分布式假设检验问题的精确速率—指数区域，特别完整解决了指定参数范围内DSBS源的全速率精确指数表征。

title: Beyond Visual Similarity: Entity-Aligned Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) relies on retrieving external information to answer queries involving long-tail entities. However, existing retrieval pipelines predominantly employ CLIP-style dual encoders, which prioritize surface-level visual similarity over entity-level semantic alignment. This paradigm often fails when semantically identical concepts exhibit large visual variations or when distinct entities appear visually similar. To address this, we propose KBMR, the first MLLM-based embedding retriever tailored for KB-VQA. Leveraging the robust autoregressive capabilities of MLLMs, KBMR maps images into a semantic space that better preserves concept identity. To tackle the challenge of noisy supervision in Wikipedia-scale retrieval, we introduce an MLLM-based semantic discriminator that generates continuous entity-consistency weights. These weights guide a novel continuous semantic distillation objective, enabling effective hard negative sampling and soft supervision beyond rigid binary labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KBMR significantly outperforms CLIP baselines, yielding up to a 14.7% improvement in retrieval Recall@1 and a 9.4% gain in end-to-end VQA accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/realHarryX/KBMR.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 KBMR：面向知识型视觉问答的首个基于多模态大语言模型嵌入的检索器，通过更强的实体语义对齐提升检索与端到端问答性能。
AI.motivation: KB-VQA 需要为长尾实体问题检索外部知识。现有 CLIP 式双编码器更偏向表层视觉相似性，难以处理同一语义实体外观差异大、或不同实体视觉相似的情况，导致实体级语义对齐不足。
AI.method: 作者利用 MLLM 的自回归语义建模能力，将图像映射到更能保持概念身份的语义嵌入空间；同时引入基于 MLLM 的语义判别器，为大规模维基百科检索中的噪声监督生成连续的实体一致性权重，并据此设计连续语义蒸馏目标，支持软监督与有效的困难负样本采样。
AI.result: 实验显示 KBMR 显著优于 CLIP 基线：检索 Recall@1 最高提升 14.7%，端到端 VQA 准确率提升 9.4%。
AI.conclusion: KBMR 证明了 MLLM 语义嵌入比传统视觉相似性导向的双编码器更适合 KB-VQA 中的实体级检索；连续语义蒸馏也能缓解维基百科规模检索中的噪声标签问题。

title: Composable Trust Infrastructure for Manufacturing Knowledge Graphs: Cross-System Provenance, Temporal Reasoning, and Decision Traceability
summary: Manufacturing knowledge graphs that integrate data from heterogeneous industrial systems face a trust deficit: consumers cannot determine whether queried data is valid, whether it was valid when a decision was made, where it originated, or how it was acted upon. We argue that four trust capabilities -- SHACL validation, PROV-O provenance, domain-aware bi-temporal versioning, and graph-native decision objects -- compose through shared correlation identifiers to produce emergent trust properties that no single capability delivers alone. We present a composable trust infrastructure that integrates these four capabilities into a unified RDF architecture. Capabilities compose through shared entity URIs, ingestion activity identifiers, and temporal correlation keys, enabling compound queries spanning all four dimensions. An experimental ablation confirms that removing any single capability causes exactly three of six composition queries to fail, demonstrating that all four are equally load-bearing. Analysis of higher-order compositions reveals four emergent three-way properties and one irreducible four-way property (full-chain auditability, 31ms execution). The infrastructure is validated on a testbed integrating eleven industrial sources -- OPC UA, TIA Portal, eClass, AAS, ISA-95, ISA-18.2, SAP S/4HANA, Teamcenter, Opcenter EX, Insights Hub, and SCM -- under an 89-class ISA-95-aligned ontology. The unified graph contains 8,743 triples across five named graphs, stitched by 81 owl:sameAs identity edges. Evaluation uses simulated but structurally realistic data from purpose-built emulators; data structures and cross-system linkage patterns are representative of real industrial installations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向制造业知识图谱的可组合信任基础设施，将SHACL验证、PROV-O溯源、领域感知双时态版本管理与图原生决策对象统一到RDF架构中，以支持跨有效性、来源、时间与决策行为的复合审计查询。
AI.motivation: 异构工业系统集成形成的制造知识图谱存在信任缺口：使用者难以判断查询数据是否有效、在决策发生时是否有效、数据来自何处以及曾如何被用于决策。因此需要一种能够同时覆盖数据质量、来源、时间状态与决策链路的统一信任机制。
AI.method: 作者构建了统一RDF架构，将四类能力通过共享实体URI、摄取活动标识符和时间相关键进行组合；在包含11类工业数据源的测试床上，基于ISA-95对齐的89类本体建立知识图谱，并使用命名图、owl:sameAs身份链接和复合查询来验证组合能力。
AI.result: 统一图包含5个命名图、8,743个三元组和81条owl:sameAs身份边。消融实验显示，移除任一能力都会导致6个组合查询中的3个失败，说明四项能力均为关键承载组件。高阶组合分析发现4个三元组合涌现属性和1个不可约四元属性；完整链路审计查询执行时间为31ms。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，单独的验证、溯源、版本管理或决策建模无法提供完整信任保障；通过共享标识符和时间键进行组合，可形成制造知识图谱中的涌现信任属性与完整链路可审计性。不过实验数据为模拟但结构现实的数据，后续仍需在真实工业环境中进一步验证。

title: FCPRAG: Fusion-Controller Parametric Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Stable Multi-Passage LoRA Injection
summary: Parametric retrieval-augmented generation (PRAG) injects retrieved evidence into a large language model (LLM) through passage-specific LoRA adapters, reducing reliance on long in-context prompts. When multiple passages are retrieved for the same query, however, evidence-level fusion becomes a bottleneck: equal-weight merging can amplify weak or conflicting evidence, and translating retrieval signals into fusion weights often requires fragile global tuning. We propose FCPRAG, a fusion-controlled parametric RAG framework that adds a lightweight controller for retrieval-conditioned, sample-level adapter fusion. The controller predicts per-passage fusion scores together with sample-level calibration signals, including a mixing gate and an adaptive temperature, enabling fusion that stays selective under informative retrieval signals and conservative under uncertainty. FCPRAG is trained with merge-aware supervision derived from each adapter's marginal contribution within a multi-adapter merge, using training data only. We further show that a single dataset-level temperature is suboptimal under heteroscedastic retrieval uncertainty, motivating sample-level adaptation. Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, PopQA, and ComplexWebQuestions (CWQ) across three LLM backbones show that FCPRAG consistently improves F1 over standard RAG and parametric RAG baselines, with gains of up to 4.65% on 2WikiMultiHopQA and 7.55% on CWQ, while also reducing tuning cost and improving robustness under retrieval perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FCPRAG：在参数化检索增强生成中，用轻量控制器根据检索证据为不同 passage 的 LoRA 适配器进行样本级加权融合，并引入混合门控与自适应温度，以提升多证据融合的选择性、鲁棒性和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 PRAG 在多个检索 passage 对应多个 LoRA 适配器时，证据级融合是瓶颈：等权融合容易放大弱证据或冲突证据；将检索分数直接映射为融合权重通常依赖脆弱的全局调参。此外，不同样本的检索不确定性存在异方差，单一数据集级温度难以适配。
AI.method: FCPRAG 增加轻量级控制器，基于检索条件预测每个 passage 的融合分数，并输出样本级校准信号，包括 mixing gate 和 adaptive temperature。训练时使用仅由训练数据得到的 merge-aware supervision，即根据每个适配器在多适配器合并中的边际贡献来监督融合。
AI.result: 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、PopQA 和 ComplexWebQuestions 上，跨三种 LLM backbone，FCPRAG 相比标准 RAG 与参数化 RAG 基线稳定提升 F1；在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上最高提升 4.65%，在 CWQ 上最高提升 7.55%，同时降低调参成本并提升检索扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 样本级、检索条件控制的适配器融合比等权或全局调参式融合更适合 PRAG 的多证据场景；通过融合分数、门控和自适应温度，FCPRAG 能在证据充分时更选择性地利用信息，在不确定时更保守，从而提升性能与鲁棒性。

title: Multi-Scale Fruit Capsules: Dilated Convolutions and Dynamic Routing for In-the-Wild Explainable Fruit Recognition
summary: The same fruit appears in a bunch, unpicked, peeled, bagged in plastic, or sliced on a dish, so automated fruit classification in the wild (AFCW) must absorb wide intra- class and narrow inter-class variability in shape, size, colour and texture. Convolutional networks route information through pooling, which discards the pose and location of the region of interest and therefore generalises poorly across these presentations. We propose FruitCapsNet, a capsule network whose Fruit Capsules replace the standard convolutional front end with dilated convolutions: the receptive field grows exponentially at constant parameter cost, so each capsule encodes multi-scale context before dynamic routing resolves part whole spatial agreement. Hyper-parameters, including the dilation factor, are selected by Bayesian optimisation rather than grid search. On three public datasets (SMP, FruitsGB, Fruits-360) and a new 19-class, 10,639-image in-the-wild dataset (PD-19), FruitCapsNet exceeds ten fine-tuned transfer-learning backbones at one-third the depth, with the largest margin (+2.7% over the nearest competitor) on the hardest set. Grad-CAM saliency propagated from the DigitCaps layer shows that the improvement comes from attributing decisions to whole-fruit regions rather than to object edges, giving post-hoc evidence that the gain is not a dataset artefact.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FruitCapsNet，用带空洞卷积的胶囊网络解决野外水果分类中同类差异大、类间差异小的问题，并在多个数据集上优于多种迁移学习骨干。
AI.motivation: 野外自动水果分类面临水果呈现形态多样（成串、未采摘、去皮、包装、切片等）导致的形状、尺寸、颜色和纹理变化；传统卷积网络的池化会丢失目标姿态与位置信息，影响跨场景泛化。
AI.method: 设计 FruitCapsNet：以 Fruit Capsules 替代标准卷积前端，引入空洞卷积在参数成本不变的情况下扩大感受野，使胶囊编码多尺度上下文；再通过动态路由建模部分—整体的空间一致性。超参数（包括空洞率）使用贝叶斯优化选择。
AI.result: 在 SMP、FruitsGB、Fruits-360 以及新建的 19 类 10,639 张野外图像数据集 PD-19 上，FruitCapsNet 以约三分之一的网络深度超过 10 个微调迁移学习骨干；在最困难数据集上较最接近方法提升 2.7%。Grad-CAM 显示模型更关注完整水果区域而非边缘。
AI.conclusion: FruitCapsNet 通过多尺度空洞卷积与胶囊动态路由提升了对水果姿态、尺度和呈现方式变化的鲁棒性，其性能提升具有可解释性证据支持，并非简单数据集偶然效应。

title: Evaluating Multimodal Narrative Understanding of Popular Hollywood Films
summary: Multimodal language models increasingly show promise for enabling the large-scale computational analysis of film, opening up new avenues for learning about film history and the evolution of narrative techniques. But the creation of stable benchmarks built around Hollywood films is complicated by copyright protections. In this work, we address these concerns directly, by building a new collection of Hollywood films defined by two criteria: box office popularity (where we publish the first large-scale, open collection of weekly box office earnings reported by Variety magazine from 1922-1979); and likely public domain status (by researching copyright registrations and renewals in the US Catalog of Copyright Entries). We build a new multimodal MCQ benchmark on top of this collection that focuses on narrative elements that directly evaluate the abilities of models to inform meaningful research on film narrative; we find that many vision-language models struggle on this task (with many performing at near-chance levels of accuracy), while audio-visual models (including those that use audio in captioning scenes) reach a maximum accuracy of 61.1%, well below human-level performance.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了一个基于可能公有领域好莱坞电影的新型多模态叙事理解MCQ基准，并发现现有多模态模型与人类表现仍有明显差距。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型有望支持大规模电影计算分析，帮助研究电影史与叙事技术演变；但围绕好莱坞电影建立稳定基准会受到版权保护限制，因此需要一个兼顾代表性与可开放使用的电影集合。
AI.method: 作者基于两个标准构建电影集合：一是票房流行度，整理并公开1922—1979年《Variety》杂志报道的每周票房收入数据；二是可能的公有领域状态，通过检索美国版权登记与续展记录进行判断。在此基础上设计多模态多项选择题基准，重点考察与电影叙事研究相关的叙事元素理解能力。
AI.result: 许多视觉—语言模型在该任务上表现较弱，准确率接近随机猜测；使用音频信息的音视频模型表现更好，最高准确率达到61.1%，但仍显著低于人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个版权风险更低、面向电影叙事分析的多模态基准，显示当前模型尚不足以可靠支持高质量的电影叙事研究，尤其在深层叙事理解方面仍有较大提升空间。

title: Evaluation Awareness in Language Models: Representation, Verbalization, and Control
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Both capability and safety benchmarks rest upon the assumption that the behavior of language models undergoing a test is informative about their behavior in deployment. This assumption can fail, should models infer that they are being evaluated and condition their response on such context. This hypothesis, termed ``evaluation awareness'', has been observed in frontier and open-weight language models alike. We provide a systematic study of this phenomenon, by probing for it across six language models (from four families and three sizes) and three metrics. More precisely, we examine whether (i) being under evaluation is linearly represented within the models' activations space, (ii) it is verbalized in their output tokens (as scored by an LLM-as-judge), and (iii) steering causally affects their behavior. For the open-checkpoint Olmo models, we further test these measures at every training stage. In doing so, we report that evaluation awareness is linearly decodable from the residual streams of every model (best AUROC $\geq 0.7$). By contrast, these representations align only in part with verbalization: their correlations and mutual information are nonzero in some settings, yet vary substantially across models, layers, and readout choices. Nevertheless, steering along probe-derived directions can shift the verbalization scores. Finally, a comparison across the Olmo checkpoints reveals that evaluation awareness is already present within base models, becomes amplified throughout the stages of supervised fine-tuning, and remains stable thereafter---unlike the effects of steering, that grow more pronounced at every successive training stage. These results show the need for evaluations to account for the disjunction between what models represent internally, what they verbalize, and their steering.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究语言模型的“评估意识”：模型能否识别自己正在被测试，并据此改变输出。结果显示，该信息可在多种模型内部激活中线性解码，但内部表征、外部口头化输出与因果 steering 效应之间并不完全一致。
AI.motivation: 现有能力与安全基准默认假设：测试时的模型行为能够代表部署时行为。但若模型能推断自己处于评估环境，并根据该情境调整回答，则基准结果可能失真。因此需要系统检验评估意识在模型内部表征、输出表达和可干预行为中的表现。
AI.method: 作者在六个语言模型、四个模型家族、三个规模上进行探测，使用三类指标：一是检查“处于评估中”是否可从残差流激活空间中线性解码；二是用 LLM-as-judge 评估模型输出中是否口头化评估意识；三是沿探针得到的方向进行 steering，检验其对行为的因果影响。对开源检查点 Olmo 模型，还在不同训练阶段逐点分析这些指标。
AI.result: 所有模型的残差流中都能线性解码评估意识，最佳 AUROC 至少达到 0.7。内部表征与输出口头化之间仅部分一致：相关性和互信息在部分设置中非零，但会随模型、层数和读出方式显著变化。沿探针方向 steering 可以改变口头化分数。Olmo 检查点显示，评估意识在 base model 阶段已经存在，在监督微调阶段被放大，之后保持相对稳定；而 steering 效应会随训练阶段推进而增强。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，评估意识是多类语言模型中普遍存在的现象，并且内部表征、显式输出和可干预行为之间存在脱节。因此，未来模型评估不能只依赖表面输出，而应同时考虑模型内部状态与可被干预的行为机制，以避免基准测试对部署行为的代表性被削弱。

title: Tomatoes, Potatoes, and Onions: Questioning the Need for Faces in Face Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) is traditionally formulated as a face-specific problem, although many of the visual artifacts introduced by print, replay, and recapture processes are not inherently tied to facial appearance. In this work, we investigate whether transferable PAD representations can be learned without using faces during downstream PAD training. To this end, we introduce TPO, a controlled face-free presentation attack dataset consisting of bona fide, print, and replay recordings of, almost randomly chosen, tomatoes, potatoes, and onions acquired under protocols that closely mirror conventional face PAD datasets. Using a foundation-model-based PAD architecture, we demonstrate that a detector trained on TPO achieves an average AUC of 92.70% across four standard cross-dataset face PAD benchmarks, outperforming training on synthetic faces and remaining competitive with models trained on real face datasets. Conversely, models trained on face PAD datasets transfer consistently above chance to TPO, suggesting that the learned representations capture characteristics of the presentation process rather than object semantics. Furthermore, incorporating TPO into conventional face PAD training consistently improves cross-dataset performance under fixed optimization budgets, indicating that face-free data provides complementary information rather than simply additional training samples. Finally, representation and frequency analyses provide further evidence that transferable PAD representations cannot be explained by a single spectral artifact but instead encode richer presentation cues shared across object categories. Together, these results provide empirical evidence that transferable presentation attack representations can be learned independently of facial content, opening new opportunities for privacy-preserving and identity-independent PAD development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并验证：人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）的可迁移表示可在不使用人脸的下游训练中学习。作者用番茄、土豆、洋葱构建无脸TPO数据集，训练出的检测器在人脸PAD跨数据集基准上表现强劲。
AI.motivation: 传统PAD通常被视为人脸特定任务，但打印、重放、再采集等攻击过程产生的视觉伪迹并不必然依赖人脸语义。论文希望检验是否能通过非人脸对象学习到可迁移的PAD表示，从而支持隐私保护、身份无关的PAD开发。
AI.method: 作者构建TPO数据集，包含真实、打印、重放记录的番茄、土豆、洋葱，采集协议尽量对齐常规人脸PAD数据集。随后使用基于基础模型的PAD架构，在TPO及不同人脸PAD数据上训练并进行跨数据集评估；同时分析将TPO并入人脸PAD训练的效果，并通过表征分析与频率分析研究模型学到的线索。
AI.result: 仅在TPO上训练的检测器在四个标准跨数据集人脸PAD基准上平均AUC达到92.70%，优于使用合成人脸训练的模型，并与真实人脸数据训练模型具有竞争力。反向实验中，人脸PAD数据训练模型迁移到TPO也稳定高于随机水平。加入TPO到常规人脸PAD训练后，在固定优化预算下跨数据集性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，可迁移PAD表示不依赖人脸内容，而更多捕捉呈现攻击过程中的共享视觉线索；这些线索也不能被单一频谱伪迹完全解释。无脸数据可为PAD训练提供互补信息，为隐私保护和身份无关的PAD研究提供新方向。

title: Agentic AI for Safety-critical Multi-drone Systems: Challenges and Opportunities
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, presented at the AgentCraft Workshop at IUI2026 Conference, https://agentcraft-iui.github.io/2026/ - CEUR-WS.org proceedings forthcoming
summary: Multi-drone systems are increasingly positioned for safety-critical missions such as search and rescue (SAR) and critical infrastructure monitoring. Yet, real-world adoption remains constrained not only by autonomy performance, but by the difficulty of integrating agentic behavior into professional work: operators must understand, trust, and govern automation under uncertainty, time pressure, and accountability. This position paper synthesizes the ambitions and lessons from two ongoing efforts: NAMUR, which explores LLM-supported robot control in SAR and firefighting contexts, and PERSIST, which explores persistent drone operations for monitoring and security at critical infrastructure sites. We argue that agentic AI should be approached as a socio-technical design problem, where interfaces, oversight mechanisms, and evaluation practices are as critical as algorithms. We outline a human-centered, participatory, and iterative research approach aimed at uncovering stakeholder needs, shaping agent capabilities through successive prototypes, and producing transferable proof-of-concept systems and evaluation strategies for other safety-critical contexts.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文主张，多无人机系统在安全关键任务中的落地应被视为社会—技术设计问题，而不仅是算法或自治性能问题。
AI.motivation: 多无人机系统可用于搜索救援、消防及关键基础设施监测等高风险场景，但实际部署受限于操作员在不确定性、时间压力和责任约束下对自主系统的理解、信任与治理能力。
AI.method: 论文综合两个进行中的项目经验：NAMUR关注LLM支持的机器人控制在搜索救援和消防中的应用，PERSIST关注关键基础设施场站的持续无人机运行。作者提出以人为中心、参与式、迭代式的研究路径，通过利益相关者需求挖掘、连续原型开发、界面与监督机制设计以及评估策略构建来塑造智能体能力。
AI.result: 论文产出的是研究议程和设计框架，而非实验性定量结果；其核心结果是强调界面、监督机制和评估实践与算法同等重要，并提出可迁移的概念验证系统与评估策略方向。
AI.conclusion: 在安全关键场景中部署具备智能体能力的AI无人机系统，需要将人机协作、可解释监督、组织流程和责任机制纳入整体设计，才能提升信任、可控性和现实采用可能性。

title: No One Model Catches Every Harm: Benchmarking Content Moderation Across Safety Scenarios
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet they remain vulnerable to generating harmful content. From adversarial jailbreaks that bypass safety filters to implicit hate that evades detection, the range of risks these models pose continues to grow. While both specialized content moderators and general-purpose LLMs are being used as safety layers, the question of which model is best suited for which type of harmful content remains unanswered. We present the most comprehensive evaluation of LLM safety capabilities to date, systematically testing \textbf{53} models across \textbf{11} datasets that we organize into four distinct categories. Our evaluation under both prompt-only and prompt-response settings uncovers critical blind spots: large frontier models that lead on one category fall significantly behind smaller, specialized alternatives on others, and real-world conversational safety remains largely unsolved across all model families. These findings challenge the assumption that scale alone ensures safety, and provide the community with a structured framework for informed model selection.

AI.tldr: 本文对53个模型在11个安全相关数据集上的能力进行系统评测，发现不同模型在不同有害内容类别上的表现差异显著，模型规模并不能单独保证安全能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型已广泛用于真实应用，但仍可能生成或未能识别有害内容。现有安全层包括专门内容审核模型和通用LLM，但尚不清楚不同类型风险应选择哪类模型，因此需要系统评估其安全能力边界。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个覆盖11个数据集、4类有害内容类别的评测框架，测试53个模型，并在两种设置下评估：仅基于提示词的prompt-only设置，以及同时考虑提示词与模型回答的prompt-response设置。
AI.result: 评测发现，大型前沿模型并非在所有安全类别上都领先；某些小型或专门化模型在特定类别上表现更好。同时，真实世界对话场景中的安全检测对所有模型家族而言仍然困难。
AI.conclusion: 论文挑战了“模型越大越安全”的假设，强调安全模型选择应依据具体风险类别和应用场景，并为社区提供了结构化的模型选择与评估框架。

title: CLSC DETR: Reliable Candidate Ranking via Cross Layer Geometric Support for UAV Small Object Detection
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object detection is critical for applications such as target search, where accurate detection of small objects in complex aerial scenes remains challenging. The limited spatial extent, dense distribution, and frequent occlusion of small objects make reliable candidate ranking particularly difficult. Existing Detection Transformer (DETR) based methods improve ranking by estimating localization quality from individual queries and incorporating it into classification scores. However, a single query often lacks sufficient geometric evidence for small objects with weak boundary cues, resulting in unreliable quality estimation and unstable ranking. To address this limitation, we propose Cross Layer Local Support and Consistency Calibration for DETR, termed CLSC DETR. Specifically, the Cross Layer Local Support module establishes correspondences between final layer queries and intermediate layer candidates to aggregate complementary geometric evidence for more reliable localization quality estimation, while the Classification and Localization Consistency Calibration module adaptively adjusts classification scores according to localization quality and classification reliability to improve candidate ranking. Experiments show that CLSC DETR improves AP and AP$_{75}$ over the baseline by 1.5\% and 2.0\% on VisDrone, respectively, while achieving consistent improvements on UAVDT.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出 CLSC DETR，用于提升无人机航拍小目标检测中候选框排序的可靠性，通过跨层局部支持聚合几何证据，并进行分类-定位一致性校准，在 VisDrone 和 UAVDT 上取得稳定性能提升。
AI.motivation: 无人机目标检测中，小目标空间占比小、分布密集且遮挡频繁，导致定位质量估计和候选结果排序困难。现有 DETR 类方法通常依赖单个查询估计定位质量，但小目标边界信息弱，单查询几何证据不足，容易造成质量估计不可靠和排序不稳定。
AI.method: 论文提出 CLSC DETR，包含两个核心模块：Cross Layer Local Support 模块在最终层查询与中间层候选之间建立对应关系，聚合互补几何信息以改进定位质量估计；Classification and Localization Consistency Calibration 模块根据定位质量和分类可靠性自适应调整分类分数，从而提升候选框排序质量。
AI.result: 在 VisDrone 数据集上，相比基线方法，CLSC DETR 的 AP 提升 1.5%，AP75 提升 2.0%；在 UAVDT 数据集上也取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: CLSC DETR 针对无人机小目标检测中的单查询证据不足问题，通过跨层几何支持和分类-定位一致性校准提升定位质量估计与候选排序可靠性，表现出较好的有效性和泛化性。

title: Software Frameworks for Explainable AI in Time Series Classification: A Systematic Review
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, to be published in ECML PKDD 2026, XKDD and Beyond Workshop, LNCS
summary: Time series arise in a wide range of application domains and are analyzed using machine learning in decision-critical settings. Time series classification (TSC) is one of the most widely studied and relevant tasks. In this context, ensuring the transparency and trustworthiness of TSC models has become an important requirement, motivating the use of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods. Despite growing interest, research on XAI for TSC remains fragmented, and a systematic understanding of the available software frameworks for explanation generation, their evaluation practices, and practical limitations is still lacking. Prior work largely focused on individual explanation methods, while cross-framework consistency, time-series-specific evaluation, and reproducibility have received little attention. In this survey, we analyze existing software frameworks for explanation generation and evaluation in TSC. We compare them along multiple dimensions, including supported XAI methods, evaluation metrics, usability, benchmarking support, and reproducibility, providing the first time-series-specific survey of frameworks with implementation comparisons and an analysis of frequency-domain support. We identify six frameworks that explicitly support time series and reveal common limitations: only one method supports frequency-domain explanations despite their relevance; only two evaluation metrics have been developed specifically for time series; and identical XAI methods can yield substantially different explanations across frameworks. Based on these findings, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research, highlighting the need for unified, time-series-specific XAI frameworks that enable faithful, reproducible, and time-series-aware explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文综述并比较了面向时间序列分类的可解释人工智能软件框架，指出现有框架在频域解释、时间序列专用评估指标、跨框架一致性与可复现性方面存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类广泛应用于决策关键场景，模型透明性与可信度至关重要；但当前面向时间序列分类的XAI研究较为分散，缺乏对解释生成软件框架、评估实践和实际局限的系统性认识。
AI.method: 作者对现有支持时间序列解释生成与评估的软件框架进行调查和比较，从支持的XAI方法、评估指标、易用性、基准测试支持、可复现性以及频域支持等多个维度展开分析。
AI.result: 研究识别出六个明确支持时间序列的框架，并发现：仅一种方法支持频域解释；仅两个评估指标是专门为时间序列设计的；相同XAI方法在不同框架中可能产生显著不同的解释结果。
AI.conclusion: 现有TSC-XAI框架尚不成熟，亟需统一、面向时间序列特性的XAI框架，以支持忠实、可复现且时间序列感知的解释生成与评估。

title: Lexical Coupling in GUI Element Grounding: Sentence Embeddings Track Labels across Mobile and Web
summary: GUI grounding evaluations that expose UI elements as text metadata often treat high instruction-element embedding similarity as evidence of semantic grounding. Across three mobile and web benchmarks, we show that this interpretation is frequently confounded by visible-label recovery. Lexical baselines remain competitive at top-1, label-poor targets remain weak for text-only methods, and encoder top-1 hits are predictable from lexical rank, candidate-pool size, and label type. We evaluate each action as a same-screen ranking task, comparing five off-the-shelf single-vector encoders with lexical baselines. Encoders recover some lexical misses, but deployable fusion gains are much smaller than target-aware oracle gains. These findings show that embedding-based evaluations can conflate visible-label recovery with semantic GUI grounding. Embedding-based evaluations should therefore report lexical baselines, label-type stratification, and deployable-fusion diagnostics. Our released repository provides analysis scripts and detexted per-step panels: https://github.com/qijia123/lexical-coupling-release.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，基于文本元数据的GUI grounding评测中，高指令-元素嵌入相似度常被误解为语义 grounding，但实际很大程度受可见标签恢复影响。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI grounding评测常将UI元素文本元数据暴露给模型，并把指令与候选元素之间的高嵌入相似度视为模型理解界面语义的证据。作者质疑这种解释可能被可见文本标签的词面匹配混淆，因此希望系统分析嵌入方法到底是在做语义理解，还是主要在恢复可见标签。
AI.method: 作者在三个移动端与网页GUI基准上，将每个动作建模为同屏候选元素排序任务，比较五种现成单向量文本编码器与词法基线；同时分析top-1命中与词法排名、候选池大小、标签类型之间的关系，并比较编码器、词法基线、可部署融合以及目标感知oracle融合的表现。
AI.result: 词法基线在top-1上仍具有竞争力；缺少可见标签或标签信息贫乏的目标对纯文本方法仍然困难；编码器的top-1命中可由词法排名、候选池大小和标签类型较好预测。编码器能弥补部分词法方法遗漏，但实际可部署融合带来的提升远小于目标感知oracle融合。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入式GUI grounding评测可能将可见标签恢复误判为语义grounding。作者建议此类评测必须报告词法基线、按标签类型分层的结果，以及可部署融合诊断，以更准确地区分词面匹配与真正语义理解。

title: FigmaTrace: Capturing Creative Nuances in Human Figma Design Workflows
summary: Vision Language Models have recently shown improvements in several objective and verifiable domains such as object detection but continue to underperform on subjective and creative design tasks. A major contributor to this performance gap is the lack of high quality human workflow data that captures a diverse set of preferences and decisions that make human experts good at design tasks. In this work, we first define a unique, expert curated taxonomy of design skills and best practices which we further expand into a set of 126 open ended, subjective, long horizon tasks. Built on top of this and expert solutions, our dataset FigmaTrace contains over 200 hours of human captured video data converted into 3469 design trajectories using a novel design phase-based method. We use our dataset to train four models and show that training on FigmaTrace leads to a performance improvement comparable to frontier closed models such as \textsc{Claude-Opus-5} and \textsc{GPT-5.6-Sol} on four out of distribution agentic GUI environments. We further perform a useful ablation to attribute these performance improvements to a design phase-based video to trajectory conversion which outperforms prior length-based conversion approaches. Finally, we perform a qualitative analysis on the best performing \textsc{Qwen3.8-27B} outputs to better correlate performance improvements to FigmaTrace's trends. We open source our dataset and the best model for the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FigmaTrace 数据集，通过专家设计技能 taxonomy、开放式长周期设计任务与人类设计视频轨迹，提升视觉语言模型在主观创意设计与 GUI 代理任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在目标检测等客观可验证任务上进步明显，但在主观、创意型设计任务上表现不足，核心原因之一是缺少高质量的人类专家工作流数据，难以覆盖设计偏好、决策过程与最佳实践。
AI.method: 作者首先构建专家策划的设计技能与最佳实践分类体系，并扩展为 126 个开放式、主观、长周期任务；随后基于专家解法采集超过 200 小时的人类设计视频，并提出按设计阶段进行视频到轨迹转换的方法，得到 3469 条设计轨迹；再使用该数据训练四个模型，并进行消融实验比较阶段式转换与传统长度式转换。
AI.result: 在四个分布外 agentic GUI 环境中，使用 FigmaTrace 训练的模型获得显著性能提升，表现可比部分前沿闭源模型；消融结果表明，设计阶段式视频到轨迹转换优于既有按长度切分的方法；对最佳 Qwen3.8-27B 输出的定性分析进一步关联了性能提升与数据集特征。
AI.conclusion: FigmaTrace 通过高质量专家工作流数据和更合理的轨迹构建方法，缓解了视觉语言模型在创意设计任务上的数据瓶颈，并为社区开放数据集与最佳模型，具有较强的实用与研究价值。

title: Enhanced Artificial Neural Networks Using QHAdamW in Air Quality Forecasting
comment: 20 pages, 16 tables, 15 figures, Published with International Journal of Engineering Trends and Technology (IJETT)
summary: The study employed an Artificial Neural Network in combination with the optimized Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) algorithm, currently the only AQI forecasting model available in the Philippines. The modified QHAdamW - Quasi-Hyperbolic Momentum (QHAdam) and Adam with decoupled weight decay (AdamW) were both extensions of the Adam optimizer, and both offer unique advantages for training ANN. The proposed QHAdamW optimizer addresses the issues on convergence, generalization, and forecasting performance of Adam. Hyperparameter tuning results revealed that 0.01 and 0.001 were the most effective optimal values for the generalization performance of QHAdamW. The comparative analysis results using seven evaluation metrics revealed that the error value range is lower, and the regression coefficient, having a value approximately equal to 1, improved the model accuracy performance. Likewise, the model converges to a satisfactory level of performance with the convergence performance results of lower loss values as obtained from training and validation losses. Based on data from a real-time air quality tracking station in Manila, a feed-forward neural network is used to predict the AQI of PM2.5 and PM10 separately. This model can be used to forecast Particulate Matter (PM), to help the Department of Environment and Natural Resources-Environmental Monitoring Bureau (DENR-EMB) implement a comprehensive air quality management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合前馈人工神经网络与改进 QHAdamW 优化器的空气质量指数预测模型，用于分别预测 PM2.5 和 PM10 的 AQI。
AI.motivation: 现有 Adam 优化器在收敛性、泛化能力和预测性能方面存在改进空间；菲律宾本地 AQI 预测模型有限，因此需要更准确、稳定的空气质量预测方法支持环境管理。
AI.method: 基于马尼拉实时空气质量监测站数据，构建前馈神经网络，并将 QHAdam 与 AdamW 的思想结合形成 QHAdamW 优化器；通过超参数调优确定关键参数，并用七种评价指标比较预测误差、回归系数及训练/验证损失。
AI.result: 超参数调优显示 0.01 和 0.001 对 QHAdamW 的泛化性能较优；相比基线，模型误差范围更低，回归系数接近 1，训练和验证损失较低，说明预测精度和收敛表现较好。
AI.conclusion: QHAdamW 优化的前馈神经网络能够有效提升 PM2.5 和 PM10 AQI 预测性能，可作为菲律宾空气质量监测与管理决策的辅助工具。

title: More Computational Resources Do Not Ensure Higher Scholarly Impact: Evidence from Leading NLP Conference Papers
summary: Computational resources are increasingly central to NLP research, but how closely reported GPU capability aligns with scholarly impact remains unclear. We analyze 13,921 ACL, EMNLP, and NAACL main-conference papers published between 2020 and 2025, using GPU resources as our operational measure of computational resources. From full texts, we extract GPU models and counts, standardize each paper's largest reported configuration into a comparable hardware-capability measure, and link these data to citation, award, topic, and institutional metadata. GPU reporting became more common but remained incomplete, while reported capability increased mainly through newer hardware generations and medium-scale multi-GPU configurations. Resource concentration substantially exceeded impact concentration: the annual top 20% of GPU-quantifiable papers accounted for 83.9%-89.9% of reported GPU capability, but only 27%-32% of citations and 20%-33% of paper awards. In adjusted models, a tenfold increase in aggregate reported GPU capability was associated with a 3.52-percentage-point increase in within-NLP topic-year citation percentile, but increased model R^2 by only 0.0042. GPU count showed more consistent positive associations with citation and award outcomes than newer hardware generation. Overall, reported GPU resources are associated with scholarly impact but provide little standalone explanation of research influence.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析2020—2025年ACL、EMNLP、NAACL主会论文中报告的GPU资源与学术影响之间的关系，发现二者存在正相关但解释力很弱。
AI.motivation: 计算资源在NLP研究中日益重要，但论文报告的GPU能力与引用、奖项等学术影响之间的对应关系尚不清楚；研究旨在量化这种关系并评估计算资源是否能解释研究影响力。
AI.method: 作者收集13,921篇ACL、EMNLP和NAACL主会论文全文，抽取GPU型号与数量，将每篇论文报告的最大GPU配置标准化为可比的硬件能力指标，并关联引用、奖项、主题和机构等元数据；随后比较资源集中度与影响集中度，并建立调整后的统计模型。
AI.result: GPU报告频率上升但仍不完整；报告的GPU能力增长主要来自新硬件代际和中等规模多GPU配置。每年GPU可量化论文中资源排名前20%的论文占83.9%—89.9%的报告GPU能力，但仅获得27%—32%的引用和20%—33%的论文奖项。模型中，GPU能力提高10倍对应主题-年份内引用百分位提高3.52个百分点，但R²仅增加0.0042；GPU数量比硬件代际与引用和奖项结果的正相关更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 报告的GPU资源与学术影响存在一定正相关，但单独解释研究影响力的能力很弱；计算资源集中度远高于学术影响集中度，说明高资源投入并不必然带来相称的学术影响。

title: Complexity Induction: Compositional Generalization via Structured Label Distortion
summary: We demonstrate that structured distortion of training data - which we term complexity induction - can induce compositional generalization in a standard CNN classifier without architectural modification. Using synthetic images of colored geometric shapes, we encode classes as flat string labels (e.g., "red-circle") with no explicit attribute decomposition, and exclude certain color-shape combinations from training entirely. We apply two distortion methods derived from Jaccard string similarity between class names: mixed labels (soft target distributions encoding inter-class overlap) and expanded dataset (false training samples with structurally motivated incorrect labels). Both methods induce the ability to predict unseen class combinations, and act at different levels: mixed labels activate the classifier for unseen combinations by exploiting the CNN's natural embedding structure, while expanded training improves the embedding factorization itself. A control with random (unstructured) false labels confirms that the effect depends on the structure of the distortion, not on noise per se. These results suggest that structured complication of training signals can influence both the internal organization of learned representations and their compositional interpretation - a principle that may underlie the role of natural language in cognitive development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“复杂性诱导”：通过对训练信号进行有结构的扭曲，可在不修改CNN架构的情况下促进组合泛化，使模型能预测训练中未见过的颜色-形状组合。
AI.motivation: 标准CNN通常依赖训练分布中的显式样本，难以对被完全排除的属性组合进行组合式泛化。作者希望探究：即使类别标签只是扁平字符串、没有显式属性分解，是否也能通过训练信号中的结构性信息诱导模型学习颜色与形状的可组合表示。
AI.method: 使用彩色几何图形的合成图像数据，将类别编码为如“red-circle”的扁平字符串标签，并从训练集中排除部分颜色-形状组合。基于类别名称之间的Jaccard字符串相似度设计两种结构化扭曲方法：一是混合标签，用软目标分布表达类别间重叠；二是扩展数据集，加入带有结构性错误标签的伪训练样本。同时设置随机错误标签对照实验，以区分结构性扭曲与一般噪声的影响。
AI.result: 两种结构化扭曲方法都能诱导模型预测未见过的类别组合。混合标签主要利用CNN自然形成的嵌入结构激活未见组合；扩展训练则进一步改善表示空间中的属性因子化。随机非结构化错误标签不能产生同样效果，说明关键因素是扭曲中的结构，而非噪声本身。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，有结构地复杂化训练信号能够影响模型内部表征组织及其组合式解释能力。这提示训练数据中的语言式结构或标签结构可能在组合泛化乃至认知发展中发挥重要作用。

title: Let Credit Follow Computation: Architecture-Aware Credit Transport for Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning
summary: Credit assignment in large-language-model reinforcement learning (LLM RL) can be separated into three objects: evidence about success, a transport operator that converts this evidence into token-level advantages, and an update geometry that turns advantages into policy changes. Recent work has greatly improved evidence, sampling, and update geometry, but the transport operator is usually architecture-agnostic. Fixed-discount GAE applies a stationary geometric kernel along token time; group-relative methods broadcast an outcome statistic across an entire response. Neither operator represents the trajectory-specific computation used by the Transformer policy itself. We introduce computation-conditioned credit transport (CCT), a general framework in which a detached statistic of the behavior policy's internal computation parameterizes the causal kernel that transports downstream value through a rollout. Our concrete algorithm, CompPO, maps native attention concentration to a bounded per-token retention gate, uses the gate in both the one-step bootstrap and a path-dependent generalized-advantage trace (Comp-GAE), and co-designs a transport-aligned critic (TAC) that reuses the actor's hidden states and routing information without a second same-scale Transformer. The task reward and clipped PPO policy objective remain unchanged; a constant gate recovers fixed-coefficient GAE. Across five Qwen3-4B seeds, CompPO reaches 61.4% final held-out accuracy (95% CI [60.8,62.0]) versus 53.8% [52.9,54.7] for tuned GRPO. Neither Comp-GAE with a standard critic (55.2%) nor TAC with a fixed gate (56.4%) matches the full model (interaction +2.4 [1.9,2.9]). Shuffle and position controls confirm trajectory-specific alignment; CompPO is stable in 10/12 PPO-grid runs versus 3/12. Frozen evaluation improves over GRPO by 4.3 and 3.9 greedy pass@1 macro points on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

AI.tldr: 提出计算条件化信用传输（CCT）及具体算法 CompPO，用 Transformer 内部注意力浓度为 token 级优势传播建模，在多个模型与实验设置中显著优于 GRPO 和部分消融版本。
AI.motivation: LLM 强化学习中的信用分配通常包含成功证据、将证据传到 token 级优势的传输算子、以及将优势转为策略更新的几何结构。现有方法改进了证据、采样和更新几何，但传输算子多为架构无关：固定折扣 GAE 使用静态几何核，组相对方法将结果统计广播到整段回复，无法刻画 Transformer 策略在具体轨迹上的计算过程。
AI.method: 提出 CCT 框架：使用行为策略内部计算的分离统计量来参数化因果核，将下游价值沿 rollout 传输。具体算法 CompPO 将原生注意力集中度映射为有界的逐 token retention gate，并将该 gate 用于一步 bootstrap 与路径依赖的 Comp-GAE；同时设计传输对齐 critic（TAC），复用 actor 的隐藏状态与路由信息，避免训练第二个同规模 Transformer。奖励函数和 clipped PPO 目标保持不变，常数 gate 可退化为固定系数 GAE。
AI.result: 在五个 Qwen3-4B 随机种子上，CompPO 最终 held-out accuracy 达 61.4%（95% CI [60.8,62.0]），优于调优 GRPO 的 53.8%（[52.9,54.7]）。仅使用 Comp-GAE 加标准 critic 为 55.2%，TAC 加固定 gate 为 56.4%，均不及完整模型，并显示 +2.4 [1.9,2.9] 的交互增益。shuffle 和 position controls 支持轨迹特异性对齐假设；CompPO 在 PPO 网格中 10/12 稳定，而 GRPO 为 3/12。冻结评估中，CompPO 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上分别较 GRPO 提升 4.3 和 3.9 greedy pass@1 macro points。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，将 Transformer 的轨迹特异性内部计算用于信用传输，可以比静态或广播式传输算子更有效地分配 token 级信用；CompPO 通过计算条件化 gate 与传输对齐 critic 的协同设计，提高了性能、稳定性和跨模型泛化表现。

title: MCite-RL: Towards Reliable Multimodal RAG via Citation-enhanced Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with visual citation is crucial for ensuring the traceability and verifiability of MLLMs. However, current RAG and SFT-based methods struggle to achieve robust cross-modal reasoning, causing imprecise visual citations or decoupling between the citation and the generated answers. To address these limitations, we propose MCite-RL, a citation-enhanced agentic reinforcement learning framework designed for reliable multimodal RAG. MCite-RL introduces an Agentic Refinement module for visual citation that employs iterative retrieval, reasoning, and recursive cropping to progressively narrow the search space, transforming citation into a dynamic, evidence-driven reasoning process rather than a static step. Furthermore, we incorporate a Citation-enhanced Reward mechanism that integrates both process-level and outcome-level feedback within a reinforcement learning paradigm to jointly optimize answer accuracy and source traceability. Extensive experiments on benchmarks such as Wiki-VISA, FinRAGBench-V, and MMLongBench-Doc demonstrate that MCite-RL effectively achieves the joint optimization of citation precision and answer quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MCite-RL：面向多模态 RAG 的视觉引用增强强化学习框架，通过迭代检索、推理与递归裁剪提升引用精度，并联合优化答案质量与证据可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 RAG 与基于 SFT 的方法在跨模态推理上不够稳健，容易出现视觉引用不准确，或生成答案与引用证据脱节的问题，影响 MLLM 输出的可验证性与可追溯性。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：其一是 Agentic Refinement 模块，将视觉引用建模为动态证据驱动过程，通过迭代检索、推理和递归裁剪逐步缩小视觉证据搜索空间；其二是 Citation-enhanced Reward 机制，在强化学习框架中结合过程级与结果级反馈，同时优化回答准确性和来源可追溯性。
AI.result: 在 Wiki-VISA、FinRAGBench-V 和 MMLongBench-Doc 等基准上的实验表明，MCite-RL 能有效提升视觉引用精度和答案质量，实现二者的联合优化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将视觉引用过程代理化并引入引用增强奖励，可以缓解多模态 RAG 中答案与证据脱耦的问题，为可靠、可追溯的多模态生成提供了有效方案。

title: 3D Point Cloud from Close-Range Photogrammetry for Defect Characterisation of Rubberised Concrete
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Published in the International Archives of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences, XXV ISPRS Congress 2026, Toronto, Canada
summary: While three-dimensional (3D) point clouds are widely used in civil engineering, mainstream LiDAR systems such as Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) are physically constrained to laboratory environments. Since their laser spot size typically exceeds the width of microcracks, the beam physically bridges over voids, rendering TLS unsuitable for fine-scale defect analysis. Alternatively, close-range photogrammetry utilising Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) algorithms offers a solution for testing highly tortuous materials, and its utility at fine-scale remains underexplored. This study adapts photogrammetric workflows specifically for rubberised concrete (RuC), a sustainable composite exhibiting high ductility and complex fracture morphologies. High-resolution image sets were captured using a Canon DSLR and an iPhone 16 to generate dense 3D models. Comparisons revealed that the DSLR-based reconstruction achieved sub-millimetre resolution, demonstrating superior performance for fine-scale surface monitoring. An RGB-guided crack extraction method was developed to enhance the identification of surface defects and isolate potential crack areas from the background. The extracted crack regions were visually distinguishable and provided a well-structured geometrical representation of defect morphology. Furthermore, a Pre and Post-Test deformation analysis was conducted to quantify surface displacement across testing stages. The results confirm that this close-range photogrammetry workflow is a flexible, high-resolution alternative to LiDAR for surface inspection and deformation monitoring of specimens in laboratory settings. Ultimately, this approach establishes a robust geometric baseline for future automated 3D feature characterisation and material performance evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一种面向橡胶混凝土细尺度裂缝与变形监测的近景摄影测量流程，可作为实验室条件下LiDAR/TLS的高分辨率替代方案。
AI.motivation: 传统三维点云技术中，TLS等主流LiDAR系统受激光光斑尺寸限制，难以识别宽度小于光斑的微裂缝；而基于SfM/MVS的近景摄影测量在高曲折性材料细尺度缺陷分析中的潜力尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 研究针对橡胶混凝土构件设计摄影测量工作流，分别使用Canon DSLR和iPhone 16采集高分辨率图像并重建稠密三维模型；比较不同设备的重建精度；提出RGB引导的裂缝提取方法以分离裂缝区域；并开展试验前后变形分析以量化表面位移。
AI.result: DSLR方案实现了亚毫米级重建分辨率，在细尺度表面监测方面优于手机方案；RGB引导方法能够生成视觉上清晰且几何结构较完整的裂缝区域；试验前后分析可量化表面位移变化。
AI.conclusion: 近景摄影测量能够在实验室环境中灵活、高分辨率地替代LiDAR用于表面缺陷检测和变形监测，并为后续自动化三维特征表征与材料性能评估提供可靠几何基础。

title: Quantifying geographic domain shift to decouple the geospatial transferability of human mobility flow generation models
summary: Human mobility serves as an essential proxy for understanding social, economic, and environmental dynamics in urban systems. Geospatial transferability, which measures a model's capability in a new location or unseen region, is a critical dimension for comparing different human mobility generation models. However, few studies have studied the intrinsic characteristics of geospatial transferability. To this end, this study systematically investigates the geospatial transferability of four representative human mobility generation models using a large-scale benchmark dataset of census tract level commuting flows across 2265 counties in the United States. Inspired by the domain adaptation theory in machine learning, we introduce geographic domain shift to describe the intrinsic differences in geographic feature distributions and spatial structures between source and target regions, which may jointly affect model transferability. Moreover, we propose two metrics, mutual information and spatial shift, to quantify the geographic domain shift. To examine their associations with model transferability, we employ linear mixed-effects regression to analyze the associations between geographic domain shifts and transferability. Our results reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity and asymmetry in transfer performance across regions. Both information shift and spatial shift exhibit statistically significant and complementary explanatory power. This indicates that geospatial transferability depends not only on model design but also on intrinsic geographic differences. These findings provide a novel methodological framework for evaluating and improving the geospatial transferability of human mobility generation models and support more robust and fair human mobility data synthesis across diverse regions. It also offers insights on spatial transferability for GeoAI model development.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究人类出行生成模型的地理空间可迁移性，提出“地理域偏移”概念及互信息、空间偏移两个量化指标，并用线性混合效应回归验证其与迁移性能的关系。
AI.motivation: 人类出行数据可反映城市系统中的社会、经济与环境动态，但现有研究较少关注出行生成模型在新地区或未见区域中的地理空间可迁移性及其内在影响因素。
AI.method: 研究使用大规模通勤流基准数据，评估四类代表性人类出行生成模型；借鉴机器学习中的领域自适应理论，定义源区域与目标区域在地理特征分布和空间结构上的差异为地理域偏移；提出互信息与空间偏移两个指标进行量化；采用线性混合效应回归分析地理域偏移与模型迁移性能之间的关联。
AI.result: 实验发现，不同区域之间的迁移性能存在显著空间异质性与非对称性；信息偏移和空间偏移均具有统计显著且互补的解释能力。
AI.conclusion: 地理空间可迁移性不仅取决于模型结构与设计，也受到区域间内在地理差异的影响。该研究为评估和提升人类出行生成模型的地理迁移能力提供了方法框架，并对GeoAI模型的空间迁移研究具有启发意义。

title: Convergence in Science, Divergence in Religion: Calibrated Framing Differences Across Wikipedia's Language Editions
summary: When Wikipedia's language editions describe the same concept, how differently do they frame it? Prior work measures coverage gaps between editions; we measure framing distance for matched concepts. We analyze 2,799 valid articles from 3,000 possible concept-language observations, spanning 150 Wikidata-anchored concepts, 20 language editions, 4 domains, and a calibration set. Raw embedding distances reflect both content differences and how well the encoder aligns each language pair. Even among calibration concepts with stable cross-cultural denotations (e.g., chemical elements, numbers, colors), the largest language-pair mean distance is 3.6 times the smallest, and distances are typically smaller within language families. We define a baseline-adjusted distance (calibrated distance): the distance between two language versions of a concept minus the mean distance for calibration concepts in the same language pair. This adjustment substantially reduces pair-specific alignment differences and the language-family pattern. Across three multilingual encoders (LaBSE, multilingual MPNet, and CMLM), scientific articles align more closely than calibration articles, and all three rank religion first and science/technology last. Concept-level rankings are highly consistent across encoders (Spearman rho=0.75-0.79 for MPNet and CMLM relative to LaBSE). Religion lies significantly above the calibration baseline under LaBSE. Within politics, divergence concentrates on concepts such as censorship and refugee, while democracy and human rights are among the most aligned. Code, data, and per-language-pair calibration baselines are released.\footnote{https://github.com/hhchen1105/cross-linqual-concept}

title: EXPL-FR: Explaining Face Recognition Models via Vision-Language Alignment
summary: Deep face recognition (FR) models reach near-saturated accuracy but remain opaque: a practitioner cannot ask which semantic attributes a similarity score relied upon. EXPL-FR answers this inside the FR model's own embedding space. A lightweight adapter aligns a vision-language model's (VLM) image encoder with the frozen FR space, trained on face images alone and never on text. Because the VLM's encoders share one space, the same adapter applies to the text encoder, turning 978 attribute prompts in 22 categories, also extendable, into FR-space anchors at no extra cost. We do not assume this transfer works: a face-verification protocol measures it, and an ablation changing only the adapter isolates its contribution. Not every concept survives, because an FR model earns its invariances by discarding the factors it must verify identities across. A label-free detectability measure compares each concept's separability in FR space against the VLM space, and the 100 most detectable form the model's readable semantic signature, which separates identities better than the full vocabulary. We cover four FR backbones and two VLM encoders, EXPL-FR needs no architecture access, and supports identity-level, per-image, and differential explanations. We benchmark attribute-level auditing under three supervision settings, human labels (current practice), VLM pseudo-labels, and our fully prompt-driven audit, against real verification behavior. With no labels, the prompt-driven audit ranks four FR models by their measured per-ethnicity RFW errors and ranks controlled attribute changes by their true verification cost.
