title: A Reproducible, License-Aware Distillation Recipe for CPUDeployable Safety Classification
summary: Deploying a safety layer for large language models on commodity hardware is constrained by the guards available to do it: current open guard models hold between 1 and 9 billion parameters, are oriented toward the graphics processing unit, and answer in seconds per request on a central processing unit. This paper presents a reproducible, license-aware knowledge-distillation recipe addressing that constraint. A strong open guard labels a corpus of roughly 97,000 prompts, drawn from 24 public datasets, into seven safety categories aligned to a public hazard taxonomy, and a fleet of small students spanning lexical, shallow, encoder and generative architectures is trained to reproduce that signal. The corpus is partitioned at the license boundary, so that a deployable and a research model differ only in their training data and the cost of that restriction becomes measurable. Every model is scored against an independent gold benchmark of 6,361 rows over four slices, labeled apart from the teacher and including a slice of harmless prompts that makes over-defense measurable. The distilled students match the teachers on adversarial text within overlapping confidence intervals and reduce false alarms on harmless prompts, the smallest generative student reaching 3.8% against 4.8% for the 8-billion-parameter teacher, while the encoder classifies in roughly 24 ms per request on CPU. Per-class rebalancing is the only decisive ingredient of the recipe. No superiority over the distilled guards is claimed; on the clean reference slice they remain ahead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可复现、关注许可证边界的知识蒸馏流程，将大型安全守卫模型的能力迁移到可在 CPU/通用硬件上快速运行的小模型。
AI.motivation: 现有开源安全守卫模型参数量大、偏向 GPU 部署，在 CPU 上响应慢，限制了大语言模型安全层在低成本通用硬件上的实际应用。
AI.method: 使用强开源守卫模型为约 9.7 万条来自 24 个公开数据集的提示打上七类安全标签；按许可证边界划分语料，训练词法、浅层、编码器和生成式等多类小学生模型；在独立人工/非教师标注的 6361 条黄金基准上评估，并包含无害提示切片以衡量过度防御。
AI.result: 蒸馏学生模型在对抗文本上与教师模型置信区间重叠，降低了无害提示误报；最小生成式学生误报率 3.8%，优于 8B 教师的 4.8%；编码器模型在 CPU 上约 24 ms/请求。逐类重平衡是唯一决定性因素。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏可显著降低安全守卫部署成本并保持接近教师的表现，但论文不声称学生全面优于教师；在干净参考切片上教师仍领先。

title: Do Large Language Models Perform Well on Comprehending Poetic Logic in Modern Chinese Poetry?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved significant progress across a wide range of natural language processing (NLP) tasks, yet their ability to understand literary texts, particularly modern Chinese poetry, remains largely unexplored. The unique literary characteristics of modern Chinese poetry necessitate a distinct form of reasoning for effective comprehension. Unlike conventional texts that convey clear information, the unique "poetic logic" of modern Chinese poetry requires a holistic reasoning approach that goes beyond superficial semantic analysis to be understood. However, current evaluation paradigms largely ignore this critical dimension. To address this gap, we propose Peony, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating the poetic logic of modern Chinese poetry. We define poetic logic as four tasks across three levels, namely stanza, line, and imagery, and systematically evaluate and analyze six mainstream LLMs based on Peony. We evaluate these models under both non-thinking and thinking configurations. The experimental results reveal the limitations of current LLMs in understanding the poetic logic of modern Chinese poetry and validate the effectiveness and necessity of Peony. Our data and code will be available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Peony，首个面向现代汉语诗歌“诗性逻辑”理解能力评测的基准，并用其评估六个主流大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在通用 NLP 任务上表现突出，但对文学文本，尤其现代汉语诗歌的理解能力研究不足；现代汉语诗歌依赖整体性的诗性逻辑，而现有评测范式多停留在表层语义，忽视这一关键能力。
AI.method: 作者将诗性逻辑定义为跨越诗节、诗行和意象三个层级的四类任务，构建 Peony 基准；在非思考与思考两种配置下，对六个主流大语言模型进行系统评测与分析。
AI.result: 实验显示，当前主流大语言模型在理解现代汉语诗歌的诗性逻辑方面仍存在明显局限；同时，结果验证了 Peony 基准的有效性与必要性。
AI.conclusion: Peony 填补了现代汉语诗歌诗性逻辑评测的空白，为评估和改进大语言模型的文学理解与深层推理能力提供了专门工具。

title: TASSO: TAsk-Specific Subspace Optimization for Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot capabilities, making them an attractive solution for continual learning across diverse tasks. However, during continual adaptation, both catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation occur, severely degrading performance. In this paper, we introduce TASSO, a new paradigm that efficiently preserves the latent space geometry while ensuring network plasticity. We achieve this with two complementary techniques: subspace learning and geometry-aware knowledge distillation. Specifically, we first learn a sequence of task-specific low-rank projectors, which we use to project the latent representations before optimizing cross-entropy. Secondly, we employ a geodesic-distance-based loss that distills knowledge from the previous-task model while effectively preserving the latent space geometry. These design choices not only avoid unnecessary parameter updates along the full embedding dimensions but also improve learning by focusing on task-specific manifolds. Moreover, the geometry-aware distillation provides strong regularization and significantly reduces both catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation throughout the continual learning sequence. Experimental results with the CLIP vision language model in the multi-domain task incremental and class incremental learning benchmarks demonstrate clear improvements over state-of-the-art methods in mitigating forgetting and preserving zero-shot capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TASSO，用于视觉语言模型的连续学习，通过保持潜在空间几何结构并维持模型可塑性，缓解灾难性遗忘和零样本能力退化。
AI.motivation: VLM 具备强零样本能力，适合多任务连续学习；但持续适配过程中会出现灾难性遗忘和零样本性能下降，影响模型在新旧任务上的稳定表现。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：一是子空间学习，学习一系列任务特定的低秩投影器，在交叉熵优化前投影潜在表示；二是几何感知知识蒸馏，使用基于测地距离的损失从上一任务模型蒸馏知识，以保持潜在空间几何。
AI.result: 在基于 CLIP 的多域任务增量学习和类别增量学习基准上，TASSO 相比现有方法更有效地减少遗忘，并更好地保留零样本能力。
AI.conclusion: TASSO 通过任务特定低秩子空间与几何结构保持型蒸馏相结合，在连续学习中兼顾稳定性与可塑性，是提升 VLM 持续适配性能的有效范式。

title: Robust Lightweight Deep Learning Models for Oral Cancer Screening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, Paper accepted for the 6th International Conference on AI-ML Systems, 2026
summary: Oral cancer is a leading cause of mortality in low-to-middle-income countries, where a shortage of specialists delays diagnosis. While point-of-care screening via smartphones offers a scalable solution, developing robust AI for resource-constrained settings poses significant challenges, including class imbalance in training data, variable data quality, and computational constraints on edge devices. In this paper, we present the optimisation of lightweight deep learning models for smartphone-based oral cancer screening. Using a diverse, multi-centre retrospective dataset of approximately 30,000 images acquired over a decade, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art convolutional, transformer, and hybrid architectures. Through rigorous pipeline ablation, we demonstrate that directly optimising hybrid architectures for the edge strictly outperforms computationally heavy paradigms, such as large models or knowledge distillation. Furthermore, interpretability analysis and simulated noise-stress tests revealed that the system anchors on clinical features and remains robust to unstructured sensor noise, despite vulnerabilities to impulse bit errors. In the held-out test set, our optimised MobileViTv2 models achieved an average sensitivity of 83.2 $\pm$ 1.5% and an average specificity of 86.0 $\pm$ 0.8%, with the best model exhibiting 87.4% sensitivity, 86.5% specificity, and a critical negative predictive value of 97.2% with reference to specialist labels. These results confirm that with targeted architectural selection and streamlined optimisation, interpretable and robust lightweight AI models exhibit high potential for edge deployment to enable automated triage in primary care settings.

AI.tldr: 本文优化用于智能手机端口腔癌筛查的轻量级深度学习模型，证明面向边缘设备直接优化混合架构可在性能、鲁棒性与可解释性之间取得较好平衡。
AI.motivation: 低中等收入地区口腔癌死亡率高，专科医生不足导致诊断延迟；智能手机端即时筛查具有可扩展性，但面临训练数据类别不平衡、数据质量差异以及边缘设备计算资源受限等挑战。
AI.method: 使用约3万张、跨中心、历时十年的回顾性口腔图像数据，系统比较卷积网络、Transformer与混合架构；通过流程消融实验评估模型优化策略，并结合可解释性分析和噪声压力测试评估模型关注区域与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 优化后的MobileViTv2模型在独立测试集上平均敏感性为83.2±1.5%，平均特异性为86.0±0.8%；最佳模型达到87.4%敏感性、86.5%特异性，以及相对于专科标签97.2%的阴性预测值。模型对非结构化传感器噪声较稳健，但对脉冲位错误存在脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 针对边缘部署进行架构选择与精简优化，比依赖大模型或知识蒸馏更有效；轻量、可解释且鲁棒的AI模型有望用于基层医疗中的自动分诊与口腔癌筛查。

title: Training a Knowledge Base: Supervised Structure Learning for Agent-Curated Document Stores
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation treats the document store as a frozen input, and the systems that instead let an agent curate one never measure what curation does to the store. We invert the framing: the knowledge base is the model. A training agent answers a supervised question against the current store, is shown the gold, then edits the store; an unchanged reader is later examined on a frozen snapshot under a fixed action budget. Where offline graph construction is unsupervised, (question, answer) pairs are our labels -- and that supervision is what makes the structure cheap. Per point of corpus indexed it returns 1.6x the action saving and 1.8x the accuracy of an unsupervised entity index covering everything, using 1,913 links against its 196,112. On questions the store trained on, an unchanged reader spends 31% fewer actions at higher accuracy, and the result reproduces on an official PhantomWiki generation whose questions we did not write. To measure how far this reaches we introduce a key-coverage gradient, a probe varying how much of a question the training set touched, replacing a train/test split's pass/fail with a decay curve. Generalization proves endpoint-dependent: accuracy carries to unseen questions (+0.167 F1 where both of a question's keys were indexed, +0.100 where one was, zero where neither) while the action saving stays on trained questions. Because that decay is indexed by coverage rather than by novelty, more training extends it -- and the store is undertrained, not saturated: coverage grows linearly in new questions and stops the moment training repeats them, so a hundred questions reach a quarter of the corpus and four times as many would close the gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将知识库视为可训练对象：智能体在监督问答后编辑文档库，使冻结读者在固定预算下更高效作答。实验显示，经监督策展的轻量链接结构在单位索引成本上优于无监督实体索引，并能提升准确率与减少动作数。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强生成通常把文档库当作静态输入；即便有系统允许智能体维护知识库，也很少定量评估这种维护对知识库结构与后续推理效率的影响。作者希望研究：通过监督问答信号训练知识库结构，是否能以更低成本提升检索与问答性能。
AI.method: 训练阶段，智能体基于当前知识库回答监督问题，看到标准答案后编辑知识库；测试阶段，冻结知识库快照和读者模型，在固定动作预算下评估表现。作者用问答对作为监督标签来构建结构化链接，并提出 key-coverage gradient，通过问题关键要素在训练集中被覆盖的程度来刻画泛化衰减。
AI.result: 相较覆盖全语料的无监督实体索引，监督策展方法仅使用 1,913 条链接对比 196,112 条链接，却在单位语料索引点上获得 1.6 倍动作节省和 1.8 倍准确率。在训练问题上，冻结读者动作数减少 31% 且准确率更高；在外部生成数据上结果可复现。泛化方面，两个关键要素均被索引时 F1 提升 0.167，一个被索引时提升 0.100，均未覆盖时无提升。
AI.conclusion: 知识库不应只被视为静态检索对象，而可以作为被监督训练和优化的模型组成部分。监督信号能以低成本塑造有用结构，提升读者效率与准确率；其泛化取决于关键覆盖率而非简单训练/测试划分。当前知识库仍处于欠训练状态，增加训练问题可线性扩展覆盖并进一步提升效果。

title: DamageScope: Vision-Language Retrieval at Scale for Disaster Damage Assessment from Satellite Imagery
summary: Timely and accurate assessment of property damage is critical following natural disasters. Traditional on-site inspections are labor-intensive, costly, and often pose safety risks. Advances in satellite imagery and vision-language models (VLMs) enable scalable remote damage assessment; however, integrating VLMs into large-scale Earth observation pipelines presents challenges in computational efficiency, data organization, and information retrieval. To address these challenges, we present DamageScope, a retrieval-augmented framework that combines satellite imagery with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate property damage analysis. Built on a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, DamageScope extracts structured visual representations from satellite imagery to support interactive natural language queries for damage assessment. To address scalability, we introduce a novel multi-vector embedding-based clustering algorithm that outperforms traditional single-vector embedding approaches while reducing indexing time by up to 14x. Furthermore, a dual-store data architecture minimizes LLM API calls, reducing both operational cost and response latency by up to approximately 3x. By effectively balancing scalability and operational efficiency, DamageScope provides a robust and practical solution for real-world damage assessment tasks.

AI.tldr: DamageScope 是一个面向灾后财产损毁评估的检索增强框架，结合卫星图像、视觉语言模型和大语言模型，实现可扩展、低成本、低延迟的自动化分析。
AI.motivation: 传统现场勘查耗时、昂贵且存在安全风险；虽然卫星影像与视觉语言模型可支持远程评估，但在大规模地球观测场景中仍面临计算效率、数据组织和信息检索方面的挑战。
AI.method: 论文提出 DamageScope：基于 RAG 架构，从卫星影像中提取结构化视觉表示，并支持自然语言交互查询；同时提出多向量嵌入聚类算法以提升索引与检索效率，并设计双存储数据架构以减少 LLM API 调用。
AI.result: 多向量嵌入聚类方法相比传统单向量嵌入方法表现更优，并将索引时间最多降低 14 倍；双存储架构将运营成本和响应延迟最多约降低 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: DamageScope 在可扩展性、效率和实用性之间取得较好平衡，可作为现实场景中灾后财产损毁远程评估的有效解决方案。

title: Data-Driven Dynamic Algorithm Dispatch with Large Language Models
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2025 IEEE High Performance Extreme Computing Conference (HPEC). Outstanding Short Paper Award
summary: We introduce a large language model (LLM)-driven approach for generating dynamic algorithmic dispatch heuristics in high-performance linear algebra. By combining prompt engineering with LLaMA 3 and a curated performance database, the model learns to synthesize selection heuristics that exploit structural patterns to identify fast algorithmic choices. A case study on LU factorization demonstrates the model's ability to replicate expert-designed strategies. This work, developed as part of the DARPA-MIT SmartSolve project, highlights the promise of LLMs for algorithmic discovery and the development of more adaptive, fast linear algebra software.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由大语言模型驱动的方法，用于为高性能线性代数生成动态算法调度启发式规则。
AI.motivation: 高性能线性代数中，不同问题结构和硬件/性能条件会影响最优算法选择，传统专家手工设计的调度策略成本高、适应性有限。作者希望利用大语言模型从性能数据中学习结构性模式，自动生成更灵活的算法选择规则。
AI.method: 结合提示工程、LLaMA 3 模型与经过整理的性能数据库，让模型综合性能样本和结构特征，生成用于选择快速算法实现的启发式调度策略。论文以 LU 分解作为案例研究，评估模型生成策略与专家设计策略的一致性和有效性。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，该方法能够复现专家设计的 LU 分解算法选择策略，并识别有利于快速算法选择的结构性模式，体现出在算法调度自动化方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可作为算法发现和性能调优的辅助工具，有望推动更自适应、更高效的线性代数软件开发，但摘要中尚未给出定量性能指标、泛化能力和鲁棒性评估细节。

title: GUI-Primitives: Diagnosing Spatial Reasoning Failures in Vision-Language GUI Grounding
summary: Computer-use agents ground natural-language instructions in screenshots to locate interface elements, yet existing benchmarks do not isolate whether models bind relational language to the correct element. We introduce GUI-Primitives, a 994-item benchmark of contrastive instruction pairs over seven spatial relations in graphical user interfaces (left/right, above/below, containment, alignment, proximity, list ordinal, occlusion). Each pair holds the screenshot and anchor fixed while changing the relation expression, so the correct target moves between two designated candidates. Five annotators validate a 196-item subset ($κ= 0.94$ well-formedness; $κ= 0.79$ target selection). Nineteen vision-language models reach at most $32\%$ strict point-in-box accuracy. Because models emit unconstrained coordinates, we classify each prediction by the candidate region it falls within. Predictions fall outside both candidates on $60-92\%$ of items. Conditional on falling within a candidate region, target selection reaches 0.82-0.90 for horizontal position, vertical position, proximity, and list ordinal, but does not differ significantly from 0.50 for containment and occlusion: most failures reflect candidate localization rather than relation understanding. Across ten models, benchmark accuracy correlates with ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy (Spearman $ρ= +0.74$), an exploratory association at this sample size. Marking the two designated candidates raises selection accuracy by 35--57 percentage points, an oracle diagnostic that supplies the candidate set rather than a deployable method. We release the benchmark, predictions, and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GUI-Primitives：一个用于检验计算机使用智能体是否真正理解 GUI 截图中空间关系语言的对比式基准。结果显示，多数模型主要失败在候选目标定位，而非在已定位候选内的关系选择。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI/屏幕定位基准通常评估模型能否根据自然语言在截图中点击正确元素，但难以隔离模型是否真正把关系表达（如左/右、包含、遮挡、序数等）绑定到正确界面元素。作者希望构造一个更精确的诊断基准，专门检验关系语言理解与目标定位之间的差异。
AI.method: 作者构建了包含 994 个样本的 GUI-Primitives 基准，每个样本为对比式指令对：固定截图和锚点，仅改变空间关系表达，使正确目标在两个指定候选元素之间切换。覆盖七类空间关系：左右、上下、包含、对齐、邻近、列表序数、遮挡。对 196 个子集进行五人标注验证，并测试 19 个视觉语言模型。由于模型输出自由坐标，作者进一步将预测点归类为落入哪个候选区域或落在候选外。
AI.result: 19 个视觉语言模型的严格 point-in-box 准确率最高仅为 32%。在 60%–92% 的样本中，模型预测落在两个候选区域之外。若只看预测落入候选区域的样本，模型在水平位置、垂直位置、邻近关系和列表序数上的目标选择准确率可达 0.82–0.90；但在包含和遮挡关系上与随机水平 0.50 无显著差异。十个模型在该基准上的准确率与 ScreenSpot-Pro 准确率呈探索性正相关（Spearman ρ=+0.74）。将两个候选元素显式标记后，选择准确率提升 35–57 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: GUI-Primitives 表明，当前视觉语言模型在 GUI 指令 grounding 中的主要瓶颈往往是候选界面元素的定位，而不是所有关系类型上的关系理解；但包含和遮挡等复杂关系仍存在理解困难。该基准可作为诊断工具，用于区分定位能力与关系语义绑定能力，并推动更稳健的计算机使用智能体研究。

title: presto: Efficient, Training-free, and Open-world Object Placement via Imaginary Search
summary: Object placement is critical in image composition, requiring spatially and semantically coherent positioning of objects within diverse scenes. Existing approaches typically rely on hand-crafted rules or supervised learning on limited datasets, which restricts their generalization and interpretability, especially in open-world scenarios involving novel objects and scenes. In this work, we reformulate open-world object placement as a heuristic search task guided by reasoning from a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). We introduce \textsf{presto}, a zero-shot, training-free framework that operates within an imaginary action space to iteratively refine object position and scale. Our coarse-to-fine search strategy ensures fast convergence, and we evaluate two decision-making variants: Metric-guided Selection and MLLM-as-a-judge. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that \textsf{presto}~achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly in previously unseen, open-world settings. Human studies further reveal that the MLLM-as-a-judge variant produces more perceptually coherent placements than metric-driven approaches, highlighting a gap between standard evaluation metrics and human visual judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 presto：一种零样本、免训练的开放世界目标放置框架，将物体位置与尺度优化建模为由多模态大语言模型推理引导的启发式搜索任务。
AI.motivation: 现有目标放置方法多依赖人工规则或有限数据集上的监督学习，导致在新物体、新场景等开放世界条件下泛化能力和可解释性不足；同时，标准指标与人类对构图合理性的感知判断可能存在差距。
AI.method: 作者将开放世界目标放置重构为启发式搜索问题，在“想象动作空间”中迭代调整目标的位置与尺度，并采用由粗到细的搜索策略提升收敛速度。框架包含两种决策变体：基于指标引导的选择，以及将 MLLM 作为裁判来评估候选放置方案。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，presto 取得了当前最优性能，尤其在未见过的开放世界设置中表现突出。人类评测显示，MLLM-as-a-judge 变体相比纯指标驱动方法能产生更符合感知一致性的目标放置。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，利用 MLLM 的语义与空间推理能力可以在无需训练的情况下有效解决开放世界目标放置问题；同时也揭示了传统自动评价指标与人类视觉判断之间的不足与差异。

title: K-Bench: measuring model performance on real scientific agent requests
summary: Benchmarks for scientific artificial intelligence are mostly written to be scored: multiple-choice questions, curated agent tasks with reference solutions, or simulators with a known generative structure. Real scientific requests arrive differently. They are underspecified, they carry attachments, and lack ground truth. We report K-Bench 01, an evaluation built from first-turn requests sampled from live user traffic on K-Dense Web and run end to end by nine frontier models in identical sandboxes, yielding 1,602 completed agent runs. Three blinded language-model judges scored every run against an eight-dimension rubric. On a rubric whose 8-anchor instructs judges that a domain scientist would accept the work with minor edits, no model clears the line under all three judges. gpt-5.6-sol has the highest pooled mean, 8.04, but its 95% interval [7.80, 8.23] spans the threshold, and two of the three judges rank claude-opus-5 first instead. We therefore report the ordering of systems as the reproducible quantity, the absolute level as an attribute of the instrument, and the top of the table as unresolved. Across all 39,934 scored judgments -- the eight dimension scores plus a holistic overall for each assessment, excluding not-applicable cells -- 47.6% fall below the 8-point threshold. Difficulty is not uniform across the rubric: scientific accuracy averages 6.22 against 7.33 for communication, on identical denominators and in the same direction within every one of the nine models. The single leading failure tag is overclaiming, on 31.4% of assessments. We argue that the informative quantity for scientific agents is not a leaderboard position but the joint distribution of what was delivered, what was claimed, and what artifacts were produced.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 K-Bench 01，用真实首轮科学请求评估前沿智能体，发现现有模型在科学准确性与不过度声称方面仍不稳定，排行榜第一名并非最有信息量的结论。
AI.motivation: 现有科学 AI 基准多为选择题、带参考答案的任务或已知结构的模拟器，便于打分但与真实科学请求不一致；真实请求往往信息不完整、含附件、缺少标准答案，因此需要更贴近真实使用场景的端到端评估。
AI.method: 作者从 K-Dense Web 的真实用户流量中抽取首轮请求，构建 K-Bench 01；让九个前沿模型在相同沙盒环境中端到端完成任务，共得到 1,602 次智能体运行。每次结果由三名盲审语言模型评委依据八维评分规程评估，并包含整体评分、失败标签与产物分析。
AI.result: 没有模型在三名评委下稳定超过“领域科学家仅需小修即可接受”的 8 分线。gpt-5.6-sol pooled mean 最高为 8.04，但 95% 区间 [7.80, 8.23] 跨过阈值，且两名评委将 claude-opus-5 排第一。所有有效评分中 47.6% 低于 8 分；科学准确性均值 6.22，显著低于沟通表达的 7.33；最主要失败标签是过度声称，占 31.4%。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为，科学智能体评估的核心不应是单一排行榜名次，而应是交付内容、声称内容与实际产物之间的联合分布；当前前沿模型在真实科学任务中仍存在准确性不足和过度声称等关键问题。

title: PUMA: A Polish Benchmark for Culturally Grounded Multimodal Understanding
summary: Large language models are increasingly moving beyond text processing, adding support for other modalities such as images and audio. While text understanding and generation have been extensively studied, multimodal data processing capabilities, particularly in the context of cultures and languages other than English, have not yet been evaluated comprehensively. In this paper, we propose PUMA (Polish Unified Multimodal Assessment), a novel benchmark of 900 hand-crafted tasks designed to probe the limits of multimodal models in the Polish cultural and linguistic context. The dataset evaluates both cultural understanding and practical skill in processing text, images, audio, and visually rich documents. Our extensive evaluation of frontier commercial models, open-weights models, and specialized smaller systems highlights a significant performance gap. While top commercial models achieve high scores in visual question answering, most models struggle with complex audio or document understanding. We open-source our evaluation framework to advance localized multimodal AI research.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PUMA，一个面向波兰语言与文化语境的统一多模态评测基准，包含 900 个手工设计任务，用于评估多模态模型在文本、图像、音频和视觉文档上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型逐步扩展到图像、音频等多模态输入，但非英语语境下，尤其是特定本地语言与文化背景中的多模态理解能力尚缺乏系统、全面的评估。
AI.method: 构建 PUMA 基准，覆盖文化理解与实用技能两类能力，任务涉及文本、图像、音频和视觉丰富文档；对前沿商业模型、开源权重模型以及专用小模型进行大规模评测比较。
AI.result: 评测显示模型之间存在显著性能差距：顶级商业模型在视觉问答方面表现较好，但多数模型在复杂音频理解和文档理解任务上表现不足。
AI.conclusion: PUMA 揭示了当前多模态模型在本地化语言文化场景中的能力短板，并通过开源评测框架推动本地化多模态 AI 研究。

title: Extending the Horizon of Early Diagnosis: Lung Cancer Prediction with Vision Transformers
summary: Lung cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and early diagnosis is critical for improving survival. However, early-stage malignancies can be subtle on chest X-rays, creating challenges for radiologists. This study evaluates Vision Transformers (ViTs) for predicting lung cancer one to two years before clinical diagnosis. We analyzed 259,361 chest X-rays from 91,020 imaging studies at the Jamaica Plains VA Hospital in Boston, MA. The dataset showed extreme class imbalance, approximately 1:150 cancer to non-cancer, which was addressed using hybrid under- and over-sampling and class-weighted loss optimization. Three ViT configurations were evaluated: a model trained from scratch, an ImageNet-pretrained model, and a Corona-pretrained model fine-tuned on the lung cancer dataset. Transfer learning improved performance, with pretrained models exceeding the scratch baseline by 6-10 percentage points in AUC and about 10-12 percent in balanced accuracy. ImageNet-pretrained models showed the most stable overall performance, while Corona-pretrained models achieved higher sensitivity in some settings but greater variability. Moderate resampling ratios, including 1:1 undersampling and 1.5:2 oversampling, provided favorable trade-offs between sensitivity, precision, and computational efficiency, reducing runtime by up to 70 percent without major performance loss. These findings demonstrate the potential of ViTs for early lung cancer risk prediction from routine chest X-rays. Although performance remains below clinical deployment thresholds, the results support further development of ViT-based triage systems to flag high-risk patients for earlier evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文评估视觉Transformer用于在临床诊断前1–2年基于常规胸片预测肺癌风险，迁移学习模型较从头训练表现更优，但尚未达到临床部署水平。
AI.motivation: 肺癌死亡率高，早期诊断可显著改善生存；但早期恶性征象在胸部X光片中较隐匿，给放射科医生带来挑战，因此需要探索自动化早期风险预测方法。
AI.method: 研究使用259,361张胸部X光片、91,020次影像检查；针对约1:150的严重类别不平衡，采用混合欠采样/过采样与类别加权损失优化。比较三种ViT配置：从头训练、ImageNet预训练后微调、Corona预训练后微调，并评估不同重采样比例下的AUC、平衡准确率、敏感性、精确率与运行效率。
AI.result: 迁移学习显著提升性能，预训练模型相比从头训练AUC提高6–10个百分点，平衡准确率提高约10–12%。ImageNet预训练模型整体最稳定；Corona预训练模型在部分设置下敏感性更高但波动更大。适度重采样（如1:1欠采样、1.5:2过采样）在敏感性、精确率和效率之间取得较好折中，运行时间最多减少约70%且性能损失较小。
AI.conclusion: ViT具备从常规胸片中进行肺癌早期风险预测的潜力，可作为高风险患者早期评估的辅助分诊工具；但当前性能仍低于临床部署门槛，需要进一步验证、优化和前瞻性研究。

title: Generate in the Chart, Not on the Boundary: Function-Symbol Grounding for Hard Constraints in LTN-GANs
summary: Logic Tensor Network-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Networks (LTN-GANs) inject background knowledge by grounding each logical axiom as a predicate and training the generator to raise its satisfaction, a fuzzy truth value in $[0,1]$. Previous LTN-GAN work grounded every constraint this way, at the predicate level, and improved constraint satisfaction. A predicate, however, only scores a sample, so it cannot embed hard structural constraints, rules such as orderings, positivity, and definitional identities that must hold in every generated sample. In this work, we investigate grounding each axiom as a function symbol inside the LTN framework. We compare against the state-of-the-art alternative, a constraint layer that clamps each violating sample onto the feasible boundary and so produces outputs that are always valid. Our investigation shows that a valid sample is not always a realistic one. An inequality is not merely satisfied or violated. It holds by a margin, and a faithful generator should also reproduce the margin's real distribution. We find that the resolution ratio $R$, the data's scale over the margin's spread, is a diagnostic, computable before training, of which constraints a chosen grounding can learn. When $R$ is large, the predicate receives no learning signal, the clamp pushes every sample onto the boundary, and the margin distribution is lost while every standard metric still looks fine. A function symbol avoids both failures, computing the constrained variable rather than scoring it. Together the function symbols form a chart, a coordinate system inside the feasible region, where every sample is valid by construction and the margin is learned like any other quantity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在 LTN-GAN 中将逻辑公理接地为函数符号而非谓词，以在生成样本中按构造满足硬结构约束，并更好保留真实数据中的约束裕度分布。
AI.motivation: 既有 LTN-GAN 多将约束作为谓词来给样本打分并提升模糊真值，但谓词只能判断满足程度，难以编码必须逐样本严格成立的结构约束，如顺序、正性和定义恒等式。约束层虽能通过投影/裁剪保证有效性，却可能破坏真实分布，尤其是约束裕度分布。
AI.method: 在 LTN 框架内把每个公理接地为函数符号，使生成器直接计算受约束变量；同时与将违规样本夹到可行边界的约束层方法对比，并引入分辨率比 R（数据尺度与裕度分布尺度之比）作为训练前可计算的诊断指标，用于判断不同接地方式能否学习相关约束。
AI.result: 研究发现，当 R 较大时，谓词接地几乎不给出有效学习信号；约束层虽然保证所有输出有效，但会把样本推到边界，导致裕度分布丢失，而常规评估指标仍可能表现正常。函数符号接地可避免这两类失败。
AI.conclusion: 函数符号可形成可行域内部的坐标图，使样本按构造满足约束，并像学习普通变量一样学习约束裕度，从而比谓词接地和简单约束层更适合处理硬结构约束与真实分布保持问题。

title: HiDiffTIR: Hierarchical Difficulty-Aware Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) is a fundamental capability for LLM agents to solve complex tasks by interacting with external tools iteratively. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become the dominant paradigm for enabling this capability. However, existing approaches typically assign uniform trajectory-level advantages and treat all correct tool calls equally, ignoring the varying difficulty and learning value across trajectories and reasoning steps. This can lead to imprecise learning signals that do not adequately distinguish between trivial and challenging tool-use patterns. To address this limitation, we propose HiDiffTIR, a Hierarchical Difficulty-aware policy optimization framework for multi-turn TIR. HiDiffTIR performs difficulty-aware credit assignment at both trajectory and turn levels, enabling the policy to focus on more informative trajectories and harder reasoning steps. Notably, this fine-grained optimization is achieved without additional supervision, relying solely on group-level statistics derived from standard RL rollouts. Extensive experiments on three tool-using benchmarks demonstrate that HiDiffTIR consistently improves multi-turn TIR performance and tool invocation accuracy over strong RL baselines, highlighting the necessity of difficulty-aware credit assignment for effective policy optimization in tool-integrated LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HiDiffTIR，一种面向多轮工具集成推理的层级难度感知强化学习优化框架，通过轨迹级与轮次级难度感知信用分配提升 LLM 智能体的工具使用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的 TIR 方法通常对整条轨迹分配统一优势值，并将所有正确工具调用等同处理，忽略不同轨迹和推理步骤在难度与学习价值上的差异，导致学习信号不够精细，难以区分简单与复杂的工具使用模式。
AI.method: HiDiffTIR 在轨迹级和 turn 级同时进行难度感知信用分配，使策略优化更关注信息量更高的轨迹与更困难的推理步骤。该方法不依赖额外监督信号，仅利用标准 RL rollout 中的组级统计信息实现细粒度优化。
AI.result: 在三个工具使用基准上的大量实验表明，HiDiffTIR 相比强强化学习基线方法，在多轮 TIR 性能和工具调用准确率上均取得稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 难度感知信用分配对于工具集成 LLM 智能体的有效策略优化具有重要作用，HiDiffTIR 为多轮 TIR 场景提供了一种无需额外监督且更精细的强化学习优化方案。

title: Perturb the Thought, Not the Pixels: Latent-Space Rollout Diversification for Reinforcement Learning of Vision-Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning ability of vision-language models (VLMs), and diversifying the rollouts within each optimization group amplifies its gains. Existing approaches diversify through decoding temperature or pixel-space image distortion; we ask whether the perturbation belongs in the model's latent space instead. We introduce Noise-Contrastive GRPO (NC-GRPO), which injects scale-calibrated Gaussian noise into the last hidden layer of the prompt-encoding pass for half of each rollout group, branching those rollouts from a displaced departure state. Branches that reach the answer despite the displacement are reinforced over those derailed by it, converting sensitivity at the branch point into policy-gradient signal; the objective, reward, and inference protocol are untouched. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B trained on Geometry3K, NC-GRPO significantly improves out-of-domain mathematical reasoning over vanilla GRPO across five held-out benchmarks (pooled McNemar $p \le 0.001$) while also improving in-domain accuracy and hallucination robustness -- the latter an axis on which image-space noise regresses even while posting a larger OOD average on perception-heavy benchmarks. Mechanism ablations indicate that independent stochastic diversity, not noise budget or direction, is the active ingredient, and a noise-scale study exposes a dial between reasoning specialization and general capability. NC-GRPO is designed to be modality-agnostic and integrates into a standard RLVR pipeline as a ~50-line change to the inference engine.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NC-GRPO：在 RLVR/GRPO 训练中向提示编码阶段的最后隐藏层注入尺度校准的高斯噪声，以增加同组 rollout 的潜在空间多样性，从而提升视觉语言模型的数学推理与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 已有 RLVR 方法常通过解码温度或图像像素扰动来增加 rollout 多样性，但这些扰动可能不够稳定或会损害感知能力。作者希望探索：将扰动放在模型潜在空间是否能更有效地把分支点敏感性转化为策略梯度信号。
AI.method: 提出 Noise-Contrastive GRPO。具体做法是在每个优化组中，对一半 rollout 的 prompt-encoding pass 最后隐藏层加入尺度校准的高斯噪声，使其从偏移后的隐状态出发；奖励函数、目标函数和推理流程保持不变。若受扰分支仍能得到正确答案，则相对受扰失败分支获得强化。
AI.result: 在 Geometry3K 上训练 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 后，NC-GRPO 在五个保留基准上相较 vanilla GRPO 显著提升域外数学推理能力，合并 McNemar 检验 p≤0.001；同时提升域内准确率与幻觉鲁棒性。相比之下，图像空间噪声虽在偏感知的 OOD 基准上平均表现更高，但会削弱幻觉鲁棒性。消融显示独立随机多样性是关键因素，而非噪声预算或方向。
AI.conclusion: NC-GRPO 是一种简单、模态无关、易集成的 RLVR 增强方法，仅需对推理引擎做小规模修改即可通过潜在空间扰动提升 VLM 的推理泛化与鲁棒性，并提供噪声尺度作为调节推理专精与通用能力的旋钮。

title: Semantic Compression Trees: Multi-Resolution Knowledge Retrieval via Hierarchical Semantic Residuals
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation relies mostly on flat, fixed-granularity indexes: documents are cut into uniform chunks and retrieved by similarity, discarding the hierarchical structure of the source. We introduce Semantic Compression Trees (SCT), a hierarchical index in which each node stores only its semantic residual -- the information it adds beyond its parent -- and retrieval proceeds by progressive descent from the root, so that per-query cost is governed by tree depth rather than collection size.
  We evaluate on QASPER (50 papers, 173 questions) under two protocols differing only in whether the benchmark supplies the relevant document, with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired significance tests throughout. The results are mixed and we report them as such. When the document is given, SCT with a zero-LLM extractive compressor matches dense retrieval on answer quality (0.274 vs. 0.277 F1, $p = 0.37$) using 30% fewer context tokens and no LLM calls to build the index, and residual storage beats storing full summaries at each node (0.274 vs. 0.205, $p < 0.001$). Increasing the collection fifty-fold multiplies flat retrieval's per-query scoring work by 48.9x and SCT's by 6.4x.
  Progressive descent itself is not supported. Retrieving the same residuals without the tree performs identically when the document is given ($p = 0.27$), and descent is substantially worse when the system must select the document (0.122 vs. 0.165, $p < 0.001$). Routing accuracy localises the cause: descent selects the correct paper 20.2% of the time against 39.3% for flat retrieval, because that choice is made from the root residual, the most compressed node in the tree. We conclude that the residual representation is worth keeping and top-down routing is not.

AI.tldr: 论文提出语义压缩树（SCT）作为检索增强生成的层次化索引；实验显示语义残差表示有价值，但自顶向下的渐进式路由效果不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG检索多采用扁平、固定粒度索引，将文档切成均匀块并基于相似度检索，忽略了源文档的层次结构，且检索成本随集合规模增长。作者希望通过层次结构降低查询成本，并保留节点相对父节点新增的语义信息。
AI.method: 构建Semantic Compression Trees：每个节点仅存储相对于父节点的语义残差；检索时从根节点逐层向下选择。作者在QASPER数据集上评估两种协议：一种给定相关文档，另一种需要系统自行选择文档；使用bootstrap置信区间和配对显著性检验，并与稠密检索、非树式残差检索、完整摘要存储等方法比较。
AI.result: 在给定文档时，零LLM抽取式压缩的SCT与稠密检索答案质量相当（F1 0.274 vs. 0.277，p=0.37），上下文token减少30%，且无需LLM构建索引；残差存储显著优于每个节点存完整摘要（0.274 vs. 0.205，p<0.001）。集合扩大50倍时，扁平检索每查询评分工作量增加48.9倍，SCT增加6.4倍。但树式渐进下降本身未获支持：给定文档时，直接检索同样残差与树式检索无显著差异（p=0.27）；需要选文档时，下降式检索显著更差（0.122 vs. 0.165，p<0.001），正确选中文档率仅20.2%，低于扁平检索的39.3%。
AI.conclusion: SCT中的语义残差表示能够节省上下文并保持答案质量，且扩展性较好；但依赖根节点残差信息进行自顶向下路由会造成早期错误并降低文档选择准确率。因此，论文结论是应保留残差表示，而不应采用当前形式的自顶向下渐进路由。

title: The Chase Is the Curriculum, the Capture Anchors the Credit: Pursuit-Evasion Self-Play for Zero-Data LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the dominant recipe for improving large language model reasoning, yet it presumes large human-curated task collections. Zero-data self-play removes this dependency, but existing methods vet learnability only by probing candidates and rejecting post hoc, never learning where along an environment's difficulty axis to place a task, and credit the solver with sparse terminal rewards alone. We recast zero-data self-play as a pursuit-evasion game: in LURE, an LLM evader positions tasks along each environment's difficulty axis to stay one step ahead of a planner-executor pursuer that hunts it down through verifiable interaction. The evader is trained on a capture-frontier reward that peaks when the solver captures it on exactly half of its rollouts, turning barely catchable into a learned positioning strategy rather than a hand-tuned rejection band. The pursuer earns capture-anchored dense process credit, in which monotone verifier progress is group-normalized jointly with the terminal capture under a round-anchored KL that keeps the co-evolution stable. Across three verifiable reasoning environments and three backbone families, LURE outperforms advanced baselines under unified/specialist settings, while the unified model attains stronger aggregate OOD zero-shot accuracy than all trained baselines across nine held-out benchmarks from three task families.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出 LURE：一种面向可验证奖励强化学习的零数据自博弈框架，将任务生成与求解训练建模为追逃博弈，使任务难度自动保持在“刚好可学”的前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习依赖大量人工构造任务；零数据自博弈虽可减少依赖，但通常只是在生成后通过试探筛掉不合适任务，无法主动学习如何沿难度轴布置任务，并且求解器多只获得稀疏终端奖励，训练信号不足。
AI.method: 论文将零数据自博弈重构为追逃博弈。LURE 中，LLM 扮演 evader，负责沿环境难度轴放置任务；planner-executor pursuer 通过可验证交互尝试捕获任务。evader 使用 capture-frontier reward，当求解器在约一半 rollout 中成功时奖励最高；pursuer 使用 capture-anchored dense process credit，将单调验证器进展与终端捕获共同进行组归一化，并通过 round-anchored KL 稳定双方共同演化。
AI.result: 在三个可验证推理环境和三个 backbone family 上，LURE 在统一模型与专家模型设置下均优于高级基线；其统一模型在来自三个任务家族的九个 held-out benchmark 上取得比所有训练基线更强的整体 OOD zero-shot accuracy。
AI.conclusion: LURE 表明，通过学习化的难度定位与密集过程奖励，零数据自博弈可以更有效地提升大语言模型推理能力，并减少对人工任务集合的依赖，同时具备较好的跨任务泛化能力。

title: Semantic Slots for Video Object-Centric Learning
summary: Video Object-Centric Learning (OCL) has traditionally focused on refining the encoder architecture to ensure temporal consistency. In this paper, we argue that the primary bottleneck lies in the decoder. We show that traditional decoders force slots to be spatially anchored, hindering their ability to adapt to motion. We propose SemanticSlots, which uses a Transformer-based decoder that leverages image context, relieving slots from encoding boundary precision and spatial location. This allows slots to function as semantic queries that are inherently object position invariant, retrieving matching features rather than memorizing coordinates. More importantly, this property allows slots computed from a single frame to decompose subsequent video frames, eliminating the need for complex temporal predictors or auxiliary temporal losses. Results on YouTube-VIS show that SemanticSlots improves upon VideoSAUR by 31 points in mBO and outperforms current state-of-the-art methods by 21 points, achieving 86.6% ARI and 62.8% mBO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SemanticSlots，将视频对象中心学习的瓶颈从编码器转向解码器，证明基于 Transformer 的上下文解码可显著提升跨帧对象分解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 Video OCL 方法主要通过改进编码器或加入时序预测/损失来保证时间一致性，但作者认为传统解码器会让 slots 过度绑定空间位置与边界细节，限制其适应目标运动的能力。
AI.method: 提出 SemanticSlots：使用基于 Transformer 的解码器并利用图像上下文，使 slots 不再负责精确编码边界和坐标，而作为位置不变的语义查询，从当前图像特征中检索匹配对象信息；因此单帧计算得到的 slots 可用于分解后续视频帧。
AI.result: 在 YouTube-VIS 上，SemanticSlots 相比 VideoSAUR 的 mBO 提升 31 个点，并超过当前最优方法 21 个点，达到 86.6% ARI 和 62.8% mBO。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明 Video OCL 的关键瓶颈可能在解码器而非编码器；通过让 slots 表示语义而非空间锚定信息，可以获得更强的运动适应性和时间泛化能力，减少对复杂时序模块的依赖。

title: SAEM: Stage-Aware Expert Management for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
comment: Extended version of the paper accepted at DAC 2026. Extends the conference version with evaluations on AIME 2024 and GPQA-Diamond and a prediction-oracle upper-bound analysis
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves LLM reasoning by decomposing complex problems into intermediate steps, but its sequential nature increases decoding latency and memory usage. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity through sparse expert activation, yet their full expert weights often exceed GPU memory and require costly GPU-CPU transfers. Existing runtimes treat all tokens uniformly, overlooking a key structural property of CoT traces: consecutive reasoning stages exhibit coherent and predictable expert activation patterns. Ignoring this stage-level regularity leads to inefficient caching and unnecessary data movement. We propose SAEM, a stage-aware MoE inference runtime that detects reasoning stage boundaries and exploits stage-level activation coherence to guide expert placement. SAEM combines stage-aware caching, expert-aligned token repacking, and in-situ CPU execution to reduce data transfer and kernel fragmentation. On mathematical and scientific reasoning workloads, SAEM achieves an average 1.33x throughput improvement over the strongest state-of-the-art caching and offloading baselines under constrained GPU memory, rising to 1.54x when calibration data matches the workload, demonstrating the effectiveness of stage-aware, locality-driven MoE inference for CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: SAEM 是一种面向链式思维推理的阶段感知 MoE 推理运行时，通过利用推理阶段内专家激活的连贯性来降低数据搬运与碎片化开销，提升受限 GPU 内存下的吞吐。
AI.motivation: CoT 提示虽能提升大模型推理能力，但顺序解码会增加延迟和内存压力；MoE 模型虽然通过稀疏专家激活扩展容量，但完整专家权重常超出 GPU 内存，需要频繁 GPU-CPU 传输。现有运行时通常将所有 token 一视同仁，忽略 CoT 推理轨迹中连续阶段存在稳定且可预测的专家激活模式，导致缓存低效与不必要的数据移动。
AI.method: 论文提出 SAEM：首先检测 CoT 推理过程中的阶段边界；然后利用阶段级专家激活一致性指导专家放置。系统包含阶段感知缓存、专家对齐的 token 重打包，以及原位 CPU 执行，以减少 GPU-CPU 数据传输和 kernel 碎片化。
AI.result: 在数学和科学推理负载上，SAEM 在 GPU 内存受限场景下相比最强的现有缓存与卸载基线平均提升 1.33 倍吞吐；当校准数据与实际负载匹配时，吞吐提升可达 1.54 倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，针对 CoT 推理的阶段结构进行建模，并利用阶段级局部性来优化 MoE 专家缓存、放置和执行，是提升受限显存环境下 MoE 推理效率的有效方向。

title: BanglaVeilGuard: Cross-Script Safety Benchmarking and Lightweight Guardrails for Bangla Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at the 4th International Conference on Computing Advancements (ICCA 2026). 8 pages
summary: Bangla large language model (LLM) safety is difficult to evaluate with English-centric or standard-script benchmarks because Bangla users routinely write across scripts, spellings, code-mixed forms, and regional registers. This paper presents BanglaVeilGuard, a compact Bangla-first safety benchmark and lightweight prompt guard for six language forms: standard Bangla, Romanized Bangla, Banglish, code-mixed Bangla--English, noisy Bangla, and dialectal Bangla. The benchmark contains 2,366 quality-filtered prompts and a held-out 354-prompt evaluation split spanning unsafe, safe, and safe-sensitive requests. BanglaVeilGuard uses non-destructive multi-view normalization with a prompt-risk classifier and thresholded pre-generation gate, allowing it to screen prompts for heterogeneous target models without changing their weights. Across target-model families, guarded runs reduce attack success under deterministic response scoring from 93.8--100.0\% to 6.3\% for Claude Opus 4.8, BanglaLLama, and TituLLM; TigerLLM-1B with BanglaVeilGuard achieves 78.2\% accuracy with 8.8\% ASR. The prompt guard also attains 88.5\% unsafe recall, substantially above the evaluated prompt-only guard baselines. The main remaining cost is over-refusal on dialectal and noisy benign prompts, revealing a concrete safety-helpfulness frontier for Bangla LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BanglaVeilGuard：面向孟加拉语多书写/混写形态的安全评测基准与轻量级提示词防护器，用于提升孟加拉语 LLM 的安全筛查能力。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准多以英语或标准书写形式为中心，难以覆盖孟加拉语用户常见的标准孟加拉语、罗马化、Banglish、孟英混合、噪声文本和方言等多样输入形式，因此无法可靠评估和防护真实场景中的安全风险。
AI.method: 构建包含 2,366 条质量过滤提示词的基准，并设置 354 条保留评测集，覆盖 unsafe、safe 与 safe-sensitive 请求；提出非破坏性多视图归一化方法，结合提示风险分类器与阈值化的生成前门控机制，在不修改目标模型权重的情况下为不同模型筛查输入。
AI.result: 在多个目标模型族上，加入防护后攻击成功率由 93.8%–100.0% 降至 6.3%（Claude Opus 4.8、BanglaLLama、TituLLM）；TigerLLM-1B 结合 BanglaVeilGuard 达到 78.2% 准确率与 8.8% ASR；提示防护器 unsafe recall 达 88.5%，明显优于所评估的仅提示式防护基线。
AI.conclusion: BanglaVeilGuard 证明了面向本地语言形态的安全基准和轻量级前置防护可显著提升孟加拉语 LLM 安全性，但在方言和噪声良性提示上仍存在过度拒答，显示出安全性与有用性之间仍需优化的权衡。

title: SketchFlow: Zero-Shot Vector Sketch Generation via GMM Prior Flow in CLIP Latent Space
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. 16 pages
summary: Vector sketches remain one of the most concise and immediate mediums for abstract human expression. However, generating high-quality vector strokes that exhibit human-like drawing styles remains an open challenge due to the severe scarcity of fine-grained, high-quality text-to-sketch paired data. Existing text-conditioned generation methods often rely on unstable, time-consuming optimization or struggle to generalize to unseen categories in a zero-shot manner. To address these limitations, we present SketchFlow, a novel generative framework rooted in Optimal Transport (OT) theory and flow matching. By leveraging pre-trained CLIP models to bypass labor-intensive image-level text annotations, we formulate cross-modal alignment as a continuous mapping problem directly within the CLIP latent space. To bridge the inevitable modality gap between discrete text concepts and continuous sketch features, we first inject noise into discrete category embeddings to construct a continuous Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) prior. We then utilize an Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching (OT-CFM) model to learn a deterministic vector field mapping from this continuous GMM prior to the target sketch feature distribution. Finally, a Hybrid Diffusion Decoder, fusing 1D U-Net and Transformer architectures, is designed to decode these features into fast and high-fidelity stroke trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SketchFlow substantially outperforms existing baselines in visual quality and adherence to natural human drawing styles. Furthermore, our geometry-preserving framework demonstrates promising local zero-shot synthesis for prompts beyond the QuickDraw training vocabulary, including unseen concept labels and semantic modifiers, while enabling smooth, continuous semantic interpolation between distinct concepts. Source code is available at: https://github.com/QiuHong-1202/SketchFlow.

AI.tldr: SketchFlow 是一个面向文本到矢量草图生成的框架，结合 CLIP 潜空间、最优传输条件流匹配与混合扩散解码器，在数据稀缺条件下生成更自然、高质量且具备一定零样本泛化能力的草图。
AI.motivation: 高质量文本-草图配对数据稀缺，现有文本条件草图生成方法常依赖不稳定且耗时的优化过程，或难以对未见类别进行零样本泛化；因此需要一种更稳定、高效且能保持人类绘画风格的矢量草图生成方法。
AI.method: 方法首先利用预训练 CLIP 绕过昂贵的图像级文本标注，将跨模态对齐转化为 CLIP 潜空间中的连续映射问题；随后对离散类别嵌入注入噪声，构建连续高斯混合模型先验；再使用最优传输条件流匹配学习从该先验到目标草图特征分布的确定性向量场；最后设计融合 1D U-Net 与 Transformer 的混合扩散解码器，将特征解码为高保真笔画轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明，SketchFlow 在视觉质量和贴近自然人类绘画风格方面显著优于现有基线；同时可对 QuickDraw 训练词表之外的概念标签和语义修饰词进行局部零样本合成，并支持不同概念之间的平滑语义插值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在 CLIP 潜空间中结合最优传输流匹配与扩散式轨迹解码，可以有效缓解文本到矢量草图生成中的数据稀缺与泛化难题，为高质量、可控、具备语义连续性的草图生成提供了可行路径。

title: Measuring Activation Control in Large Language Models
summary: Safe deployment of increasingly capable models will likely come to rely on latent-space monitoring as a complement to behavioral evaluations, especially when evaluation-aware models exhibit scheming or deception. However, if models can also control their own activations, deception could extend into the latent space itself. With this in mind, we introduce the Activation Controllability Benchmark to quantify the extent to which models can modulate their residual stream via natural-language instruction. Across model families and capability levels, we find that most LLMs can control the direction and magnitude of their residual stream activations with some degree of temporal resolution, though performance varies considerably across models. In simple tasks, this level of control can evade activation-based monitoring methods (including linear probes, natural language autoencoders, activation oracles, and the Jacobian lens), albeit imperfectly. These results suggest that control over the activation space itself could become a confound for monitoring as introspective capabilities increase; therefore, we recommend that frontier labs and evaluators track activation controllability in future models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Activation Controllability Benchmark，用于衡量大语言模型通过自然语言指令调控自身残差流激活的能力，并发现这种能力可能削弱基于激活空间的安全监控。
AI.motivation: 随着模型能力增强，安全部署可能依赖潜在空间/激活空间监控来补充行为评估；但如果模型能控制自身激活，潜在空间中的监控也可能被规避，因此需要系统量化这种“激活可控性”。
AI.method: 作者设计 Activation Controllability Benchmark，跨不同模型家族和能力水平测试模型是否能按自然语言指令调节残差流激活的方向、幅度和时间分辨率，并进一步在简单任务中评估其对线性探针、自然语言自编码器、activation oracles、Jacobian lens 等监控方法的规避效果。
AI.result: 多数 LLM 在一定程度上能够控制残差流激活的方向和幅度，并具备一定时间分辨率，但不同模型之间差异显著。在简单任务中，这种控制能力可部分规避多类基于激活的监控方法，但规避并不完美。
AI.conclusion: 激活空间本身的可控性可能成为未来潜在空间监控的重要混杂因素；随着模型内省能力增强，前沿实验室和评估者应持续跟踪并评估模型的 activation controllability。

title: Modeling Claim Dependency Structure for Patent Litigation Prediction with Graph Attention Networks
summary: Patent litigation imposes substantial costs on firms and distorts R&D incentives, making early risk identification a practically important task. While prior work has applied BERT-based models to patent claim text, two fundamental limitations remain: flat sequence encoding loses the dependency structure between independent and dependent claims that legally determines patent scope, and feeding the entire claim set to a single encoder discards legally critical text. A six-model ablation on 1.34 million USPTO utility patents confirms that per-claim encoding, graph connectivity, attention, and Attentional Aggregation each provide independent, additive predictive value. We propose ClaimGAT, a Graph Attention Network that encodes each claim independently, constructs a directed claim dependency graph, processes it with GATConv layers, and aggregates independent claims via Attentional Aggregation to yield both a litigation risk score and claim-level gate weights that enable post-hoc structural analysis. ClaimGAT achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.818 and a lift of 4.89x at the top 10%, using only information observable at the time of patent grant. It reveals a tendency in high-risk patents for structural selection and content sensitivity to diverge, a pattern consistent with defensive claim drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ClaimGAT，用图注意力网络建模专利权利要求之间的依赖结构，用于在授权时预测专利诉讼风险，并在大规模数据上取得较强效果。
AI.motivation: 专利诉讼成本高且会扭曲研发激励，因此需要尽早识别诉讼风险。既有基于 BERT 的方法主要存在两点不足：一是将权利要求作为扁平序列编码，忽略独立权利要求与从属权利要求之间决定保护范围的法律依赖结构；二是把整组权利要求输入单一编码器会因长度限制或压缩而丢失关键法律文本。
AI.method: 作者提出 ClaimGAT：先对每条权利要求独立编码，再根据权利要求依赖关系构建有向图，使用 GATConv 图注意力层传播结构信息，最后通过 Attentional Aggregation 聚合独立权利要求，输出诉讼风险分数以及 claim-level gate weights，用于事后结构分析。并通过六模型消融实验检验逐条编码、图连接、注意力机制和注意力聚合的独立贡献。
AI.result: 在 134 万件 USPTO 实用专利数据上，ClaimGAT 使用授权时即可观测的信息达到 AUC-ROC 0.818，并在风险排名前 10% 实现 4.89 倍 lift。消融结果表明各关键组件具有独立且可叠加的预测价值。
AI.conclusion: ClaimGAT 证明了显式建模权利要求依赖结构能够显著提升专利诉讼风险预测，并提供可解释的权利要求级权重。模型还发现高风险专利中结构选择与内容敏感性存在分离趋势，这与防御性权利要求撰写模式一致。

title: Emotion Intensity Matters: Generating Realistic Expressions in Virtual Humans with CVAEs
summary: Generating expressive facial behavior in virtual humans (VHs) remains a central challenge in affective computing and character animation. This paper presents a novel approach based on Conditional Variational Autoencoders (CVAEs), trained on real human facial expression data, to synthesize controllable emotional expressions at varying intensities. Using a dataset comprising six basic emotions represented at two intensity levels (low and high), we train a CVAE model to generate synthetic facial expression data while preserving semantic consistency with real human expressions. Despite the limited amount of training data (only 7,680 facial expression samples), the proposed approach learns meaningful latent representations and generates coherent emotional variations. Our method enables control over emotional intensity, making it suitable for animating virtual characters without requiring actor performances or manual artistic intervention. Our research aimed to evaluate whether the method (CVAE) preserves the characteristics associated with the different intensity levels present in the dataset. Results show that the proposed model preserves key expressive characteristics across intensity levels while supporting generalization across emotional intensity levels, contributing to the creation of emotionally expressive virtual characters from relatively small datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的虚拟人面部表情生成方法，可在小规模真实表情数据上学习并合成可控强度的情绪表情。
AI.motivation: 虚拟人和角色动画需要自然、可控且具有情绪表现力的面部行为，但传统方法往往依赖演员表演采集或人工动画制作，成本较高；同时，小数据条件下如何保持不同情绪及强度语义一致性仍是挑战。
AI.method: 作者使用包含六种基本情绪、两种强度水平（低/高）的真实人脸表情数据集，训练条件变分自编码器。模型通过条件信息控制情绪类别与强度，并在潜在空间中学习表情变化表示，用于生成合成面部表情数据。
AI.result: 尽管训练样本仅有 7,680 个，模型仍能学习有意义的潜在表示，生成连贯的情绪表情变化，并在不同强度水平上保留关键表达特征，同时表现出一定的强度泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够从相对小规模数据集中生成语义一致、强度可控的虚拟人情绪面部表情，适用于减少演员采集和人工干预的虚拟角色动画生成。

title: From Mastery Profile to Simulated Response: Stochastic Student Knowledge Graphs (SSKG) for Faithful LLM Student Simulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate students at different mastery levels. These simulations can generate synthetic training data and stress-test tutoring systems. However, common prompt-based approaches leave the answer decision to the LLM, which tends to perform according to its built-in capabilities even when instructed to simulate a student with low mastery. As a result, these approaches may have difficulty distinguishing students with low and high levels of mastery. We demonstrate this limitation using 379 College Board-calibrated SAT Algebra items and five archetypal mastery profiles. Three LLMs from three vendors (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, Claude Haiku 4.5, and GPT-5.4-mini) achieve 96.8-100% accuracy across all profiles. To address this limitation, we introduce a method grounded in a Stochastic Student Knowledge Graph (SSKG). A curriculum knowledge graph (CKG) is extracted from an open algebra textbook, and each SAT solution is decomposed into a chain of required triples. The SSKG assigns a mastery probability to each triple, which is sampled to determine question correctness. An LLM then generates a first-person rationale consistent with the outcome. The simulation reduces accuracy to 44.1-85.2% across profiles and produces a clear monotone mastery gradient.

AI.tldr: 本文指出提示式LLM学生模拟难以真实区分不同掌握水平，并提出基于随机学生知识图谱的方法，使模拟表现呈现清晰的掌握度梯度。
AI.motivation: LLM常被用于模拟不同掌握水平的学生，以生成合成训练数据和压力测试辅导系统；但仅靠提示让LLM扮演低掌握学生时，模型仍倾向于凭自身能力作答，导致低、高掌握水平区分不明显。
AI.method: 作者使用379道College Board校准的SAT代数题和五类典型掌握画像测试三种LLM；随后提出SSKG方法：从开放代数教材抽取课程知识图谱，将每道题解法分解为所需知识三元组链，为每个三元组分配掌握概率并采样决定答题正误，再由LLM生成与结果一致的第一人称推理说明。
AI.result: 三种LLM在纯提示模拟下对所有掌握画像均达到96.8%至100%的高准确率，难以体现学生能力差异；SSKG方法将准确率降至44.1%至85.2%，并产生单调递增的掌握水平梯度。
AI.conclusion: 基于知识图谱与概率采样的学生模拟比单纯提示LLM更能刻画不同掌握水平，有助于生成更可信的学生行为数据并评估智能辅导系统。

title: EDGE: Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with outcome-based objectives such as GRPO enables LLM-based agents to solve complex, long-horizon tasks, yet the reusable exploration patterns embedded in interaction trajectories are largely discarded after a single policy update. Existing experience-augmented approaches retrieve historical guidance at inference time, but they apply experiences without accounting for the policy's evolving capability and create persistent dependencies on external retrieval. We propose EDGE (Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration), a framework that treats retrieved experiences as temporary training-time scaffolds and progressively internalizes their benefits into the parametric policy. Concretely, EDGE partitions each rollout group into experience-conditioned and experience-free trajectories to estimate and admit only positive marginal gains without extra sampling, then distills the induced behavior into the base policy via a reverse-KL objective on its own empirical support. A co-evolutionary experience bank further synthesizes guidance from emerging failure modes and prunes obsolete entries as the policy evolves. On ALFWorld and WebShop, EDGE improves over GRPO by 8.3 and 12.5 success-rate points at the 7B scale and retains 96.0% of its scaffolded performance when external experiences are removed at inference time. The code is available at https://github.com/xvolcano02/EDGE.

AI.tldr: EDGE 将检索经验作为训练期临时脚手架，通过估计经验带来的正向边际收益并蒸馏到基础策略中，使 LLM 智能体在无需推理期外部检索依赖的情况下提升长程任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于结果奖励的强化学习方法（如 GRPO）能提升 LLM 智能体解决复杂长程任务的能力，但交互轨迹中的可复用探索模式在单次策略更新后通常被丢弃。已有经验增强方法依赖推理期检索历史经验，未考虑策略能力随训练演化而变化，并造成长期外部依赖。
AI.method: 提出 EDGE（Experience-Distillation for Guided Exploration）：将检索经验视为训练期脚手架；在每个 rollout group 中划分经验条件轨迹与无经验轨迹，在不额外采样的情况下估计并接纳正向边际增益；随后使用基于自身经验支持集的 reverse-KL 目标将经验诱导行为蒸馏进基础策略；同时维护共演化经验库，根据新出现的失败模式合成指导并剪除过时经验。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，EDGE 相比 GRPO 在 7B 规模模型上分别提升 8.3 和 12.5 个成功率百分点；在推理期移除外部经验后，仍保留 96.0% 的脚手架性能。
AI.conclusion: EDGE 有效将外部经验指导转化为模型参数化能力，缓解推理期检索依赖，并通过经验库共演化保持经验与策略能力匹配，是一种面向 LLM 智能体长程探索任务的有效训练框架。

title: StereoDiffuer: Diffusion-based Progressive Geometry Modeling with Saliency Attention Perception for Stereo Matching
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, and 11 tables. Accepted by Signal Processing: Image Communication
summary: With the advance of deep neural networks, the quality of disparity maps obtained through stereo matching has steadily improved. However, existing stereo matching methods still struggle to preserve fine-grained geometric details, resulting in blurred edges and over-smoothed predictions in challenging regions. To address these limitations, we propose StereoDiffuer, an iterative diffusion-based stereo matching framework that explicitly models geometric details and progressively refines disparity estimates. The framework incorporates a Saliency Attention Perception (SAP) module to extract salient geometric cues, including object boundaries, thin structures, and sharp edges. Confidence-guided SAP features are combined with the initial disparity estimate to condition an iterative denoising diffusion process, which corrects residual disparity errors and restores geometric details suppressed during cost-volume regularization and upsampling. Experimental results on the Scene Flow and KITTI benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and its competitive performance relative to the compared stereo matching methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 StereoDiffuer：一种基于迭代扩散过程的立体匹配框架，用于逐步修正视差残差并恢复细粒度几何细节。
AI.motivation: 现有深度立体匹配方法虽然整体视差质量持续提升，但在复杂区域中仍难以保留物体边界、细结构和锐利边缘等细粒度几何信息，常出现边缘模糊和预测过平滑问题。
AI.method: 方法引入 Saliency Attention Perception（SAP）模块提取显著几何线索，并利用置信度引导的 SAP 特征与初始视差估计共同作为条件，驱动迭代去噪扩散过程，以逐步校正残余视差误差并恢复在代价体正则化和上采样过程中被抑制的几何细节。
AI.result: 在 Scene Flow 和 KITTI 基准数据集上的实验表明，该框架有效提升了细节恢复能力，并相较于对比的立体匹配方法具有竞争性表现。
AI.conclusion: StereoDiffuer 通过显式建模几何细节并结合扩散式迭代优化，为解决立体匹配中的边缘模糊和过平滑问题提供了一种有效方案。

title: Context as an Environment: Programmatic Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly take on long-running tasks whose history grows far beyond a single model context window. Existing approaches compress earlier interactions or extract selected information into fixed memory representations, committing to what to preserve before future needs are known. We present Scroll, a context manager that treats each agent session as an executable Session Environment. The environment is backed by an append-only Event Log and a sandboxed, persistent Python kernel. The kernel maintains a typed namespace across model calls, allowing tool outputs, retrieved history, and derived state to be bound to variables rather than serialized into the prompt at each call. Model-written code searches, materializes, and transforms session state through exec; only explicitly printed projections enter the model's working view for the next call. Context management thus becomes a programming task that inherits the improving coding abilities of LLMs, while the Event Log preserves lossless historical ground truth. As the working view approaches its budget, stale spans are evicted but remain recoverable: an eviction index keeps compact landmarks tied to exact Event Log addresses, so that the agent navigates directly to evicted regions instead of searching the full log. With Qwen3.8-Max as the backbone, Scroll achieves 94.8% on LongMemEval_S; 73.1% on BEAM_10M, surpassing the best published memory system by 5.1 points; and 86.7% on LOCA_256K, exceeding the best published long-horizon agent by 37.4 points.

AI.tldr: Scroll 将长期智能体会话建模为可执行的 Session Environment，用追加式事件日志与持久化 Python 内核管理上下文，在多项长记忆/长程任务基准上显著优于既有方法。
AI.motivation: 长运行 LLM 智能体的交互历史会远超单次上下文窗口。现有方法通常提前压缩历史或抽取信息为固定记忆表示，但这会在未来需求未知时过早决定保留内容，可能丢失后续任务所需细节。
AI.method: 论文提出 Scroll：每个会话由追加式 Event Log 保存无损历史事实，并由沙箱化、持久化 Python 内核维护跨模型调用的类型化命名空间。工具输出、检索历史和派生状态可绑定为变量，而非每轮都序列化进提示词。模型通过编写代码执行搜索、物化和变换状态，只有显式打印的投影进入下一轮工作视图。当工作视图接近预算时，过期片段被驱逐，但通过 eviction index 记录紧凑地标和精确 Event Log 地址以便恢复。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3.8-Max 为骨干模型，Scroll 在 LongMemEval_S 上达到 94.8%；在 BEAM_10M 上达到 73.1%，比已发表最佳记忆系统高 5.1 个百分点；在 LOCA_256K 上达到 86.7%，比已发表最佳长程智能体高 37.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Scroll 将上下文管理从固定记忆压缩问题转化为可编程状态管理问题，兼具无损历史保留、按需恢复和可执行变换能力，表明利用 LLM 日益增强的代码能力可以显著提升长上下文/长程智能体性能。

title: Bulbul: A Dataset for Dialectal Arabic Speech Recognition
summary: Arabic automatic speech recognition (ASR) faces unique challenges due to diglossia, extensive regional dialect variation, and limited speech resources. Existing speech datasets often focus on single dialects or large-scale broadcast/web data, leading to trade-offs between linguistic diversity and annotation quality. We present BULBUL, a multi-dialect Arabic ASR dataset collected from 275 speakers in 11 Arab countries. BULBUL includes structured dialect and sub-dialect coverage, as well as recordings of classical Arabic and modern standard Arabic spoken by participants in their native dialectal accents to support accent-aware modeling. The quality of the recordings was ensured through a two-level human verification process. We further benchmark a range of recent ASR systems, establishing strong baselines for modern dialectal and accented Arabic ASR.

title: The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Reasoning-augmented text-to-image models such as GoT-R1 emit an explicit textual plan - object names, attributes, and bounding boxes - before generating image tokens. When such a model fails a compositional prompt, is the plan wrong, or is the plan right and the decoder unfaithful? Because the plan is machine-readable it can be edited before decoding, which makes the two separable. We first validate the ruler. Swapping the two bounding boxes inside the model's own chain demonstrably flips the generated layout: detector-based accuracy falls 0.75 -> 0.48 (p<1e-3), while a widely used VQA-based spatial metric rises. A five-rater human study agrees with the detector on 81% of items and with the VQA judge on 57%. All spatial results therefore use geometric scoring. Under sound measurement the decoder is a faithful executor: 94% of generated layouts realize the planned relation, and object-box binding survives reordering of the plan's object segments. The planner is the bottleneck. It writes wrong relations for phrasing-dependent reasons - 98% accuracy on "left" against 54% on "right" for semantically identical layouts, a raster-order bias we isolate with a mention-order control - and cluttered geometry that the decoder faithfully reproduces. Editing the plan therefore fixes the image without retraining: symbolic verification with resampling gives +5.0 points (p<1e-3), minimal in-place repair +6.0 (p=.02), rewriting only box geometry +10.7 (p<1e-4), and replacing the plan outright +13.3 (p=1e-4). Gains are indifferent to the plan's prose style and to its likelihood under the planner, but not to its geometry. Modular planner-decoder designs are therefore viable, provided the plan is internally consistent: box-text contradictions induce object duplication and identity fusion. We release the plan-fidelity evaluation protocol, all plans, and 12k generated images.

AI.tldr: 该摘要研究推理增强文本到图像模型中“文本计划”和“图像解码”两部分的责任归因，发现主要瓶颈在规划器而非解码器。
AI.motivation: 当带显式文本计划的文生图模型在组合性提示上失败时，需要区分失败源于计划本身错误，还是计划正确但解码器未忠实执行。由于计划可读且可编辑，作者希望建立一种可分离评估与干预的方法。
AI.method: 作者首先验证空间评估指标，比较检测器几何评分、VQA式空间指标和人工评审；随后通过交换边界框、重排计划对象片段、编辑或替换计划等干预，评估计划与生成布局之间的因果关系和忠实度。
AI.result: 检测器评分与人工判断更一致；解码器能以94%的比例实现计划关系，且对象-框绑定对片段重排较稳健。主要错误来自规划器，包括方向表达偏差、光栅顺序偏差和拥挤几何。计划编辑可显著提升生成准确率，几何修改收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 模块化规划器-解码器文生图架构是可行的，但关键在于生成内部一致且几何正确的计划；解码器总体忠实执行计划，而规划器是主要瓶颈。

title: From Association to Causation: Improving Retrieval Precision of Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Causal Relations and an Attention Mechanism
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Code available at https://github.com/Silk-Road/causal-rag-rerank
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM generation on retrieved documents, but the standard terminal retrieval stage--dense-vector similarity, optionally followed by reranking--often returns documents that share keywords with the query without containing the needed information, a failure mode that grows with the knowledge base. We trace it to a conceptual gap: similarity captures only associational relations, whereas the documents that matter are linked to the query causally. We model the terminal retrieval stage with a causal graph grounded in Reichenbach's common cause principle: the keywords shared by the query and a retrieved document form a latent common cause A, and the document's residual keywords form a latent set B linking the document to the ideal output. Since a retrieved document is a collider (A -> d <- B), retrieval itself opens an associational path between the query and B, which licenses a training-free, attention-style re-scoring rule: the cosine similarity between the query embedding and the weighted centroid embedding of B. Unlike causality-enhanced RAG variants that model causal relations inside the knowledge content, our graph models the causal structure of the retrieval process itself. On a real 471-document enterprise knowledge base, the method promotes a relevant guideline from rank 6 to the top 3; on a controlled diagnostic corpus reproducing the keyword-stuffing regime, it improves the mean target rank from 2.88 to 1.25, while a trained cross-encoder reranker barely helps (2.63). Conversely, on three BEIR benchmarks the score underperforms the similarity baseline, delineating the applicability boundary: the method guards the keyword-stuffing regime of growing proprietary knowledge bases and complements neural rerankers; a corpus-level calibration gate selects the correct regime with >= 95% reliability. A fully local testbed demonstrates deployability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种训练-free 的 RAG 终端检索重评分方法，用因果图解释并缓解关键词堆砌导致的相似度误检问题。
AI.motivation: 标准 RAG 终端检索依赖稠密向量相似度与可选重排序，容易返回与查询共享关键词但缺少真实答案信息的文档；该问题在企业知识库规模增长时更明显。作者认为根因在于相似度只刻画关联关系，而真正有用的文档与查询之间存在更接近因果性的联系。
AI.method: 作者基于 Reichenbach 共同原因原则构建检索过程的因果图：查询与文档共享关键词被视为潜在共同原因 A，文档剩余关键词构成潜在集合 B，并连接文档与理想输出。由于被检索文档形成碰撞器结构 A -> d <- B，检索行为打开查询与 B 的关联路径，据此设计一种注意力式重评分规则：计算查询嵌入与 B 的加权质心嵌入之间的余弦相似度。
AI.result: 在 471 篇企业知识库中，该方法将相关指南从第 6 名提升至前 3 名；在模拟关键词堆砌的诊断语料上，平均目标排名由 2.88 提升至 1.25，而训练式 cross-encoder 重排器仅提升至 2.63。但在三个 BEIR 基准上弱于相似度基线。语料级校准门可用不低于 95% 的可靠性选择适用场景，本地测试床验证了可部署性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适用于增长型私有知识库中的关键词堆砌检索失败场景，可作为神经重排器的补充；但不适合作为通用检索替代方案，其有效性依赖于语料是否处于特定的关键词堆砌机制。

title: ToSCA: Leveraging Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning on Temporal and Strategic Abstractions of Conversational Agents
summary: Humans have multiple levels of temporal abstractions on daily interaction and thinking, such as concept perception and strategic planning. Inspired by this nature, we propose a two-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework for conversational agents, bridging the gap between previous token-level or utterance-level RL methods. Developed on a two-level MDP, the token-level response decoding is conditioned on the utterance-level action, the explicit textual strategies. Based on theoretical derivation and efficiency consideration, we use DQN to solve the high-level critic and PPO to solve the low-level actor-critic. To further alleviate the reward sparsity and facilitate the convergence, we also design the dual-granularity reward mechanism, in which the utterance-level satisfaction score is integrated with token-level intrinsic motivation and K-L penalty. Experiments on both daily and emotional support conversations show that our method outperforms versatile baselines in strategy determination and response quality. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/AaronJi/ToSCA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于对话智能体的两层层次化强化学习框架，将话语级显式策略与词元级回复生成结合，以提升策略选择和回复质量。
AI.motivation: 现有对话强化学习方法多集中在词元级或话语级，难以同时建模人类交互中的高层策略规划与低层语言生成；因此需要一种能桥接不同时间抽象层次的统一框架。
AI.method: 作者构建两层 MDP：高层在话语级选择显式文本策略，低层在词元级基于该策略进行响应解码。算法上，高层 critic 采用 DQN，低层 actor-critic 采用 PPO；同时设计双粒度奖励机制，将话语级满意度分数与词元级内在动机、KL 惩罚结合，以缓解奖励稀疏并促进收敛。
AI.result: 在日常对话和情感支持对话任务上的实验表明，该方法在策略确定能力和回复质量方面优于多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 两层层次化强化学习能够更有效地结合高层对话策略与低层语言生成，提升对话智能体的策略控制和响应质量。

title: Calibrate What You SHIP: Post-Selection Risk Control for Verifier-Guided Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Verifier-guided text-to-image systems increasingly use test-time search to select, refine, or stop among multiple candidates, yet release thresholds are often calibrated on individual images. This creates a candidate-to-policy calibration mismatch: search changes both which prompts receive an output and which candidate is released, so candidate-level risk control need not imply control of released-output risk. We formalize this estimand shift through prompt reweighting and within-prompt selection, and introduce SHIP, Selection-aware Held-out calibration of Inference Policies. SHIP runs or replays the complete deployed policy on held-out prompts, evaluates the image it actually releases using an independent target judge, and selects the most permissive threshold whose risk upper bound satisfies a prescribed budget. For replayable policies with a prespecified threshold grid, simultaneous confidence control provides finite-sample validity. Experiments across fixed, sequential, and adaptive T2I inference procedures show that policy-level calibration recovers lower-risk operating points while exposing policy-dependent tradeoffs among risk, coverage, and compute. On GenEval2 with FLUX at N=16, a pooled-candidate threshold yields released risk 0.310, whereas SHIP reduces it to 0.162. Across 200 cached-stream splits, the fixed-grid certificate has no target crossing. Reliable inference-time scaling therefore requires calibrating the output distribution induced by the complete deployed policy.

AI.tldr: 本文指出文本生成图像系统在测试时搜索会改变最终发布输出的分布，导致按候选图像校准的阈值无法保证发布结果风险；提出 SHIP 在保留提示集上运行完整部署策略并校准策略级风险。
AI.motivation: 现有发布阈值常基于单张候选图像校准，但实际系统会在多个候选中选择、细化或提前停止，造成候选级风险控制与最终发布输出风险控制不一致。
AI.method: 作者形式化候选到策略的校准错配，包括提示重加权与同一提示内选择效应；提出 SHIP：在 held-out prompts 上运行或回放完整推理策略，用独立目标评判器评估实际释放图像，并选择满足风险预算上界的最宽松阈值；对可回放且预设阈值网格的策略提供同时置信控制。
AI.result: 在固定、序贯和自适应 T2I 推理流程中，策略级校准能获得更低风险的运行点并揭示风险、覆盖率和计算量之间的权衡；在 GenEval2 + FLUX、N=16 条件下， pooled-candidate 阈值发布风险为 0.310，而 SHIP 降至 0.162；200 个 cached-stream 划分中固定网格证书无目标越界。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的推理时扩展需要针对完整部署策略诱导的最终输出分布进行校准，而不是仅对单个候选图像进行阈值校准。

title: ATHENA: Knowledge-guided agentic neural architecture search for AutoFormer-based electronic health record modeling
summary: Transformer-based models are widely used for clinical prediction from electronic health records (EHRs), yet their architectures still require substantial manual tuning, and the optimal configuration may vary across tasks and hospitals. Neural architecture search (NAS) automates architecture design, but conventional methods are computationally costly for Transformer-based EHR models. Recent large language model (LLM)-guided NAS methods reduce manual search design but typically conduct each search independently, without reusing architecture knowledge across hospitals. In this study, we propose ATHENA (Agentic Transfer across Hospitals for EHR Neural Architecture Search), a knowledge-guided agentic NAS framework for Transformer-based EHR modeling. ATHENA uses a weight-sharing supernet that is pretrained once per hospital, allowing candidate architectures to be instantiated as inherited subnetworks and evaluated through fine-tuning rather than independent pretraining. It also incorporates a two-layer cross-hospital architecture prior. The first layer retrieves high-performing architecture examples from source sites based on task descriptors, while the second estimates the effects of architectural components using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based meta-regression. These priors guide a multi-agent LLM search together with validation feedback from the target hospital. Across six clinical prediction tasks and two independent health systems, ATHENA matches or outperforms four NAS baselines in 9 of 12 hospital-task evaluations at a search budget of 30. It also shows more consistent architecture selection across repeated searches. ATHENA provides a practical approach for reducing manual architecture tuning in Transformer-based EHR modeling. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/GatorAIM/ATHENA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ATHENA：一种面向基于 Transformer 的 EHR 临床预测模型的跨医院知识引导 agentic NAS 框架，通过权重共享超网与跨医院架构先验，在较低搜索预算下提升架构搜索效率与稳定性。
AI.motivation: Transformer 模型在电子健康记录临床预测中应用广泛，但架构配置依赖人工调参，且不同任务与医院的最优架构可能不同。传统 NAS 计算成本高，而现有 LLM 引导 NAS 通常独立搜索，未能复用跨医院的架构经验。
AI.method: ATHENA 首先在每个医院预训练一次权重共享 supernet，使候选架构可作为继承子网络实例化，并通过微调评估而非独立预训练。其次构建两层跨医院架构先验：第一层基于任务描述符检索源医院高性能架构示例；第二层使用基于 SHAP 的元回归估计架构组件效应。这些先验与目标医院验证反馈共同引导多智能体 LLM 搜索。
AI.result: 在两个独立卫生系统的六项临床预测任务中，在搜索预算为 30 的条件下，ATHENA 在 12 个医院-任务评估中的 9 个达到或超过四种 NAS 基线，并在重复搜索中表现出更一致的架构选择。
AI.conclusion: ATHENA 为 Transformer-based EHR 建模提供了一种实用的自动化架构搜索方案，可减少人工调参需求，并通过跨医院知识迁移提高搜索效率、性能和稳定性。

title: Machine learning and digital pragmatics: Which word category influences emoji use most?
summary: This study examines the performance of the state-of-the-art MARBERT model in identifying the lexical/pragmatic category associated with emoji use on X within a digital pragmatics approach (DPA). A net corpus of 15856 Colloquial Arabic (CA) posts containing emojis was collected from X using Python. The texts were tokenized and normalized into 4 lexical categories, namely noun_norm, verb_norm, adj_norm, and adverb_norm, and 2 pragmatic/structural categories, question_norm and exclamation_norm. MARBERT was finetuned and optimized to identify which category scores standard metrics more, hence associated with emoji use, while binary logistic regression was used to examine which category is statistically associated with emoji occurrence. Findings unveil that nouns dominate the corpus in normalized frequency (M = 0.675, SD = 0.161), followed by verbs (M = 0.083, SD = 0.100). However, verbs have the strongest influence of emoji use indicated by verb density (\b{eta} = 0.821, p = .001, 95% CI [0.332, 1.309]). The study concludes that in digital pragmatics of CA on X, emoji use association with lexical/pragmatic category can be explained by a hybrid approach of computational, statistical, and pragmatic methods, reflecting the interaction among machine learning, linguistic/lexical features, contextual representation, and pragmatic communication.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 MARBERT 在识别 X 平台含表情符号的口语阿拉伯语文本中，哪些词汇/语用类别与表情符号使用相关。结果显示名词频率最高，但动词密度对表情符号出现的统计影响最强。
AI.motivation: 在数字语用学框架下，探究社交媒体文本中表情符号与词汇及语用结构类别之间的关系，并评估先进阿拉伯语预训练模型 MARBERT 对相关类别识别的效果。
AI.method: 收集 15,856 条含表情符号的口语阿拉伯语 X 帖文，进行分词与规范化，划分为名词、动词、形容词、副词、疑问和感叹六类；微调并优化 MARBERT 以识别类别表现，同时使用二元逻辑回归检验各类别与表情符号出现之间的统计关联。
AI.result: 名词在语料中归一化频率最高（M=0.675, SD=0.161），动词次之（M=0.083, SD=0.100）；但动词密度对表情符号使用的影响最强（β=0.821, p=.001, 95% CI [0.332, 1.309]）。
AI.conclusion: 表情符号与词汇/语用类别的关系可通过计算建模、统计分析与语用解释相结合的混合方法来说明，体现机器学习、语言特征、上下文表征与数字语用交际之间的互动。

title: Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC): Data Pruning for Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Despite the success of data pruning (DP) in reducing training data sizes and improving downstream model performance in classification and segmentation tasks, its potential in remote sensing change detection remains unexplored. For the first time, we benchmark six representative DP methods across building- and forest-change datasets, CNN- and transformer-based models, and three pruning budgets, and show that existing baselines yield no reliable advantage over random selection. Notably, even the strongest evaluated baseline, Feature Diversity, is matched or exceeded by $\sim$33\% of randomly sampled subsets. To understand the underlying mechanism, we conduct a systematic regression study over 540 randomly sampled data subsets, characterizing each with four descriptors covering label statistics, image diversity, and feature-space geometry. Random Forest models show that \emph{change distribution fidelity} is the most prominent factor in determining the quality of change detection data subsets, a property absent from the existing pruning literature. Our analyses further show that pixel-wise image diversity and label-feature consistency are secondary factors. We translate these findings into Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency (FDC), a simple two-stage pruning method that shows consistent improvements over existing baselines across change detection benchmarks and backbones, especially at lower pruning ratios. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}{https://github.com/ddydyd32/fidelity-diversity-consistency}.

AI.tldr: 论文首次系统评估数据剪枝在遥感变化检测中的效果，发现现有方法相对随机选择优势不稳定，并提出基于变化分布保真度、图像多样性与标签-特征一致性的FDC方法，取得更稳定改进。
AI.motivation: 现有数据剪枝研究主要集中在分类和分割任务，尚未充分探索其在遥感变化检测中的适用性；变化检测具有像素级变化分布、双时相图像和类别不平衡等特点，可能需要不同的数据子集选择准则。
AI.method: 作者在建筑物与森林变化数据集、CNN与Transformer骨干网络、三种剪枝预算下评测六种代表性数据剪枝方法；进一步对540个随机子集进行回归分析，用标签统计、图像多样性和特征空间几何等四类描述符刻画子集质量，并据此提出两阶段Fidelity-Diversity-Consistency方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有剪枝基线整体上并未稳定优于随机选择；即使最强的Feature Diversity方法，也被约33%的随机子集持平或超过。随机森林回归显示，变化分布保真度是决定子集质量的最重要因素，像素级图像多样性和标签-特征一致性为次要因素。FDC在不同数据集和骨干网络上较现有基线表现更稳定，低剪枝比例下优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 遥感变化检测中的数据剪枝不能直接沿用分类/分割领域的既有准则，需显式考虑变化分布保真度。FDC将保真度、多样性和一致性结合，为变化检测任务提供了简单有效且更可靠的数据剪枝策略。

title: Ask or Answer: A Decision Framework for Multi-Turn Health Misinformation Intervention
summary: Correcting health misinformation in dialogue requires more than producing a factual rebuttal: users differ in what they know, what they believe, and what they need to hear, so an effective intervention often depends on first asking the right clarifying question. Yet existing methods either respond immediately or probe indiscriminately, treating clarification as either unnecessary or always beneficial. We propose Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond (RO-PnR), a framework that learns when asking is worth its cost. At each turn, RO-PnR chooses between probing for more information and committing to a final correction, guided by a turn-level reward that weighs the expected gain from probing against its interaction cost. To capture how user heterogeneity affects probing value, we model each simulated user with a latent state along health literacy and belief commitment. Experiments show that RO-PnR achieves the highest cost-adjusted utility across three health-misinformation datasets and three base models, using 30% fewer turns than always-probe baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RO-PnR 框架，用于在健康误信息纠正对话中学习何时应先提澄清问题、何时应直接给出纠正回应，以在效果与交互成本之间取得最优权衡。
AI.motivation: 纠正健康误信息不能只依赖事实反驳，因为用户在知识水平、既有信念和信息需求上存在差异；现有方法要么直接回应，要么无差别地持续追问，未能判断澄清问题是否真正值得。
AI.method: 提出 Reward-Optimized Probe-and-Respond（RO-PnR）。在每轮对话中，模型在“继续探询信息”和“给出最终纠正”之间决策；其决策由轮次级奖励函数引导，该奖励同时衡量探询带来的预期收益与额外交互成本。框架还通过健康素养与信念坚持程度两个潜在维度建模模拟用户异质性。
AI.result: 在三个健康误信息数据集和三个基础模型上的实验表明，RO-PnR 获得最高的成本调整效用，并且相比 always-probe 基线减少约 30% 的对话轮次。
AI.conclusion: RO-PnR 证明了澄清问题并非总是必要，而应基于用户状态和预期收益进行动态决策；该方法能在保持纠错效果的同时降低交互成本。

title: Align, Unify, Suppress, Route: A Coherentist View of Transformer Computation
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has identified transformer circuits, but lacks a shared vocabulary for describing how their functions compose across tasks and architectures. We introduce Coherentist Probabilistic Compositionalism (CPC), an interpretive framework that grounds transformer computation in coherentist theories of interpretation and describes it through four operator roles. Alignment identifies candidate relations, unification integrates supporting information, suppression reduces incompatible alternatives, and routing carries selected information to the output. Across 15 models from five architecture families, the suppression, unification, and routing weight-space signatures correlate with held-out activation-level role measures above random baselines. Suppression is more stable across tasks than unification. Ablating alignment heads reduces downstream suppressive activity beyond a random-head control in 10 models, but similar effects on no-conflict prompts indicate a general upstream dependency, not contradiction-specific coupling. Explicit contradictions significantly shift a layerwise coherence proxy in 14 models; after removing shared residual covariance, the gap has the predicted direction in every model. Base and instruction-tuned variants preserve induction-head score structure ($r{\geq}0.98$) without a consistent shift of operator signatures towards later layers.
