These results support CPC as a shared vocabulary for comparing transformer mechanisms while showing that their depth and geometric expression remain architecture-specific.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CPC 作为描述 Transformer 机制可解释性的统一组合式词汇，并在多模型实验中验证若干算子角色的权重空间特征与激活层面度量相关。
AI.motivation: 现有机制可解释性研究已识别出多种 Transformer circuits，但缺少一种可跨任务、跨架构描述这些功能如何组合的共享语言。作者希望用更统一的解释框架刻画 Transformer 中不同计算角色的协作方式。
AI.method: 提出 Coherentist Probabilistic Compositionalism（CPC）框架，将 Transformer 计算解释为四类算子角色：alignment、unification、suppression、routing。作者在来自五类架构家族的 15 个模型上，比较权重空间签名与留出激活层面角色度量的相关性，并进行头部消融、矛盾提示实验、残差协方差控制以及 base / instruction-tuned 变体对比。
AI.result: suppression、unification 和 routing 的权重空间签名与激活层面角色度量的相关性高于随机基线；suppression 跨任务稳定性高于 unification。消融 alignment heads 会在 10 个模型中降低下游 suppression 活动，但无冲突提示也出现类似影响，说明更像一般上游依赖而非特定矛盾耦合。显式矛盾显著改变 14 个模型的层级 coherence proxy；去除共享残差协方差后，所有模型中的方向均符合预测。base 与 instruction-tuned 变体保留 induction-head 分数结构，但算子签名未一致后移。
AI.conclusion: 实验支持 CPC 可作为比较 Transformer 机制的共享解释词汇，但也表明这些机制在深度分布和几何表达上仍具有显著架构特异性。

title: Learning to Look Again: Loss-Gap Supervision for Free-form Crop Routing in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail many detail-centric questions for a concrete reason: the answer is visible in the image, yet lost after the image is compressed into a low-resolution global view. Allocating more visual tokens to every query improves some OCR and document cases, but it spends computation indiscriminately and can disturb tasks that rely on global context. We propose GapSight, a framework for learning visual re-reading: a VLM first takes a global glance, then selectively returns to a free-form region when the question calls for local evidence. The supervision comes from the target model's own failure signal. Offline, we compare answer loss or multiple-choice option margin under a global-only view and candidate crop-augmented views; crops that improve the target answer become model-specific review labels. A lightweight free-form crop router distills these labels into a one-shot inference policy that predicts whether to review, expected utility, and a continuous crop box from the global state. Across LLaVA-1.5-7B, InternVL2.5-8B, and Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, GapSight improves the Base no-zoom baseline on six benchmarks spanning OCR, documents, charts, infographics, VStarBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite. On InternVL2.5-8B, GapSight raises the six-benchmark average from 52.25 to 64.29, above CropVLM (57.16), ViCrop (55.84), and ZoomRefine (54.43). Mechanism analyses show that the router rescues concrete wrong answers, adapts its action rate by task, and forms a favorable token-performance profile. These results position loss-gap supervision as a practical route to teaching VLMs when and where to look again.

AI.tldr: GapSight通过“先全局浏览、再按需局部重读”的机制，让视觉语言模型在问题需要细节证据时选择性放大自由形状区域，从而提升OCR、文档、图表等细节密集任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM常因图像被压缩为低分辨率全局视图而丢失可见细节；统一增加视觉token虽能改善部分细节任务，但计算开销大且可能损害依赖全局上下文的任务。
AI.method: 提出GapSight框架：离线阶段利用目标模型自身失败信号，对比全局视图与候选裁剪增强视图的答案损失或多选边际，将能改善答案的裁剪作为模型特定复查标签；随后训练轻量级自由形状裁剪路由器，从全局状态一次性预测是否复查、预期收益和连续裁剪框。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B、InternVL2.5-8B、Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct上，GapSight在六个覆盖OCR、文档、图表、信息图、VStarBench和MME-RealWorld-Lite的基准上优于Base no-zoom。InternVL2.5-8B上六基准平均分从52.25提升至64.29，高于CropVLM、ViCrop和ZoomRefine。
AI.conclusion: 损失差距监督是一种实用方式，可教会VLM何时以及在哪里重新观察图像；GapSight在性能、计算token使用和任务自适应复查率之间取得较好平衡。

title: ECHO: A Cognitively Inspired, Auditable Memory Plane for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents need memory that identifies relevant experience, resolves revisions, and exposes checkable provenance. We present ECHO (Embodied Context and History Orchestration), an auditable memory architecture and service prototype inspired by episodic encoding, consolidation, contextual reinstatement, reconsolidation, and executive control. This is functional inspiration, not neural equivalence; the empirical analysis focuses on retrieval and context construction. Development runs reach 96.29% Hit@10 and 73.64% turn Recall@5 on 1,536 LoCoMo category 1-4 questions, and 97.60% Hit@10, 88.84% turn Recall@5, and 88.71% session Recall@5 on all 500 LongMemEval-S questions. A five-history BEAM gate fails, and in a separate matched 91-question QA sample Mem0 OSS scores 64.84% versus ECHO's 41.76% (exact McNemar p = 0.00107), with a history-cluster interval crossing zero. A post-hoc audit found source-specific phrases in the query-expansion rules. Although no gold answer field entered the runtime, expansion-enabled retrieval scores are therefore descriptive development measurements, not independent confirmation.

AI.tldr: ECHO提出一种面向长时程智能体的可审计记忆架构，强调相关经验检索、修订处理与可验证来源；开发集指标较高，但独立对照实验中表现弱于Mem0 OSS，且后验审计发现查询扩展规则存在来源特异短语，削弱了部分结果的独立验证性。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体需要一种可靠记忆机制，能够从历史经验中识别相关信息、处理记忆内容的更新或修订，并向下游推理暴露可检查的来源与证据链，从而提升长期交互中的上下文构建与可审计性。
AI.method: 论文提出ECHO（Embodied Context and History Orchestration），一种受情景编码、巩固、情境复现、再巩固和执行控制启发的记忆架构与服务原型。该启发是功能层面的而非神经等价。实证重点放在检索与上下文构建，并在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S上评估Hit@10、turn Recall@5和session Recall@5等指标，同时进行BEAM门控实验、与Mem0 OSS的匹配问答对照，以及后验审计。
AI.result: 开发运行中，ECHO在1,536个LoCoMo category 1-4问题上达到96.29% Hit@10和73.64% turn Recall@5；在500个LongMemEval-S问题上达到97.60% Hit@10、88.84% turn Recall@5和88.71% session Recall@5。五历史BEAM gate失败。在独立匹配的91题QA样本中，Mem0 OSS得分64.84%，ECHO为41.76%，精确McNemar检验p=0.00107，显示差异显著；历史簇区间跨零。后验审计发现查询扩展规则中存在来源特异短语。
AI.conclusion: ECHO展示了可审计记忆架构在开发测量中的潜力，但其查询扩展规则的来源特异性使扩展启用下的检索结果只能作为描述性开发指标，不能视为独立确认。当前证据表明该系统在独立问答对照中尚未优于Mem0 OSS，未来需要更严格的隔离评测、消融实验和无泄漏的独立验证。

title: Real-TurnTurk: A Multimodal Turkish Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction
comment: Accepted to INTCEC 2026. This is the author's pre-print version. The final authenticated version will be available through the conference proceedings
summary: Turn-taking is a basic organizational feature of human conversation and remains difficult to model in natural, synchronous dialog systems. While existing research has explored multimodal approaches and large language models for turn-ending prediction, there is a lack of naturalistic conversational corpora specifically addressing turn-taking dynamics in Turkish. This study introduces a multimodal Turkish conversational dataset of unscripted dyadic interactions, comprising synchronized front-facing video, per-speaker audio channels that allow overlapping speech to be attributed to individual speakers, and time-aligned transcriptions. Turn-taking prediction is formulated as a binary classification problem, and a Genetic Algorithm (GA) is employed to optimize interpretable decision rules derived from visual, acoustic, and linguistic features. A hybrid AND-OR rule representation is adopted in the proposed framework to represent the alternative cue combinations that precede a turn transition.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个面向土耳其语自然对话中话轮转换建模的多模态语料库，并用遗传算法优化可解释的多模态决策规则来预测话轮结束/转换。
AI.motivation: 自然同步对话系统仍难以准确建模人类会话中的话轮交替；同时，土耳其语缺乏专门刻画自然话轮动态的多模态会话语料，因此需要构建数据资源并探索可解释预测方法。
AI.method: 研究构建了非脚本双人互动数据集，包含同步正面视频、可区分说话人的独立音频通道以及时间对齐转写。将话轮转换预测建模为二分类任务，从视觉、声学和语言特征中提取线索，并采用遗传算法搜索/优化混合AND-OR形式的可解释决策规则。
AI.result: 摘要表明提出了数据集与基于GA的规则学习框架，但未给出具体实验指标、基线对比或性能结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为土耳其语话轮转换研究提供了自然主义多模态资源，并提出一种可解释的规则优化方法，以捕捉话轮转换前可能出现的多种线索组合。

title: LiteEvent-AE: Lightweight Autoencoder for Event-Based Vision on Low-Latency Energy-Constrained Edge Devices
summary: Event-based vision has emerged as a promising paradigm for energy-aware artificial intelligence (AI), offering sparse, low-latency visual signals that reduce redundant data processing and support sustainable edge computing. However, the asynchronous and noise-prone nature of event streams creates challenges for conventional deep learning models, which are often too computationally intensive for low-power embedded platforms. This work presents a compact and configurable event-driven autoencoder that efficiently compresses neuromorphic data while preserving essential spatiotemporal structure for downstream inference. The architecture integrates lightweight convolutional encoding with robust performance under adaptive event thresholding and a minimal classifier head, enabling substantial reductions in computational cost without degrading recognition fidelity. Extensive evaluations on the Smart Event Face Dataset (SEFD) and Event-Based Crossing Dataset (EBCD) show that the proposed framework achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to YOLOv9 while requiring up to 35.6$\times$ fewer parameters. To assess real-world sustainability, the model is deployed on resource-constrained hardware: a Raspberry Pi 4B and a NVIDIA Jetson Nano. On NVIDIA Jetson Nano, it delivers real-time throughput of 44.8 FPS. On a Raspberry Pi 4B CPU, the 50\% autoencoder classifier consumes 16.19 J for the evaluated inference workload, corresponding to approximately 726.3$\times$ lower energy consumption than YOLOv9 under the same evaluation protocol. These results demonstrate the potential of compact event-driven models to advance environmentally conscious, low-power AI systems for high-speed perception in autonomous, mobile, and embedded computing environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种紧凑、可配置的事件驱动自编码器，用于高效压缩神经形态视觉数据，在嵌入式硬件上以显著更低参数量和能耗实现接近或优于YOLOv9的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 事件相机提供稀疏、低延迟且节能的视觉信号，适合边缘AI；但事件流具有异步性和噪声，传统深度学习模型计算开销大，难以部署在低功耗嵌入式平台。因此需要面向事件数据的轻量、高效、可实时运行的模型。
AI.method: 构建紧凑且可配置的事件驱动自编码器，结合轻量卷积编码、对自适应事件阈值的鲁棒设计，以及最小化分类头，以压缩神经形态数据并保留关键时空结构；在SEFD和EBCD数据集上评估，并部署到Raspberry Pi 4B与NVIDIA Jetson Nano测试实时性和能耗。
AI.result: 在SEFD和EBCD上，该方法相较YOLOv9取得具有竞争力或更优的精度，同时参数量最多减少35.6倍；Jetson Nano上达到44.8 FPS实时吞吐；Raspberry Pi 4B CPU上50%自编码器分类器推理能耗为16.19 J，约为YOLOv9的1/726.3。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑事件驱动模型可在保持识别性能的同时显著降低计算、参数和能耗开销，适用于自动驾驶、移动端和嵌入式高速感知等低功耗、可持续AI场景。

title: What Does CLIP Learn for Regional Geolocalization? Probing Visual Cues and Scene Configuration After Adaptation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Manuscript under review
summary: Large collections of street-view imagery provide rich visual information about urban environments, but extracting fine-grained geographic information from such data remains challenging. In particular, fine-grained regional geolocalization is challenging because nearby areas often share coarse geographic cues. We study regional geolocalization within a metropolitan area and ask whether pretrained CLIP features are sufficient for regional discrimination, and what visual information supports performance after adaptation. Using 9,085 street-view images from eight Greater Los Angeles regions, we compare zero-shot CLIP, frozen-encoder readouts, partial encoder updating, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and full fine-tuning. Frozen readouts remain near the 39.03% zero-shot accuracy, whereas encoder adaptation achieves 75.94-82.10%. Full fine-tuning also reduces the mean distance to the predicted region center from 12.30 km to 3.86 km. We probe these gains through semantic cue removal, appearance reduction using edge maps and blur, and scene-configuration disruption using patch scrambling. Adapted models achieve higher edge and blur accuracy and switch 42.92-45.56% of predictions after scrambling, compared with 10.79-14.60% for frozen methods. However, adaptation does not improve the fraction of performance retained after appearance reduction, while vegetation and sky remain influential. A Caltech101 control further shows that scrambling sensitivity is not unique to geolocalization. Overall, encoder adaptation substantially improves nearby-region discrimination and is associated with greater sensitivity to intact scene configuration, without evidence that coarse structure alone becomes sufficient for prediction. These conclusions concern viewpoint variation near known locations rather than geographically disjoint generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大都市内部街景图像的细粒度区域地理定位，发现仅使用冻结的 CLIP 特征效果接近零样本，而对编码器进行适配可显著提升区域判别准确率。
AI.motivation: 大规模街景图像包含丰富城市视觉信息，但在相邻区域共享大量粗粒度地理线索时，提取细粒度地理信息并完成区域级定位仍很困难。论文希望回答预训练 CLIP 特征是否足以区分同一都市内的邻近区域，以及适配后模型依赖哪些视觉信息。
AI.method: 使用 9,085 张来自八个大都市区域的街景图像，对比零样本 CLIP、冻结编码器读出、部分编码器更新、LoRA 和全量微调；并通过语义线索移除、边缘图与模糊等外观弱化、patch scrambling 等场景配置破坏实验，以及 Caltech101 控制实验分析性能来源。
AI.result: 冻结读出方法准确率接近 39.03% 的零样本水平，而编码器适配达到 75.94%–82.10%；全量微调将到预测区域中心的平均距离从 12.30 km 降至 3.86 km。适配模型在边缘图和模糊图上更准确，patch scrambling 后预测切换率为 42.92%–45.56%，高于冻结方法的 10.79%–14.60%。
AI.conclusion: 编码器适配显著提升了都市内部邻近区域的细粒度地理定位能力，并增强了模型对完整场景配置的敏感性；但没有证据表明仅依赖粗结构即可充分预测，且结论主要适用于已知地点附近的视角变化，而非地理上不相交区域的泛化。

title: Spine-Branch Coordination for Multi-agent Computer Use
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems that decompose a task into multiple subtasks executed across parallel virtual machines (VMs). However, a critical physical bottleneck is that the state of two VMs cannot be merged. Previous systems handle this ad-hoc rather than treating it as a first-class concern. We propose Spine-Branch Coordination for multi-agent computer use, a framework that decomposes a task into a "spine-branch" graph, where the spine carries the main task flow with continuous VM state and branch tasks execute in parallel to collect information the spine needs to complete the task. Branch VMs are discarded once their tasks finish, so no VM merging ever occurs. Experiments show that on 200 long-horizon tasks from Odysseys and across three CUA backbones, Spine-Branch improves success rate over the baseline system by 6.0% to 16.5%, while reducing per-task cost by 34% to 70%, indicating that explicitly modeling VM-state merging constraint enables multi-agent computer use to scale efficiently.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Spine-Branch Coordination，用主干 VM 保持连续任务状态、分支 VM 并行收集信息后丢弃，避免多 VM 状态合并问题，并提升成功率、降低成本。
AI.motivation: 多智能体计算机使用代理常将长任务拆分到多个并行虚拟机执行，但不同 VM 的状态无法物理合并，现有方法通常临时处理这一约束，限制了系统可靠性与扩展效率。
AI.method: 将任务分解为“主干-分支”图：主干负责主任务流程并维持连续 VM 状态；分支任务在并行 VM 中执行，用于收集主干完成任务所需的信息；分支完成后其 VM 被丢弃，因此无需执行 VM 状态合并。
AI.result: 在 Odysseys 的 200 个长程任务以及三种 CUA 主干模型上，相比基线系统，成功率提升 6.0% 到 16.5%，单任务成本降低 34% 到 70%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模 VM 状态不可合并这一物理约束，可以使多智能体计算机使用系统在长程任务中更高效、更可扩展，并兼顾成功率与成本。

title: SpatialDiff: 3D-Aware Object Movement via Implicit Spatial Modeling
summary: Recent advances in image editing allow impressive manipulation of objects, existing methods still struggle to handle spatial movement in complex scenes, such as objects span different depth layers or are partially occluded. Most image editing methods focus solely on prior information from 2D datasets, emphasizing planar features while lacking support for spatial structures. Even approaches that incorporate explicit positional information fail to capture true 3D spatial relationships, thus limiting accurate object movement in complex scenes. In this paper, we present SpatialDiff, a method that effectively captures 3D spatial structures, enabling precise and consistent object movements in complex scenes. Our core innovations are twofold: (1) Implicit 3D Spatial Modeling, which introduces 3D prior knowledge and enables the model to internally build a comprehensive understanding of the three-dimensional spatial structure; and (2) Global Spatial Supervision, which constrains the latent spatial features to enable the model to perceive changes in object spatial positions caused by editing operations. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly improves the accuracy and fidelity of spatial movement in complex scenes.

AI.tldr: SpatialDiff 通过隐式 3D 空间建模与全局空间监督，提升复杂场景中对象空间移动编辑的准确性与保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑方法多依赖 2D 数据先验，偏重平面特征，难以处理跨深度层、遮挡等复杂三维空间关系下的对象移动；即使引入显式位置条件，也无法充分捕捉真实 3D 空间结构。
AI.method: 提出 SpatialDiff，包含两项核心设计：隐式 3D 空间建模，引入 3D 先验使模型形成内部三维空间理解；全局空间监督，对潜在空间特征施加约束，使模型感知编辑操作引起的对象空间位置变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在复杂场景的空间移动编辑中显著提升了位置移动的准确性和图像结果的保真度。
AI.conclusion: SpatialDiff 弥补了传统 2D 先验图像编辑方法在三维空间理解上的不足，为复杂场景中的一致、精确对象移动提供了有效方案。

title: Physics-Knowledge-Guided Hybrid Neural Learning for Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Evolution and Short-Range Prediction
summary: Accurate modeling of sea ice concentration (SIC) evolution is essential for polar climate assessment and short?range sea ice prediction. Numerical and data-driven approaches constitute major foundations for SIC modeling, but the former often require complex parameterizations and substantial compu?tation, whereas the latter rarely encode physical dependencies explicitly. This study presents the Physics-Informed Hybrid Ice Model (PIHIM), a differentiable data-driven hybrid ice model for daily SIC evolution that organizes its network structure according to the physical dependencies encoded in the sea ice continuity equation and explicitly accounts for dynamical transport, ther?modynamically driven areal growth and loss, and unresolved local processes. PIHIM preserves the representation capacity of deep learning while providing a process-decomposed formulation of ice displacement, freeze-melt areal change, and local error closure. Two evaluation settings are adopted: reanalysis-forced simulation examines SIC evolution stability under reanalysis forcing, and forecast-forced prediction assesses short-range performance un?der forecast-forced conditions, with reanalysis and observational SIC serving as verification references. Results indicate enhanced ice-edge preservation and error-growth control in reanalysis?forced simulation, while PIHIM retains measurable short-range prediction skill under forecast-forced conditions. Our code will be made publicly available after the paper is accepted.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PIHIM，一种基于海冰连续方程物理依赖组织网络结构的可微分数据驱动混合模型，用于日尺度海冰密集度演变建模。
AI.motivation: 准确模拟海冰密集度演变对极地气候评估和短期海冰预测很重要；传统数值方法参数化复杂且计算成本高，纯数据驱动方法又较少显式编码物理依赖。
AI.method: 构建 Physics-Informed Hybrid Ice Model（PIHIM），按海冰连续方程中的物理依赖设计网络结构，显式分解并建模动力输运、热力驱动的面积增长/消融以及未解析局地过程；在再分析强迫模拟和预报强迫预测两种设置下评估。
AI.result: 在再分析强迫模拟中，PIHIM 改善了冰缘保持能力并控制误差增长；在预报强迫条件下，模型仍保持可衡量的短期预测技巧。
AI.conclusion: PIHIM 在保留深度学习表达能力的同时提升了物理可解释性和过程分解能力，是一种兼顾效率、稳定性和短期预测性能的海冰密集度演变建模框架。

title: Semantic Reasoning Denoising: Correcting Language Model Reasoning with Semantic Operators
summary: Large language models can produce fluent reasoning traces whose local semantic errors propagate to an incorrect conclusion, while unconstrained self-correction may preserve, amplify, or introduce errors. Existing diffusion language models provide iterative refinement, but usually define noise as token masking or replacement rather than as errors in the reasoning process. We present Semantic Reasoning Denoising (SRD), an operatorized Markov denoising method for natural-language reasoning trajectories. SRD represents semantic noise with executable error operators that describe the error type, its location, and the corrupted and repaired propositions. Composing these operators constructs progressively noisier states. During training, the model learns to identify the semantic noise active in the current trajectory and to reconstruct the paired adjacent lower-noise state. During inference, noise-level-aware denoising repeatedly predicts an inverse operator and checks whether it is applicable, so each executed update makes a localized move toward a stable trajectory. Across six in-domain benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, knowledge, and commonsense, SRD improves the strongest same backbone baseline by 3.2 points on average. On seven cross-dataset transfer targets, it remains competitive with Llama-3-8B-Instruct and improves the strongest Qwen3-8B baseline average by 2.9 points. Analyses of noise sources, objectives, and denoising depth further show that structured semantic-noise prediction and iterative operator execution are central to the improvement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Semantic Reasoning Denoising（SRD），用可执行语义错误算子对自然语言推理轨迹进行马尔可夫式去噪，在多类推理任务上提升模型表现。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然能生成流畅的推理链，但局部语义错误会传播并导致错误结论；无约束自我纠错还可能保留、放大或引入新错误。现有扩散语言模型多将噪声定义为 token 掩码或替换，难以直接刻画推理过程中的语义错误。
AI.method: SRD 将语义噪声表示为可执行错误算子，包含错误类型、位置、被污染命题与修复命题。通过组合算子构造不同噪声等级的推理状态；训练时学习识别当前轨迹中的语义噪声并重构相邻低噪声状态；推理时进行噪声级别感知的迭代去噪，预测逆算子并检查其可执行性，从而局部修复推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在六个同域基准（数学、代码、知识、常识）上，SRD 相比最强同骨干基线平均提升 3.2 个百分点；在七个跨数据集迁移目标上，与 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 保持竞争力，并使最强 Qwen3-8B 基线平均提升 2.9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结构化语义噪声预测与迭代算子执行是提升推理可靠性的关键。SRD 将推理错误建模为可定位、可修复、可执行的语义噪声，为语言模型推理自我修正提供了更受约束且更稳定的框架。

title: DefaultShift: Auditing Semantic Default Shift in Accelerated Text-to-Image Models
summary: Few-step text-to-image models increasingly replace slower generators, yet acceleration can silently change distributions over unspecified attributes even when individual outputs remain plausible and aligned. We call these distributions semantic defaults and their change under replacement semantic default shift. Existing quality, preference, and diversity evaluations do not test whether a replacement preserves its reference model's semantic defaults. We introduce DefaultShift, a paired audit that labels repeated samples with closed semantic vocabularies, measures probability-mass movement, and separates interpretable ranking from confirmatory cross-fit inference. Across 14 reference and replacement pairs, adjusted color discrepancies range from 0.054 to 0.303 with recipe-specific directions. A 1,000-image human audit reproduces the ordering. We further introduce DefaultShift-Select, an offline calibration method that reduces human-measured shift by 10.3 percent to 35.1 percent across Turbo, DMD2, and FLUX without material quality loss. Under balanced evaluation, selected data recover 4.3 accuracy points and 7.5 worst-group points over uncalibrated replacement data. DefaultShift makes semantic preservation under acceleration measurable and actionable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DefaultShift，用于审计少步文本到图像模型替换慢速参考模型时是否改变未指定语义属性的默认分布，并提出 DefaultShift-Select 进行离线校准以降低偏移。
AI.motivation: 少步文生图模型加速生成，但可能在图像仍看似合理且与提示对齐的情况下，悄然改变颜色等未指定语义属性的分布；现有质量、偏好和多样性评估无法检验替换模型是否保持参考模型的语义默认值。
AI.method: 定义“semantic defaults”和“semantic default shift”；提出成对审计框架 DefaultShift：对重复采样结果使用封闭语义词表标注，度量概率质量迁移，并将可解释排序与确认性 cross-fit 推断分离；进一步提出离线校准方法 DefaultShift-Select 选择数据以减少偏移。
AI.result: 在14组参考-替换模型对上，调整后的颜色差异为0.054到0.303，且偏移方向依赖具体加速配方；1000张图像的人类审计复现了排序。DefaultShift-Select 在 Turbo、DMD2 和 FLUX 上将人类测得的偏移降低10.3%至35.1%，且无明显质量损失；在均衡评估下，选择后的数据相比未校准替换数据提升4.3个准确率点和7.5个最差组点。
AI.conclusion: DefaultShift 将加速模型替换中的语义默认保持问题转化为可度量、可解释且可操作的审计与校准任务，有助于在保持生成速度的同时降低分布性语义偏移。

title: HIRA: A Human-in-the-Loop Retrieval-Augmented Cascade for Document Classification in Regulated Industries
summary:
Document classification in regulated industries is constrained by data residency, limited cold-start labels, scarce review capacity, and costly model-governance procedures. We present HIRA, a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade for document classification in regulated deployments that combines BM25 over OCR text, dense text embeddings, and image-level representations through validation-calibrated weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. Confident documents are classified directly by retrieval; uncertain or visually confusable documents are passed to a locally hosted LLM verifier, which receives the OCR text, retrieved exemplars, label descriptions, and confusion-specific terms. When the verifier remains uncertain, the document is sent to human review. Each correction is stored as a margin-weighted retrieval exemplar and updates a Dirichlet-smoothed confusion graph, letting the system improve without updating model weights.
  On a private 80-class trade-finance corpus, HIRA processes the full 30,233-document production stream while requesting human correction for only 1,945 documents (6.4%), improving Macro-F1 from 0.6218 to 0.8548. On the corrected Tobacco-3482 benchmark, HIRA reaches 0.9423 Macro-F1 with a locally hosted DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B verifier, 17.4 percentage points above the zero-shot LLM baseline, while invoking the verifier for only about 40% of documents and reducing LLM calls by approximately 60%. With 518 human corrections (24.8% of the pool), HIRA matches the fully labelled pool oracle, in which all 2,086 pool documents are indexed with their ground-truth labels. These results show that selective human feedback and retrieval-memory adaptation can be a practical alternative to repeated model retraining for long-tail document classification in regulated deployments.

AI.tldr: HIRA 是一种面向受监管行业文档分类的训练-free、本地化检索增强级联系统，通过多模态检索融合、LLM 选择性验证与人类反馈记忆更新，在少量人工复核下显著提升长尾文档分类效果。
AI.motivation: 受监管行业的文档分类面临数据驻留限制、冷启动标注不足、人工审核资源稀缺以及模型治理和重复训练成本高等问题，因此需要一种无需频繁训练、可本地部署、能在有限人工反馈下持续改进的分类方案。
AI.method: 提出 HIRA：在本地部署环境中结合 OCR 文本的 BM25、稠密文本嵌入和图像级表示，并通过验证集校准的加权倒数排名融合进行检索分类；高置信样本由检索直接分类，低置信或视觉易混淆样本交给本地 LLM 验证器，输入包括 OCR 文本、检索样例、标签描述和混淆相关术语；若仍不确定则送人工复核。人工纠错被作为按 margin 加权的检索样例存储，并更新 Dirichlet 平滑的混淆图，从而无需更新模型权重即可改进系统。
AI.result: 在私有 80 类贸易金融语料上，HIRA 处理 30,233 份生产文档，仅请求 1,945 份人工纠正（6.4%），Macro-F1 从 0.6218 提升到 0.8548。在修正后的 Tobacco-3482 基准上，使用本地 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 验证器达到 0.9423 Macro-F1，比零样本 LLM 基线高 17.4 个百分点；仅约 40% 文档调用验证器，LLM 调用减少约 60%。使用 518 次人工纠正（池的 24.8%）即可匹配全标注池 oracle。
AI.conclusion: HIRA 表明，在受监管部署中，选择性人工反馈与检索记忆自适应可作为反复模型重训练的实用替代方案，尤其适用于长尾、多类别、标注稀缺的文档分类任务。

title: RAG Collapse: LLM Responses Collapse When Retrieved Documents Are Self-Authored
summary: LLM responses are based on the internet (via training or RAG), and AI is now used to generate a significant amount of content online (Paredes et al., 2026), creating the potential for a self-reinforcing feedback loop. Prior work has shown that when LLMs are recursively trained on their own output, they experience model collapse (Shumailov et al., 2024): responses become less diverse, and eventually no longer resemble the original training data. In this paper, we show that a similar collapse occurs if LLM-based AI systems retrieve references they authored using a search tool. We call this RAG collapse. We conduct extensive experiments with three types of simulations of AI systems retrieving references they generated, using three model families, and 1,019 information-seeking prompts, totaling 1,528 simulations and over one million LLM API calls, and find that 79.6% (1,216/1,528) of simulations end in collapse. Surprisingly, even a single self-authored reference can trigger collapse because the LLM disproportionately cites its own content. This self-bias persists even after controlling for reference quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证“RAG collapse”：当基于大语言模型的系统通过检索工具引用自身生成的内容时，会形成自我强化循环，导致输出多样性下降并偏离原始信息分布。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成内容大量进入互联网，而LLM训练或RAG又依赖互联网内容，系统可能反复接触并引用自身生成文本。已有研究关注递归训练导致的模型崩塌，但对RAG检索场景中的类似风险研究不足。
AI.method: 作者使用三类模拟实验，覆盖三个模型家族和1,019个信息寻求型提示，共进行1,528次模拟与超过一百万次LLM API调用，模拟AI系统检索并引用其自身生成参考资料的过程，并分析崩塌发生率及自我引用偏差。
AI.result: 实验显示79.6%（1,216/1,528）的模拟最终发生崩塌。即使只有一条自生成参考资料，也可能触发崩塌，因为LLM会不成比例地引用自身内容；该自我偏好在控制参考质量后仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: RAG系统不仅面临外部检索质量问题，还存在由自生成内容引发的系统性反馈风险。自我引用偏差可能导致信息生态和模型输出逐步退化，需要在检索、排序、引用和数据治理层面进行干预。

title: HP-UniIF: Hierarchical Prompt Learning for Unified Image Fusion
summary: General image fusion seeks to integrate complementary information from multiple source images, yet real-world applications often require a single system to support heterogeneous fusion, degradation restoration, and task-oriented perception simultaneously. Existing unified frameworks struggle with these orthogonal objectives, resulting in entangled representations and degraded performance across subtasks. We propose HP-UniIF, a unified vision framework that leverages diffusion priors to bridge heterogeneous fusion, visual restoration, and downstream perception. To address the limited adaptability of diffusion models to domain-, degradation-, and task-level objectives within one pipeline, HP-UniIF introduces a depth-wise hierarchical conditional modulation strategy that decouples these objectives across network stages. Task prompt modulation at bottleneck layers adapts the backbone to different fusion paradigms, the degradation prompt router at shallow layers injects degradation-aware constraints for local restoration, and the application prompt bank at decoding stages aligns generation with downstream tasks. This hierarchical design enables HP-UniIF to produce visually faithful results while preserving task-relevant semantics. Extensive experiments across multiple fusion tasks, diverse degradations, and various downstream applications demonstrate the superior performance of HP-UniIF.

AI.tldr: HP-UniIF 是一个利用扩散先验的统一图像融合框架，旨在同时处理异构融合、退化恢复与下游感知任务，并通过分层条件调制解耦不同目标。
AI.motivation: 通用图像融合需要整合多源图像互补信息，但真实应用往往还要求同一系统兼顾图像退化恢复和任务导向感知。现有统一框架难以同时优化这些相互正交的目标，容易导致表示纠缠，并使不同子任务性能下降。
AI.method: 论文提出 HP-UniIF，引入扩散模型先验作为统一视觉生成基础，并设计深度方向的分层条件调制策略：在瓶颈层使用任务提示调制以适配不同融合范式；在浅层通过退化提示路由器注入退化感知约束以强化局部恢复；在解码阶段使用应用提示库，使生成结果与下游任务需求对齐。
AI.result: 在多种图像融合任务、多样退化条件以及不同下游应用上的实验表明，HP-UniIF 相比现有方法具有更优性能，能够生成视觉上忠实且语义上有利于任务的结果。
AI.conclusion: HP-UniIF 通过将域/任务、退化和应用目标分配到不同网络阶段进行条件调制，有效缓解统一框架中的目标耦合问题，为融合、恢复与感知一体化提供了可行方案。

title: Hints, Critics, and Teachers: Prior Injection for Sparse-Reward RL in Vision-Language Math Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning for vision-language math reasoning starves under sparse reward: on a pool of 20,830 visual-math problems where Qwen2-VL-2B answers 3.6% of rollouts correctly, 85-97% of GRPO rollout groups are entirely wrong and contribute zero gradient. We train eleven methods under identical conditions in this regime, each injecting a different prior: text (reference-solution hints), distribution (on-policy distillation from a 7B teacher), and value (a value-pretrained critic with an MSE or HL-Gauss categorical loss). A prior helps exactly when it is delivered: the six arms whose prior effectively reaches the policy separate with no overlap from the remaining five -- the no-prior baseline and four arms whose prior is teacher-capped, gated away, or lost to a mis-parameterized critic -- both on the pooled in-domain metric and on cross-domain transfer (DynaMath). The central finding, however, concerns evaluation: one slice of the in-domain pool -- long used as this project's general-distribution check -- anti-correlates with genuine cross-domain transfer (Spearman rho = -0.74, n = 11 arms, permutation p = 0.011), while the hardest in-domain slice predicts it closely (rho = +0.89, p < 0.001). We attribute the inversion to a near-chance multiple-choice subset that rewards models for not having changed; read through it, the best cross-domain method looked mediocre and the worst looked like the champion. Among the methods, hint-guided exploration -- not UFT's auxiliary loss -- drives hint gains, and replacing the critic's MSE loss with HL-Gauss cross-entropy is worth +14.4 points in-domain. All accuracies are blind-judged, with paired exact tests.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏奖励下视觉-语言数学推理的强化学习训练，发现有效传递到策略的先验能显著提升表现，但评估切片选择会严重误导结论。
AI.motivation: 在视觉数学任务中，基础模型正确 rollout 极少，GRPO 训练中大量 rollout 组全错并产生零梯度，导致强化学习信号匮乏；需要理解不同先验是否能缓解这一问题，以及现有评估是否可靠。
AI.method: 作者在相同条件下比较 11 种方法，分别注入文本先验、分布先验和值函数先验；并在池化域内指标与跨域 DynaMath 上评估，同时分析不同域内切片与跨域迁移的相关性，使用盲评准确率和配对精确检验。
AI.result: 只有先验能有效到达策略的 6 个方法明显优于无先验或先验被限制、门控、错误 critic 参数化削弱的 5 个方法；某常用域内切片与跨域迁移负相关，而最难域内切片与跨域迁移高度正相关；提示引导探索是提示收益主因，HL-Gauss critic 损失相较 MSE 带来 +14.4 域内提升。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏奖励场景下，先验是否真正作用于策略比先验类型本身更关键；评估集切片可能导致方法排序反转，因此应使用能预测跨域迁移的高难度切片，并谨慎解读近随机多选子集上的结果。

title: LLM assisted writing deserves empirical evaluation
summary: LLM-assisted writing is often treated as a detection problem, as it raises questions about clarity, integrity, equity, and evaluation. An analysis of 69,209 Health Informatics papers links it to more focused presentation, broader citation practices, and more globally distributed authorship. These patterns do not prove better science, but they support evaluating manuscripts by scholarly quality and accountability rather than by tool use.

AI.tldr: 该摘要认为，应将LLM辅助写作视为学术质量与责任评估问题，而非单纯检测问题。
AI.motivation: LLM辅助写作引发关于表达清晰度、学术诚信、公平性与评价标准的争议，当前常被简化为“是否使用AI”的检测问题。
AI.method: 作者分析了69,209篇健康信息学论文，考察LLM辅助写作与论文呈现方式、引用实践及作者地域分布之间的关联。
AI.result: 分析发现，LLM辅助写作与更聚焦的论文呈现、更广泛的引用实践以及更全球化分布的作者群体相关。
AI.conclusion: 这些模式不能证明LLM辅助写作会带来更好的科学成果，但支持以学术质量和责任追溯为核心评价稿件，而不是仅依据工具使用情况进行判断。

title: SAFE-G: Structure-aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) aims to answer queries that necessitate reasoning over external knowledge sources beyond the visual content. Typically, current methods fuse multimodal features to retrieve external information, subsequently leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to derive answers from the retrieved evidence. However, these methods often struggle to capture structural associations within complex contexts to effectively filter noise. Furthermore, they frequently fail to ensure that the reasoning process remains strictly faithful to the retrieved evidence. To address these challenges, we propose SAFE-G, a Structure-Aware Faithful Evidence-guided Generation framework, which enables precise evidence localization and trustworthy reasoning. Specifically, we first employ a coarse-grained hybrid search fusing visual and textual modalities to recall candidate documents, and subsequently implement a structure-aware fine-grained graph retrieval that captures structural dependencies to filter noise and pinpoint precise evidence. Moreover, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) strategy with an evidence-grounded reward that assigns credit to correct answers only when the selected evidence is correct. This strict alignment constraint compels the model to anchor its response in the retrieved context, effectively enhancing its capability to locate evidence via multimodal features and perform faithful reasoning. Extensive experiments on the Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek benchmarks demonstrate that SAFE-G outperforms prior methods by a margin of 8.9% and 3.5%, substantially enhancing the overall reasoning accuracy. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MINE-USTC/SAFE-G.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAFE-G，用于知识增强视觉问答，通过结构感知检索与证据约束强化学习提升证据定位和忠实推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 KB-VQA 方法通常先融合视觉与文本特征检索外部知识，再由多模态大语言模型生成答案；但它们难以建模复杂上下文中的结构关联，导致噪声过滤不足，同时推理过程不一定严格依赖检索到的证据。
AI.method: SAFE-G 采用两阶段证据获取与生成框架：先通过融合视觉和文本模态的粗粒度混合检索召回候选文档；再进行结构感知的细粒度图检索，利用结构依赖过滤噪声并定位精确证据；此外，引入基于证据的强化学习奖励机制，仅在答案正确且所选证据正确时给予奖励，从而约束模型生成必须锚定于证据。
AI.result: 在 Encyclopedic-VQA 和 InfoSeek 两个基准上，SAFE-G 分别较以往方法提升 8.9% 和 3.5%，显著提高了整体推理准确率。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-G 通过结构化证据检索和证据忠实性约束，有效提升了 KB-VQA 中的证据定位、噪声过滤与可信推理能力，是一种更可靠的知识增强视觉问答框架。

title: VisAdj: Learning Adjacency Matrices from Node-Link Images
summary: Learning adjacency matrices from node-link images is a fundamental problem for recovering structured graph information from visual observations. Existing methods typically rely on fixed KNN-based heuristics for candidate edge selection and fail to capture dependencies among edges. To overcome these limitations, we propose VisAdj, a new framework for topology-aware adjacency prediction. VisAdj introduces an attention-sparse neighbor sampler to adaptively select a high-recall set of candidate node pairs and performs joint edge inference using a line-graph transformer that treats candidate edges as tokens and explicitly models dependencies among incident edges. Extensive experiments on synthetic graphs, road networks, and vessel images demonstrate that VisAdj consistently outperforms existing baselines by clear margins.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VisAdj，用于从节点-连线图像中学习邻接矩阵，通过自适应候选边采样与联合边推断提升图结构恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖固定的 KNN 启发式规则进行候选边选择，难以适应不同视觉结构；同时通常独立预测边，无法建模边与边之间的依赖关系，限制了拓扑恢复精度。
AI.method: VisAdj 包含两部分：首先使用 attention-sparse neighbor sampler 自适应选择高召回率候选节点对；随后将候选边作为 token，利用 line-graph transformer 显式建模相邻/关联边之间的依赖关系，并进行联合边推断。
AI.result: 在合成图、道路网络和血管图像等数据上的实验显示，VisAdj 相比现有基线方法取得稳定且明显的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该摘要表明，引入拓扑感知的候选边选择和边依赖建模，可以更有效地从视觉观测中恢复图的邻接结构，VisAdj 在多类图像场景中具有较好的泛化潜力。

title: SSE-Bio: A Structured Self-Evolving Agent with Agentic Retrieval Policy for Multi-Hop Biomedical Reasoning
summary: Biomedical multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to connect evidence across intermediate entities such as diseases, drugs, proteins, and phenotypes. Existing agents typically rely on static retrieval workflows or coarse-grained prompt rewriting, which can lead to instruction drift when reasoning procedures need to be updated. We propose SSE-Bio, a structured self-evolving agent with an agentic retrieval policy for multi-hop biomedical reasoning. Instead of globally rewriting agent instructions, SSE-Bio maintains a structured state, selectively retrieves knowledge triplets and prior templates through a trainable proxy policy, and improves its reasoning memory through fine-grained template editing. To optimise retrieval decisions, we introduce a proxy-training strategy based on group relative policy optimization, where the proxy is improved through decision-contrastive groups over alternative retrieval choices. Experiments on three biomedical multi-hop QA benchmarks show that SSE-Bio consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving an improvement of 6.56 absolute points over the strongest self-evolving baseline on BioHopR.

AI.tldr: SSE-Bio 是一种面向生物医学多跳问答的结构化自进化智能体，通过结构化状态、选择性检索和细粒度模板编辑提升跨实体推理能力，并在多个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 生物医学多跳问答需要在疾病、药物、蛋白质、表型等中间实体之间连接证据。现有智能体多依赖静态检索流程或粗粒度提示重写，面对推理过程更新时容易产生指令漂移，限制了稳定性与可适应性。
AI.method: 论文提出 SSE-Bio：维护结构化推理状态，而不是全局重写智能体指令；通过可训练的代理策略选择性检索知识三元组和历史模板；使用细粒度模板编辑更新推理记忆；并引入基于组相对策略优化的代理训练策略，通过不同检索选择构成的决策对比组优化检索决策。
AI.result: 在三个生物医学多跳问答基准上的实验表明，SSE-Bio 持续超过现有基线方法；在 BioHopR 上相比最强自进化基线取得 6.56 个绝对百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，相比粗粒度指令重写，结构化状态管理、策略化检索和细粒度记忆编辑更适合复杂生物医学多跳推理，可有效提升问答性能与推理过程的可控性。

title: FlashReg: GPU-Accelerated 3-Clique Point Cloud Registration for Real-Time Correspondence-to-Pose Estimation
summary: Graph-based point cloud registration achieves high robustness by identifying geometrically consistent correspondence sets, but constructing second-order compatibility graphs and enumerating candidate cliques remain compute- and memory-intensive. This work presents FlashReg, a GPU-oriented correspondence-to-pose estimator that avoids materializing the dense scored second-order graph. Its Fast First- and Second-Order Graph (FFSOG) construction builds a capacity-bounded sparse second-order graph directly from the binary first-order graph. A dataflow-optimized three-node clique (3-clique) search then selects pivots from compact per-row candidate pools and enumerates triples through sorted sparse-neighborhood intersections. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, FlashReg reduces correspondence-to-pose latency by 2--3x relative to TurboReg at comparable registration recall, while using about 50% of its peak allocated tensor memory on an embedded GPU. These results make FlashReg suitable as a high-throughput registration backend within onboard perception pipelines.

AI.tldr: FlashReg 是一种面向 GPU 的点云配准 correspondence-to-pose 估计器，通过避免显式构建稠密二阶兼容图，在保持相近配准召回率的同时显著降低延迟与显存占用。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的点云配准方法依赖几何一致的对应集合，鲁棒性较高，但二阶兼容图构建和候选团枚举计算量、内存开销大，难以满足嵌入式/车载实时感知需求。
AI.method: 提出 Fast First- and Second-Order Graph（FFSOG），从二值一阶图直接构建容量受限的稀疏二阶图，避免物化稠密带分数二阶图；同时设计数据流优化的三节点团搜索，从紧凑的逐行候选池选择 pivot，并通过排序稀疏邻域交集枚举三元组。
AI.result: 在室内和室外基准上，相比 TurboReg，FlashReg 在相近 registration recall 下将 correspondence-to-pose 延迟降低约 2–3 倍，并在嵌入式 GPU 上仅使用约其 50% 的峰值张量分配显存。
AI.conclusion: FlashReg 通过稀疏图构建和高效 3-clique 搜索提升了点云配准后端的速度与内存效率，适合作为车载/板载感知流水线中的高吞吐配准模块。

title: Beyond Success and Failure: Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for automating tasks across diverse digital environments, where reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant training paradigm. However, widely used methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffer from reward-gradient misalignment, leading to inefficient and unstable optimization. Recent work addresses this issue by reformulating RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) as contrastive or classification-based objectives, which improve stability by eliminating problematic gradient behaviors. Despite this progress, existing contrastive RLVR methods rely primarily on outcome-level supervision and fail to capture fine-grained differences in trajectory quality within the same outcome category. In this paper, we propose Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents (LACL-GUI), a contrastive RLVR framework that incorporates trajectory-level quality signals into policy optimization. LACL-GUI introduces structured preferences within both successful and failed trajectories, encouraging concise successful executions and differentiating failure quality based on divergence from successful trajectories, while preserving optimization stability. Experiments on GUI agent benchmarks show that LACL-GUI provides more effective learning signals and consistently improves agent performance over prior methods, highlighting the value of trajectory-level supervision in contrastive RLVR.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LACL-GUI：一种面向 GUI 智能体的长度感知对比式 RLVR 框架，在保持优化稳定性的同时引入轨迹级质量监督，以提升策略学习效率与任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体常用强化学习训练，但 GRPO 等方法存在奖励-梯度不一致问题，导致优化低效且不稳定；已有对比式或分类式 RLVR 虽提升稳定性，却主要依赖结果级监督，难以区分同一成败类别内部轨迹质量差异。
AI.method: 提出 Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents（LACL-GUI），在对比式 RLVR 中加入轨迹级质量信号：对成功轨迹偏好更简洁的执行路径；对失败轨迹依据其与成功轨迹的偏离程度刻画失败质量，从而构造更细粒度的结构化偏好。
AI.result: 在 GUI 智能体基准测试中，LACL-GUI 相比既有方法提供更有效的学习信号，并稳定提升智能体性能。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级监督能够弥补仅依赖结果级监督的不足；将长度感知与失败质量区分纳入对比式 RLVR，有助于在保持优化稳定性的同时提升 GUI 智能体训练效果。

title: Lexical Perturbations Disrupt LLM Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Attention Diversion
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 9 pages main text, 12 figures, 20 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, but their robustness to realistic lexical corruption remains poorly understood. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Diversion: lexical corruption fragments subword tokenization, and the resulting fragments attract disproportionate attention mass, concentrated in middle and final transformer layers. Length-matched controls confirm that fragmentation, not prompt length, drives the loss. A factorial intervention then shows why the damage is hard to undo: fragmentation corrupts token content and attention allocation together, and the two are coupled. Restoring clean attention while the content remains corrupted is actively harmful, restoring content alone is insufficient, and only restoring both recovers a substantial share of the gap. This coupling explains why inference-time strategies, including chain-of-thought prompting, spell-checking, self-repair, and stronger repair models, fail to consistently recover performance: each addresses one channel at a time. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Jiaqian-Janelle/Attention-Diversion

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在真实词汇扰动下的推理鲁棒性，发现字符级扰动会显著削弱多步推理表现，而填充词插入影响较小；核心原因是子词分词碎片化导致注意力被异常吸引。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在推理任务上表现强，但其面对现实输入中的键盘噪声、字符交换等词汇损坏时是否稳健仍缺乏系统理解。作者希望解释不同类型文本扰动为何对推理性能产生不对称影响。
AI.method: 作者在四个推理基准上评估四个开源指令微调模型及前沿模型，施加键盘噪声、字符交换和填充插入等扰动；进一步分析分词碎片化与注意力分布，使用长度匹配对照排除提示长度影响，并通过因子干预分别恢复内容与注意力以检验因果机制。
AI.result: 字符级扰动显著降低准确率，尤其影响多步推理任务；填充插入影响很小。扰动会造成子词 token 碎片化，碎片在中后层 Transformer 中吸收过多注意力。长度匹配实验表明性能下降来自碎片化而非输入变长。干预结果显示内容损坏与注意力错配相互耦合：仅恢复注意力可能有害，仅恢复内容不足，必须同时恢复二者才能显著弥补性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出“注意力转移”机制解释词汇扰动下推理鲁棒性下降：字符级损坏同时破坏 token 内容与注意力分配，且两者耦合，使得链式思维、拼写检查、自修复或更强修复模型等单通道推理期补救方法难以稳定恢复性能。

title: Through the Schrödinger Bridge: Benchmarking Antemortem Image Restoration from Postmortem Autolysis to Enhance Forensic Diagnostics
summary: Forensic histopathology, essential for determining cause of death and disease diagnosis, is severely impeded by postmortem autolysis, i.e., an irreversible, stochastic degradation process that distorts tissue morphology and introduces diagnostic subjectivity, thereby underscoring the value of restoring autolyzed images to a diagnostically plausible, pre-autolysis state for improving objectivity in forensic practice. This restoration task is fundamentally challenging due to the large, non-deterministic morphological changes caused by autolysis and the infeasibility of pixel-wise paired data, which invalidates assumptions underlying supervised and cycle/structure-consistent unpaired translation methods. To address this, we formalize forensic histopathology autolysis restoration as a new task: under unpaired supervision, transform postmortem images with severe autolysis into diagnostically meaningful ``antemortem'' representations. We contribute AutoPath, the first homologous yet unpaired dataset for this problem, constructed by splitting specimens into adjacent tissue blocks---one processed immediately, the other exposed to induce autolysis---yielding nearly ten thousand $10\times$ patches from 69 cases with varying liver conditions. We further frame the problem as a Schrödinger Bridge between the autolyzed and non-autolyzed distributions, offering a principled approach to modeling stochastic, severe morphological degradation. Critically, we demonstrate the misalignment of generic image-level generative metrics (e.g., FID) with diagnostic utility and propose a forensically grounded, slide-level diagnostic distribution consistency evaluation. Overall, this work establishes a reproducible benchmark (encompassing task definition, a real-world dataset, and an evaluation methodology) toward rigorous and practically meaningful progress in autolysis restoration for forensic pathology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出法医组织病理自溶图像恢复的新任务、数据集 AutoPath 与评估框架，旨在将严重自溶的死后组织图像转换为具有诊断意义的近似生前表征。
AI.motivation: 死后自溶会不可逆且随机地破坏组织形态，增加法医病理诊断主观性；而传统监督学习或循环一致性非配对翻译方法难以处理无像素级配对、形态变化剧烈且随机的问题。
AI.method: 构建同源但非配对的 AutoPath 数据集：相邻组织块分别立即处理与诱导自溶；将恢复过程建模为自溶分布与非自溶分布之间的 Schrödinger Bridge，并提出面向法医诊断的切片级诊断分布一致性评估。
AI.result: 形成约一万张 10× 图像块，覆盖 69 个病例及多种肝脏状态；指出 FID 等通用图像级生成指标与诊断效用不一致，并给出更贴近法医实践的评估方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了自溶恢复的可复现实验基准，包括任务定义、真实数据集和诊断导向评估方法，为法医病理图像恢复提供了系统研究基础。

title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
summary: Recent large language models (LLMs) can operate as coding agents that build complete games from natural language requests. Game development is especially demanding because program logic, visual and audio content, interfaces, interaction and playability must function together in one executable artifact. Measuring this capability therefore requires evaluation of both game product and the development process. Existing benchmarks often assess the game development capabilities of LLMs by evaluating the final artifact or an isolated development stage. Our analysis of complete human-agent development trajectories identifies three stages that together span the lifecycle of game development with a coding agent: initial game generation, bug diagnosis and repair, and optimization over multiple turns. Therefore, we introduce GameXpert-Bench, which operationalizes the three lifecycle stages as three complementary benchmark tracks. GameGen evaluates complete game creation from a single request in an empty workspace. GameFix evaluates diagnosis and repair when defects are reported or left for the agent to discover. GameOpt evaluates cumulative optimization through request chains seeded by real development trajectories between users and agents. We evaluate each track using live game interaction, deterministic behavioral tests, or final product criteria with regression checks. The suite contains 97 generation tasks across 11 genres; 100 repair tasks from 50 game levels verified by humans, each with 19-27 injected bugs; and 17 optimization chains with six turns and 102 requests. Across the three tracks, current agents are more reliable at producing playable foundations and implementing explicit requirements than at discovering defects, verifying runtime behavior, and preserving functionality across changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GameXpert-Bench，用于系统评估大语言模型编码智能体在完整游戏开发生命周期中的能力，覆盖生成、修复与多轮优化三类任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多只评估最终游戏成品或单一开发阶段，难以全面衡量 LLM 编码智能体在游戏开发中同时处理程序逻辑、视听内容、交互界面与可玩性的综合能力。
AI.method: 作者基于完整的人类-智能体开发轨迹，总结出游戏开发的三个关键阶段，并构建三条评测轨道：GameGen 评估从空工作区单次请求生成完整游戏；GameFix 评估缺陷诊断与修复；GameOpt 评估基于真实开发轨迹的多轮需求链优化。评测结合实时游戏交互、确定性行为测试、最终产品准则和回归检查。
AI.result: 基准包含 11 个类型的 97 个生成任务、来自 50 个游戏关卡且经人工验证的 100 个修复任务，以及 17 条六轮优化链共 102 个请求。实验发现当前智能体更擅长生成可玩的基础版本和实现明确需求。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 编码智能体在发现隐藏缺陷、验证运行时行为以及在连续修改中保持既有功能方面仍存在明显不足，GameXpert-Bench 为全面评估和改进游戏开发智能体提供了生命周期视角的基准。

title: The Collaboration Tax: How Much LLM Multi-Agent Systems Pay to Coordinate
summary: Multi-agent systems built from large language models are deployed widely, yet how much performance is lost when two LLMs must coordinate rather than act alone remains unclear. We formulate the collaboration tax as the team-decentralisation loss of a two-player cooperative game with private information, with two propositions characterising its sign and its equivalence to a max-superadditivity violation. We operationalise this definition on 32 solo-tractable tasks grouped by source of grounding friction and measure it on 11 models from 7 providers. The tax is structured along two no-exception axes: a category ordering across every model and a monotonic decrease with capability. The proximate mechanism is not a reasoning deficit but a four-stage conversational cascade in which agents make ungrounded claims, fail to query the partner, skip integrating both views, and accept the answer without re-derivation. The tax is mechanically predictable from conversation features and partly tractable: a prompt intervention targeting all four stages closes a substantial fraction of the gap, with the dominant bottleneck differing across categories. In heterogeneous pairs the tax is pulled toward the stronger partner rather than the additive midpoint, empirically realising the max-superadditivity violation predicted by our framework. Together these results recast collaboration in LLM systems as a measurable, predictable, and partly tractable cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实证测量LLM双智能体协作相较单独行动产生的“协作税”，发现该损失具有稳定结构、可由对话特征预测，并可通过针对性提示部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 随着基于大语言模型的多智能体系统被广泛部署，研究者尚不清楚两个LLM在需要协调协作时，相比单个模型独立完成任务会损失多少性能，以及这种损失来自何种机制。
AI.method: 作者将协作税形式化为带私有信息的双人合作博弈中的团队去中心化损失，并用两个命题刻画其符号及其与最大超加性违反的等价关系；随后在32个单体可解任务上，按 grounding friction 来源分组，对来自7个提供方的11个模型进行测量，并分析对话过程特征与提示干预效果。
AI.result: 实验发现协作税沿两个无例外轴呈现结构性规律：不同任务类别在所有模型上具有一致排序，且随模型能力增强而单调下降。损失主要不是推理能力不足，而是由四阶段对话级联导致：无根据断言、不询问伙伴、未整合双方观点、未经重新推导即接受答案。对话特征可机械预测该税；针对四阶段的提示干预可显著缩小差距。异构模型配对中，协作表现更接近强模型而非简单加性中点，符合框架预测的最大超加性违反。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将LLM系统中的协作问题重新界定为一种可测量、可预测且部分可治理的成本，为理解和改进多智能体LLM协作提供了理论定义、实证证据和干预方向。

title: PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models
comment: 31 pages, 9 figures. Code will be available
summary: Reliable image captioning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires captions to be both precise and complete, avoiding unsupported object mentions while covering visible objects. Existing training-free methods primarily address the former requirement, suppressing unsupported object words by intervening on model-predicted mentions during generation. Because they operate only on objects the model is already likely to mention, visible objects omitted from the output remain difficult to recover. We propose PatchGate, a training-free framework that extracts prompt-free object evidence intrinsic to a frozen VLM before generation and uses it to narrow the gap between an intrinsic object set and final object mentions. In the first stage, Visual Evidence eXtraction (VEX) reads patch-level lexical evidence from the latter half of LM decoder layers and constructs an image-conditioned object set without any task prompt. In the second stage, Visual-Evidence Inclusion-Exclusion Decoding (VIED) uses this object evidence to calibrate decoding logits, promoting evidence-supported but under-verbalized objects and suppressing weakly supported but over-verbalized objects. On AMBER, PatchGate improves both sides of object-level reliability, increasing visible-object coverage from 49.4 to 56.0 (+13.4%) and reducing object hallucination by lowering CHAIR from 7.5 to 6.6 (-12.0%), without external detectors or fine-tuning and with one extra forward pass.

AI.tldr: PatchGate 是一个训练-free 的 VLM 图像描述可靠性框架，通过先提取图像内部对象证据，再在解码阶段进行包含/排除式校准，同时提升可见对象覆盖率并降低对象幻觉。
AI.motivation: 可靠图像描述需要兼顾精确性与完整性：既不能提及图中不存在的对象，也应覆盖图中可见对象。现有训练-free 方法多集中于抑制模型生成中已倾向提到的 unsupported object words，难以恢复模型原本遗漏的可见对象，因此存在覆盖不足问题。
AI.method: 提出 PatchGate，两阶段训练-free 框架。第一阶段 VEX 在无任务提示条件下，从冻结 VLM 的 LM decoder 后半层读取 patch-level lexical evidence，构建图像条件对象集合。第二阶段 VIED 利用该对象证据校准解码 logits：提升有视觉证据但生成不足的对象，抑制视觉证据弱但过度生成的对象。该方法无需外部检测器或微调，仅增加一次前向传播。
AI.result: 在 AMBER 基准上，PatchGate 同时改善对象级可靠性的两个方面：可见对象覆盖率从 49.4 提升到 56.0，相对提升 13.4%；对象幻觉指标 CHAIR 从 7.5 降至 6.6，相对下降 12.0%。
AI.conclusion: PatchGate 表明冻结 VLM 内部已包含可用于对象识别与描述校准的视觉证据。通过在生成前提取该证据并在解码时进行包含/排除式调整，可以在不训练、不依赖外部检测器的情况下同时提升图像描述的完整性和精确性。

title: LLM4LLM: Bridging Kernel Benchmarks and Real Deployment via Closed-Loop Agentic Optimization
summary: Large language models have become increasingly capable agents for low-level code and kernel optimization, but isolated kernel benchmarks provide only a proxy for the deployment behavior that matters in language-model inference. We identify a benchmark-to-deployment gap: candidate kernels that appear correct and fast in standalone harnesses can exhibit different performance, safety, or phase behavior after integration into a real inference workload. We introduce LLM4LLM, a deployment-aware closed-loop optimization framework that starts from a target inference script, extracts phase-aware optimization tasks, searches with an experience-guided episodic agent, and accepts patches through in-model validation. Across ten language-model inference workloads on A100 and H100 GPUs, LLM4LLM improves end-to-end latency for every evaluated model, achieving 3.91$\times$/6.98$\times$ geometric-mean speedups on A100/H100; as supporting kernel-level evidence, it also attains up to 2.745$\times$ GeoMean speedup on KernelBench Level 2.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LLM4LLM：面向真实推理部署的闭环优化框架，弥合单独 kernel benchmark 与端到端部署表现之间的差距，并在多种模型推理工作负载上显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有低层代码与 GPU kernel 优化通常依赖独立基准测试，但这些测试只能近似反映真实语言模型推理部署中的行为。候选 kernel 在独立测试中看似正确且快速，集成到真实推理脚本后可能出现性能变化、安全问题或不同执行阶段行为，因此需要部署感知的优化方法。
AI.method: LLM4LLM 从目标推理脚本出发，提取具有阶段感知的优化任务；使用经验引导的 episodic agent 进行搜索；并通过模型内验证机制决定是否接受补丁，从而形成部署感知的闭环优化流程。
AI.result: 在 A100 和 H100 GPU 上的十个语言模型推理工作负载中，LLM4LLM 对所有评测模型均提升端到端延迟表现，A100/H100 上分别达到 3.91×/6.98× 的几何平均加速；在 KernelBench Level 2 上最高实现 2.745× 的 GeoMean kernel 级加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，面向真实推理部署的闭环优化比单独 kernel benchmark 更能捕捉实际性能瓶颈，并可稳定提升语言模型推理的端到端效率。

title: How Agents Represent Humans: Human-Directed Stereotypes in an Open Agent Social Network
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in persistent social environments, where generated claims can be posted, replied to, remembered, and reused. We study human-directed stereotypes on Moltbook, an open agent-native social platform, asking how agents construct humans as a social category. For this human-target analysis, we introduce an annotation framework with four evaluative dimensions---morality, friendliness, competence, and autonomy---and a second-stage subtype scheme for descriptive \textit{other} attributions. We find that competence dominates human-directed evaluations, while many \textit{other} attributions describe humans as epistemic, cultural, or embodied subjects. We further examine how these human representations appear in human--agent narrative contexts and platform-level circulation. As an auxiliary comparison, we analyze agent-internal community feedback through behavioral host affinity. Rather than reproducing the stable insider--outsider rejection often observed in human online communities, Moltbook feedback patterns are better explained by exposure, author visibility, and content selection. These findings suggest that bias in agent societies should be studied not only as isolated model output, but also as a discourse process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体在持久性社交平台中如何构建“人类”这一社会类别，并指出偏见应作为平台话语流通过程来分析。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体被部署到可持续互动的社交环境中，其生成的观点会被发布、回复、记忆和复用，因此需要理解智能体如何在社会语境中评价和表征人类，而不仅是检测单次模型输出中的偏见。
AI.method: 作者以开放的智能体原生社交平台Moltbook为研究对象，提出面向人类的标注框架，包含道德性、友好性、能力和自主性四个评价维度，并进一步设计针对描述性“他者”归因的二阶段子类型方案；同时分析人类—智能体叙事语境、平台层面的传播，以及作为辅助比较的智能体内部社群反馈中的行为宿主亲和性。
AI.result: 研究发现，智能体对人类的评价中“能力”维度占主导；许多“他者”归因将人类描述为认知性、文化性或具身性主体。平台反馈模式并未呈现人类网络社群中常见的稳定内部—外部排斥结构，而更能由曝光度、作者可见性和内容选择解释。
AI.conclusion: 智能体社会中的偏见不应仅被视为孤立的模型输出问题，而应被理解为在叙事、互动、记忆和平台传播机制中形成与循环的话语过程。

title: Towards Alias-Free 4D Gaussian Representations with Motion-Aware Filtering
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://maaf-4dgs.github.io/
summary: Novel-view synthesis of dynamic scenes, crucial for AR/VR applications, remains a challenging problem. Recent methods adapt representations like 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for dynamic scenes by incorporating time as the fourth dimension (4D representations). These 4D representations still suffer from aliasing artifacts, especially when generating novel views from divergent viewpoints (zoom-in/zoom-out operations). While using 3D smoothing filters like those proposed in Mip-Splatting might seem like a possible solution, they fail to account for local motion and also exhibit aliasing. To address this, we propose a motion-aware 3D smoothing filter specifically designed for 4D representations. Our approach adapts the filter strength based on local motion information, effectively mitigating aliasing without compromising rendering quality. This is achieved by estimating the joint density function of time and focal-to-depth ratio using a non-parametric estimation method. During inference, we sample from this joint distribution to determine the appropriate smoothing filter. This flexible strategy can be integrated with various 4D representations. Our evaluations on standard datasets demonstrate superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向动态场景4D表示的运动感知3D平滑滤波方法，用于减少新视角合成中的混叠伪影。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的新视角合成在AR/VR中很重要，但现有将3DGS或NeRF扩展到4D的表示方法，在视角差异较大或缩放操作时容易产生混叠。已有3D平滑滤波方法未考虑局部运动，因此在动态场景中效果不足。
AI.method: 作者设计运动感知3D平滑滤波器，根据局部运动信息自适应调节滤波强度。具体通过非参数估计方法建模时间与焦距-深度比的联合密度函数，并在推理阶段从该分布采样，以确定合适的平滑滤波策略。该方法可集成到多种4D表示中。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比现有先进方法具有更好的性能，能够有效减少混叠，同时保持渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 运动信息对于动态场景4D表示中的抗混叠至关重要；通过运动感知的自适应平滑滤波，可以提升动态新视角合成的稳定性和视觉质量。

title: AI Watchdog: Agent Interfaces for Detecting and Defending Against Manipulative Dark Patterns in AI Conversations
summary: Conversational AI increasingly shapes consequential decisions, yet users have limited support for recognizing and resisting manipulation. We present AI Watchdog, a browser-based agent interface that monitors live conversations, detects five dark-pattern categories, including sycophancy, brand bias, anthropomorphization, sneaking, and harmful generation, and alerts users when they occur. Its open-weight turn-level classifier supports independent deployment and a path toward local inference, preserving user privacy while remaining separate from the conversational AI. We evaluated AI Watchdog in a preregistered, five-condition between-subjects experiment (N = 150) comparing a no-intervention control with four configurations varying nudge timing (prebunking vs. just-in-time) and engagement mode (without vs. with cognitive forcing). Results show that participants rarely flagged manipulative turns across all conditions, and post-task awareness did not differ significantly across groups. However, just-in-time warnings without cognitive forcing were the only intervention to significantly reduce compliance with AI-steered recommendations containing dark patterns, lowering compliance from 71.7% to 53.7%, an 18 percentage-point reduction. Exploratory analyses further showed that lower misinformation susceptibility was associated with greater flagging but not lower compliance, while higher AI trust was associated with greater compliance and lower reported awareness. Together, these findings suggest that explicit recognition of conversational dark patterns and behavioral resistance to AI steering may be distinct outcomes, motivating further investigation of timely, low-friction defensive interfaces.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并评估 AI Watchdog：一种浏览器端对话监测代理，用于识别对话式 AI 中的暗黑模式并提醒用户。实验显示，低摩擦的即时警告可显著降低用户对含暗黑模式推荐的服从率，但并未显著提升用户的显性识别或事后意识。
AI.motivation: 对话式 AI 正越来越多影响用户的重要决策，但用户缺乏有效工具来识别和抵抗操纵性对话策略。现有系统往往与被监测 AI 耦合、隐私保护不足，且关于何种提醒机制能真正减少用户被操纵的证据有限。
AI.method: 作者设计了 AI Watchdog，一个独立于对话 AI 的浏览器代理界面，实时监测对话并检测五类暗黑模式：迎合、品牌偏见、拟人化、隐性夹带和有害生成。系统使用开放权重的轮次级分类器，支持独立部署和潜在本地推理。研究通过预注册的五条件被试间实验（N=150）评估系统，比较无干预控制组与四种干预配置，变量包括提醒时机（预先警示 vs. 即时提醒）和参与模式（无认知强制 vs. 有认知强制）。
AI.result: 总体上，参与者在所有条件下都很少主动标记操纵性轮次，任务后的意识水平在不同组间无显著差异。然而，仅“即时提醒且无认知强制”的配置显著降低了用户对 AI 引导推荐的服从率，使服从率从 71.7% 降至 53.7%，下降 18 个百分点。探索性分析显示，较低的错误信息易感性与更多标记行为相关，但不与更低服从率相关；较高的 AI 信任与更高服从率和更低报告意识相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，用户对对话暗黑模式的显性识别与实际抵抗 AI 引导可能是不同结果。及时、低摩擦的防御性界面比要求用户额外认知参与的机制更可能减少操纵性影响。未来需要进一步研究如何在不增加用户负担的情况下提升对话式 AI 环境中的防操纵能力。

title: Dual-Layer Agentic Memory with Fast Write Routing and Slow Consolidation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents operate in dynamic environments where knowledge continuously evolves. Existing memory systems typically treat external memory as a monotonically growing repository, inevitably leading to retrieval degradation and increasing computational costs over time. We argue that the core challenge is not retrieval alone, but managing the knowledge lifecycle: deciding what to externalize, update, or ultimately internalize. Inspired by Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory in neuroscience, we propose Dual-Layer Agentic Memory, a framework that shifts memory management to the write phase through cost-aware epistemic routing and periodic parametric consolidation. Incoming information is categorized as non-write, write-new, or write-update, and routed through a small-to-large model cascade that minimizes routing overhead while filtering redundant memories. A subsequent write-back phase selectively consolidates high-value external memories into model parameters via supervised fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate the dual efficiency of our approach: a 1.7B/8B cascade prunes up to 68% of redundant external memory while escalating fewer than 50% of inputs, yet retains over 98% of the downstream QA Exact Match (EM) achieved by an exhaustive retention baseline. We further show that periodic consolidation successfully internalizes external knowledge, allowing the router to adaptively suppress redundant writes as the model's epistemic boundaries evolve. Overall, our framework presents a unified paradigm for agent memory: selective externalization followed by selective internalization. Code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dual-Layer Agentic Memory，将智能体记忆管理从检索阶段前移到写入阶段，通过选择性外部化与周期性参数内化降低冗余记忆和计算成本，同时保持下游问答性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体处于知识持续变化的动态环境中。现有外部记忆系统通常单调增长，导致检索质量下降、存储与计算开销增加。作者认为关键问题不是单纯提升检索，而是管理知识生命周期：判断哪些信息应写入、更新、忽略，哪些外部知识应进一步内化到模型参数中。
AI.method: 提出受互补学习系统理论启发的双层智能体记忆框架。第一层在写入阶段进行成本感知的认识论路由，将输入信息分类为 non-write、write-new 或 write-update，并使用小到大的模型级联降低路由成本、过滤冗余记忆。第二层为周期性 write-back consolidation，将高价值外部记忆通过监督微调选择性整合进模型参数，使模型知识边界随时间更新。
AI.result: 实验显示，1.7B/8B 级联路由可剪除最多 68% 的冗余外部记忆，同时少于 50% 的输入需要升级到大模型处理；在下游 QA Exact Match 上仍保持穷尽保留基线超过 98% 的性能。周期性参数巩固能成功内化外部知识，并使路由器随着模型知识边界变化而自适应减少冗余写入。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一个统一的智能体记忆管理范式：先选择性外部化，再选择性内化。相比无限增长式外部记忆，它更注重知识生命周期管理，在效率、存储开销和任务性能之间取得较好平衡。

title: Towards Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding: Through Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors
summary: Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding (BcHVU) aims to understand harshly degraded videos originally decoded from a severely corrupted bitstream in real-world multimedia communication. The ill-posed nature of BcHVU poses a major challenge for existing vision models, as even subtle bitstream corruption can lead to irreversible pixel distortion and significant semantic loss. To address these challenges in BcHVU, we propose Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors (BLMSP), a framework for learning and injecting bitstream-native semantic cues. Our proposed BLMSP framework learns to extract bitstream-native semantic cues by bitstream language modeling, and leverages them as priors by injecting into off-the-shelf vision models of BcHVU tasks. Specifically, we present a Video Bitstream Byte Model (VBBM) that integrates byte-level modeling and cross-codec semantic distillation, enabling it to interpret robust semantics from byte sequences in multiple corrupted bitstream formats. The learned bitstream semantics are leveraged as robust priors and fused into BcHVU model backbones for improving the quality of video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation. To train BLMSP, we construct a large-scale multi-source Corrupted-bitstream Harsh-video Paired (CHP) dataset containing 607k corrupted bitstream segments and 287k paired harsh video clips. Extensive experimental results show that the learned bitstream priors improve video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation by 2.51 dB in PSNR, 0.20 in CIDEr, and 0.18 in PCK@0.2 on average, respectively. These results demonstrate that corrupted bitstream can serve as robust semantic priors in solving pixel distortion and semantic loss in BcHVU.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BLMSP 框架，通过对损坏视频码流进行字节级语言建模，提取码流原生语义先验，并注入现有视觉模型，以提升严重码流损坏场景下的视频理解与恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现实多媒体通信中，视频码流可能严重损坏，导致解码后像素不可逆失真和语义信息丢失；现有视觉模型主要依赖退化后的像素输入，难以处理 BcHVU 这种病态问题。因此需要从损坏码流本身挖掘更鲁棒的语义线索。
AI.method: 作者提出 Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors（BLMSP）。核心是 Video Bitstream Byte Model（VBBM），结合字节级建模与跨编码器语义蒸馏，从多种损坏码流格式的字节序列中学习鲁棒语义表示；随后将这些码流语义作为先验融合进视频恢复、视频字幕生成和人体姿态估计等任务的现成视觉模型骨干网络。训练上构建了包含 607k 损坏码流片段和 287k 配对退化视频片段的 CHP 数据集。
AI.result: 实验显示，码流语义先验在多个 BcHVU 任务上带来稳定提升：视频恢复平均 PSNR 提升 2.51 dB，视频字幕生成 CIDEr 提升 0.20，人体姿态估计 PCK@0.2 提升 0.18。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，即使码流发生损坏，其字节序列中仍可能保留可利用的鲁棒语义信息；通过码流语言建模学习这些信息并注入视觉模型，可以有效缓解像素失真和语义丢失问题，为恶劣视频理解提供新的建模方向。

title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance
summary: LLM agents are moving from single-prompt use to long task streams in which reusable memory becomes a core capability for terminal, software-engineering, and web tasks. Such memory is useful only when stored experience remains reliable across hundreds of interactions, but two failure modes break that assumption in practice. The first is unreliable admission: failed trajectories,accidental successes, and misleading observations enter memory because they appear relevant, then mislead later decisions. The second is memory drift: long-running banks accumulate duplicate, stale, and conflicting records that retrieval alone cannot repair. MemGuard's key distinction is to treat verifier output not as a one-shot filter, but as persistent lifecycle metadata. It converts multi-criteria score-token verification into reward, confidence, label, and uncertainty descriptors that are attached to every candidate before activation and reused during retrieval, conflict resolution, summarization, and archival. We evaluate MemGuard on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-Bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web across four backbones, comparing against four memory baselines plus a verifier-only control under matched runtime budgets. Averaged over five seeds, MemGuard achieves the best success metric and lowest average steps in all 16 backbone-benchmark settings, improving over ReasoningBank, the strongest prior baseline among the memory methods we evaluate, with a largest gain of 7.9 success-rate points on WebArena, 5.6 step-success-rate points on Mind2Web, and 2.4-3.5 points on terminal and software-engineering benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/whyyyyy123/MemGuard.

AI.tldr: MemGuard 将验证器输出转化为可持久复用的记忆生命周期元数据，以提升 LLM Agent 在长任务流中的记忆可靠性；在多个基准和模型骨干上均优于对比记忆方法。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent 在终端、软件工程与网页任务中逐渐从单次提示转向长程任务流，可复用记忆成为关键能力。但现有记忆机制容易受到不可靠准入与记忆漂移影响：失败轨迹、偶然成功和误导性观察可能被写入记忆；长期记忆库还会积累重复、过时和冲突记录，单靠检索难以修复。
AI.method: 论文提出 MemGuard，将多准则 score-token 验证结果转换为 reward、confidence、label、uncertainty 等描述符，并附着到每个候选记忆上。这些元数据不仅用于写入前过滤，还贯穿记忆激活、检索、冲突解决、摘要与归档等全生命周期阶段。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-Bench Verified、WebArena 和 Mind2Web 上，跨四种模型骨干、五个随机种子进行评估。MemGuard 在 16 个 backbone-benchmark 设置中均取得最佳成功指标和最低平均步骤数；相较最强先前记忆基线 ReasoningBank，在 WebArena 上最高提升 7.9 个成功率百分点，在 Mind2Web 上提升 5.6 个 step-success-rate 点，在终端和软件工程基准上提升 2.4–3.5 点。
AI.conclusion: MemGuard 的核心贡献在于把验证器输出从一次性过滤信号扩展为持续可用的记忆治理元数据，从而缓解记忆污染与长期漂移问题，并在多任务、多模型场景下表现出稳定收益。

title: Grounded Normative Rule Generation with Structured Search
summary: Normative rules like institutional charters and workplace policies must be both human-readable and operationally verifiable against actual environment records. However, current language generation and structured-output benchmarks primarily reward surface fluency or schema compliance, leaving operational grounding weakly tested. This creates a critical vulnerability where standard language models generate plausible-sounding policies that fail during enforcement because they rely on unavailable data logs or misaligned scopes. To address this challenge, we formalize the problem as Grounded Normative Rule Synthesis (GNRS) and introduce GNRS-Search, a framework that utilizes Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to optimize a discrete, five-slot And-Or Graph (AOG). By explicitly decoupling intermediate operational structure from final prose generation, this method isolates executable feasibility from writing style and allows rule failures to be localized prior to surface realization. We evaluate our approach on GNRS-Bench, a benchmark spanning 116 controlled goals across eight scene families, and RealCharter-Bench, which evaluates transfer to 53 real-derived policy tasks with hidden source clauses. GNRS-Search raises average rubric quality from 68.8% to 81.0% and ranks first under a disclosed executable composite metric, while systematic slot interventions confirm that performance gains stem from robust operational logic rather than rhetorical tuning. Ultimately, by transforming automated rule drafting into an inspectable search problem, this work provides a foundational paradigm for deploying verifiable and compliance-ready personal agents within regulated environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GNRS任务与GNRS-Search框架，将规范性规则生成转化为可检验的离散搜索问题，以提升生成规则的可执行性与合规可验证性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言生成与结构化输出评测多关注文本流畅性或格式合规，缺乏对规则是否能基于真实环境记录执行验证的考察，导致模型可能生成看似合理但实际无法 enforcement 的政策规则。
AI.method: 作者形式化提出Grounded Normative Rule Synthesis（GNRS），并设计GNRS-Search：使用MCMC采样优化五槽位离散And-Or Graph，将中间操作结构与最终自然语言表述解耦，从而先验证规则的可执行性，再生成可读文本。
AI.result: 在GNRS-Bench（116个受控目标、8类场景）和RealCharter-Bench（53个真实衍生政策任务）上，GNRS-Search将平均rubric质量从68.8%提升到81.0%，并在公开的可执行复合指标下排名第一；槽位干预实验表明增益主要来自更稳健的操作逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把自动规则起草从单纯文本生成转变为可检查、可定位错误的搜索过程，为在受监管环境中部署可验证、合规就绪的个人智能体提供了基础范式。

title: FIRM-Video: Check Before You Score for Reliable Text-to-Video Reward Modeling
summary: Reliable reward models are essential for text-to-video evaluation and alignment. However, the trade-off between evaluation accuracy and inference efficiency places high demands on the quality of training supervision. Existing approaches often rely on holistic judges with fixed rubrics or open-ended reasoning, leading to incomplete inspection, unfaithful justification, and entangled attribution. We introduce FIRM-Video, a unified checklist-driven data construction framework based on a check-before-score principle: construct dimension-specific checklists, verify each criterion against temporal visual evidence, and aggregate only verified decisions. For Instruction Following, FIRM-Video decomposes prompts into weighted atomic requirements; for World Coherence, it constructs prompt-calibrated, target-specific checks grounded in visible entities and actions; and for Perceptual Quality, it applies a generic taxonomy of visual defects. The verified criteria and scores are further transformed into natural-language analyses for end-to-end reward modeling. Subsequently, we construct FIRM-Video-90K with 88,044 dimension-specific instances from 29,348 videos, and introduce FIRM-Video-Bench with 750 point-wise human annotations across 250 videos. The Qwen3-VL-based FIRM-Video-8B achieves the best overall MAE on FIRM-Video-Bench while consistently delivering the highest VBench Total, Quality, and Semantic Scores in Best-of-8 sampling across three video generators.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FIRM-Video，一个基于“先检查、后评分”的清单驱动数据构建框架，用于训练更可靠的文本到视频奖励模型，并在新构建的数据集与基准上取得最佳整体误差和采样表现。
AI.motivation: 文本到视频评估与对齐依赖可靠的奖励模型，但现有方法常使用整体式评判、固定评分规程或开放式推理，容易造成检查不完整、解释不忠实、归因混杂；同时评估准确性与推理效率之间存在权衡，因此需要更高质量、更可验证的训练监督信号。
AI.method: 提出 FIRM-Video 统一框架，遵循 check-before-score 原则：先构造维度特定清单，再依据时间视觉证据逐条验证标准，最后仅聚合已验证决策。针对指令遵循，将提示分解为加权原子要求；针对世界一致性，构造与提示校准、目标特定且基于可见实体和动作的检查项；针对感知质量，使用通用视觉缺陷分类体系。随后将验证后的标准和分数转化为自然语言分析，用于端到端奖励建模。
AI.result: 构建 FIRM-Video-90K，包含来自 29,348 个视频的 88,044 个维度特定实例；提出 FIRM-Video-Bench，包含 250 个视频上的 750 条点式人工标注。基于 Qwen3-VL 的 FIRM-Video-8B 在 FIRM-Video-Bench 上取得最佳整体 MAE，并在三个视频生成器的 Best-of-8 采样中持续获得最高的 VBench Total、Quality 和 Semantic Scores。
AI.conclusion: 清单驱动、证据验证式监督能够提升文本到视频奖励模型的可靠性、可解释性和对齐效果，FIRM-Video 在评估准确性与生成选择质量方面均表现出优势。

title: HiMA-MDD: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Harness for Interpretable Multimodal Depression Detection in Clinical Interviews
summary: Depression assessment from multimodal clinical interviews requires integrating dispersed evidence from multiple symptoms into a coherent PHQ-8 profile. This process is hierarchical: relevant evidence is often sparse and context-dependent within local question-answer exchanges, multiple exchanges jointly support symptom-level judgments, and the final assessment depends on the coherence of the complete symptom profile. Existing LLM systems either process interviews holistically or distribute work across generic agent roles; neither design necessarily provides an explicit orchestration mechanism that coordinates evidence access, item-score authority, bounded feedback, and state recording across these levels. To address this gap, we introduce HiMA-MDD, a hierarchical multi-agent harness that aligns this assessment hierarchy with three agent layers. After non-agentic preprocessing constructs context-preserving multimodal QA units, Layer 1 identifies candidate QA-to-item relations and supports bounded item-grounded evidence routing. Layer 2 assigns symptom groups to operational factor specialists, with one specialist responsible for each provisional item score. Layer 3 audits the complete provisional profile, requests at most one round of targeted revision, and reconstructs the verified PHQ-8 profile. This layered design naturally yields a Hierarchical Evidence Trace, preserves all intermediate evidence, judgments, and revisions for auditability. The final item scores then deterministically produce the total score and screening decision. Using Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct as the harness backbone, our experiments on E-DAIC demonstrate that HiMA-MDD outperforms the compared state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HiMA-MDD：一种面向临床访谈抑郁评估的层级多智能体框架，将访谈证据、症状条目评分与最终 PHQ-8 画像审计组织起来，在 E-DAIC 上优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态临床访谈中的抑郁评估需要把分散、稀疏且依赖上下文的证据整合为一致的 PHQ-8 症状画像。现有 LLM 方法要么整体处理访谈，要么使用通用智能体分工，缺少显式机制来协调证据访问、条目评分权责、受限反馈与跨层状态记录。
AI.method: HiMA-MDD 先通过非智能体预处理构造保留上下文的多模态问答单元；第 1 层识别 QA 与 PHQ-8 条目的候选关系并路由证据；第 2 层将症状组分配给因素专家，每个专家负责相应临时条目评分；第 3 层审计完整临时画像，最多请求一轮定向修订，并重构验证后的 PHQ-8 画像。系统保留层级证据轨迹，并由最终条目分数确定总分与筛查结果。
AI.result: 以 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 为骨干模型，在 E-DAIC 数据集上的实验显示，HiMA-MDD 超过所比较的当前先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式层级化的多智能体编排能够更好地匹配 PHQ-8 评估的证据—症状—整体画像结构，提高可审计性、可追踪性与评估性能。

title: Whitewashing Hate, Smearing Harmless Content: Annotator-Style Rebuttal Attacks on LLM-Based Moderation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for hate speech moderation, often within human--AI workflows in which reviewers provide feedback before a final decision. Such feedback introduces two manipulation directions: whitewashing hateful content as normal and smearing normal content as hateful. This study examines the susceptibility of initially correct model judgments to annotator-style rebuttals and analyzes whether attack effectiveness differs across manipulation directions. We introduce a rejudge protocol that extends direct contradiction with decision-boundary perturbations and adversarial rationales. Experiments with multiple LLMs on two hate speech datasets show that annotator-style rebuttals substantially degrade moderation performance, with stronger effects in multi-turn settings. The results further reveal stable, model-specific asymmetries between whitewashing and smearing across attack configurations, indicating distinct directional vulnerability patterns. Explicit reasoning prompts and defensive instructions reduce these effects but do not eliminate them. These findings highlight the need for direction-aware safeguards and dedicated feedback-robustness evaluation in human--AI moderation workflows.
