AI.result: 原型在55个功能查询和一个30轮对话上测试，token级缓存命中率分别达到90.99%和95.2%。在DeepSeek计价下，由于缓存命中输入token价格约为未命中的1/30，输入成本分别降至无缓存基线的约12.0%和8.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该设计将工具选择与工具交付解耦，扩展了渐进式披露思想：能力通过路由通道披露，而主模型前缀保持稳定。实验表明，该架构能在工具集动态增长的情况下显著提高缓存利用率并降低输入成本。

title: Molecular LLM Agents: From Architectural Design to Scientific Autonomy
summary: Molecular science represents an important frontier for LLM-based agents. Unlike general agents that mainly operate over natural language, code, or web environments, molecular LLM agents must perceive, reason about, and act upon chemical objects across symbolic strings, molecular graphs, 3D conformations, spectra, simulations, and wet-lab measurements. Their capabilities depend on chemically faithful molecular perception, an LLM-centered agent framework, domain-specific tool grounding, and computational or experimental feedback, in addition to planning and tool use. This work develops a conceptual framework for molecular LLM agents from two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce an architectural view of molecular-agent design, covering molecular representation and perception, the agent framework, domain-specific toolboxes, and learning and optimization. Second, we propose a scientific autonomy ladder inspired by staged autonomy in engineering systems, categorizing agents into four levels: L1 assistive or fixed workflows, L2 adaptive computational agents, L3 feedback-aware physical experiment agents, and L4 scientific-agenda agents. Together, these two perspectives establish a comprehensive framework for comparing existing molecular LLM agents, identifying missing capabilities and deployment risks, and guiding the design, evaluation, and deployment of future agents in molecular discovery workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分子领域 LLM Agent 的概念框架，用于理解、比较和指导分子发现工作流中的智能体设计与评估。
AI.motivation: 分子科学中的 LLM Agent 不同于通用语言、代码或网页智能体，需要处理化学符号、分子图、三维构象、光谱、模拟和实验测量等多模态化学对象。因此，需要一个面向分子任务的系统性框架来刻画其能力构成、缺失环节与部署风险。
AI.method: 文章从两个互补视角构建框架：一是架构视角，涵盖分子表示与感知、以 LLM 为中心的 Agent 框架、领域工具箱、学习与优化机制；二是科学自治阶梯，将分子 LLM Agent 分为 L1 辅助/固定流程、L2 自适应计算智能体、L3 反馈感知的物理实验智能体、L4 科学议程智能体四个等级。
AI.result: 该框架为现有分子 LLM Agent 的比较提供了统一维度，并明确了分子感知、工具接地、反馈闭环、实验自治和科学问题设定等关键能力层级。
AI.conclusion: 本文认为，未来分子 LLM Agent 的发展需要同时强化化学忠实的感知能力、领域工具集成、计算与实验反馈以及分层自治能力；所提出的框架可指导分子发现场景中 Agent 的设计、评估和安全部署。

title: Hybrid Generative-Discriminative Object Placement
summary: As an important operation of image composition, object placement aims to predict the plausible placement (location, scale) for the inserted foreground object. Previous object placement methods can be divided into generative methods and discriminative methods, both of which cannot balance efficiency and effectiveness well. In this work, we propose a semi-generative method in the middle ground between them. In particular, we assign uniformly distributed anchors on the background. Then, we fuse foreground and background features to predict the rationality score for each anchor and predict plausible placement sets for positive anchors. Extensive experiments on the OPA dataset show that our method can strike a good balance between efficiency and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于图像合成中前景物体合理放置预测的半生成式方法，在效率与效果之间取得较好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有物体放置方法主要分为生成式与判别式：生成式方法通常效果较好但效率不足，判别式方法效率较高但表达能力或预测质量有限，难以同时兼顾效率和有效性。
AI.method: 方法在背景图像上均匀设置锚点，融合前景物体与背景图像特征；随后为每个锚点预测其放置合理性分数，并针对正锚点进一步预测一组合理的物体放置方案，包括位置与尺度。
AI.result: 在 OPA 数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法相比既有生成式和判别式方法，在计算效率和预测效果之间实现了更优折中。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出的半生成式框架有效结合了生成式与判别式方法的优势，适用于图像合成中的自动物体放置任务，能够高效预测合理的前景物体位置与尺度。

title: SEAM: Shot Entity-Attribute Memory for Consistent Short-Drama Generation at Scale
summary: Short-drama generation has grown into a large, industrialized pipeline, and as it scales from isolated shots to the episode level, visual continuity has become a critical bottleneck. Current agent frameworks generate each shot in isolation, so context drifts across shots and props, character posture, and blocking turn inconsistent. Once assembled, these small discrepancies amplify into severe visual breaks. We present SEAM (Shot Entity-Attribute Memory), a training-free, model-agnostic memory graph that repairs continuity entirely at the prompt-text layer by extracting a multi-dimensional state for every shot, retrieving only causally prior context over the resulting graph, filtering it selectively, and injecting the surviving constraints by natural-language prompt rewriting. We further release SEAM-Bench, a double-blind continuity storyboarding benchmark, on which SEAM raises cross-episode continuity recall from 0.700 to 0.946, generalizes across six mainstream text models, and yields consistent, though not yet significant, gains at the generated-image layer. Deployed as a mandatory stage in CreativeFitting's SEAM-Agent production pipeline over 201 shots, SEAM reaches a 96.5% director-acceptance rate with zero unsafe injections; a conservative counterfactual attributes at least 21.9 percentage points of that rate to its cross-episode memory.

AI.tldr: SEAM 是一种无需训练、模型无关的镜头实体-属性记忆图方法，用于在提示词层面修复短剧多镜头/跨集视觉连续性问题，并在基准与生产环境中显著提升连续性表现。
AI.motivation: 短剧生成从单镜头扩展到剧集级工业流水线后，视觉连续性成为关键瓶颈。现有智能体框架通常独立生成每个镜头，导致上下文漂移，使道具、角色姿态、站位等跨镜头不一致，最终形成明显视觉断裂。
AI.method: 提出 SEAM（Shot Entity-Attribute Memory），在不训练模型且不绑定特定模型的前提下，构建镜头级实体-属性记忆图：为每个镜头抽取多维状态，仅检索因果上先前的上下文，对检索结果进行选择性过滤，并通过自然语言提示词重写注入保留下来的约束。
AI.result: 在双盲连续性故事板基准 SEAM-Bench 上，SEAM 将跨集连续性召回率从 0.700 提升到 0.946，并可泛化到六种主流文本模型；在生成图像层面也带来一致但尚未达到统计显著性的收益。部署到 CreativeFitting 的 SEAM-Agent 生产流水线、覆盖 201 个镜头后，导演接受率达到 96.5%，且未出现不安全注入；保守反事实估计显示其中至少 21.9 个百分点归因于跨集记忆机制。
AI.conclusion: SEAM 表明，通过提示词层面的结构化记忆、因果检索与约束注入，无需重新训练生成模型即可显著改善短剧生成中的跨镜头与跨集视觉连续性，具备良好的模型泛化性和实际生产可用性。

title: Statistical Machine Translation Systems of English-Pnar Language Pair : Some Insights of the Emperical Study
summary: Pnar, an Austroasiatic language spoken by approximately 0.4 million people in the Jaintia Hills of Meghalaya, lacks the digital corpora and natural language processing (NLP) resources. This paper presents the first machine translation study for the English and Pnar language pair. Using articles collected from the Wyrta newspaper, we built a parallel corpus comprising of 10,234 sentences and trained phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) systems the models using 9,563 parallel corpora under three configurations for each direction using Moses, GIZA++ , KenLM, varying lexicalized reordering and minimum error rate training (MERT) tuning. The models are evaluated on a held out test set of 371 sentences, the best performing system achieves a BLEU score of 14.97 (chrF2: 33.42, TER: 77.60) for Pnar to English and 11.16 (chrF2: 31.38, TER: 93.51) for English to Pnar, establishing the first quantitative benchmark for this language pair. Lexicalized reordering improves translation quality by 3.73 BLEU points for Pnar to English, reflecting the structural shift from the source language's SOV word order to the target language's SVO order, whereas MERT tuning degrades BLEU performance under low resource conditions. Finally, we analyze the remaining translation errors, including morphological out of vocabulary (OOV) words, long-distance reordering and Khasi code mixing and discuss future directions toward neural and multilingual machine translation for Pnar.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个英语—Pnar平行语料与机器翻译基准，基于短语统计机器翻译在低资源条件下取得初步可量化结果。
AI.motivation: Pnar作为低资源南亚语系语言，缺乏数字语料和NLP资源；此前几乎没有针对英语—Pnar语言对的机器翻译研究，因此需要建立语料、训练系统并给出基准性能。
AI.method: 作者从Wyrta报纸收集文章，构建10,234句平行语料；使用9,563句训练短语型统计机器翻译系统，工具包括Moses、GIZA++和KenLM，并在双向翻译中比较不同配置，包括词汇化重排序和MERT调参。使用371句保留测试集，以BLEU、chrF2和TER评价。
AI.result: 最佳Pnar→English系统达到BLEU 14.97、chrF2 33.42、TER 77.60；最佳English→Pnar系统达到BLEU 11.16、chrF2 31.38、TER 93.51。词汇化重排序使Pnar→English提升3.73 BLEU；MERT在低资源条件下降低BLEU表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次为英语—Pnar机器翻译建立定量基准，证明短语型SMT在低资源语言上可提供初步可用结果，但仍受OOV、长距离重排序和代码混合等问题限制；未来可探索神经机器翻译和多语种迁移方法。

title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections: Methods and Results
summary: This workshop paper comprehensively reviews the First Challenge on Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections. The challenge aims to address a frequently encountered practical problem in the field of autonomous driving, i.e., raindrop-reflection composite degradation on rainy days. This competition attracted 149 registered participants and received 12 valid final submissions with corresponding fact sheets, significantly contributing to the progress of unified removal of raindrops and reflections. All the methods are developed and evaluated on our real-shot RainDrop and ReFlection (RDRF) dataset. A detailed analysis of the submitted methods and corresponding results is provided in this report, which highlights effective approaches and provides interesting insights for future research.

AI.tldr: 该研讨会论文综述了首届统一去除雨滴与反射挑战赛，围绕自动驾驶雨天场景中的复合退化问题，对参赛方法、数据集评测与结果进行了系统分析。
AI.motivation: 雨天自动驾驶场景中，挡风玻璃或成像系统常同时受到雨滴与反射干扰，形成复合退化，影响视觉感知与下游任务；因此需要推动能够统一处理雨滴和反射去除的方法研究。
AI.method: 论文组织并回顾了一个挑战赛：基于真实拍摄的RainDrop and ReFlection（RDRF）数据集，对参赛团队提交的方法进行统一评估，并结合12份有效最终提交及其fact sheets分析模型设计、性能表现和有效策略。
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引149名注册参与者，收到12份有效最终提交；报告总结了各方法在RDRF数据集上的评测结果，识别出若干有效的统一去除雨滴与反射的技术路线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过挑战赛和系统报告推动了雨滴-反射复合退化恢复研究，为未来在真实雨天自动驾驶视觉增强任务中的方法设计和评测提供了数据、基准与研究启示。

title: LLM-Based Selection of Incongruent Verbal and Nonverbal Behavior for Virtual Humans
summary: Nonverbal behavior generation systems for virtual agents often take an utterance as input and generate nonverbal behaviors that emphasize or illustrate the content of the verbal channel. However, human nonverbal behavior is shaped by more than the content of the speech. It is also influenced by speaker roles, interpersonal relationships, social context, and the cognitive and emotional states of the interactants. As a result, the nonverbal channel may reinforce, weaken, qualify, or even contradict the verbal channel. It may also reveal internal states that are hidden or only indirectly implied in speech, including emotional "leakage" that may be incidental to the immediate interaction. Modeling this richer relationship between verbal and nonverbal behavior is important for designing virtual agents that exhibit realistic, human-like behavior. It is especially critical in training contexts that require nuanced social interpretation, such as counseling simulations involving virtual patients. Drawing on Ekman's framework of verbal nonverbal relationships, we propose a taxonomy of categories in which mismatches between verbal and nonverbal behavior can occur. We then examine alternative approaches for realizing these behaviors using large language models, focusing on whether LLMs can select contextually appropriate mismatched verbal and nonverbal behaviors from a given dialogue and social interaction context. Finally, we evaluate the resulting behaviors in a human-subject study, assessing whether context-driven nonverbal behavior, when embodied in a virtual human, produces the intended effects on observers.

AI.tldr: 该论文关注虚拟智能体中语言与非语言行为不一致的建模问题，提出分类体系并评估大语言模型在上下文驱动的非语言行为生成中的作用。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟智能体的非语言行为生成通常主要依据话语内容，用手势、表情等去强调或说明语言信息。但真实人类的非语言行为还受到说话者角色、人际关系、社会情境、认知与情绪状态等因素影响，可能与语言信息一致、弱化、修饰甚至矛盾。为了提升虚拟人的真实感，尤其是在咨询训练等需要细腻社会理解的场景中，有必要建模更丰富的语言—非语言关系。
AI.method: 论文基于 Ekman 的语言与非语言关系框架，提出一种用于描述语言和非语言行为不匹配类型的分类法；随后探索利用大语言模型生成或选择这些不匹配行为的方法，重点考察 LLM 是否能根据给定对话和社会互动上下文选择合适的非语言表现；最后通过被试实验评估这些行为在虚拟人身上呈现后是否能对观察者产生预期效果。
AI.result: 摘要表明研究评估了由上下文驱动的非语言行为在虚拟人中的观察者效应，但未给出具体实验数值或显著性结果。因此只能判断其结果关注点是验证行为是否被观察者按预期解读，以及 LLM 所选行为是否具备情境适切性。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为，虚拟智能体若要表现得更自然可信，不能只根据语言内容生成非语言行为，而应结合社会语境、关系、角色及内部状态来建模语言与非语言之间的复杂关系。基于分类法和 LLM 的方法可能为更具人类真实感的虚拟人行为生成提供有效路径。

title: LITERARYBIGFIVE: Author-Personalized Text Generation in a Unified Interpretable Space
summary: Personalized text generation for authors and literary writing is essential for applications such as adaptive writing assistants, creative support tools, and computational literary analysis. However, existing approaches to author modeling and personalization often represent writing behavior as independent labels, requiring large-scale corpus collection or fine-tuning for each author or stylistic category. Such formulations are costly, difficult to interpret, and poorly suited for generalizing across authors. Inspired by the Big Five model's dimensional view of personality, we propose LiteraryBigFive, a framework that reframes authorial writing characteristics as coordinates within a unified and interpretable space. In this space, we derive each interpretable axis (e.g., Classicism, Emotionality) from activation-space contrasts between author-written and neutral passages, yielding distinct stylistic dimensions that allow texts or authors to be positioned within a five-dimensional system. Beyond localizing different authors, we further introduce an interpretable steering mechanism, which adaptively guides text generation toward target coordinates to perform author-personalized writing. Experimental results show that LiteraryBigFive improves authorial expressiveness while preserving semantic fidelity. The derived author per-axis scores strongly correlate with real-world literary consensus, offering transparent and interpretable explanations of author-specific generation behavior: https://github.com/Znull-1220/LiteraryBigFive.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LiteraryBigFive，将作者写作风格从离散标签重构为五维、可解释的连续坐标空间，并用该空间指导个性化文本生成。
AI.motivation: 现有作者建模通常把作者或风格视为独立标签，需要为每位作者收集大量语料或单独微调，成本高、可解释性弱，且难以跨作者泛化。作者希望借鉴 Big Five 人格模型的连续维度思想，为文学风格建立统一、可解释、可迁移的表示空间。
AI.method: 通过比较作者文本与中性文本在模型激活空间中的差异，构造若干可解释风格轴（如 Classicism、Emotionality），将文本或作者映射到五维风格坐标；同时提出可解释的 steering 机制，根据目标坐标动态引导生成模型，使输出接近特定作者或目标风格。
AI.result: 实验显示，该方法在提升作者风格表达能力的同时保持语义一致性；模型得到的作者各维度分数与现实文学共识高度相关，说明其风格维度具有一定外部有效性和解释性。
AI.conclusion: LiteraryBigFive 为作者个性化生成提供了一个连续、可解释且可控的风格建模框架，相比离散标签或逐作者微调更具泛化潜力，并能为生成行为提供透明解释。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Semantic-in-Gaussian for Sparse-View 3D Generalization
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on 3DWM
summary: Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (G-3DGS) has emerged as a promising approach for novel view synthesis undersparse-view settings. However, existing frameworks remain restricted by pixel-aligned Gaussian estimation, whichstruggles in partially observed or occluded regions and often leads to incomplete surfaces or structural collapse. Toaddress these challenges, we propose SeeU (Seeing the Unseen), a novel G-3DGS framework. We frame its core design asSemantic-in-Gaussian: semantic-conditioned refinement in Gaussian space. Specifically, we introduce a Cross-viewEntropy-Aware (CEA) module that aggregates multi-view semantic and geometric cues into compact embeddings. Theseembeddings guide the Conditional Gaussian Transformer, which applies residual updates to coarse Gaussians, helpingrecover under-constrained regions of partially observed structures while preserving surface consistency. Comprehensiveexperiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SeeU consistently improves rendering quality and structuralcompleteness while retaining efficient feed-forward inference. Especially under challenging extrapolation settings,SeeU achieves an average improvement of 2.44 dB in PSNR compared to recent SOTA G-3DGS methods.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SeeU，一个面向稀疏视角新视角合成的可泛化 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，通过在高斯空间中引入语义条件化细化来改善遮挡和未充分观测区域的结构恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有 G-3DGS 方法多依赖像素对齐的高斯估计，在部分观测、遮挡或外推视角下难以推断不可见区域，容易产生表面不完整、结构坍塌和渲染质量下降等问题。
AI.method: 作者提出 Semantic-in-Gaussian 设计范式：首先使用 Cross-view Entropy-Aware（CEA）模块聚合多视角语义与几何线索，形成紧凑嵌入；随后利用 Conditional Gaussian Transformer 根据这些嵌入对粗糙高斯进行残差更新，在高斯空间中进行语义条件化细化，以恢复欠约束区域并保持表面一致性。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，SeeU 在渲染质量和结构完整性方面持续优于近期 SOTA G-3DGS 方法，同时保持高效的前馈推理。尤其在具有挑战性的外推设置下，PSNR 平均提升 2.44 dB。
AI.conclusion: SeeU 表明，将跨视角语义信息显式注入高斯表示并用于条件化细化，可以有效缓解稀疏视角下不可见区域建模不足的问题，是提升可泛化 3DGS 结构完整性和渲染质量的有效方向。

title: The Compaction Cliff in Long-Running AI Agent Memory
summary: A safety rule and an episodic log compete for the same tokens in an AI agent's context. When the budget overflows, both are summarized at the same rate; only the rule needs exact wording to remain enforceable. On 20 production agent configurations, Claude Code's /compact prompt on Sonnet 4.6 preserves 53\% of safety rules after one compaction round and 10\% after five. We name this the Compaction Cliff. We address it with Knowledge Triage, a framework that classifies each line of an agent's knowledge base by type and routes each type through its own retention policy. Three deterministic operators implement this triage across the three context-management operations: TypeCompact rewrites items in place under per-type fidelity, TypeDecompose partitions a topic too large to compact safely, replicating in-scope safety rules across partitions, and TypeRetrieve fetches items from external storage with in-scope rules pinned ahead of relevance. On five public corpora, TypeCompact preserves 2--4$\times$ more safety rules than the strongest single-shot LLM compactor at every ratio, with 96\% recall over five rounds. TypeDecompose reaches 0\% locality violations against 93\% under uniform partitioning. TypeRetrieve reaches 100\% recall@50 against 73\% for the best single-shot LLM retriever. On three downstream behavioral benchmarks, we outperform the production Sonnet compactor on medical compliance (paired McNemar $p < 10^{-8}$ on preservation, $N = 200$), the full-policy and hierarchical baselines on retail task pass rate ($p < 0.01$, $N = 115$), and the hierarchical compaction on the airline domain ($p = 0.024$). We release AgentArtifactCorpus (396{,}934 agent configurations from 54{,}628 public GitHub repositories), the classifier, and the reference implementation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“Compaction Cliff”现象：统一压缩上下文会快速损失需要精确保留的安全规则；并提出 Knowledge Triage，通过按知识类型分类与差异化保留策略显著提升规则保真、分区一致性和检索召回。
AI.motivation: AI agent 的上下文预算有限，当安全规则与任务日志等内容共同被压缩时，通用摘要会同等压缩所有信息，但安全规则往往需要精确措辞才能继续约束行为。因此需要一种能区分知识类型并按重要性与保真需求管理上下文的方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 Knowledge Triage 框架，对知识库逐行分类，并为不同类型配置不同保留策略。其包含三个确定性算子：TypeCompact 按类型保真要求原位重写；TypeDecompose 将过大的主题拆分并复制相关安全规则；TypeRetrieve 从外部存储检索，并将范围内规则优先固定在相关性结果之前。
AI.result: 在多个公共语料和下游任务上，该方法显著优于统一压缩、LLM 单次压缩器、统一分区和常规检索基线：TypeCompact 在各压缩率下保留 2–4 倍安全规则，五轮后召回率 96%；TypeDecompose 达到 0% locality violations；TypeRetrieve recall@50 达到 100%；下游医疗、零售、航空领域基准均有统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为上下文管理不应将所有信息同等摘要，而应依据知识类型实施差异化保留。Knowledge Triage 能更可靠地维护 agent 中关键规则的可执行性，并提升实际任务表现。

title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization
summary: The alignment of Large Language Models heavily relies on English-centric high-quality preference data, which often leads to suboptimal performance in other languages. In this paper, we propose Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization (CRPO), a novel framework that leverages robust preference knowledge from English to facilitate preference alignment in the target language. We design a hierarchical structure within parallel preference pairs across the target language and English to jointly optimize intra- and inter-lingual preferences, thereby enhancing language adaptation and output quality. Building on the LambdaLoss framework, CRPO goes beyond the binary comparison based optimization by providing a relative ranking signal across multiple candidate responses. Our experiments across five languages with varying resource scales demonstrate that CRPO consistently outperforms standard approaches in both instruction-following and knowledge utilization capability. Notably, the robust performance gains observed across various weighting schemes further validate the empirical effectiveness of our hierarchical design in a multilingual setup. Furthermore, our findings highlight that CRPO significantly improves both reward margins and the log-probability of desirable responses, contributing to a more stable preference manifold for cross-lingual alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CRPO，将英语中的高质量偏好知识迁移到目标语言，通过跨语言分层排序优化提升多语言大模型对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型对齐高度依赖英语中心的高质量偏好数据，导致在其他语言上的指令遵循、知识利用和输出质量不足；因此需要一种能有效利用英语偏好信号并适配目标语言的跨语言偏好优化方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 Cross-Lingual Ranking Preference Optimization（CRPO）。该方法在目标语言与英语的平行偏好样本之间构建层次化结构，同时优化语言内偏好与语言间偏好；并基于 LambdaLoss 框架，将传统二元偏好比较扩展为多候选回答的相对排序信号。
AI.result: 在五种不同资源规模的语言上，CRPO 在指令遵循和知识利用能力方面均稳定优于标准方法；不同权重设置下仍有稳健增益，表明分层设计在多语言场景中有效。
AI.conclusion: CRPO 能更稳定地完成跨语言偏好对齐，提升目标语言输出质量，并通过增大奖励间隔和提高优质回答的对数概率，形成更稳定的跨语言偏好表示/流形。

title: Object-Uni: A Unified Model for Object-Centric Spatial Understanding and Controllable Generation
summary: Unified models for visual understanding and generation have made rapid progress, yet they still lack the ability to understand and manipulate the spatial states of object instances. Existing models can describe objects in natural language, but they struggle to precisely represent continuous object poses and generate geometrically consistent images under target viewpoints. To mitigate this, we propose \emph{Object-Uni}, a unified model for object-centric spatial understanding and controllable generation. Specifically, we formulate object-centric spatial intelligence as a unified problem connecting pose perception, spatial reasoning, pose-conditioned generation, and object-centric novel view synthesis. We treat object pose as an explicit geometric variable shared by understanding and generation, rather than merely a prediction label or control signal. To make pose usable by multimodal large language models, we propose a viewpoint-based orientation abstraction that maps orientation into structured viewpoint descriptions while preserving continuous geometric supervision. We further construct an object-centric spatial benchmark (UniSpatial-80K) and train a unified model with an object-token-grounded pose anchor to associate each instance with its pose state. Experiments show that our model improves object-level pose understanding and pose-controllable generation, moving unified models from describing objects toward manipulating spatial states.

AI.tldr: Object-Uni 将物体姿态作为理解与生成共享的显式几何变量，统一处理物体中心的空间理解、推理与可控生成任务。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉理解与生成统一模型虽能用自然语言描述物体，但难以精确表示连续姿态、理解物体实例的空间状态，也难以在目标视角下生成几何一致的图像。
AI.method: 论文提出 Object-Uni：将物体中心空间智能统一为姿态感知、空间推理、姿态条件生成和新视角合成等任务；设计基于视点的朝向抽象，将连续姿态映射为结构化视点描述，同时保留几何监督；构建 UniSpatial-80K 基准，并通过 object-token-grounded pose anchor 将每个实例与其姿态状态关联。
AI.result: 实验表明，该模型提升了物体级姿态理解能力和姿态可控生成能力，在目标视角生成方面具有更好的几何一致性。
AI.conclusion: Object-Uni 推动统一多模态模型从“描述物体”走向“操控物体空间状态”，为物体中心的空间智能建模提供了有效框架。

title: Compositional Chain-of-Relations for Faithful Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) is a key task for evaluating KG-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs), and complex KGQA that requires multi-hop reasoning is especially challenging. Solving a complex query involves two coupled phases: candidate retrieval, which locates answer candidates over the KG, and constraint handling, which filters these candidates against the query constraints. Faithful reasoning requires grounding both phases in the KG. However, existing agent-based methods ground candidate retrieval through entity-centric exploration, while leaving constraint handling to the LLM's internal knowledge, which leads to two critical limitations. (1) Unreliable entity pruning: entity-centric exploration uses entities as search units and must prune them to a fixed-size subset at each hop. Because entity information in KGs is often incomplete and a fixed-size subset cannot retain all valid entities, such pruning inevitably drops valid entities and ultimately leads to wrong answers. (2) Ungrounded constraint handling: query constraints are resolved from the LLM's internal knowledge rather than the KG, leaving the final answers unverifiable and prone to hallucination. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a relation-centric exploration paradigm, which uses relations rather than entities as search units and thus avoids unreliable entity pruning. Built on this paradigm, this paper proposes Compositional Chain-of-Relations (CCoR), a simple and effective framework that grounds both phases in the KG with two relation chains: a main chain for candidate retrieval and a constraint chain that verifies query constraints through explicit KG exploration. Experiments on four KGQA benchmarks show that CCoR consistently improves accuracy, faithfulness, and efficiency over strong baselines, with more pronounced gains on complex queries.

AI.tldr: 论文提出关系中心的 KGQA 推理框架 CCoR，用关系链替代实体剪枝，并用约束链显式验证查询约束，从而提升复杂多跳问答的准确性、忠实性与效率。
AI.motivation: 复杂知识图谱问答需要同时完成候选答案检索与约束处理。现有基于智能体的方法通常通过实体中心探索进行检索，但在每跳固定规模实体剪枝时容易丢失有效实体；同时，约束处理依赖大语言模型内部知识，缺乏知识图谱 grounding，导致答案不可验证并可能产生幻觉。
AI.method: 作者提出 relation-centric exploration 范式，以关系而非实体作为搜索单元，避免不可靠的实体剪枝。在此基础上构建 Compositional Chain-of-Relations（CCoR）框架，使用两类关系链：主链用于候选检索，约束链通过显式知识图谱探索验证查询约束，从而将检索与约束处理都锚定在知识图谱中。
AI.result: 在四个 KGQA 基准上的实验表明，CCoR 相比强基线在准确性、忠实性和效率方面均有稳定提升，且在复杂查询上提升更明显。
AI.conclusion: 关系中心探索能够缓解实体剪枝导致的答案遗漏问题；通过主链与约束链的组合，CCoR 实现了更可验证、更忠实且更高效的复杂 KGQA 推理。

title: Counter with Evidence! A Multi-Agent Memory Efficient Reasoning Framework for Hate Category Informed Counterspeech Generation
summary: Counterspeech effectively neutralizes the impact of online hate. Although prior work explores automated counterspeech generation, it largely emphasizes stylistic control while treating hate speech as homogeneous, overlooking that distinct forms of abuse require fundamentally different counterspeech strategies. To address this gap, we introduce FIRE (Factuality Informed Multi-Agent Reasoning Framework) that first decomposes hate speech into one of the five distinct categories (misinformation, stereotype, conspiracy, dehumanizing, non-factual), and then maps it to a targeted counterspeech style. To facilitate FIRE, we curate FactualCS, a novel dataset of $4,784$ instances that provides the annotations regarding hate categories, reasoning traces, and evidence mappings, which are critical elements for grounded generation that are missing in prior work. A comprehensive evaluation across $28$ baseline configurations demonstrates that FIRE significantly surpasses existing methods, despite using compact agents ($<$2B). FIRE achieves a $\sim$ $12 \%$ and $\sim$ $11 \%$ improvements in factual and category-specific accuracy respectively, while simultaneously reducing toxicity by $\sim$ $11 \%$ relative to the strongest baselines. Further human evaluation confirms that responses generated by FIRE are significantly preferred over the strongest baselines, underscoring its effectiveness for real-world deployment. These findings show that decomposing the underlying intent of hate speech is essential for generating safe, effective, and contextually precise counterspeech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FIRE：一个基于事实性信息的多智能体推理框架，用于将仇恨言论细分为不同类型并生成针对性反言论；同时构建 FactualCS 数据集，实验显示其在事实准确性、类别匹配和低毒性方面优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 以往自动反言论生成方法多关注表达风格控制，通常将仇恨言论视为同质现象，忽略不同滥用形式需要不同回应策略的问题。因此需要一种能识别仇恨言论内在意图并生成更有针对性、事实支撑更强回应的方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 FIRE 框架，先将输入言论分解为五类之一：错误信息、刻板印象、阴谋论、非人化、非事实类内容；随后根据类别映射到相应的反言论风格。为支持该框架，作者构建 FactualCS 数据集，包含 4,784 个样本，并提供类别标注、推理轨迹和证据映射。
AI.result: 在 28 种基线配置上的综合评估表明，即使使用小于 2B 参数的紧凑智能体，FIRE 仍显著优于现有方法：事实准确性提升约 12%，类别特定准确性提升约 11%，同时相较最强基线将毒性降低约 11%。人工评估也显示 FIRE 生成的回应更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，识别并分解有害言论背后的具体意图，对于生成安全、有效、事实扎实且上下文精准的反言论至关重要；FIRE 为面向真实部署的自动反言论生成提供了更细粒度和更可控的方案。

title: ByteAction: Byte-space Action Recognition Foundation Model
summary: Byte-space Action Recognition (BAR) aims to recognize human actions directly from compressed image bitstreams without any pixel decoding. By operating entirely in byte space, BAR is inherently independent of file integrity and pixel-level reconstruction, making it naturally applicable to privacy-sensitive scenarios and robust against bitstream corruption. In this paper, we propose ByteAction, a BAR foundation model that achieves accurate action recognition on corrupted image bitstreams. ByteAction follows a dual-view byte-level recognition framework. It constructs weakly and strongly corrupted bitstream views, which are augmented by Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA) and encoded with a shared ByteFormer backbone. The model is optimized with both classification and corruption consistency objectives. Specifically, we propose Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA), which reshapes one-dimensional byte sequences into two-dimensional byte matrix and applies region-level erasure to encourage the model to learn robust cross-region byte dependencies. We further propose a Corruption Consistency Training strategy that constrains the model to maintain stable predictions across different corruption severities through bidirectional KL divergence. Experiments on the image bitstream from Stanford40, PPMI, and PASCAL VOC 2012 Action demonstrate that ByteAction achieves state-of-the-art corruption robustness across all scenarios while maintaining competitive intact bitstream performance.

AI.tldr: ByteAction 是一种面向压缩图像比特流的人体动作识别基础模型，无需像素解码即可在受损比特流上实现鲁棒识别。
AI.motivation: 现有动作识别通常依赖像素级解码与完整图像重建，在隐私敏感场景和比特流损坏情况下适用性受限。BAR 旨在直接从字节空间识别动作，从而提升隐私友好性与抗损坏能力。
AI.method: 论文提出双视图字节级识别框架：构造弱损坏与强损坏的比特流视图，通过 Bitstream Pattern Augmentation 将一维字节序列重塑为二维字节矩阵并进行区域级擦除，再使用共享 ByteFormer 编码；训练目标结合分类损失与基于双向 KL 散度的损坏一致性约束。
AI.result: 在 Stanford40、PPMI 和 PASCAL VOC 2012 Action 的图像比特流实验中，ByteAction 在多种损坏场景下取得最先进的鲁棒性，同时在完整比特流上保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: ByteAction 表明直接在字节空间进行动作识别是可行且有效的，尤其适用于隐私保护和比特流损坏环境；其增强与一致性训练策略显著提升了模型的抗损坏泛化能力。

title: The Retriever Should Remember: Experience-Amortized Reranking for Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: Long-term language-model agents accumulate memories across interactions, but their retrievers typically do not accumulate retrieval experience. Semantic retrieval is efficient, but embedding similarity does not always reflect whether a memory contains evidence relevant to the current query. Large language model (LLM) rerankers provide stronger query-conditioned relevance scores, yet stateless reranking repeatedly scores a large candidate pool and discards these scores after each query. We introduce EARM, an experience-amortized reranking framework that treats previously acquired LLM relevance scores as reusable retrieval experience. EARM stores sparse query--memory relevance scores in an online matrix, learns their shared structure through causal matrix completion, and combines a small set of newly observed scores with estimated scores to rerank the remaining candidates. The scoring budget decreases as experience accumulates, changing LLM reranking from a repeated per-query expense into a retrieval capability learned over an agent's lifetime. Experiments on long-term conversational memory show that mixed observed-and-estimated reranking improves answer accuracy over semantic retrieval by up to 6.62% and remains effective when only 17.5% of candidates receive direct LLM relevance scores, thereby substantially reducing the inference overhead of LLM reranking. These results motivate a broader view of agent memory: a long-lived agent should remember not only past content, but also how that content has proved useful for retrieval.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EARM，将历史 LLM 相关性打分作为可复用的检索经验，通过在线稀疏矩阵与因果矩阵补全来估计未打分候选记忆的相关性，从而以更低 LLM 打分预算提升长期记忆检索与问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 长期语言模型智能体会持续积累记忆，但现有检索器通常不会积累“检索经验”。语义检索虽然高效，但嵌入相似度不一定等同于证据相关性；LLM 重排序更准确，却需要对大量候选反复打分且每次查询后丢弃分数，造成高推理开销。
AI.method: EARM 将已获得的查询—记忆 LLM 相关性分数存入在线稀疏矩阵，利用因果矩阵补全学习查询与记忆相关性的共享结构。对于新查询，仅对少量候选进行 LLM 直接打分，并将这些观测分数与矩阵补全估计出的未观测分数结合，用于对其余候选记忆重排序。
AI.result: 在长期对话记忆实验中，混合观测分数与估计分数的重排序相较语义检索最高提升 6.62% 的答案准确率；即使只有 17.5% 的候选接受直接 LLM 相关性打分，方法仍保持有效，从而显著降低 LLM 重排序的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，长期智能体记忆不应只保存过去内容，还应保存这些内容在检索中如何被证明有用的经验。EARM 将 LLM 重排序从重复的单次查询成本转化为随智能体生命周期逐渐学习到的检索能力。

title: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models via Structured Suffix Modeling
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) exhibit strong parallel decoding capabilities by denoising multiple tokens in a single generation step. However, this parallelism comes with substantial computational overhead, as each step requires interactions with all suffix tokens. Existing methods typically reduce this cost by retaining only a local suffix window as a substitute for the full suffix. Despite their effectiveness, these methods overlook the structural heterogeneity across suffix regions and re-initialize suffix tokens with identical representations at each timestep. To this end, we propose a structured suffix modeling method for efficient DLM inference. Specifically, we divide the suffix into three regions, i.e., the local, middle, and tail regions, and retain different numbers of suffix tokens in each region according to their structural roles. Moreover, we incorporate the decoding results from the previous step into the suffix token representations at the current step, allowing them to carry evolving denoising information across generation steps. Notably, our method is training-free and orthogonal to several existing acceleration techniques, such as parallel decoding strategies and KV cache. Empirical results across multiple benchmarks on three DLMs demonstrate that our method can further accelerate DLM inference and improve performance in most cases. In particular, in long-sequence inference, our method achieves up to a \(72.81\times\) speedup when combined with other acceleration techniques. Our code is available at https://github.com/zifengcheng/SSM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的结构化后缀建模方法，用于提升扩散语言模型推理效率，并在长序列场景中与其他加速技术结合取得最高 72.81× 加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型可通过单步去噪多个 token 实现并行解码，但每步需与全部后缀 token 交互，计算开销较大。现有局部后缀窗口方法虽能降本，但忽略后缀不同区域的结构异质性，并且每个时间步都用相同表示重新初始化后缀 token，未利用跨步演化信息。
AI.method: 作者将后缀划分为 local、middle、tail 三个区域，并依据各区域结构作用保留不同数量的后缀 token；同时将上一解码步的结果融入当前步后缀 token 表示，使其携带跨生成步骤演化的去噪信息。该方法无需训练，且可与并行解码策略、KV cache 等现有加速技术正交结合。
AI.result: 在三个扩散语言模型和多个基准测试上，实验显示该方法能进一步加速 DLM 推理，并在多数情况下提升性能；在长序列推理中，与其他加速技术结合最高达到 72.81× 加速。
AI.conclusion: 结构化建模后缀区域并复用上一时间步去噪信息，可以在不额外训练的情况下有效降低 DLM 推理开销，同时保持或提升生成质量，适合作为现有 DLM 加速框架的通用补充。

title: LagrangeGS: Non-Conservative Lagrangian System on Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves photorealistic reconstruction of time-varying scenes, and recent physics-aware extensions improve extrapolation by explicitly predicting velocity fields. However, these extensions merely fit vector fields to visual deformations without satisfying Lagrangian mechanics, leading to three major issues: (i) physically inconsistent trajectories, (ii) lack of time-reversibility, and (iii) geometric collapse during long-term extrapolation. In this paper, we propose LagrangeGS, which formulates dynamic 3DGS as a non-conservative Lagrangian system. While this Lagrangian formulation fundamentally solves (i), a direct application of general LNNs to dynamic 3DGS requires a large velocity-Hessian inversion for millions of Gaussian particles. To overcome this computational bottleneck, we approximate the velocity-Hessian as an identity matrix, decoupling particle dynamics for computational tractability. For (ii), we restrict the non-conservative forces to be explicitly time independent, enabling consistent backward integration. Finally, to address (iii), we introduce local rigid alignment that regularizes particle trajectories. Extensive evaluations on dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate that LagrangeGS enables stable long-term extrapolation, consistent time reversal, and counterfactual physics-based editing without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LagrangeGS，将动态 3D Gaussian Splatting 建模为非保守拉格朗日系统，以提升动态场景的物理一致性、时间可逆性和长期外推稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有物理感知动态 3DGS 方法通常只拟合视觉形变对应的速度场，并未满足拉格朗日力学约束，导致轨迹物理不一致、无法稳定时间反演，以及长期外推时几何结构塌缩。
AI.method: 作者将动态 3DGS 表述为非保守拉格朗日系统；为避免对数百万高斯粒子进行大规模速度 Hessian 求逆，将速度 Hessian 近似为单位矩阵以解耦粒子动力学；同时限制非保守力显式不依赖时间以支持反向积分，并引入局部刚性对齐正则化粒子轨迹。
AI.result: 在动态场景基准上的实验表明，LagrangeGS 能实现更稳定的长期外推、更一致的时间反演，并支持无需重新训练的反事实物理编辑。
AI.conclusion: LagrangeGS 通过将动态 3DGS 与拉格朗日力学结合，在计算可行的前提下显著增强了动态重建模型的物理合理性和外推能力。

title: TailSieve: Partial-Rollout-Guided Tail Routing for LLM Rollouts
summary:
Large-scale rollouts have become a core component of modern LLM systems, spanning reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, on-policy distillation (OPD), and sampling-heavy evaluation pipelines. Unlike online serving, which is typically optimized for request-level latency and throughput, a small number of long-tail generations can dominate the end-to-end makespan of an entire rollout step. In practice, rollout requests are often routed uniformly across replicas, which can place extremely long generations inside high-concurrency decoding batches.
  To address this, we present TailSieve, a partial-rollout-guided framework that jointly controls tail routing and replica allocation for LLM rollouts. In an idealized setting with known completion lengths, we show that makespan-optimal routing in the long-tail regime combines tail isolation with load balancing, and that a simple top-k policy closely approximates this offline optimum. Leveraging the observation that long-tail prompts tend to remain long-tailed across policy updates, TailSieve uses partial rollouts as a training-free signal for identifying candidate tail groups. A hierarchical controller then jointly adapts the number of isolated groups and the replica split between the tail and bulk pools using collected response-work history and a measured concurrency-throughput model. TailSieve achieves up to 1.67x routing-only speedup over uniform group routing. The resulting low-concurrency tail pool further enables route-specialized speculative decoding with MTP or DFlash, achieving up to 2.59x speedup over uniform routing. Selected prompts are regenerated under the current policy, preserving on-policy generation and avoiding additional routing-induced length bias in steady state.

AI.tldr: TailSieve 是一种面向大规模 LLM rollout 的尾部请求路由与副本分配框架，通过部分 rollout 识别长尾提示，将长尾与普通请求分池处理，并结合吞吐模型动态调度，显著降低 rollout makespan。
AI.motivation: 现代 LLM 系统中的 RL 后训练、on-policy distillation 与重采样评测依赖大规模 rollout；少数超长生成会支配整个 rollout 步骤的完成时间。传统均匀路由可能把超长请求放入高并发解码批次，导致批次拖尾和资源利用不佳，因此需要专门处理长尾生成。
AI.method: 论文提出 TailSieve：首先在理想化已知完成长度场景下分析长尾路由最优策略，指出应结合尾部隔离与负载均衡，并用 top-k 策略近似离线最优；随后利用长尾 prompt 在策略更新间具有稳定性的现象，用 partial rollout 作为无需训练的尾部识别信号；最后设计层次化控制器，基于历史 response-work 与实测并发-吞吐模型，联合调整隔离组数量及 tail/bulk 副本划分，并支持针对低并发尾部池的投机解码优化。
AI.result: TailSieve 在仅路由优化时相较均匀组路由最高获得 1.67x 加速；结合低并发 tail pool 上的 route-specialized speculative decoding（如 MTP 或 DFlash）后，相较均匀路由最高获得 2.59x 加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，LLM rollout 的系统瓶颈与在线服务不同，应以整体 makespan 和长尾控制为核心优化目标。通过部分 rollout 识别稳定长尾、隔离处理并动态分配副本，TailSieve 能在保持 on-policy 生成、避免稳态路由长度偏置的同时，有效提升大规模 rollout 效率。

title: CaRGo-T: Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought improves Multimodal Humor Comprehension
summary: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, understanding humor remains challenging because humorous content often depends on subtle interactions among entities, events, context, and implicit relationships across image and text modalities. These interactions can involve complex chains of reasoning that are difficult to capture through conventional prompting or linear chain-of-thought reasoning. In this work, we propose CaRGo-T (Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought), a reasoning framework that represents the causal and contextual relationships underlying multimodal humor as a lightweight graph-based reasoning structure. The graph is serialized into a code-based representation generated by a VLM, which can subsequently be interpreted by the same or a different VLM to produce the final prediction in zero-shot or in-context learning settings. We evaluate CaRGo-T on humor understanding and humor detection across four datasets spanning diverse forms of comedic content, including satire, sarcasm, and memes. Experiments with state-of-the-art commercial and open-source VLMs show that CaRGo-T consistently improves performance over existing reasoning-based baselines, achieving gains of approximately 1-20% on humor understanding and 1-3% on humor detection. Further analysis using mutual information indicates that the reasoning representations produced by CaRGo-T contain more information relevant to the target output than those generated by baseline reasoning approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/abhi1nandy2/CaRGo-T.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CaRGo-T，一种面向多模态幽默理解的因果图式思维推理框架，通过将图结构序列化为代码表示，提升视觉-语言模型在幽默理解与检测任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模视觉-语言模型虽在多模态任务中表现突出，但幽默理解仍困难，因为幽默往往依赖图像与文本之间细微的实体、事件、上下文和隐含关系；传统提示或线性链式思维难以刻画这类复杂因果推理链。
AI.method: 作者提出 Causal Reasoning Graph-of-Thought（CaRGo-T），将多模态幽默背后的因果与上下文关系建模为轻量级图结构。该图由 VLM 生成，并序列化为代码式表示，再由同一或不同 VLM 在零样本或上下文学习设置下解释该表示并输出最终预测。
AI.result: 在覆盖讽刺、反讽和表情包等多种喜剧内容的四个数据集上，基于商业和开源先进 VLM 的实验显示，CaRGo-T 相比现有推理基线稳定提升性能：幽默理解提升约 1–20%，幽默检测提升约 1–3%。互信息分析表明，CaRGo-T 生成的推理表示包含更多与目标输出相关的信息。
AI.conclusion: CaRGo-T 证明了图结构因果推理表示能够更有效地捕捉多模态幽默中的复杂关系，并可作为一种通用、轻量、可迁移的推理增强框架提升 VLM 的幽默理解能力。

title: Can We Perform Online RL for Image Editing without Editing Rewards?
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables direct preference optimization for image editing through editing-specific rewards, which remain less developed due to costly triplet supervision and complex task-dependent calibration. In contrast, text-to-image (T2I) generation benefits from a mature and diverse reward ecosystem spanning semantic alignment, aesthetics, realism, glyph shape, and other visual preferences. Extending this ecosystem to image editing would substantially broaden the range of visual preferences accessible to RL-based optimization, prompting the central question: \emph{Can We Perform Image Editing RL without Editing Rewards?} In this paper, we argue that the standard image editing dimensions have potential to be mapped to the T2I reward space: image quality can transfer directly, prompt following can be aligned through a description of the desired visual state, and reference consistency admits a coarse semantic conversion by encoding the source content to preserve. However, editing instructions specify relative changes, whereas T2I rewards require self-contained target descriptions; moreover, semantically valid captions from generic vision-language models may be incompatible with the frozen reward. Hence, we further introduce Lever-Edit, a two-stage framework that learns a reward-aligned captioner for counterfactual target descriptions, freezes it, and optimizes the editing policy solely with the transferred T2I reward. Experiments show competitive editing alignment and source preservation against editing-reward-based fine-tuning, while outperforming intuitive transfer baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在没有专门图像编辑奖励的情况下，利用成熟的文生图奖励体系来进行图像编辑强化学习优化。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑RL需要编辑专用奖励，但这类奖励依赖昂贵的三元组监督和复杂的任务校准；相比之下，文生图已有成熟、多样的奖励模型。论文希望将文生图奖励迁移到图像编辑任务，以降低奖励构建成本并扩展可优化的视觉偏好范围。
AI.method: 论文分析图像编辑目标与文生图奖励空间的对应关系，并提出Lever-Edit两阶段框架：先学习一个与冻结文生图奖励对齐的captioner，用于生成反事实目标描述；随后冻结该captioner，仅使用迁移来的文生图奖励优化图像编辑策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在编辑对齐和源图保持方面可与基于编辑奖励的微调方法竞争，并优于直接迁移等直观基线。
AI.conclusion: 图像编辑RL不一定依赖显式编辑奖励；通过将编辑目标转化为奖励兼容的目标描述，成熟的文生图奖励可以有效支持图像编辑策略优化。

title: Performance of a domain-specific large language model in answering patient questions in psychiatry
summary: Background This study was designed to evaluate whether a domain-specific large language model (LLM) trained exclusively on patient education resources can answer questions about psychiatric medications, in a manner superior to LLM chatbots. We developed an LLM ("MIND") fine-tuned for clinical fidelity, trained on patient education resources from authoritative medical organizations. Methods We compared the responses of MIND, ChatGPT, and OpenEvidence to patient questions about escitalopram, using two methods: (1) computer analysis according to a rubric measuring accuracy, clarity, completeness, nuance, safety, and referral appropriateness; (2) ratings from N=10 board-licensed psychiatrists on similar metrics. Results When rated by rubric, MIND was rated highest in all domains (p<0.001). When rated by psychiatrists, ChatGPT was rated accurate more often than MIND with a negligible effect size (p=0.021, r=0.073); MIND was rated complete more often than ChatGPT with a small effect size (p<0.001, r=0.160); and MIND and ChatGPT were rated safe with the same frequency (p=0.955, r=0.002). The majority of psychiatrists preferred the responses generated by ChatGPT (57.6%) compared to MIND (42.4%, p=0.003). Conclusions MIND was able to answer many questions about escitalopram in a manner deemed accurate, complete, and safe by psychiatrists the majority of the time. However, despite MIND's ability to provide more complete responses, psychiatrists preferred ChatGPT's responses. MIND represents a step towards building safe LLM systems to enhance patient education in psychiatry.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了面向精神科用药患者教育的专域大语言模型 MIND 与 ChatGPT、OpenEvidence 在回答艾司西酞普兰相关问题时的表现；MIND 在自动评分中全面领先，但精神科医生整体更偏好 ChatGPT 的回答。
AI.motivation: 通用 LLM 在医疗问答中可能存在准确性、安全性和临床细节不足的问题。研究希望评估仅用权威患者教育资源训练、并针对临床忠实性微调的专域模型，是否能在精神科药物患者教育场景中优于现有聊天机器人。
AI.method: 研究构建了 MIND 模型，并围绕艾司西酞普兰相关患者问题，将 MIND、ChatGPT 和 OpenEvidence 的回答进行比较。评估包括两类：一是基于量表的计算机分析，衡量准确性、清晰度、完整性、细微差别、安全性和转诊适当性；二是由 10 名持证精神科医生按照类似维度进行人工评分与偏好判断。
AI.result: 自动量表评分显示，MIND 在所有评估维度上均排名最高，差异显著。精神科医生评分中，ChatGPT 在准确性上略高于 MIND，但效应量可忽略；MIND 在完整性上优于 ChatGPT，效应量较小；两者安全性评分频率几乎相同。总体偏好上，57.6% 的精神科医生更喜欢 ChatGPT 的回答，42.4% 更喜欢 MIND，差异显著。
AI.conclusion: MIND 能够在多数情况下生成被精神科医生认为准确、完整且安全的艾司西酞普兰患者教育回答，显示专域 LLM 在安全医疗教育系统构建中的潜力。然而，尽管 MIND 回答更完整，医生仍更偏好 ChatGPT，提示专域模型还需在表达方式、可读性和临床沟通体验方面进一步优化。

title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks
summary: Large language models are increasingly expected to execute complex workflows whose success depends on maintaining interdependent constraints and producing artifacts that satisfy strict end-to-end verification. Yet successful execution experience is typically lost after a single run, forcing subsequent models to rediscover strategies and failure modes from scratch. We study whether such experience can instead be externalized and reused through EvoMap, where verifier-confirmed execution trajectories are consolidated into structured Gene. To evaluate this setting, we introduce the Long-Workflow Benchmark (LongWoF-Bench), comprising 778 machine-verifiable tasks across code generation, agent-environment synthesis, mathematical reasoning, and rule following. On the 252 tasks with verifier-confirmed Opus trajectories, evolved EvoMap Gene outperform Skill across all seven evaluated models by 8.7-15.5 percentage points, with the gains extending to consumer models from different model families. In contrast, reference-distilled Gene do not exhibit the same advantage, indicating that compact representation alone is insufficient and that Gene utility is closely associated with verified experience provenance. For Claude Opus, Gene reuse also completes 39 more tasks than Skill while reducing solve-time token consumption by 9.9%. Together, these results show that verified execution experience can be retained and shared as a reusable external resource, enabling models to improve long-workflow completion without repeatedly paying the full cost of experience discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将大语言模型在复杂长流程任务中的已验证成功执行经验外部化、结构化并复用，以提升后续模型完成任务的能力。
AI.motivation: 复杂工作流要求模型同时维护多重相互依赖的约束，并生成可通过端到端验证的产物；但一次运行中获得的成功经验通常无法保留，导致后续模型重复探索策略与失败模式，成本高且效率低。
AI.method: 作者提出 EvoMap，将通过验证器确认的执行轨迹整合为结构化的 Gene，并构建 Long-Workflow Benchmark（LongWoF-Bench），包含 778 个机器可验证任务，覆盖代码生成、智能体环境合成、数学推理和规则遵循。实验比较基于已验证轨迹演化得到的 Gene、Skill 以及参考蒸馏 Gene 在多个模型上的效果。
AI.result: 在 252 个拥有验证器确认的 Opus 轨迹任务上，EvoMap 演化 Gene 在七个评测模型上均优于 Skill，提升 8.7–15.5 个百分点，并能迁移到不同模型家族的消费级模型。参考蒸馏 Gene 未表现出同等优势。对 Claude Opus 而言，Gene 复用比 Skill 多完成 39 个任务，同时将求解阶段 token 消耗降低 9.9%。
AI.conclusion: 经验证的执行经验可作为可复用的外部资源被保留和共享；其价值不仅来自紧凑表示，更与验证过的经验来源密切相关，可帮助模型提升长流程任务完成率并降低重复探索成本。

title: OmicSync: Reliability-Aware Spatial Multi-Omics Clustering with Evidence-Constrained LLM Reasoning
summary: Spatial multi-omics technologies jointly profile gene expression, surface proteins, and histology at each tissue spot, yet most spatial domain discovery methods provide only cluster assignments, without indicating assignment reliability, modality contributions, or why a domain decision should be trusted. We present OmicSync, a reliability-aware spatial multi-omics framework that couples unsupervised domain clustering with evidence-constrained LLM reasoning using model-derived per-spot signals, including assignment confidence, epistemic routing uncertainty, and modality-routing weights. These signals are converted into structured evidence dictionaries and used to generate standard, stepwise, counterfactual, contrastive, and uncertainty-focused explanations. OmicSync integrates a KAN-GCN backbone with spatial encoding, cross-modal fusion, uncertainty-aware routing, cell-type supervision, and missing-modality imputation. We further introduce OmicSync-R, which closes the reasoning-clustering loop by using automatically computed reasoning-quality scores as REINFORCE rewards, allowing reasoning coherence to shape the latent structure without backpropagating through the language model. Across four 10x CytAssist FFPE spatial proteomics benchmarks, OmicSync achieves the best average rank on Human Tonsil (1.44), Glioblastoma (1.78), and Tonsil Add-on (1.22), and second-best on Human Breast Cancer (2.33). OmicSync-R further improves ARI on Human Breast Cancer from 45.73 to 46.72 and outperforms existing methods on six of nine clustering metrics. Together, OmicSync and OmicSync-R enable reliability-aware, spot-level auditable spatial domain discovery guided by evidence-constrained reasoning.

AI.tldr: OmicSync 是一个面向空间多组学的可靠性感知空间域发现框架，结合无监督聚类与基于证据约束的大语言模型推理，既给出空间域划分，也解释每个 spot 的可信度、模态贡献和不确定性；其强化版本 OmicSync-R 进一步利用推理质量奖励反向塑造潜在表示并提升聚类表现。
AI.motivation: 现有空间域发现方法通常只输出聚类标签，缺少对分配可靠性、不同模态贡献以及判定依据的说明，难以满足空间多组学分析中对可审计性、可解释性和不确定性评估的需求。
AI.method: 提出 OmicSync：以 KAN-GCN 为主干，结合空间编码、跨模态融合、不确定性感知路由、细胞类型监督和缺失模态插补；从模型中提取每个 spot 的置信度、认知不确定性和模态路由权重，构建结构化证据字典，并生成标准、逐步、反事实、对比和不确定性解释。进一步提出 OmicSync-R，通过自动计算推理质量分数作为 REINFORCE 奖励，将推理一致性反馈到聚类潜在结构中，而不需要对语言模型反向传播。
AI.result: 在四个 10x CytAssist FFPE 空间蛋白组学基准上，OmicSync 在 Human Tonsil、Glioblastoma 和 Tonsil Add-on 上取得最佳平均排名，在 Human Breast Cancer 上排名第二；OmicSync-R 将 Human Breast Cancer 的 ARI 从 45.73 提升到 46.72，并在九项聚类指标中的六项上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: OmicSync/OmicSync-R 将可靠性估计、模态归因与证据约束推理引入空间多组学聚类，实现了 spot 级别、可审计、可靠性感知的空间域发现，并显示出较强的基准性能和解释能力。

title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
summary: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates that enterprise benchmarks like BEAVER annotate, here recovered from production SQL--we compare the value of oracle query graphs versus retrieved knowledge-base context. In this ablation, retrieved knowledge-base context provides the largest marginal improvement when added to the full oracle graph. Building on this, we optimize a distillation procedure that turns historical query profiles into reusable SQL reference cards. On a benchmark of 5176 production queries from a major online retailer, optimizing these context artifacts yields larger gains (${\sim}12$--$25\%$ AST similarity) than optimizing the retrieval harness (${\sim}3$--$12\%$). On the public BEAVER benchmark, which lacks the production-usage signals available in our internal setting, the picture is more mixed: table cards alone perform about the same as raw historical SQL. The best optimized variant retrieves both cards and raw SQL, scoring $9.00\%$ versus $6.33\%$ (p-value $0.12$) for the comparable baseline on a held-out $N{=}300$ subset, using retrieved context and harness changes but no agentic loop.

AI.tldr: 论文主张企业级 Text-to-SQL 的关键瓶颈在于提供给 LLM 的知识库上下文，而非模型本身；通过从历史 SQL 使用中构造可复用的上下文卡片，可显著提升生成效果。
AI.motivation: 企业数据库包含大量表和复杂业务逻辑，LLM 无法一次性接收完整 catalog。作者希望找到比单纯优化模型或检索框架更有效的方法，即优化模型实际消费的知识库上下文。
AI.method: 作者从生产 SQL 中恢复 query-DAG 分解，比较 oracle query graph 与检索到的知识库上下文的贡献；随后设计并优化一种蒸馏流程，将历史查询画像转化为可复用的 SQL reference cards，并在内部生产查询基准和 BEAVER 公共基准上评估。
AI.result: 在 5176 条生产查询上，优化上下文 artifacts 带来约 12%–25% AST similarity 提升，高于优化检索 harness 的约 3%–12%。在 BEAVER 上，表卡片与原始历史 SQL 表现相近，最佳变体同时检索卡片与原始 SQL，在 N=300 子集上得分 9.00%，相比基线 6.33%，p=0.12。
AI.conclusion: 企业 Text-to-SQL 中，基于历史使用构造和优化知识库上下文比单纯调整检索流程更具价值；但在缺少生产使用信号的公开基准上，收益不够稳定且统计显著性有限。

title: Aligning Biomedical Texts and Knowledge Graphs: A Systematic Comparison of Lightweight Alignment Strategies
comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Knowledge Graphs and Neurosymbolic AI (KG-NeSy 2026) co-located with ISWC 2026
summary: Biomedical knowledge exists in two complementary but distinct forms: unstructured scientific literature and structured knowledge graphs (KGs). Aligning them is essential for knowledge grounding, evidence retrieval, and KG completion, yet existing methods do not explicitly align free-text evidence with KG triples. We present a unified framework for systematically studying design choices for aligning biomedical text and KGs. With a text encoder and a KG embedding model both frozen, we learn only a lightweight projection between their spaces via a contrastive objective. This enables a fair comparison across six design dimensions: text encoder, KG embedding model, projection head, triple composition, training direction, and hard-negatives sampling. We construct CTD-Align, a corpus of over 22K one-to-one tripledocument pairs linking chemical-gene interactions from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database to supporting PubMed passages. We evaluate alignment on it in two retrieval settings: document-to-triple and triple-to-document. We find that the triple composition and the training direction (i.e., shared retrieval space) have the greatest impact, whereas the text encoder and hard-negatives sampling matter little. Overall, simple choices win: projecting text into the KG space with a linear head over concatenated subject, predicate, and object embeddings performs best. These findings establish lightweight contrastive alignment as an effective, practical foundation for bridging biomedical text and KGs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个轻量级对比学习框架，用于对齐生物医学自由文本证据与知识图谱三元组，并构建 CTD-Align 数据集；实验表明，将文本投影到 KG 空间、使用线性投影头和拼接三元组嵌入效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 生物医学知识同时存在于非结构化文献和结构化知识图谱中。有效对齐二者有助于知识溯源、证据检索和知识图谱补全，但现有方法较少显式地将自由文本证据与 KG 三元组进行一对一对齐，也缺乏对关键设计选择的系统比较。
AI.method: 作者冻结文本编码器和 KG 嵌入模型，仅学习一个轻量级投影层，并使用对比学习目标对齐文本与三元组表示。论文系统考察六个设计维度：文本编码器、KG 嵌入模型、投影头、三元组组合方式、训练方向以及 hard negative 采样。作者还构建了 CTD-Align 数据集，包含超过 2.2 万个化学物质-基因交互三元组与 PubMed 支持段落的一对一配对。
AI.result: 在 document-to-triple 和 triple-to-document 两类检索任务上的实验显示，三元组组合方式和训练方向影响最大；文本编码器选择和 hard negative 采样影响较小。最佳方案是使用 subject、predicate、object 嵌入拼接表示三元组，并通过线性投影头将文本表示投影到 KG 空间。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级对比对齐是一种有效且实用的方法，可用于连接生物医学文本与知识图谱。论文强调，复杂模型并非必要，合理的表示组合与共享检索空间设计对性能更关键。

title: GuidedFlow: An Attention-Guided Framework for Anomaly Detection in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Additive Manufacturing (AM) plays a vital role in the ongoing industrial revolution. However, quality control remains crucial and challenging due to printing defects or potential cyber-physical intrusions. Image or video-based anomaly detection is a key effort towards addressing these challenges. Various approaches have been explored in this domain, including reconstruction-based, embedding-based, and flow-based methods. Though normalizing flow-based methods address some of the core challenges of unforeseen defects and generalization while maintaining detection performance, existing approaches struggle with tiny/stringing defects common in 3D printing. In a small-data setting, this poses a limitation in generalization. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GuidedFlow}, a novel attention-guided normalizing flow model for anomaly detection and localization. GuidedFlow employs a pre-trained ResNet model, fine-tuned on the domain dataset. An attention-guided spatial and temporal flow framework models the dynamics across multiple scales and frames. A Spatio-Temporal Attention Network (SAN) enables the flow model to prioritize relevant contextual cues from input frames. We evaluate GuidedFlow on our AM3D-AD dataset, consisting of benign and anomalous real 3D printed object images and videos. We also conduct a comparative study using the MVTec-AD industrial image anomaly detection dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that GuidedFlow outperforms most of the state-of-the-art models with enhanced detection accuracy and AUROC.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GuidedFlow：一种面向增材制造缺陷检测与定位的注意力引导归一化流模型，针对小样本场景下微小/拉丝缺陷难检测的问题提升泛化与检测性能。
AI.motivation: 增材制造质量控制困难，图像/视频异常检测可用于发现打印缺陷或潜在系统异常。现有归一化流方法虽具备较好泛化能力，但对3D打印中常见的微小缺陷、拉丝缺陷表现不足，尤其在小数据条件下限制明显。
AI.method: 方法采用经领域数据微调的预训练 ResNet 提取特征，并构建注意力引导的空间-时间归一化流框架，在多尺度、多帧层面建模动态信息；同时引入时空注意力网络 SAN，使流模型优先关注输入帧中的关键上下文线索，用于异常检测与定位。
AI.result: 在作者构建的 AM3D-AD 数据集（真实3D打印物体图像和视频，含正常与异常样本）上进行评估，并在 MVTec-AD 工业异常检测数据集上开展对比实验。结果显示 GuidedFlow 在检测准确率和 AUROC 上优于大多数现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: GuidedFlow 通过结合预训练特征、时空归一化流和注意力机制，增强了对增材制造场景中细粒度缺陷的检测与定位能力，尤其适合小样本和视频/多帧工业质检场景。

title: Let the Bullets Fly: Multimodal Fake News Detection with Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku
summary: The social interactions among crowds via \textit{Danmaku} (a.k.a., bullet comments) on modern multimedia platforms can facilitate both viewpoint conflicts and consensus, providing fine-grained discriminative social signals that can benefit fake news detection. However, the inherent accumulation latency of \textit{Danmaku} in real-world scenarios violates the real-time necessity of fake news detection, making the studies of \textit{Danmaku}-related fake news detection underexplored. To break this violation, we simulate this temporal-aware user interactive process by proposing a novel temporal \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{da}nmaku framework, called \textbf{Genda}, which consists of: (1) a \textit{Danmaku} Trigger for predicting the timing and intensity of user reactions; and (2) a \textit{Danmaku} Generator for synthesizing corresponding semantic and emotional expressions, thereby mutually constructing a temporally aligned and human-like pseudo \textit{Danmaku} streams. To make the generated \textit{Danmaku} useful for identifying fake news videos, we further design a \textit{Danmaku}-guided Temporal Multimodal fake news detection model - \textbf{DM-FEND}, which enables fine-grained multimodal interactions among video, audio, text, and \textit{Danmaku}, enhancing dynamic modalities alignment and semantic noise inhibition. The experimental results demonstrate that \emph{DM-FEND} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across both Chinese (FakeSV) and English (FakeTT) benchmarks. Further ablations validate the crucial role of temporal \textit{Danmaku} modeling in enhancing robustness and discriminative capability. Finally, this study offers a bright and robust solution for multimodal fake news detection in modern social interactive fashions by bridging the temporal inconsistency between news and user behaviors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Genda 生成时序伪弹幕，并结合 DM-FEND 多模态检测模型，用于缓解真实弹幕积累延迟对视频虚假新闻实时检测的影响，在中英文基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 弹幕能反映用户观点冲突、共识、情绪等细粒度社会信号，有助于虚假新闻检测；但真实场景中弹幕需要随时间积累，存在延迟，难以满足实时检测需求，因此需要在新闻发布早期构造可用的时序弹幕信号。
AI.method: 提出时序生成式弹幕框架 Genda，包括 Danmaku Trigger 用于预测用户反应的发生时间与强度，Danmaku Generator 用于生成相应语义和情绪表达，从而形成时间对齐、类人的伪弹幕流。进一步设计 DM-FEND，将视频、音频、文本和弹幕进行细粒度时序多模态交互，以增强动态模态对齐并抑制语义噪声。
AI.result: 实验表明，DM-FEND 在中文 FakeSV 和英文 FakeTT 基准数据集上持续优于当前先进基线；消融实验验证了时序弹幕建模对提升模型鲁棒性和判别能力的重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过生成时序一致的伪弹幕并将其融入多模态检测，弥合新闻内容与用户行为信号之间的时间不一致问题，为现代社交互动环境下的视频虚假新闻检测提供了有效方案。

title: A Multi-Domain and Multi-Task Generative Framework with Explicit Task and Domain Conditioning for Cross-Domain Event Extraction
summary: Event extraction aims to identify event triggers, classify event types, and extract arguments to construct structured event representations. Despite strong in-domain performance, developing models that generalize robustly across domains remains challenging due to variations in contextual expressions and event schemas. Prior unified and multi-task approaches improve in-domain accuracy but exhibit limited flexibility when applied to unseen domains. Even large language model-based methods that provide full event ontologies at inference time often underperform compared to smaller, task-specific fine-tuned models. We propose a unified multi-domain and multi-task training framework that models heterogeneous event schemas within a single model. Our approach introduces domain conditioning signals, jointly with task-specific prompts, enabling dynamic adaptation to dataset-specific schemas without requiring complete event label sets at inference time. The framework supports both pipeline and end-to-end extraction settings, facilitating efficient task- and domain-level transfer. Experiments on diverse event extraction benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance, strong cross-domain generalization, and practical scalability, while preserving domain-specific precision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出统一的多领域、多任务事件抽取训练框架，通过领域条件信号与任务提示联合建模异构事件模式，提升跨领域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 事件抽取模型在域内表现较好，但跨领域时会受到上下文表达差异和事件模式不一致的影响；现有统一/多任务方法灵活性有限，基于大语言模型且推理时提供完整本体的方法也常不如小型任务微调模型。
AI.method: 构建单模型框架以统一建模不同数据集中的异构事件 schema；引入领域条件信号，并结合任务特定 prompts，使模型可根据数据集 schema 动态适配；同时支持流水线式和端到端事件抽取设置，以促进任务级与领域级迁移。
AI.result: 在多个事件抽取基准上的实验显示，该方法取得有竞争力的性能，表现出较强的跨领域泛化能力和实际可扩展性，同时保持较好的领域特定精度。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多领域、多任务训练结合领域条件与任务提示，是提升事件抽取跨域适应性和可扩展性的有效方案，可在无需推理时完整事件标签集的情况下适配不同 schema。

title: VersaDB: A High-Performance AI Storage Database for Unifying Mutimodal Datasets
summary: The AI field has been rapidly developing, leading to the emergence of a large number of AI training datasets of various types. These datasets contain different modalities, including text, images, audio, etc., and may come in various data storage formats. With the advancement of AI hardware, AI computation units like GPUs, TPUs, and NPUs can greatly accelerate the training speed of AI models, which in turn increases the demand for faster data processing. When using existing AI processing frameworks to handle datasets with different modalities and storage formats, processing speeds may be suboptimal due to issues such as data layout and the way users handle the data. Therefore, using a unified database to store multiple data formats can better manage and optimize data access. In this paper, we introduce VersaDB, a database designed specifically for AI datasets with various modalities. We implemented a page-based storage system, separating structured and unstructured data. Additionally, we generated B+ tree-based index files to accelerate data access. VersaDB supports automatic sharding and maintains a hierarchical metadata management system, with corresponding metadata maintained at the page, shard, and global levels, forming the foundation for the efficient operation of the database. We also focused on ease of use by providing APIs for directly converting datasets into VersaDB, as well as APIs for converting popular AI data storage formats (e.g., CSV, TFRecord, .bin) into VersaDB.Our experiments show that using VersaDB can achieve up to 5.35x acceleration and maintain consistent performance across different parallelism levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VersaDB，一个面向多模态 AI 训练数据集的统一数据库，通过页式存储、结构化/非结构化数据分离、B+树索引、自动分片和分层元数据管理来提升数据访问与训练数据加载效率。
AI.motivation: AI 训练数据集规模和类型快速增长，包含文本、图像、音频等多种模态及 CSV、TFRecord、.bin 等多种存储格式。现有 AI 数据处理框架在面对不同数据布局、格式和用户访问方式时，可能出现数据读取与预处理瓶颈，难以充分匹配 GPU/TPU/NPU 等加速硬件对高速数据供给的需求。因此需要统一的数据管理系统来优化多格式、多模态数据访问。
AI.method: 作者设计并实现 VersaDB：采用页式存储系统，将结构化数据与非结构化数据分离管理；为数据生成基于 B+ 树的索引文件以加速随机/定位访问；支持自动分片以提升并行处理能力；构建页级、分片级和全局级的分层元数据管理体系；同时提供数据集直接转换为 VersaDB 的 API，以及从 CSV、TFRecord、.bin 等常见 AI 数据格式转换到 VersaDB 的 API。
AI.result: 实验表明，VersaDB 相比现有处理方式最高可实现 5.35 倍加速，并且在不同并行度设置下能够保持较稳定的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: VersaDB 通过统一管理多模态、多格式 AI 数据集并优化底层存储、索引、分片和元数据机制，有效缓解 AI 训练中的数据访问瓶颈，提升数据加载效率和系统可用性。

title: FinixDoc: Rethinking Financial Document Parsing Beyond Saturated Benchmarks
summary: Financial document parsing requires accuracy, structural consistency, and verifiability that current benchmarks often fail to reflect. We present FinixDoc, an end-to-end agentic parsing system for real-world financial documents, with FinixDoc-VL, a 4B-scale vision-language model built on Qwen3-VL-4B, as its core parser. To characterize the gap between benchmark and deployment performance, we introduce a Document Parsing Capability Matrix organized along two practical axes: visual quality and document scale. Guided by this matrix, FinixDoc-VL is trained with a domain-adapted recipe combining homoglyph-aware contrastive learning and multi-stage reinforcement learning with composite domain-specific rewards. To better leverage our accumulated advantage in low-quality financial-document data and support large-scale, high-quality data production, we further build a human-in-the-loop Data Factory pipeline with confidence-aware expert review. For evaluation, we construct FinixDocBench, a financial-domain evaluation suite covering digital-native, camera-captured, ultra-large-page, and internal-workflow scenarios, with a compliance-reviewed subset released alongside this technical report. On its main subsets, FinixDoc-VL achieves the highest overall score (81.43) among evaluated baselines, outperforming the next-best open-source model by 5.13 points, with the largest gains on internal financial workflows (FinixInner: 84.08 vs. 78.73).

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FinixDoc：面向真实金融文档的端到端智能解析系统，并以 4B 规模视觉语言模型 FinixDoc-VL 作为核心解析器，在自建金融文档评测集上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析基准难以充分反映金融场景中对准确性、结构一致性与可验证性的部署需求，尤其无法覆盖低视觉质量、大规模页面和内部业务流程等真实复杂场景。
AI.method: 作者提出文档解析能力矩阵，从视觉质量与文档规模两个轴刻画基准与部署之间的差距；基于 Qwen3-VL-4B 构建 FinixDoc-VL，并采用同形异义字符感知的对比学习、多阶段强化学习以及复合领域奖励进行训练；同时构建人机协同 Data Factory，通过置信度感知的专家审核生产高质量数据。
AI.result: 作者构建 FinixDocBench，覆盖数字原生、相机拍摄、超大页和内部工作流等金融场景。在主要子集上，FinixDoc-VL 总分达到 81.43，超过最佳开源基线 5.13 分；在内部金融工作流 FinixInner 上提升最明显，达到 84.08，相比 78.73 更优。
AI.conclusion: FinixDoc 表明，面向领域需求的数据生产、训练策略和评测体系能够显著提升金融文档解析在真实部署场景中的性能，尤其是在低质量和复杂工作流文档上具有优势。

title: Credal Large Language Models for Semantic Commitment under Uncertainty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce fluent but incorrect answers with unwarranted confidence. A central limitation is that standard LLMs represent uncertainty through a single predictive distribution, conflating epistemic ignorance with genuine ambiguity. We introduce Credal Large Language Models (CLLMs): an ensemble of LoRA adapters induces a credal set whose lower and upper probabilities expose the spread of plausible predictive distributions rather than collapsing to a single softmax output. From this representation we derive two complementary commitment scores. Credal Token Commitment (CTC) is a token-space score that combines lower-bound support, credal width, and intersection entropy, computed without additional generation. Semantic Commitment Consistency (SCC) extends commitment to semantic space using sampled completions, with SCC-Gap measuring the mismatch between token-level and semantic-level support. We evaluate hallucination detection, calibration, selective prediction, and reasoning on Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B across OpenBookQA, CoQA, TriviaQA, and ARC-Challenge. CLLM is the best method on QA accuracy at competitive expected calibration error, and CTC tracks the best hallucination AUROC within 1.5 pp on most settings without additional generation. On selective prediction at 80% coverage, CLLM with SCC reaches 99.0% accuracy on OpenBookQA, and on ARC-Challenge CLLM with Csem confidence achieves <= 0.6% ECE across the three backbones.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Credal Large Language Models（CLLMs），用 LoRA 适配器集成形成 credal set，以区分模型无知与真实歧义，并提出 CTC 与 SCC 两类承诺度指标，用于更可靠地检测幻觉、校准置信度和选择性预测。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 通常用单一预测分布表达不确定性，容易把 epistemic uncertainty（模型知识不足）与 aleatoric/semantic ambiguity（问题本身歧义）混在一起，导致模型对错误答案表现出过度自信，影响问答、推理和可靠部署。
AI.method: 作者构建 LoRA adapter ensemble，使多个适配器产生一组可能的预测分布，即 credal set，并通过上下概率刻画预测分布的范围。在此基础上提出 Credal Token Commitment（CTC），结合下界支持、credal width 和 intersection entropy，在 token 空间无需额外生成即可计算；同时提出 Semantic Commitment Consistency（SCC），基于采样补全在语义空间衡量承诺一致性，并用 SCC-Gap 衡量 token 层支持与语义层支持之间的不匹配。
AI.result: 在 Gemma-2-9B、Llama-3.1-8B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 上，跨 OpenBookQA、CoQA、TriviaQA、ARC-Challenge 评测。CLLM 在 QA 准确率上表现最好，同时保持有竞争力的 ECE；CTC 在多数设置中无需额外生成即可达到接近最佳的幻觉检测 AUROC，差距通常在 1.5 个百分点以内；在 80% 覆盖率选择性预测中，CLLM+SCC 在 OpenBookQA 达到 99.0% 准确率；在 ARC-Challenge 上，CLLM+Csem 在三种 backbone 上 ECE 均不超过 0.6%。
AI.conclusion: CLLM 通过集合式不确定性表示改善了 LLM 的置信度估计和可靠性评估，CTC 与 SCC 分别从 token 与语义层面提供互补的承诺度信号，可有效用于幻觉检测、校准和选择性预测。

title: Direct, Parallel, or Sequential? A Comparative Study of Training-Free Multi-Subject Image-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-conditioned image-to-video (I2V) generation has advanced rapidly, yet generating videos with multiple subjects remains challenging. A model must simultaneously preserve the appearance of each subject, assign distinct motions, and maintain coherent spatial and temporal interactions. This paper presents a systematic study of three representative paradigms for training-free multi-subject I2V generation: direct, parallel, and sequential generation. Direct generation applies a pretrained I2V model to the complete reference image and prompt, requiring all subjects and motions to be synthesized jointly. Parallel and sequential generation instead decompose the reference image and prompt into subject-specific visual and textual conditions. Parallel generation synthesizes each subject independently and subsequently composes the resulting videos, reducing the complexity of each generation step at the cost of weaker inter-subject context. Sequential generation first synthesizes a background video and then progressively introduces individual subjects. This preserves accumulated scene context but introduces sensitivity to subject ordering and error propagation. We empirically evaluate the three paradigms across diverse multi-subject scenes, comparing appearance preservation, motion fidelity, temporal consistency, and inter-subject coherence, while also characterizing their distinct failure modes. Our findings reveal the strengths and limitations of each paradigm and offer practical insights for designing controllable multi-subject video generation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了三种免训练多主体文本条件图像到视频生成范式：直接生成、并行生成与顺序生成。
AI.motivation: 多主体 I2V 生成需要同时保持各主体外观、分配不同运动，并维持空间与时间交互一致性，现有方法在复杂多主体场景中仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 作者将三种代表性训练-free范式进行系统研究：直接生成使用完整参考图像与提示词联合生成；并行生成将图像和文本分解为主体级条件，分别生成后再合成；顺序生成先生成背景视频，再逐步加入各主体。并从外观保持、运动保真、时序一致性和主体间一致性等维度进行实证评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示了三类范式的不同优势、局限与失败模式：直接生成依赖模型联合建模能力；并行生成降低单步复杂度但主体间上下文较弱；顺序生成保留累积场景上下文但对主体顺序敏感且易产生误差传播。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为可控多主体视频生成系统的设计提供了实践性见解，说明不同生成范式适用于不同复杂度、交互强度和一致性需求的场景。

title: GSAR: Goal-State-Anchor Rewards for Mobile GUI Agents with Self-Evolving Data Synthesis
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) based GUI agents stand to benefit significantly from online reinforcement learning (RL). However, their training is bottlenecked by two fundamental issues: current data synthesis methods for GUI Agents rely on specific environments and struggle to generate diverse data, while existing evaluators either suffer from limited scalability or provide inaccurate and unreliable reward signals. To overcome these challenges, we introduce GSAR (Goal-State-Anchor Reward), a RL reward framework that supports scalable task generation and delivers reliable reward signals for stable and efficient policy optimization. Our approach features self-evolving data synthesis, which produces multiple environments through task execution and generates diverse tasks and goal states. Complementing this, a state-anchor mechanism automatically annotates task-relevant UI elements in successful goal states as reference anchors. During RL training, these reference anchors provide accurate, scalable reward signals that substantially enhance efficiency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves over 90% accuracy on offline trajectory verification and performs closest to rule-based methods. Furthermore, agents trained using our reward framework exhibit strong performance on both AndroidWorld and our constructed benchmark, establishing a scalable approach for GUI agent training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GSAR（Goal-State-Anchor Reward），用于 GUI 智能体在线强化学习的可扩展奖励框架，通过自演化数据合成与状态锚点机制生成多样任务并提供可靠奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉-语言模型的 GUI 智能体有望受益于在线强化学习，但现有训练受两类问题限制：一是 GUI 任务数据合成依赖特定环境、数据多样性不足；二是现有评估器可扩展性有限，或奖励信号不准确、不可靠，影响稳定高效的策略优化。
AI.method: 提出 GSAR 框架：首先采用自演化数据合成，通过任务执行产生多个环境，并生成多样化任务与目标状态；其次引入 state-anchor 机制，在成功目标状态中自动标注与任务相关的 UI 元素作为参考锚点；强化学习训练时，利用这些参考锚点为轨迹或状态提供准确且可扩展的奖励信号。
AI.result: 实验显示，该框架在离线轨迹验证中达到超过 90% 的准确率，表现最接近基于规则的方法。使用该奖励框架训练的智能体在 AndroidWorld 和作者构建的基准测试上均表现较强。
AI.conclusion: GSAR 通过结合可扩展任务生成与可靠锚点式奖励评估，缓解了 GUI 智能体在线强化学习中的数据与奖励瓶颈，为大规模、稳定且高效的 GUI 智能体训练提供了一种可行方案。

title: Future Querying: Can LLMs Serve as Implicit Medical World Models?
comment: This paper is accepted at The 1st MICCAI Workshop on Medical World Models (MICCAI-2026)
summary: Traditional clinical prediction models rely on task-specific pipelines and curated, structured data, which scale poorly and underutilize unstructured text. To address this, we introduce future querying, a paradigm that probes whether large language models (LLMs) can function as implicit medical world models by evaluating their ability to answer time-indexed clinical queries about a patient's future. Our framework operates on unstructured clinical documentation using endpoint-agnostic training, enabling a single model to answer diverse clinical queries over patient trajectories without manual feature engineering or task-specific retraining. We show that small, locally fine-tuned open-weight models can match or approach larger proprietary systems, making the framework suitable for privacy-preserving, on-premise deployment. Evaluated on a new synthetic medical reports dataset and real ICU notes from the MIMIC-IV dataset, our results provide encouraging evidence that LLMs can capture aspects of clinical dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“future querying”范式，用时间索引的临床未来查询评估LLM是否能作为隐式医学世界模型，并在非结构化临床文本上实现端点无关训练。
AI.motivation: 传统临床预测模型依赖任务特定流水线和人工整理的结构化数据，扩展性差，且未充分利用临床记录中的非结构化文本信息。
AI.method: 构建基于非结构化临床文档的端点无关训练框架，使单一模型无需人工特征工程或针对每个任务重新训练，即可回答患者轨迹中多样化、带时间索引的临床未来问题；在合成医疗报告数据集和MIMIC-IV ICU真实笔记上评估，并比较小型本地微调开源模型与大型专有模型。
AI.result: 实验显示，小型、本地微调的开源权重模型能够匹配或接近更大型专有系统的表现；在合成数据和真实ICU记录上，结果表明LLM能够捕捉部分临床动态。
AI.conclusion: future querying为临床预测提供了一种可扩展、隐私友好、无需任务特定重训的LLM范式，具备本地部署潜力，但摘要仅表明证据“令人鼓舞”，仍需进一步验证其可靠性、泛化性和临床安全性。

title: SiZeUp: Fast 3D Proxy from Aerial Images via Depth Ordinal Loss
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: We present SiZeUp, a fast and scalable approach for constructing large-scale 3D urban proxy models directly from calibrated oblique aerial imagery. Our method adopts a height-from-footprint representation, reducing 3D building abstraction to a low-dimensional optimization problem in which building footprints are extruded by a single height parameter. To enable efficient and robust height estimation, we introduce an ordinal depth consistency loss that enforces agreement between the relative depth ordering of rendered proxies and depth priors predicted by a monocular depth model. This is realized through a differentiable renderer that maps parametric building proxies into multi-view depth images, allowing gradients to be propagated from depth supervision to building heights. Our ordinal formulation produces stable optimization in practice and avoids explicit feature matching or dense point cloud reconstruction. Rather than relying on metric depth, which can be unreliable under monocular scale ambiguity, our ordinal depth consistency loss operates on relative depths, providing a more reliable signal across views. Combined with an efficient dynamic view selection, our approach achieves a 23-52$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art proxy reconstruction pipelines while maintaining comparable proxy-level coverage and volume consistency, making it well suited for large-scale urban modeling tasks.

AI.tldr: SiZeUp 是一种从已标定倾斜航拍影像快速构建大规模城市 3D 代理模型的方法，通过“建筑轮廓+单一高度”表示和序深度一致性损失，实现高效、可扩展的建筑高度估计。
AI.motivation: 大规模城市 3D 代理重建通常依赖特征匹配或稠密点云，计算成本高且扩展性受限；单目深度虽可提供先验，但存在尺度歧义，直接使用度量深度不够可靠。因此需要一种更快、更稳健、适合大规模城市建模的高度估计方法。
AI.method: 方法采用 height-from-footprint 表示，将建筑足迹按单一高度参数拉伸，把 3D 建筑抽象转化为低维优化问题。通过可微渲染器将参数化建筑代理渲染为多视角深度图，并与单目深度模型预测的深度先验进行相对深度排序约束，提出序深度一致性损失；同时结合动态视角选择提升效率和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 相较于先进的代理重建流程，该方法实现了 23–52 倍加速，同时保持了相近的代理级覆盖率和体积一致性。
AI.conclusion: SiZeUp 通过相对深度监督和可微优化避免了复杂的显式匹配与点云重建，在速度、稳定性和可扩展性上具有优势，适合大规模城市 3D 代理模型构建。

title: Your AI, On a Dial: Controlling Investment Bias in LLMs with a Single Neuron
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in investment decision-making, yet prior work shows that they exhibit systematic, model-specific investment preferences. We study whether a model's overall investment stance can be calibrated to a specified direction and strength. We introduce an investment-bias dial, an inference-time intervention on a single neuron that continuously adjusts a model-level decision prior---its overall tendency toward buying or selling---without targeting specific firms or investment attributes. Using matched positive and negative evidence, we evaluate five open-weight LLMs and find that the dial produces monotonic changes in investment stance without modifying prompts or model parameters. At the response level, the dial shifts both investment decisions and the evidential emphasis of generated rationales under identical inputs. In an agentic retrieval setting, the dial also changes what information the model searches for, which evidence it selects, and which evidence is reflected in its final analysis. In a long-context evaluation, the dial maintains stable stance control as context length increases, whereas a matched system-prompt instruction progressively attenuates. We further show that changes in the dial propagate to security rankings and downstream portfolio composition in an exploratory backtest. Overall, our results show that an LLM's aggregate investment stance can be calibrated toward a specified target at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种推理时“投资偏置旋钮”，通过干预单个神经元连续调节大语言模型整体买入/卖出倾向，并在多种评测中验证其可控性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正被用于投资决策，但已有研究发现不同模型存在系统性、模型特定的投资偏好。作者希望研究模型整体投资立场是否能被校准到指定方向和强度，而不是仅依赖提示词或重新训练。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个 inference-time intervention：对单个神经元进行调控，形成“investment-bias dial”，用于调整模型级决策先验。实验覆盖五个开源权重大语言模型，使用匹配的正负证据进行评估，并进一步考察响应生成、代理式检索、长上下文场景、证券排序与组合回测中的影响。
AI.result: 该旋钮在不修改提示词和模型参数的情况下，使模型投资立场产生单调变化；它不仅改变买卖决策，也改变生成理由中的证据强调。在检索式代理场景中，它影响搜索信息、证据选择和最终分析内容；在长上下文中，其控制效果比系统提示更稳定；变化还能传导至证券排名和下游投资组合构成。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，大语言模型的整体投资立场可以在推理阶段被连续、定向地校准，并且这种校准会影响从单次回答到检索行为、长上下文推理及组合构建的多个层面。

title: A Scalable Cross-Domain Event Extraction System via a Unified Generative Training Framework
summary: Event extraction is fundamental to information extraction. Prior approaches often separate event detection and argument extraction or depend on dataset-specific designs, limiting scalability and cross-domain generalization. We propose a unified generative sequence-to-sequence framework that performs event extraction subtasks jointly and supports both pipeline and end-to-end configurations. We fine-tune pretrained language models on multiple event datasets across diverse domains, enabling a single model to retain domain-specific semantics while generalizing over large and evolving label spaces. We demonstrate these capabilities through a web-based application tailored for researchers and practitioners. The platform supports document upload, schema-aware event extraction, visualization of triggers and arguments, and comparison of different extraction configurations across domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的生成式序列到序列事件抽取框架，可联合完成事件检测与论元抽取，并支持流水线和端到端两种配置。
AI.motivation: 现有事件抽取方法通常将事件检测与论元抽取分离，或依赖特定数据集的设计，导致可扩展性不足，跨领域泛化能力有限，难以适应不断变化的大规模标签空间。
