AI.method: 论文提出两条互补路径：一是 Environment Scaling，扩展可执行文件、搜索和代码环境的多样性与可验证性；二是 Agentic Coordination Scaling，训练智能体进行任务分解、并行委派、异步结果整合与重新规划。同时使用共享执行框架和 AgentOS 维护跨工具、跨智能体的任务状态与来源记录，并将环境轨迹和协同轨迹转化为训练信号。
AI.result: Apodex 1.1 在复杂专业工作、金融、科学研究、数学、编程和搜索等任务上达到领先性能区间，且模型规模显著小于许多前沿系统。35B 参数的 Apodex 1.1 Mini 也在本地可部署形态下保留了较强工作能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将智能体能力从单次回答扩展到长期、可验证的实际任务完成，表明通过环境扩展和协同训练可以构建面向复杂长期任务的 Heavy-Duty Solver。

title: BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 in the 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
summary: Computer vision applications for 3D scene understanding in underwater environments remain challenging due to the lack of high-quality 3D data and the inability of surface-trained models to generalize to underwater scenes. To address this challenge, an emerging trend is to employ generative models to close the data domain gap. However, existing methods assemble large scenes by stitching independently generated tiles post hoc with separately trained models, while demonstrating heterogeneous landscapes only within individual survey sites. We introduce BenthicFlow, a unified framework based on a single conditional flow-matching model that jointly generates aligned textures and depth maps. A MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling procedure reconciles overlapping windows throughout the generative trajectory, enabling spatially extensible RGBD mosaics without a separate stitching model. The generated mosaics are subsequently lifted into explicit 3D benthic environments using surface-aligned Gaussian surfels. Experiments across geographically distinct survey sites demonstrate that BenthicFlow preserves site-specific appearance while generating coherent, large-scale 3D scenes that closely match the target distributions. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow.

AI.tldr: BenthicFlow 是一个用于生成大规模水下 RGBD 马赛克并重建 3D 底栖场景的统一生成框架。
AI.motivation: 水下 3D 场景理解受限于高质量 3D 数据稀缺，以及在陆地/表面场景上训练的视觉模型难以泛化到水下环境。现有生成式方法通常独立生成小块图像后再拼接，场景一致性和尺度扩展能力不足。
AI.method: 论文提出基于单一条件 flow-matching 模型的 BenthicFlow，联合生成对齐的纹理与深度图；采用受 MultiDiffusion 启发的采样过程，在生成轨迹中协调重叠窗口，从而无需额外拼接模型即可生成空间可扩展的 RGBD 马赛克；随后利用表面对齐的 Gaussian surfels 将 RGBD 马赛克提升为显式 3D 底栖环境。
AI.result: 在多个地理位置不同的调查站点上，BenthicFlow 能保持站点特定外观，并生成连贯的大规模 3D 场景；生成结果与目标数据分布高度接近。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过统一的条件生成模型和重叠窗口一致化采样，有效缓解水下 3D 数据不足与域差异问题，为水下大规模 3D 场景合成与理解提供了可扩展方案。

title: EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language model safety benchmarks typically evaluate only final responses: whether a model refuses, warns, or complies. This outcome-level view cannot tell whether a model is safe for the right multimodal reason. Safelooking behavior may reflect keyword-triggered refusal, missed visual hazards, or over-refusal of benign-sensitive inputs. We introduce EviSafe, an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety that jointly evaluates natural user-facing behavior, explicit grounding in textual and visual evidence, and behavioral sensitivity to counterfactual changes in safety-critical evidence. EviSafeBench instantiates the framework as a controlled benchmark with 1,181 gold image-text scenarios and 2,452 targeted counterfactual variants across eight safety domains and eight risk-source types. Each scenario includes a gold safety decision, evidence annotations, a safe-response policy, and counterfactual interventions. The three-probe protocol queries models with natural-response, evidencereporting, and counterfactual-response prompts, then scores them using an evidence-aware judge. Across eleven evaluated VLMs, natural severity accuracy ranges from 27.6% to 52.8%, relaxed diagnostic consistency from 6.1% to 29.3%, and unsafe-to-safe counterfactual transition success from 30.4% to 58.4%. These gaps show that the evaluated VLMs are not reliably safe for the right multimodal reason and motivate evaluation beyond refusal counts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EviSafe，用于评估视觉语言模型是否基于正确的多模态证据做出安全行为，而不只是统计最终拒答或合规结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型安全基准多只评估最终回复，如拒绝、警告或遵从，无法判断模型是否真正识别了图文中的安全关键证据；表面安全可能来自关键词触发、遗漏视觉风险或对良性敏感输入过度拒绝。
AI.method: 作者提出证据扎根的 EviSafe 框架，并构建 EviSafeBench：包含 1,181 个金标准图文场景和 2,452 个针对性反事实变体，覆盖八类安全领域和八类风险来源。每个场景标注安全决策、证据、安全响应策略及反事实干预。评测采用三探针协议：自然回复、证据报告、反事实回复，并用证据感知评审器打分。
AI.result: 在 11 个视觉语言模型上，自然严重性准确率为 27.6%–52.8%，宽松诊断一致性为 6.1%–29.3%，从不安全到安全的反事实转换成功率为 30.4%–58.4%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，当前被评估的视觉语言模型尚不能稳定地基于正确的多模态证据实现安全行为，因此安全评测应超越简单的拒答率或最终响应统计，转向证据 grounding 与反事实敏感性评估。

title: Neighbor-Aware View Synthesis for Restoring Missing Views in Light-Field Camera Arrays
summary: In light-field (LF) imaging systems, dense spatial sampling from a camera array enables powerful post-capture capabilities such as refocusing and depth estimation. However, real-world LF capture is often affected by hardware malfunctions, where one or more cameras in the array fail, leading to missing sub-aperture images and degraded reconstruction quality. This paper addresses the problem of defective or missing view restoration in light-field camera arrays. We propose a novel generative framework that synthesizes the absent views by exploiting information from a carefully selected subset of neighboring cameras. These selected images, along with a positional encoding map indicating both their locations and the desired target view, are fed into a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) trained to generate the missing viewpoint in a geometrically consistent manner. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world LF datasets demonstrate that our method produces visually plausible and photometrically accurate reconstructions, outperforming baselines for view interpolation both quantitatively and qualitatively. The proposed framework thus offers a robust and efficient solution for fault-tolerant light-field image acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于光场相机阵列中缺失/故障视角恢复的条件生成框架，通过选择邻近相机图像与位置编码来合成缺失子孔径图像。
AI.motivation: 光场成像依赖相机阵列的密集空间采样以支持重聚焦、深度估计等后处理能力；但实际系统中相机硬件故障会导致部分子孔径图像缺失，从而降低光场重建质量。因此需要一种鲁棒、高效的缺失视角恢复方法。
AI.method: 方法首先从目标缺失视角周围选择一组有信息量的邻近相机图像；随后将这些图像与位置编码图一起输入条件生成对抗网络。位置编码同时表示输入视角位置和目标视角位置，使网络能够学习几何一致的跨视角合成。
AI.result: 在合成与真实光场数据集上的实验表明，该方法生成的缺失视角在视觉上合理、光度上准确，并在定量指标和定性效果上优于传统或基线视角插值方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效恢复光场相机阵列中的缺失或故障视角，为容错型光场图像采集提供了鲁棒且高效的解决方案。

title: Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Hint-based reinforcement learning addresses reward sparsity in long-horizon agentic tasks by retaining a prefix of an expert trajectory before each rollout, letting the policy explore from a state closer to success. Its effectiveness hinges on the guidance depth: how much of the trajectory to keep. Existing methods treat this depth as a deterministic scalar. Scheduled approaches share one value across samples and ignore per-task heterogeneity; per-sample probing estimates it separately at the cost of extra rollouts. We find that useful guidance occupies a band of depths whose informativeness profile is approximately Gaussian around the band center, rather than concentrating at a single optimal point. We propose Agent-G$^2$, a Gaussian guidance framework that draws the depth per task from a Gaussian whose center and spread are estimated online from rollouts already collected for policy optimization, requiring no probe rollouts or learned depth predictor. The center combines a global baseline with per-cluster difficulty, and the spread tracks within-cluster variance. We evaluate Agent-G$^2$ on ALFWorld and WebShop on Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct. Agent-G$^2$ outperforms the strongest hint-based, hint-free, and Aux-RL baselines on ALFWorld by 2.3 / 3.9 / 7.4 points at under one-third the rollout cost of per-sample probing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agent-G²：一种用于提示式强化学习的高斯引导深度采样框架，通过在线估计每个任务的引导深度分布，在不增加探测 rollout 的情况下缓解长时程任务的稀疏奖励问题。
AI.motivation: 提示式强化学习依赖保留专家轨迹前缀来让策略从更接近成功的状态开始探索，但关键在于选择合适的引导深度。现有方法要么使用全局确定性深度，忽略任务差异；要么逐样本探测，带来额外 rollout 成本。作者观察到有效引导深度并非单点最优，而是围绕某个中心呈近似高斯的信息性区间。
AI.method: 提出 Agent-G²，将每个任务的引导深度建模为高斯分布并进行采样。分布中心由全局基线与按簇估计的任务难度共同决定，方差/扩展程度由簇内差异在线跟踪。所有统计量均利用策略优化过程中已有的 rollout 估计，无需额外探测 rollout 或训练深度预测器。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct 进行评估。Agent-G² 在 ALFWorld 上相较最强的提示式、无提示式和 Aux-RL 基线分别提升 2.3 / 3.9 / 7.4 个百分点，同时 rollout 成本低于逐样本探测方法的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: Agent-G² 通过将引导深度从确定性标量扩展为任务自适应的高斯分布，在性能与采样成本之间取得更优平衡，说明利用已有 rollout 在线估计引导深度分布是解决长时程稀疏奖励任务的一种高效策略。

title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
summary: We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. Discrete commands and continuous poses are mapped to a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory, with dataset-level calibration preserving motion magnitude across heterogeneous data. To jointly learn audio-visual generation and trajectory control, we construct a complementary data engine and adopt progressive training followed by autoregressive post-training for long-horizon generation. Extensive evaluations show that \model achieves strong trajectory following and high visual quality on public world-model benchmarks, supporting both first- and third-person interaction across varied subjects, and maintaining synchronized environmental sound and speech over long-horizon generation.

AI.tldr: EchoWM 是一个面向可进入式生成媒体的全模态世界模型，能在连续导航控制下联合生成 720p 视频、环境声、音乐与语音。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式世界模型通常难以同时满足连续可控导航、高质量长时程视听生成、第一/第三人称统一交互，以及跨异构数据的运动尺度一致性。该工作旨在构建一个可响应相机意图并生成同步多模态内容的统一框架。
AI.method: 论文以“相机意图”组织交互：第一人称场景中表示观察者运动，第三人称场景中从数据学习相机—角色动态。将离散命令与连续位姿统一映射到共享的度量尺度相对 6-DoF 轨迹，并通过数据集级校准保持异构数据中的运动幅度一致。为联合学习视听生成与轨迹控制，构建互补数据引擎，并采用渐进式训练和用于长时程生成的自回归后训练。
AI.result: 实验显示，该模型在公开世界模型基准上具备较强的轨迹跟随能力和较高视觉质量，能支持多主体、多场景下第一人称与第三人称交互，并在长时程生成中保持环境声与语音同步。
AI.conclusion: EchoWM 通过统一 6-DoF 轨迹控制、多模态联合生成和长时程自回归训练，推进了可导航、可进入式生成媒体的世界模型能力，尤其适合需要连续交互和同步视听输出的应用。

title: Walking on the DARKSIDE
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) recognise patterns but do not natively track the path of exclusions that a coherent discourse demands. When an input rests on a fabricated authority, a misapplied mechanism, or a surreptitious analogy, an unsteered LLM tends to engage with it as if it were grounded, and to reify the misstep into any structured output it generates. Logic-Augmented Generation (LAG) with POLANYI++, an LLM-steering method that uses heuristics, ontologies and problem solving methods for tacit knowledge extraction, produces an Extended Knowledge Graph (XKG) in OWL2, but inherits the same vulnerability: a sophisticated nonsensical input is reified into the graph alongside the legitimate triples, and is hardly detectable by automated reasoners since the XKG is generated jointly with the wrong assumptions. We introduce DARKSIDE, a coherence auditing method on top of POLANYI++. It formalises the trail as an explicit data structure of accumulated exclusions over discourse time, complemented by a warrant axis that classifies each named referent as Warranted, Unattested, Misattributed or Fabricated, with an escalation rule that pushes the DelegationRiskAssessment to UNSAFE when the fabricated rate is positive or the unsupported rate exceeds a threshold. We evaluate DARKSIDE as a steering layer over a Gemini 3 on BSBench, a 100-item adversarial corpus of sophisticated-sounding nonsense across software engineering, finance, healthcare, physics and law, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 as an independent judge. The empirical evidence supports an architectural claim: when an LLM forward pass is wrapped in an ontology-mediated negative-trail apparatus, the structural pattern-vs-path gap can be partially scaffolded. The XKG functions as the missing memory, and the warrant axis as an epistemic firewall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DARKSIDE：在 POLANYI++/LAG 生成的 OWL2 扩展知识图谱之上增加“负向排除轨迹”和“凭证轴”审计机制，用于识别并阻断看似专业但无根据的输入被模型结构化固化。
AI.motivation: LLM 及其逻辑增强生成方法容易把伪造权威、误用机制或隐蔽类比当作有效前提，并将错误假设写入结构化知识图谱；由于图谱与错误前提共同生成，传统自动推理器难以发现这些问题。
AI.method: DARKSIDE 将话语过程中的排除路径形式化为显式数据结构，并为命名指称对象设置凭证分类：Warranted、Unattested、Misattributed、Fabricated；同时引入升级规则，当伪造率为正或无支持率超过阈值时，将 DelegationRiskAssessment 判为 UNSAFE。该方法作为 POLANYI++ 上的 steering layer 包装 LLM 前向生成。
AI.result: 作者在 BSBench 上评估该方法，该基准包含 100 个跨软件工程、金融、医疗、物理和法律领域的对抗性“貌似高深的胡言乱语”样本，使用 Gemini 3 作为被审计模型，并以 Claude Sonnet 4.6 作为独立评判者。摘要称经验证据支持该架构性主张。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为，通过本体介导的负向轨迹机制包裹 LLM 生成过程，可以部分弥补模型“模式识别”与“排除路径跟踪”之间的结构性缺口；XKG 充当缺失的记忆，凭证轴则发挥认识论防火墙作用。

title: Toward a Foundation Plug-and-Play Prior for Computed Tomography Reconstruction via a Multimodal Diffusion Model
summary: Computed tomography (CT) throughput is limited by scan time, which grows with both the number of projections acquired and the detector integration time for each. Reconstructing high-quality volumes from sparse-view or low-dose measurements therefore depends on an informative prior, typically a neural network trained for one specific scan setting and retrained whenever the modality, geometry, or material changes. We investigate whether a single diffusion model trained across several imaging domains can instead serve as a prior for many CT problems simultaneously. We evaluate the proposed method using the same frozen model on three datasets that differ in modality, beam geometry, material, and degradation type, spanning flaw analysis in additively manufactured metal parts imaged with cone-beam X-ray CT and concrete microstructure imaged with parallel-beam neutron CT. Our proposed method out-performs analytic reconstructions in all three cases, providing a step toward a reusable foundation prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用一个跨多个成像领域训练的冻结扩散模型，作为多种CT重建任务的通用先验，以提升稀疏视角或低剂量CT的重建质量。
AI.motivation: CT吞吐量受扫描时间限制，而扫描时间随投影数量和探测器积分时间增加而增长。稀疏视角或低剂量测量需要强先验；现有神经网络通常针对特定扫描设置训练，换模态、几何或材料后需要重新训练，限制了复用性。
AI.method: 作者训练/使用一个覆盖多个成像域的扩散模型，并在不同CT问题中保持模型冻结，将其作为重建先验。实验覆盖三类差异显著的数据集，包括锥束X射线CT中的增材制造金属部件缺陷分析，以及平行束中子CT中的混凝土微结构成像，涉及不同模态、束流几何、材料和退化类型。
AI.result: 在三个测试场景中，该方法均优于解析重建方法，表明同一个冻结扩散模型能在异构CT重建任务中提供有效先验。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，跨领域扩散模型有潜力成为可复用的CT重建基础先验，减少针对每种扫描条件重新训练模型的需求，并为多模态、多几何、多材料CT问题提供统一解决方向。

title: Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting
summary: Forecasting long-range influenza-like illness (ILI) matters for public health readiness. Publicly available surveillance datasets typically pair numeric epidemiological signals with textual information that is noisy, loosely structured, only indirectly related to near-term trends, and often lagged relative to the numeric signal. Fusing the two therefore requires careful design. We propose Dual-Stream Attention (DSA), a multimodal deep learning framework that forecasts 12-week-ahead ILI activity from a 36-week multimodal history by letting the numerical and textual streams condition each other. Using the Time-MMD health-domain dataset, DSA separately encodes the two modalities with a Transformer-based numerical encoder and a domain-adapted headline encoder, then couples them through a bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) mechanism: the text (news headlines) conditions the interpretation of the numeric signal and vice versa. The CMA output then passes to a causal temporal model for forecasting. Evaluated across ten random seeds, DSA achieves a median test MSE of 0.416, versus 0.668, 0.607, and 0.851 for iTransformer, TaTS, and GPT4MTS, corresponding to mean-error reductions of 54.95%, 37.29%, and 67.23%, with paired Cohen's d of 0.555, 0.337, and 0.345, respectively, and ranks first in 100% of bootstrap draws. It also has substantially lower worst-window error than all baselines. On an external-geography dataset, DSA again ranks first among nine evaluated baselines. Ablations show the advantage does not depend on text-encoder choice or language-model fine-tuning, and that bidirectional attention outperforms either direction alone. Finally, perturbation-based faithfulness analysis shows the learned CMA is functionally informative under targeted masking, with a stronger effect in the text-to-numerical direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DSA 双流注意力多模态框架，用于基于 36 周数值与文本历史预测 12 周后的 ILI 活动，在 Time-MMD 及外部地理数据集上优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 长期 ILI 预测对公共卫生准备很重要，但公开监测数据中的数值流行病学信号与文本信息存在噪声大、结构松散、与短期趋势关系间接且可能滞后的问题，因此需要更精细的多模态融合设计。
AI.method: DSA 分别使用 Transformer 数值编码器和领域适配的新闻标题编码器处理两种模态，并通过双向跨模态注意力 CMA 使文本与数值信号相互条件化；融合后的表示输入因果时间模型进行 12 周提前预测。
AI.result: 在十个随机种子评估中，DSA 测试 MSE 中位数为 0.416，优于 iTransformer、TaTS、GPT4MTS 的 0.668、0.607、0.851；相应平均误差降低 54.95%、37.29%、67.23%，且在 bootstrap 抽样中 100% 排名第一。外部地理数据集上也在九个基线中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 双向跨模态注意力是提升多模态 ILI 长期预测的关键，模型优势对文本编码器选择和语言模型微调不敏感；扰动式忠实性分析表明 CMA 学到的交互具有功能信息性，尤其文本到数值方向作用更强。

title: Learning Spherical Occupancy Profiles for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation
comment: 12 pages,5 figures,5 tables. Code and data will be released
summary: We study spherical occupancy profiles-the ray-wise occupancy probability profiles P(r) = T(r) o(r) distilled from multi-view 3D Gaussian reconstructions-as a unified intermediate representation for both discriminative and generative 3D reconstruction from images. On a 999-object subset of Google Scanned Objects with 48 turntable views each, we train (i) a discriminative per-ray decoder that injects global view-averaged and ray-specific image evidence into a FiLM-conditioned profile head, reaching median soft depth error 0.035 (normalized) on an independent 90-object test split, and (ii) a generative pipeline built on a profile VAE and a latent diffusion model, which supports unconditional sampling that matches the reconstruction manifold and image-conditioned multi-solution reconstruction whose per-object solution spread is quantifiable and tunable via classifier-free guidance. We further analyze the morphology of predicted profiles: post-hoc power sharpening and a learned sharpening target both recover ground-truth profile width without degrading depth, exposing a monotonic width-peak frontier in the L1-per-ray loss family and motivating a principled redefinition of morphology gates. Real-photo validation on two DTU scenes confirms the pipeline transfers to non-synthetic input. Our results suggest that ray-wise occupancy profiles offer a compact, learned, and uncertainty-aware interface between multi-view reconstruction and generative priors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将从多视角 3D Gaussian 重建中蒸馏出的球面逐射线占据概率剖面作为统一中间表示，用于判别式与生成式图像到三维重建。
AI.motivation: 现有多视角三维重建与生成先验之间缺少一种紧凑、可学习且能表达不确定性的统一接口；作者希望用逐射线占据剖面同时服务于深度/形状预测、生成采样和多解重建。
AI.method: 在 Google Scanned Objects 的 999 个物体、每物体 48 个转台视图上训练两条路线：其一是判别式逐射线解码器，将全局视图平均特征与射线特定图像证据注入 FiLM 条件化的剖面预测头；其二是生成式流程，包含 profile VAE 与潜空间扩散模型，支持无条件采样和图像条件多解重建。同时分析预测剖面的形态，通过后验幂次锐化与学习式锐化目标研究宽度、峰值和损失之间的关系。
AI.result: 判别式模型在独立 90 物体测试集上达到 0.035 的归一化 median soft depth error；生成式模型能够产生符合重建流形的无条件样本，并通过 classifier-free guidance 生成可量化、可调节分散度的图像条件多解结果。锐化策略可恢复接近真实的剖面宽度且不损害深度精度；在两个 DTU 真实照片场景上验证了从合成到真实输入的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 逐射线占据概率剖面可作为多视角重建与生成式三维先验之间的紧凑、学习型、不确定性感知接口，并有助于统一判别式重建、生成式采样和形态不确定性分析。

title: MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction
summary: Interactive clinical agents must gather decisive evidence and convert it into grounded actions under partial observability. A correct final diagnosis alone does not show that an agent respected evidence and care-process constraints. We introduce MediSkill-Evo, a clinical agent that evolves governed process knowledge without backbone fine-tuning. It separates experience into four typed banks for clinical skills, process rules, symbolic schemas, and measurement procedures. Provenance, support, replay, and controller-defined safety checks govern publication to a frozen test-time snapshot. A Process-Constrained Preference Harness binds evidence to its source, rejects controller-invalid candidates, and ranks actions with a safety-prioritized Clinical Process Critic. We evaluate complete agent systems across two backbone endpoints and six controlled stress dimensions under the same Doctor-turn limit. On 300 held-out Qwen encounters, MediSkill-Evo improves diagnosis accuracy from 61.33 percent to 69.00 percent and treatment-intent coverage from 33.62 percent to 66.44 percent, while reducing automatically scored critical failures from 31.00 percent to 16.33 percent relative to AgentClinic. On 180 hard-isolation conditions derived from 30 cases, target recovery reaches 93.61 percent under patient-behavior pressure, 100.00 percent for temporal evidence, and 92.22 percent for triage red flags. An exploratory 100-case MedSAM comparison evaluates request-gated tool-interface feasibility. These results provide descriptive end-to-end evidence for the complete system on fixed evaluation suites, not causal evidence for an individual bank or clinical validation of the automatic judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MediSkill-Evo，一种无需微调骨干模型、通过受治理的过程知识进化来提升临床交互代理表现的方法；在多项固定评测中提升诊断准确率、治疗意图覆盖率并降低关键失败率。
AI.motivation: 交互式临床代理不仅要给出正确最终诊断，还必须在部分可观测条件下收集关键证据，并遵守证据约束与医疗流程约束；单纯诊断正确率无法充分反映其是否进行了可靠、可追溯且安全的决策过程。
AI.method: MediSkill-Evo 将经验拆分为四类知识库：临床技能、流程规则、符号模式和测量程序；通过来源追踪、支持证据、回放机制和控制器定义的安全检查来管理知识发布，并冻结为测试时快照。其 Process-Constrained Preference Harness 将行动与证据来源绑定，过滤流程无效候选，并用安全优先的 Clinical Process Critic 对动作排序。
AI.result: 在 300 个保留 Qwen 病例上，相比 AgentClinic，诊断准确率从 61.33% 提升到 69.00%，治疗意图覆盖率从 33.62% 提升到 66.44%，自动评分关键失败率从 31.00% 降至 16.33%。在 180 个困难隔离条件中，患者行为压力下目标恢复率为 93.61%，时间证据为 100.00%，分诊红旗为 92.22%。另进行了 100 例 MedSAM 探索性比较以评估请求门控工具接口可行性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 MediSkill-Evo 作为完整系统在固定评测集上具有描述性的端到端改进证据，但不能证明单个知识库的因果贡献，也不能视为自动评判器的临床有效性验证。

title: Bee Detection and Tracking at Hive Entrance using YOLO11 and ByteTrack
summary: This work presents an automatic bee entrance monitoring system based on YOLO11 transfer learning and the ByteTrack tracking algorithm. The study investigates the influence of data augmentation, backbone freezing, and tracker parameter optimization on the detection and counting of small, fast-moving bees. The detector with progressive backbone unfreezing strategy achieved about 97.0% precision and 98.7% mAP50, while providing more stable convergence than full fine-tuning. Experiments also showed that light augmentation outperformed heavy augmentation. For tracking, ByteTrack parameters were optimized to improve trajectory continuity under low-confidence detections. On an independent 25 FPS side-view video, the optimized YOLO11-ByteTrack system correctly counted 43 of 47 incoming bees (91.5%) and 7 of 30 outgoing bees (23.3%). Error analysis showed that most counting errors were caused by missed detections due to rapid bee motion and motion blur, while tracking failures became less frequent after parameter optimization. Overall, the results indicate that moderate augmentation, progressive backbone unfreezing, and ByteTrack tuning improve the reliability of automatic bee entrance monitoring under realistic recording conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于 YOLO11 迁移学习与 ByteTrack 的蜜蜂巢门自动监测系统，用于检测、跟踪并计数快速运动的小目标蜜蜂。
AI.motivation: 蜜蜂进出巢门行为是蜂群状态监测的重要指标，但蜜蜂体型小、运动快，真实视频中存在运动模糊、低置信度检测和轨迹中断等问题，导致自动计数可靠性不足。
AI.method: 研究采用 YOLO11 进行迁移学习检测，并结合 ByteTrack 进行多目标跟踪；系统评估数据增强强度、骨干网络冻结/逐步解冻策略以及 ByteTrack 参数优化对检测精度、收敛稳定性和计数性能的影响。
AI.result: 采用渐进式骨干解冻的检测器达到约 97.0% precision 和 98.7% mAP50，且比全量微调收敛更稳定；轻量数据增强优于重度增强。优化后的 YOLO11-ByteTrack 在独立 25 FPS 侧视视频中正确计数 43/47 只进入蜜蜂（91.5%）和 7/30 只离开蜜蜂（23.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 适度数据增强、渐进式骨干解冻和 ByteTrack 参数调优可提升真实条件下蜜蜂巢门自动监测的可靠性，但出巢计数仍明显不足，主要瓶颈来自快速运动与运动模糊引发的漏检。

title: SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation
summary: Agent skills are reusable procedural artifacts that extend language agents with specialized workflows, tool conventions, and domain behaviors at inference time. However, creating reliable skills still depends largely on human authorship, model priors, or execution traces. These sources are often unavailable for unfamiliar tasks, suggesting the need to create skills from open-world materials. In this paper, we study open-world skill creation: given an underspecified skill brief and a source-access specification, a creator must discover behavior-relevant requirements omitted by the brief and determine how broadly each source-derived procedure is justified. We propose SkillAlchemy, an admission-centered framework for source-grounded skill creation. SkillAlchemy identifies implicit requirements through contrastive evidence, admits candidate procedures based on evidence-supported scope, and compiles the admitted content into a grammar-guided skill package. Extensive experiments across 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks demonstrate that SkillAlchemy improves pass rate over no-skill execution by 19.9 percentage points and the strongest automated baseline by 8.6 percentage points, while achieving performance comparable to human-curated skills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillAlchemy，用于从开放世界资料中自动创建可复用的语言智能体技能，在 SkillsBench v1.1 上显著提升任务通过率，并接近人工编写技能的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体技能的创建主要依赖人工编写、模型先验或执行轨迹；但在陌生任务中，这些来源往往不可用。因此需要一种能够基于开放世界材料，从不完整技能描述中发现隐含需求并生成可靠技能的方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 admission-centered 的 SkillAlchemy 框架：给定欠规范的技能简述和源访问规范，先通过对比证据识别隐含需求，再根据证据支持的适用范围接纳候选流程，最后将接纳内容编译为语法引导的技能包。
AI.result: 在 87 个 SkillsBench v1.1 任务上的实验显示，SkillAlchemy 相比无技能执行提升 19.9 个百分点的通过率，相比最强自动化基线提升 8.6 个百分点，并达到与人工策划技能相近的性能。
AI.conclusion: SkillAlchemy 证明了从开放世界资料中进行源依据技能创建的可行性，可在缺乏人工技能、模型先验或执行轨迹时，为语言智能体自动构建可靠且可复用的任务技能。

title: BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations
summary: Automated perception in side-scan sonar (SSS) imagery is severely hindered by physical acoustic artifacts, resulting in representations that inextricably mix intrinsic seabed reflectivity with transient viewing geometries. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks rely on augmentations designed for natural images, failing to account for acoustic degradation and explicitly enforce view-invariance. To address this gap, we introduce a physics-informed self-distillation framework built upon the DINOv3 architecture utilizing a ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny backbone to maximize data efficiency. The proposed methodology enforces view-invariance through two primary mechanisms: physically motivated augmentations that simulate speckle noise, range-dependent attenuation, and radiometric miscalibration; and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) penalty that explicitly decouples learned dense patch features from physical viewing parameters. Furthermore, we propose a dense, hierarchical feature fusion strategy across all four network stages to preserve fine-grained sediment details alongside deep semantic abstractions. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that the framework natively groups complex benthic topographies into stable, noise-free semantic clusters without relying on manual annotations. During supervised downstream tasks on the S3Seg dataset, the fused representations exhibited exceptional data efficiency, achieving 96% of its absolute peak performance using only 10% of the available annotated data, ultimately reaching a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 71.4% and an overall accuracy of 86.5%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种面向侧扫声呐图像的物理信息自蒸馏自监督框架，在DINOv3与ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny基础上，通过声学退化增强、HSIC去相关约束和多层密集特征融合，学习对观测几何与噪声更鲁棒的海底语义表征。
AI.motivation: 侧扫声呐图像受散斑噪声、距离衰减、辐射校准误差和视角几何变化等物理声学伪影影响，导致模型学到的表示混合了真实海底反射属性与瞬时成像条件。现有自监督学习方法多沿用自然图像增强，难以建模声呐成像退化，也缺乏显式视角不变性约束。
AI.method: 方法基于DINOv3自蒸馏框架，采用ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny作为轻量主干以提升数据效率。核心包括：1）物理启发式数据增强，模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射误校准；2）引入Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion（HSIC）惩罚，使稠密patch特征与物理观测参数解耦；3）融合网络四个阶段的层级稠密特征，同时保留细粒度沉积物纹理与深层语义信息。
AI.result: 无人工标注条件下，模型能够将复杂海底地形聚合为稳定、低噪声的语义簇。在S3Seg监督下游任务中，融合表征表现出较强数据效率：仅使用10%标注数据即可达到其绝对峰值性能的96%；最终取得71.4%的mIoU和86.5%的总体准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将声呐成像物理先验融入自监督自蒸馏，并通过显式去相关约束与层级特征融合，可显著提升侧扫声呐表征的鲁棒性、语义稳定性和标注效率，适合标注稀缺的海底感知任务。

title: Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers
comment: This paper is the extended version of Contet, Grandi, Mengin. Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers. In: Proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Algorithmic Decision Theory (ADT) (2026)
summary: We study the problem of formally explaining why a candidate was not selected by a given tournament rule, by identifying sub-tournaments in which the candidate loses independently of how the rest of the tournament is completed. We define destructive minimal supports as any minimal sub-tournaments satisfying this property, which in formal explainable artificial intelligence correspond to abductive explanations for the question "Why does the loser lose the tournament?". For six common tournament solutions (maximin, uncovered set and its weighted variant, top-cycle, Copeland, and Borda) we provide characterizations of when a candidate is either a necessary loser or a possible winner, we determine the size of the smallest destructive minimal supports, complemented by polynomial-time algorithms for their computation except for the case of the Borda rule which is suspected to be NP-complete.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何形式化解释某候选者为何未被锦标赛规则选中，提出“破坏性最小支持”作为解释对象，并分析六类常见锦标赛解的性质与算法。
AI.motivation: 在可解释人工智能与社会选择/锦标赛规则中，仅给出获胜者不足以说明失败原因；作者希望找到一个最小的子锦标赛，使得目标候选者无论其余关系如何补全都必然失败，从而提供可验证、局部且简洁的反事实无关解释。
AI.method: 作者定义破坏性最小支持，即能独立保证候选者失败且在包含关系下最小的子锦标赛；针对 maximin、uncovered set、加权 uncovered set、top-cycle、Copeland、Borda 六种规则，刻画候选者成为必要失败者或可能获胜者的条件，并研究最小支持规模及计算算法。
AI.result: 除 Borda 规则外，论文为相关规则给出了破坏性最小支持的规模界定与多项式时间计算算法；对 Borda 情形，作者认为其计算问题可能是 NP-complete。
AI.conclusion: 破坏性最小支持为解释“为什么该候选者输掉锦标赛”提供了统一的形式化框架；多数常见规则下该解释可高效计算，而 Borda 规则表现出更高的计算复杂性。

title: MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: A 3rd Place Report for the MeViS-Audio Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge
summary: In this technical report, we present a training-free framework for audio-guided video object segmentation, which integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with SAM-based segmentation models. We decompose the task into several stages and identify suitable foundation models for each stage. Without introducing additional model training or task-specific fine-tuning, our approach leverages the strong multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to model text-visual correspondence and employs SAM-based models for accurate object mask generation. The proposed framework demonstrates the effectiveness of leveraging foundation models for audio-guided video segmentation and achieves competitive performance in the MeViS-Audio Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的音频引导视频目标分割框架，将多模态大语言模型与基于 SAM 的分割模型结合，在不进行额外训练或任务微调的情况下实现具有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 音频引导视频目标分割需要同时理解音频、文本/视觉语义对应关系以及生成精确目标掩码。传统方法通常依赖任务特定训练或微调，成本较高且泛化受限。作者希望利用现有基础模型的能力，构建一个训练-free 的解决方案。
AI.method: 将任务拆解为多个阶段，并为每个阶段选择合适的基础模型：利用多模态大语言模型进行跨模态推理和文本-视觉对应建模；利用 SAM 系列分割模型生成精确目标掩码。整个流程不引入额外训练，也不进行任务特定微调。
AI.result: 该框架在第 8 届 LSVOS Challenge 的 MeViS-Audio Track 中取得了有竞争力的表现，验证了基础模型组合用于音频引导视频分割的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过合理拆解任务并组合 MLLM 与 SAM 等基础模型，即使不进行额外训练，也能在音频引导视频目标分割任务中获得较好效果，体现了训练-free 多模型协作范式的潜力。

title: StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models
summary: As large language models are increasingly used in data-scarce and evolving task scenarios, few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has become a key paradigm for task adaptation. However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose StrategyBench, which selects strategy-inducible tasks from BIG-Bench, constructs reference strategies, and defines evaluation metrics along two dimensions: strategy quality and downstream utility. We further analyze strategy induction from three perspectives: task variation, model configuration, and adaptation setting, covering category-wise differences, generator-executor choices, demonstration design, and SFT-based adaptation. Experiments show that explicit strategy utility differs substantially across task categories and depends on both strategy generation and execution conditions. The benchmark is released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StrategyBench-D53C.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StrategyBench，用于评估大语言模型从少量示例中归纳任务策略并将其用于下游推理的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本上下文学习通常直接依赖少量示例进行预测，缺少对任务规则或策略的显式抽象，因此对示例选择与构造较为敏感。人类学习者通常会先从示例中总结规则，再应用到新样本；论文希望系统评估大语言模型是否具备这种策略归纳能力。
AI.method: 作者从 BIG-Bench 中筛选可诱导策略的任务，构建参考策略，并提出 StrategyBench 基准；评估维度包括策略质量和下游效用。同时从任务变化、模型配置和适应设置三个角度展开分析，涉及任务类别差异、生成器-执行器组合、示例设计以及基于监督微调的适应。
AI.result: 实验表明，显式策略的下游效用在不同任务类别之间存在显著差异，并且受到策略生成条件和策略执行条件的共同影响。
AI.conclusion: StrategyBench 为研究和评估大语言模型的策略归纳能力提供了系统基准，揭示了显式策略并非在所有任务中都稳定有效，其效果依赖任务类型、模型配置和适应方式。

title: Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360° Panoramic Images
summary: We present Mover360, a controllable object manipulation framework for 360° images. Unlike perspective images, 360° images in equirectangular projection (ERP) exhibit horizontal wrap-around, latitude-dependent distortion, and global scene continuity, which makes object-level edits difficult for existing perspective editors to produce and for users to specify. To address this, Mover360 centers on object Translation (relocating a specified object within an existing panorama) while supporting reference-guided Insert and Remove as auxiliary tasks. Its interface unifies point-, bbox-, and mask-guided control by encoding each task into a fixed prompt and a compact, ERP-aligned instruction map. In the default point mode, a single click relocates an object, allowing the model to infer a plausible size, support, and illumination using panoramic context and an auxiliary depth condition. Structurally, Mover360 is a lightweight adaptation of a pretrained diffusion transformer. To generate paired supervision, we construct a UE5 data-generation pipeline with surface-aware object placement and randomized illumination, yielding large-scale paired data and a dual-domain benchmark of synthetic and real panoramas with ground truth for all three tasks. Across both test domains and two evaluation protocols, Mover360 outperforms strong baselines for perspective editing, insertion, and inpainting in reconstruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and distributional quality. Code and our benchmark dataset are available at https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/.

AI.tldr: Mover360 是一个面向 360° 全景图（ERP 投影）的可控对象编辑框架，重点解决对象平移，并支持插入与移除，在合成和真实全景基准上优于现有透视图编辑/修复方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑方法主要面向普通透视图，难以处理 360° ERP 图像中的水平环绕、纬度相关畸变和全局场景连续性，因此对象级移动、插入和移除在全景场景中难以准确指定和自然生成。
AI.method: 论文提出 Mover360：将点、边界框和掩码等控制形式统一编码为固定文本提示和紧凑的 ERP 对齐指令图；默认点模式下用户单击即可指定对象迁移目标，模型结合全景上下文与辅助深度条件推断合理尺度、支撑关系和光照。模型结构上基于预训练扩散 Transformer 做轻量适配；数据上构建 UE5 管线，通过表面感知对象放置和随机光照生成大规模成对监督数据，并建立包含合成与真实全景的双域基准。
AI.result: 在合成和真实测试域，以及两种评估协议下，Mover360 在重建保真度、语义一致性和分布质量方面均超过强基线，包括透视图编辑、对象插入和图像修复方法。
AI.conclusion: Mover360 证明了针对 ERP 几何与全景连续性进行任务编码、模型适配和数据构建，可以显著提升 360° 图像中的可控对象操作质量，并为该方向提供了数据集和评测基准。

title: Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation
summary: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用于 ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge 的会话式音乐推荐系统，采用多模态检索、轻量重排与个性化回复生成三阶段流程，最终在 Blind B 上取得 0.3213 的综合分数。
AI.motivation: 会话式音乐推荐需要同时理解用户历史、对话上下文、音乐内容与个性化表达。单一模态或单一召回信号难以覆盖曲目语义、音频、视觉、歌词、元数据及协同过滤偏好，因此需要构建融合多源信号的稳健推荐框架。
AI.method: 系统包含三阶段：第一阶段使用七类稠密嵌入空间构建带时间衰减权重的用户/会话中心，包括曲目与用户级 CF-BPR、Qwen3 元数据/歌词/属性、CLAP 音频、SigLIP 视觉，并结合 BM25 词法检索与艺人子串匹配信号，通过加权 Reciprocal Rank Fusion 融合；第二阶段进行轻量重排，包括历史过滤、流行度平滑和目录多样性惩罚；第三阶段使用 GPT-4o-mini 生成具有人设多样性的回复。作者还在开发阶段测试了 LLM 引导艺人注入、专辑延续信号、XGBoost LambdaMART 和更强的 GPT-4.1 提示词，但因成本和复杂度未部署到 Blind B。
AI.result: 在 500 个会话开发集上，作者通过差分进化优化 RRF 权重，使 MRR 提升 19.5%。Blind A 实验显示，无约束 LLM 艺人注入在 54 个会话上导致 nDCG 大幅下降 18.9%，而仅在 9 个会话上进行保守注入取得 Blind A 上最佳观察 nDCG。最终提交系统在 Blind B 上取得 0.3213 的综合分数。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，多模态、多信号融合结合简单稳健的重排策略可有效支持会话式音乐推荐；同时，LLM 辅助推荐信号需要严格约束，否则可能严重损害排序质量。整体方案强调工程可部署性、成本控制与多模态融合的有效性。

title: Semantic Reconstruction and 3-D Detection via Learned Multi-Pair Fusion in RF Imaging
summary: We consider a multistatic radio-frequency imaging problem with anisotropy, in which the reflection from a point depends on the positions of the transmit (Tx) and receive (Rx) arrays. The goal is to label the voxels of a field of view by a finite set of semantic classes and to group them into object instances. For the image formation of each Tx--Rx pair we apply a standard inverse-problem solver, and we feed the resulting per-pair reconstructions into a trained three-dimensional (3-D) U-Net that performs the fusion implicitly and the per-voxel classification explicitly. On a controlled, under-determined multistatic setup, we consider the following image formation methods: back-projection (BP) and the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) from a single deterministic snapshot, and incoherent BP and group-LASSO from multiple fading snapshots. For each imaging method we train a separate U-Net that fuses the six Tx--Rx pairs (its input channels) and assigns each voxel a probability vector over the classes. Taking the most probable class gives a labeled volume---the semantic reconstruction. Object instances and their oriented bounding boxes then follow by geometric post-processing (clustering and principal-component analysis). Across a wide range of signal-to-noise ratio, the semantic reconstruction (scored against ground truth by segmentation intersection-over-union) and the resulting 3-D detection degrade far more gracefully than the classical intensity reconstruction: the detection in particular stays reliable well into noise levels at which that reconstruction has dissolved. Because real scenes contain objects of classes the network was not trained on, we add an explicit unknown class trained by outlier exposure, which labels held-out novel objects as unknown instead of mislabeling them as a known class by reconstructed shape.

AI.tldr: 论文研究各向异性多基地射频成像中的语义重建与实例检测：先对每个Tx-Rx通道做传统成像，再用3D U-Net融合多通道并进行体素级分类，随后通过几何后处理得到实例和三维有向框。
AI.motivation: 传统强度成像在欠定、多基地且存在噪声/衰落的射频成像场景中容易退化；同时各向异性反射使不同发射-接收对观测差异明显。作者希望直接获得更稳健的语义级体素标签和对象实例，而不仅是易受噪声影响的强度重建，并处理训练集中未见类别的误分类问题。
AI.method: 对六个Tx-Rx对分别使用图像形成方法生成重建结果，包括单次确定性快照下的BP、LASSO，以及多次衰落快照下的非相干BP、group-LASSO。针对每种成像方法训练一个3D U-Net，将六个通道作为输入，隐式完成融合并显式输出每个体素的类别概率。取最大概率类别形成语义体；再通过聚类和PCA等几何后处理得到对象实例及其有向包围盒。另通过outlier exposure训练显式unknown类以识别未见对象。
AI.result: 在宽信噪比范围内，相比经典强度重建，语义重建的分割IoU和由此产生的3D检测性能随噪声增加下降更平缓；检测在传统重建已严重失效的噪声水平下仍保持可靠。加入unknown类后，模型能将保留的新颖对象标注为未知，而非按形状误分为已知类别。
AI.conclusion: 将传统逆问题成像与学习式3D语义融合结合，可显著提升欠定多基地射频成像在噪声条件下的语义分割和目标检测鲁棒性；显式未知类训练增强了开放集场景下的可靠性。

title: SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

AI.tldr: 论文提出自反思策略优化（SRPO），让大语言模型从自身完成的轨迹中总结错误并生成“反思补丁”，将稀疏终端反馈转化为密集的 token 级训练信号，在数学推理与长程智能体任务上以较低训练成本取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 人类学习中，自我反思能够把稀疏的结果反馈转化为可操作的改进指导；但在大语言模型后训练中，这种机制尚未被充分利用。现有方法往往依赖外部 critic、奖励模型或更强教师模型，训练成本较高且反馈不够细粒度。
AI.method: SRPO 让模型分析自身已完成的轨迹，归纳错误并生成简洁的 reflection patches；随后在学生模型的 on-policy rollout 上，利用反思条件化的教师评分生成密集 token 级监督信号，从而进行策略优化。该框架不需要外部 critic、独立奖励模型或更大的教师模型。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3-8B，SRPO 在 AIME'24 上达到 73.3%，仅使用相对于扩展监督微调 8% 的训练 FLOPs；同时在 WebShop、ALFWorld、SWE-Bench-Lite 上分别达到 64.7%、76.8%、31.2% 的成功率/表现，显示出较高数据效率和跨任务效果。
AI.conclusion: SRPO 表明，自我反思可以作为一种有效的后训练机制，将稀疏监督转化为密集学习信号，并在推理和长程智能体任务中提升性能与训练效率。

title: E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable parameters, or fine-tuning. In the first stage, E2S-Pruner treats each attention head as an independent evidence source, estimates its reliability from evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and represents each visual token using three states: important, unimportant, and uncertain. In the second stage, Dempster--Shafer evidence theory is used to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse complementary evidence from multiple network layers. We further introduce a spatial novelty constraint that promotes coverage of distinct image regions and prevents the retained tokens from concentrating in a few locally salient areas. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, E2S-Pruner retains 98.0%, 96.8%, and 90.6% of the aggregate performance when the average numbers of retained visual tokens are 192, 128, and 64, respectively, while improving throughput by 1.96x and 2.09x under the 128-token and 64-token settings. Experiments on Qwen2-VL-7B further demonstrate cross-model generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/taoyu-qian/E2S-Pruner.git.

AI.tldr: E2S-Pruner 是一种无需训练和微调的视觉 token 剪枝方法，通过两阶段证据融合减少视觉语言模型推理开销，并在较少 token 下保持较高性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型通常将图像编码为大量视觉 token，导致推理延迟和 GPU 显存开销较高。现有剪枝方法多依赖注意力分数，并直接跨注意力头和网络层聚合，难以刻画证据不确定性与冲突。
AI.method: 提出 E2S-Pruner 渐进式两阶段证据融合框架。第一阶段将每个注意力头视为独立证据源，根据证据清晰度和头间一致性估计可靠性，并用重要、不重要、不确定三种状态表示视觉 token。第二阶段利用 Dempster-Shafer 证据理论量化层间冲突并融合多层互补证据，同时引入空间新颖性约束以覆盖不同图像区域，避免 token 集中在局部显著区域。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上，平均保留 192、128、64 个视觉 token 时，分别保持 98.0%、96.8%、90.6% 的综合性能；在 128 和 64 token 设置下吞吐量分别提升 1.96 倍和 2.09 倍。在 Qwen2-VL-7B 上也验证了跨模型泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: E2S-Pruner 能在不引入额外模型、可训练参数或微调的情况下，有效降低视觉 token 数量和推理成本，同时保持较强任务性能与跨模型适用性。

title: Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty
summary: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理微调可能在无有害数据的情况下诱发大模型安全行为退化的问题，并提出训练期约束方法 SDP 来缓解。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现，使用数学、代码、问题求解及链式思维等推理数据进行微调，可能导致模型出现 Reasoning-Induced Misalignment（RIM），但其表征空间机制及有效训练期修复方法尚不清楚。
AI.method: 作者从激活表征空间中提取“推理能力方向”和“安全行为方向”，分析二者耦合关系；利用 CKA 距离比和探针定位安全决策相关层；在此基础上提出 Safety-Direction Penalty（SDP），在推理微调时惩罚模型沿学习到的安全方向发生位移，并根据诊断结果迭代扩展约束层范围。
AI.result: 实验表明，在 Qwen2.5-3B 和 7B 上，SDP 能够恢复或保持安全表现，同时基本保留基准推理性能。
AI.conclusion: RIM 可从表征空间中推理方向与安全方向的耦合来解释；针对安全方向位移施加惩罚是一种有效的训练期缓解策略，可在提升推理能力的同时降低安全退化风险。

title: Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space
summary: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.

AI.tldr: HetSkills 是一个用于物理角色控制的统一框架，通过共享潜在空间逐步学习并整合异构技能，支持动作跟踪、文本到动作、动作补全和下游任务适应。
AI.motivation: 现有物理角色控制方法通常针对不同数据来源、监督形式或任务分别训练技能/控制器，难以在长时程任务中复用与扩展；同时，文本到动作控制可能绕过语言语义，依赖捷径信号，导致泛化和语义对齐不足。
AI.method: 方法将统一潜在空间视为共享的可执行接口。首先学习动作跟踪技能，建立稳定的运动控制基础和可复用的共享动作解码器；随后在该空间中扩展文本到动作等技能。为避免文本到动作学习捷径，引入 motion intuition distillation 以增强语言语义 grounding，并设计 task-guidance 模块，根据高层语言指令动态调整动作。
AI.result: 实验显示该框架在动作跟踪、文本到动作生成、动作补全和下游任务适应中均表现有效；在具有挑战性的条件下仍能取得较高成功率，并保持动作自然性。
AI.conclusion: HetSkills 通过共享潜在空间和可复用解码器实现异构技能的渐进式整合，提升了物理角色控制系统的可扩展性、语义对齐能力和长时程任务适应能力。

title: EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards
summary: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.

AI.tldr: EarthVerse 是一个面向地球系统与自然灾害研究的科学智能体基准，包含 405 个可复现任务，用于评估智能体在异构证据检索、计算、溯源和跨尺度推理中的端到端可靠性。
AI.motivation: 地球系统分析需要整合来源、尺度、时间和模态各异的观测证据；在自然灾害研究中，证据不完整或处理不一致会影响对严重程度、暴露范围和机制的判断。因此需要一个能真实衡量科学智能体完整研究流程可靠性的基准。
AI.method: 作者提出 EarthVerse，基于 199 个有记录事件和 19 类灾害家族构建 405 个包级调查任务。智能体需检查异构事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、协调不同来源差异，并在答案中保留来源溯源。基准提供可执行的标准答案，将任务拆解为细粒度答案单元，并配套任务特定评分规则以评估研究过程。作者在受控工具使用协议下评估 25 个模型与智能体系统，并通过控制实验定位证据访问、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互和科学执行等失败来源。
AI.result: 最佳系统的平均答案单元准确率为 84.65%，但最高 Strict@95 仅为 34.81%。这表明模型虽然常能完成局部步骤，但很难在证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释之间维持一致的完整推理链。
AI.conclusion: EarthVerse 为动态地球系统中的端到端科学可靠性评估提供了可复现基础，揭示当前科学智能体在跨证据整合、长期一致性和科学执行方面仍存在显著不足。

title: Dual-Grained Agent Memory and Shapley Context Attribution for Multimodal Agentic Learner
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deliver impressive perception yet still falter on scientific and mathematical reasoning. Parameter-level adaptation is unavailable for closed-weight or on-device backbones, and stateless prompting forfeits any compounding benefit from problems already solved. We propose \textbf{DG-Mem}, a dual-grained agentic memory framework that augments a frozen MLLM with a non-parametric, externally stored memory built once from training-time rollouts and consulted read-only at test time. Motivated by the Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) account of human memory, DG-Mem factors its store into an instance-grounded exemplar memory and a category-level schema memory of IF-THEN rules, with a transient reflection store mediating their construction so that schemas are synthesized only from abstract reflections, never from exemplar text. Two design choices distinguish DG-Mem: an online concept categorizer that grows the category space incrementally during training rather than committing to a predefined taxonomy, and a Shapley context attribution procedure that decomposes correctness across the entire retrieved rule set and yields a per-rule utility that re-weights retrieval at test time. The pipeline introduces no gradient updates and is deployable on closed-weight or on-device backbones. Across MathVista, MMMU, and MMMU-Pro on four open-weight and proprietary backbones (Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, GPT-5-Nano, Gemini-3-Flash), DG-Mem improves consistently over no-memory and competitive memory baselines.

AI.tldr: DG-Mem 是一种无需参数更新的双粒度代理记忆框架，为冻结的多模态大语言模型提供外部只读记忆，以提升科学与数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿 MLLM 在感知任务上表现强，但在科学和数学推理上仍不足；闭源或端侧模型无法进行参数级适配，而无状态提示无法累积已解决问题带来的经验收益。
AI.method: DG-Mem 在训练期 rollout 中构建非参数外部记忆，测试时只读检索。其记忆分为实例级 exemplar memory 和类别级 schema memory（IF-THEN 规则），并通过临时 reflection store 生成抽象反思后再合成 schema。框架还包含在线概念分类器以增量扩展类别空间，以及 Shapley 上下文归因机制，为检索到的规则估计效用并在测试时重加权。
AI.result: 在 MathVista、MMMU 和 MMMU-Pro 上，基于 Qwen3.5-27B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、GPT-5-Nano、Gemini-3-Flash 等多种骨干模型，DG-Mem 相比无记忆方法和竞争性记忆基线均取得稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: DG-Mem 表明，在不更新模型参数的情况下，通过结构化、可检索、效用加权的外部记忆，可以有效增强冻结 MLLM 在多模态科学与数学推理中的表现，并适用于闭源和端侧部署场景。

title: Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts
summary: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.

AI.tldr: 论文研究冻结的 DreamerV3 世界模型是否能从摆色视频中学习到被其潜在动力学近似守恒的标量不变量，并发现其虽能编码能量样约束，却会在自主想象 rollout 中违背该约束。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型可预测视频，但这并不意味着其潜在动力学真正学习并可靠保持物理约束。作者希望区分“可解码的相关量”和“具有动力学意义的不变量”，并检验世界模型在长期预测中是否违反已学习的物理规律。
AI.method: 作者使用仅由摆色视频训练、冻结的 DreamerV3，在标签无关条件下搜索潜在空间中的近似守恒标量；比较独立训练的保守系统模型与匹配的阻尼系统模型；在自主 rollout 中测量该标量漂移，并通过将潜在状态投影回初始水平集来测试其对预测误差的影响，同时与随机约束进行对照。
AI.result: 标签无关搜索在多个独立训练的保守模型中恢复出相同的能量样不变量；在匹配的阻尼模型中未发现类似不变量。自主 rollout 时该量发生漂移。将潜在状态投影回初始水平集可降低三个保守模型的 rollout 误差，而随机约束通常会增加误差。
AI.conclusion: DreamerV3 可从像素中学习到具有动力学意义的物理不变量，但其生成式潜在转移在向前想象时并不必然保持该不变量。这揭示了世界模型的一个具体失效模式：学到物理约束不等于能够在长期预测中可靠遵守约束。

title: Spatiotemporally Decoupled Autoregressive Diffusion Model for Human Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven human motion synthesis has made substantial development with two core modules of motion representation and generative architecture. For representation, Vector Quantization (VQ)-based methods compress motion data into discrete tokens while latent-based models operate directly in continuous space. However, both of these representations exhibit significant limitations. VQ-based methods suffer from inherent information loss, which compromises the quality, diversity, and generalization of generated motions, while continuous representation on holistic whole-body motion hinders part-level flexibility. For architecture, diffusion and autoregressive diffusion models have demonstrated their superiority, yet the fine-grained controllability over individual body parts is also limited. Thus, we propose a unified spatiotemporally decoupled framework named DeMoDiff, which jointly redesigns representation and architecture. To enhance representation extraction capabilities and offer greater part-level controllability, we present a spatial-temporal VAE that encodes each body joint rather than compressing the whole-body motion into a single latent space. Then, we incorporate spatial-temporal masking and attention mechanisms into an autoregressive diffusion generator, achieving both generative capability and controllable editability. Extensive experiments on the HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and compelling motion generation results. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong temporal and spatial editing capabilities, further validating its effectiveness. Our project page: https://rex0191.github.io/DeMoDiff/

AI.tldr: DeMoDiff 是一个文本驱动人体运动生成框架，通过关节级时空 VAE 表征与自回归扩散生成器结合，提升重建、生成质量以及时空/身体部位级编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 现有运动表征存在局限：VQ 离散 token 会带来信息损失，影响生成质量、多样性和泛化；连续全身潜空间虽避免量化损失，但缺乏身体部位级灵活控制。同时，扩散和自回归扩散架构虽生成能力强，但对单个身体部位的细粒度可控性不足。
AI.method: 论文提出统一的时空解耦框架 DeMoDiff。首先设计 spatial-temporal VAE，不再将整个人体运动压缩到单一潜空间，而是对每个身体关节进行编码，以增强表征能力和部位级控制。随后在自回归扩散生成器中引入时空 masking 与 attention 机制，使模型兼具高质量生成能力与可编辑性。
AI.result: 在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法达到当前最优的重建性能，并获得有竞争力的人体运动生成效果。此外，模型展现出较强的时间维度和空间身体部位维度编辑能力。
AI.conclusion: DeMoDiff 通过同时改进运动表征和生成架构，有效缓解了 VQ 信息损失、整体连续潜空间缺乏局部控制以及扩散模型细粒度可控性不足的问题，是一种兼具高质量生成、重建与可控编辑能力的文本驱动人体运动合成方法。

title: How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles
comment: Accepted at Human-AI Complementarity and Alignment (HCOMP) 2026
summary: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究按需AI辅助在短期提升表现与长期削弱技能发展之间的张力，发现低成本AI会增加使用频率，而依赖AI的参与者在移除AI后表现更差。
AI.motivation: AI辅助可能提高即时任务表现，但也可能替代人的独立思考，从而抑制长期技能形成；论文希望在可控实验中识别这种潜在代价。
AI.method: 作者设计逻辑谜题实验，让参与者在AI可用前、可用期间、移除后完成任务，并实验性改变请求AI的成本；同时使用贝叶斯潜在能力模型区分初始能力、AI后能力与个体技能变化，并估计AI可用阶段的独立推理努力与技能增长之间的关系。
AI.result: 较低的AI请求成本导致更频繁的AI使用；在AI可用阶段请求帮助的参与者，AI移除后任务表现更差；基于AI辅助阶段表现预测其后续无辅助表现会产生高估；独立解题努力越多，潜在能力提升越大。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助虽能带来短期绩效收益，但当其替代独立推理时，可能削弱技能发展；合理设计AI使用成本与激励机制、鼓励人类保持主动思考，对长期能力培养至关重要。

title: Spotter: Efficient Urban Visual Localization via Geo-Referenced Facade Landmarks in GPS-Degraded Environments
summary: Accurate visual localization on robotic and wearable platforms remains challenging in dense urban environments. Existing methodologies typically rely on GPS for absolute positioning, yet GPS signals frequently degrade in urban canyons due to multipath propagation. Consequently, standard solutions like visual odometry suffer from unmitigated drift over time, while map-matching techniques struggle to acquire the reliable GPS priors they need, on top of being too computationally heavy for real-time edge execution. To address these limitations, we propose Spotter, a robuts and real-time visual localization framework that uses building facades as a reliable source of global geo-reference, while retaining the capability to integrate GPS signals when available. In an offline stage, Spotter processes Google Street View panoramas by semantically segmenting facades and pairing multi-view stereo depth with cartographic data to build a compact metric database. At runtime, query images are matched via a cascaded retrieval and geometric verification pipeline to recover fine-grained global camera localization. We benchmark Spotter on a newly collected dataset of pedestrian sequences acquired with wearable smart glasses across several districts of Barcelona. Experimental results show that Spotter outperforms odometry-based baselines and achieves localization accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art map-based methods while operating at significantly higher frame rates.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Spotter：一种面向城市峡谷中机器人/可穿戴设备的实时视觉定位框架，利用建筑立面作为全局地理参照，在GPS不可用或不稳定时实现高精度定位。
AI.motivation: 密集城市环境中GPS易受多路径效应影响，导致视觉里程计长期漂移；依赖GPS先验的地图匹配方法鲁棒性不足且计算开销大，难以在边缘设备实时运行。
AI.method: 离线阶段处理街景全景图，对建筑立面进行语义分割，并结合多视角立体深度与地图制图数据构建紧凑度量数据库；在线阶段对查询图像执行级联检索与几何验证，恢复细粒度全局相机位姿，同时可在可用时融合GPS信号。
AI.result: 在使用可穿戴智能眼镜采集的行人序列数据集上，Spotter优于基于里程计的基线方法，并达到与先进地图方法相近的定位精度，同时具备显著更高的帧率。
AI.conclusion: 建筑立面可作为可靠的城市全局地理参照，Spotter在精度、实时性和GPS退化场景鲁棒性之间取得较好平衡，适合机器人和可穿戴平台的边缘实时视觉定位。

title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
summary: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

AI.tldr: Prime Agent 是一个开源长程评测与编码代理工作流框架，通过持久化 REPL、连续化记忆/技能/提示保存、递归子代理协作和会话管理，提高长程任务中的执行、恢复、验证与资源核算能力，并在多类任务上显著提升表现。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型本质上是顺序处理器，其权重和当前上下文难以支撑长时间跨度任务所需的外部信息、持续计算、历史保留和复杂协作；同时，评测框架本身的失败可能掩盖模型真实能力。因此需要一个低摩擦、可恢复、可验证、可持续运行的代理框架，以更准确测量模型在长程任务中的上限能力。
AI.method: 论文提出 Prime Agent：使用持久 IPython REPL 实现程序化上下文处理与测试时计算；通过 Continual Harness 跨轨迹保存历史、记忆、技能、提示和子代理规格；支持递归子代理之间的直接通信；提供 Agents View 供人类检查和管理后台会话；并标准化执行、恢复、验证和资源统计，同时将策略构造交由模型完成。
AI.result: Prime Agent 将 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 从 30% 提升到 95.5%；在长上下文编码、GPU kernel 生成、模拟器构建和自主 nanoGPT 加速实验中达到或超过原生及流行 harness；在 Factorio 实验中，迭代改进支持持续技术推进，专用子代理可实现并行化工作。
AI.conclusion: Prime Agent 通过提供持久化计算、连续记忆、递归多代理协作和稳健执行环境，降低框架层面的干扰，使评测更接近模型真实潜能；其结果表明，合适的代理 harness 对长程任务性能具有显著影响。

title: What Memory Composition Does Not Tell Us About Anomaly Detection
summary: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP

AI.tldr: 论文研究记忆型异常检测器在稀疏训练污染下的覆盖选择问题，发现全局覆盖选择会显著过度纳入污染样本；CLEANCON几乎消除最终记忆污染并提升全部匹配比较中的P-AP，但污染率最低的记忆并不一定带来最高P-AP。
AI.motivation: 记忆型异常检测器会把被选入记忆库的训练图像块直接作为正常参考，但常规覆盖选择并不会额外验证几何稀有样本是否可信。若训练集中存在少量异常污染，这种“覆盖即信任”的耦合可能导致异常样本进入正常记忆，从而影响检测性能。
AI.method: 在固定表征、记忆预算、构建器和推理规则的条件下，比较随机、medoid、局部覆盖和全局覆盖等记忆选择策略；进一步提出/使用CLEANCON，一种基于跨图像out-of-bag支持的门控机制，用于改变候选图像资格，同时保持其他实验因素不变；通过保留率扫描分析污染率与类别宏平均P-AP之间的关系。
AI.result: 全局覆盖策略会强烈过度表示稀疏污染。CLEANCON将最终记忆污染降低到近似为零，并在12个匹配比较中均提升类别宏平均P-AP。然而，在保留率扫描中，污染最低的记忆并未取得最高P-AP；随着污染上升，性能仍可能继续改善。
AI.conclusion: 训练记忆中的污染率并不能单调决定或排序最终检测性能；仅追求最低污染并不足以获得最佳P-AP。更关键的是在覆盖、多样性、支持度和污染抑制之间取得平衡，CLEANCON表明跨图像支持门控可有效缓解稀疏污染带来的风险。

title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
summary: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

AI.tldr: ReWorld提出一种面向实时交互式世界模型的训练与推理框架，通过分离短期控制与长期记忆，并在推理时用固定预算缓存和姿态索引地标库实现长时一致性与实时生成。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型需要同时满足用户动作控制、长期场景记忆和实时视频流生成，但短期动作响应依赖近邻上下文，而长期记忆需要跨越无界历史，二者在注意力范围、缓存规模和推理成本上存在结构性矛盾。
AI.method: 训练阶段采用混合逐头注意力窗口：多数注意力头关注近期历史，少数全局头关注完整历史；随机头路由防止能力绑定到固定头，随机块丢弃使稀疏历史成为训练分布内情况。推理阶段使用有界KV缓存结合姿态索引的landmark bank，根据当前相机姿态检索最近地标。数据方面，将多源数据统一到物理动作尺度，并使用回文轨迹提供重访证据。另通过限制在LoRA适配器中的分布匹配蒸馏，将采样压缩到四步。
AI.result: 在涵盖动作跟随、长时记忆和视频质量的三轴评测中，相比六个近期交互式世界模型，ReWorld取得最佳控制保真度、最佳相机运动一致性和最佳生成质量；其旋转误差为11.95°。在64秒、384个latent的往返长序列中，固定12块缓存仍能重建起始视角，而滑动窗口已遗忘证据，全KV注意力则受限于显存。
AI.conclusion: ReWorld通过训练时解耦控制与记忆、推理时以固定预算管理历史信息，在实时交互、长时场景召回和高质量视频生成之间取得有效平衡，展示了面向可交互世界模型的可扩展长程记忆方案。

title: What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection
summary: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究记忆库式异常检测器在稀疏训练污染下的记忆选择问题，发现全局覆盖策略会显著过度选择污染样本；提出 CLEANCON 通过跨图像的 out-of-bag 支持门控降低最终记忆污染，并在 12 个匹配比较中提升类别宏平均 P-AP，但污染率最低并不必然对应最高性能。
AI.motivation: 记忆库式异常检测通常将被选入覆盖集合的训练 patch 直接作为正常参考，但没有额外验证其几何稀有性是否意味着可信正常样本。若训练集中存在少量污染异常，这种“覆盖选择”和“正常性假设”的耦合可能导致异常样本进入记忆库并影响检测性能。
AI.method: 在固定表征、记忆预算、构建器与推理规则的条件下，比较随机、medoid、局部覆盖和全局覆盖等记忆选择策略；进一步提出 CLEANCON，一种基于 out-of-bag 跨图像支持的候选图像资格门控方法，用于改变候选图像是否可进入记忆构建，同时保持其他实验因素不变。
AI.result: 实验显示，全局覆盖选择会强烈过度表示稀疏污染。CLEANCON 能将最终记忆污染降至约为零，并在全部 12 个匹配比较中提高 category-macro P-AP。然而，在保留率扫描中，污染最低的记忆库并未取得最高 P-AP，性能在污染上升时仍继续提升。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，记忆库污染率本身不能单调地排序或预测不同记忆库的 P-AP 表现；降低污染有帮助，但异常检测性能还受到覆盖性、代表性和记忆保留率等因素共同影响。CLEANCON 是一种在不改变表征和推理规则的前提下降低污染并提升性能的有效门控策略。

title: Grounding Free-Form Instructions for Fashion Complementary Image Generation
summary: Fashion complementary image generation (CIG) aims to create garments that stylistically match a seed item based on user intent, making it a natural multimodal grounding problem where models must interpret language in visual context. Existing CIG benchmarks rely on rigid template prompts (e.g., "a photo of a skirt"), failing to reflect natural user queries and obscuring model behavior across levels of linguistic specificity. We introduce fashion complementary image generation with free-form instructions, a multimodal language-grounding setting where a model generates a compatible garment from a seed image and a natural-language instruction. To this end, we enrich three CIG benchmarks with low-, medium-, and high-specificity instructions generated by a vision-language model and validated by human annotators. We instantiate the task with StyleFlow, a Rectified Flow Matching model that jointly conditions on the seed image and instruction within a single multimodal transformer. Across image quality metrics, catalog-alignment analysis, ablations, and human evaluation, StyleFlow consistently produces instruction-aligned and stylistically coherent garments while reducing architectural complexity and inference cost relative to auxiliary-module approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向自由形式指令的时尚互补图像生成任务，并构建多层次语言具体性的基准；提出StyleFlow模型，在种子图像与自然语言指令联合条件下生成风格匹配且符合指令的服装。
AI.motivation: 现有时尚互补图像生成基准多依赖固定模板提示，难以反映真实用户的自然语言需求，也无法系统评估模型在不同语言具体性层级下的理解与生成能力。
AI.method: 作者将三个CIG基准扩展为包含低、中、高具体性自由形式指令的数据集，这些指令由视觉语言模型生成并经人工验证；同时提出StyleFlow，一个Rectified Flow Matching模型，在单一多模态Transformer中联合编码种子图像与指令以进行条件生成。
AI.result: 在图像质量指标、商品目录对齐分析、消融实验和人工评估中，StyleFlow均能稳定生成与指令一致、与种子服装风格协调的服装，并相比依赖辅助模块的方法降低了架构复杂度与推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 自由形式指令更适合作为CIG的真实评测设定；StyleFlow证明了统一多模态条件建模能够有效提升指令对齐与风格一致性，同时简化系统设计。

title: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents
summary: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses each tool result to select the next action, so localized video clips guide external retrieval and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To develop this capability, we construct an automated data curation pipeline, producing 26K verified SFT trajectories and 3K challenging RL instances. We also introduce VideoRover-Bench, a benchmark stratified by video duration and research difficulty. Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench show that our VideoRover-8B-RL achieves performance comparable to proprietary models in the direct-answer setting without tool use while outperforming larger open-source models equipped with the same tool suite. Ablation studies and training dynamics further validate the complementary roles of active video grounding, external retrieval, and long-horizon reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: VideoRover 是一个统一的视频深度研究框架，通过迭代协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索与网页浏览来回答开放世界视频问题。
AI.motivation: 开放世界视频理解常需要在视频中定位稀疏视觉证据，并获取视频内容与模型参数记忆中缺失的外部知识；现有主动视频感知与多步信息检索能力通常彼此割裂。
AI.method: 提出 VideoRover 框架：给定视频-问题对，模型根据每轮工具结果动态选择下一步行动，使局部视频片段引导外部检索，检索证据再触发进一步的视频检查与验证。作者还构建自动数据整理流水线，生成 26K 经验证的监督微调轨迹与 3K 强化学习实例，并提出按视频时长与研究难度分层的 VideoRover-Bench。
AI.result: 在 VideoDR 与 VideoRover-Bench 上，VideoRover-8B-RL 在无工具直接回答设定下达到接近专有模型的性能；在配备相同工具套件时，优于更大规模的开源模型。消融实验与训练动态验证了主动视频定位、外部检索和长程强化学习的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将主动视频 grounding、外部知识检索与长程决策训练统一起来，可以显著提升开放世界视频问答与视频深度研究能力。

title: IntentQA: Intent Question Answering in Videos by Cognitive Context Reasoning
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Accepted manuscript of an article published in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Video understanding requires intelligent agents to transcend mere recognition of visual facts and comprehend the underlying intents behind human actions (often termed the "dark matter" of social intelligence). To bridge the gap between visual observation and intent reasoning, we introduce a novel task, IntentQA, and contribute a large-scale VideoQA dataset specifically tailored for this purpose. However, recognizing that standard metrics may overestimate capabilities due to dataset biases, we go beyond simple accuracy to rigorously evaluate model robustness. We augment the benchmark by generating five distinct contrast sets via Large Language Models (LLMs) and introducing a "Contrast Performance Decline" metric. We propose the X-CaVIR (eXplainable Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning) framework, which leverages three types of "Cognitive Context" to enhance video analysis: i) Situational Context via a cross-modal Video Query Language (VQL) module, ii) Contrastive Context via a Contrastive Learning module, and iii) Commonsense Context via a Commonsense Reasoning module. Crucially, to overcome the opacity of traditional black-box models, we refine the integration of LLMs within X-CaVIR by employing a transparent pipeline that synergizes video captions with VQA model outputs. This approach not only improves performance by effectively utilizing rich commonsense knowledge but also renders the reasoning process explicitly interpretable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our components, the superiority of X-CaVIR over state-of-the-art baselines, and its stability against perturbations on the contrast sets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IntentQA 视频问答任务与大规模数据集，面向视频中人类行为意图理解，并提出 X-CaVIR 框架提升可解释、鲁棒的意图推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解多停留在视觉事实识别层面，难以推断人类行为背后的意图；同时，常规准确率可能受数据集偏差影响而高估模型能力，因此需要更专门的任务、数据集与鲁棒性评估。
AI.method: 构建 IntentQA 数据集，并利用大语言模型生成五类对比测试集，引入 Contrast Performance Decline 指标评估扰动下性能下降。提出 X-CaVIR 框架，结合三类认知上下文：基于跨模态 Video Query Language 的情境上下文、对比学习模块提供的对比上下文、以及常识推理模块提供的常识上下文；同时采用透明流水线融合视频字幕与 VQA 输出，以增强可解释性。
AI.result: 实验表明，X-CaVIR 各组成模块有效，整体性能优于现有先进基线，并且在对比测试集上的稳定性更好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将视频问答从视觉事实识别推进到意图推理层面，并通过对比评估和可解释框架提升了模型的鲁棒性、透明度与常识推理能力。

title: Can Coding Agents Build Robust Baselines? A Skill-Based Approach for Automating the Medical Imaging Model-Development Pipeline
summary: Developing competitive deep learning baselines for medical imaging remains a highly iterative process requiring literature review, implementation, experimentation, and expert refinement. Existing automation approaches typically optimize isolated components, such as architecture search or hyperparameter tuning, rather than the complete baseline development process. We present an agentic AI Scientist workflow that combines literature-guided reasoning, automated code generation, and hypothesis-driven experimentation to generate competitive baseline models for medical imaging challenges. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks spanning segmentation, classification, and detection. Across all tasks, the Experimentation Pipeline consistently improves validation performance, achieving competitive leaderboard results, including 6th place on both PUMA tracks (15 teams) and 31st place on MILK10k (125 teams). On MIDOG25, the resulting model also demonstrates strong domain generalization across scanners, tumor types, and species. Using the same workflow across all challenges without task-specific redesign, we demonstrate that skill-based, literature-guided agentic workflows can substantially reduce the engineering effort required to develop competitive medical imaging baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向医学影像竞赛基线开发的智能体 AI Scientist 工作流，通过文献引导推理、自动代码生成与假设驱动实验，自动构建具有竞争力的深度学习基线。
AI.motivation: 医学影像深度学习基线开发通常依赖反复的文献调研、实现、实验和专家调优，工程成本高；现有自动化方法多只优化架构搜索或超参数调优等局部环节，难以覆盖完整基线开发流程。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个 skill-based、literature-guided 的 agentic workflow，将文献知识用于方案推理，结合自动代码生成与实验管线，围绕假设进行迭代实验与模型改进，并在分割、分类、检测等医学影像任务上统一应用该流程。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上，该实验管线均持续提升验证集性能，并取得有竞争力的排行榜成绩：PUMA 两个赛道均在 15 支队伍中排名第 6，MILK10k 在 125 支队伍中排名第 31；在 MIDOG25 上模型还表现出较强的跨扫描仪、肿瘤类型和物种的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，无需针对每个任务进行专门重设计，文献引导的智能体工作流也能显著降低医学影像竞争性基线开发所需的工程投入，并产生较强的可迁移性与实用价值。

title: Controllable blind deblurring with diffusion models
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted to IEEE ICIP 2026
summary: Image acquisition with a camera involves several degradations due to the optical system, sensor, or low-level processing steps. We address blind deblurring in professional photography: we aim to invert unknown isotropic blur without knowledge of the degradation kernel.For such inverse problems,where some high-frequency information is lost, it is challenging to use generative models to produce details that are both photo-realistic and faithful to the input. We propose SuperSharpen, a diffusion-based blind deblurring method offering explicit control over restoration strength through a blur measure. We compare two conditioning strategies: a ControlNet-style adapter on a frozen backbone, and full finetuning of the diffusion prior. Our experiments show that finetuning achieves better fidelity with fewer hallucinated details. We validate our approach on synthetic and real-world blur, demonstrating improved perceptual quality and controllable restoration strength.

AI.tldr: SuperSharpen 是一种基于扩散模型的盲去模糊方法，面向专业摄影中的未知各向同性模糊，并通过模糊度量显式控制恢复强度。
AI.motivation: 相机成像会受到光学系统、传感器和底层处理流程造成的退化影响；在未知模糊核且高频信息丢失的情况下，生成式模型很难同时生成逼真且忠实于输入图像的细节，因此需要一种可控、低幻觉的盲去模糊方法。
AI.method: 论文提出 SuperSharpen，利用扩散模型进行盲去模糊，并引入 blur measure 作为条件以控制复原强度；同时比较两种条件注入策略：在冻结扩散主干上使用 ControlNet 风格适配器，以及对扩散先验进行完整微调。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比 ControlNet 风格适配器，完整微调在图像保真度上表现更好，并产生更少的幻觉细节；在合成模糊和真实模糊数据上均验证了方法能提升感知质量并实现可控复原。
AI.conclusion: SuperSharpen 展示了扩散模型在专业摄影盲去模糊中的有效性，尤其是通过微调扩散先验和模糊度量条件控制，可在感知质量、输入忠实度和恢复强度可控性之间取得较好平衡。

title: DF-MoE: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Multimodal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Audio-visual deepfake detection is an actively studied topic, where one of the main challenges is to develop detectors able to generalize across deepfake generation methods. We conjecture that overfitting can be mitigated by extracting multiple high-level cues from the available audio and visual modalities via pre-trained models. We therefore assemble a wide variety of pre-trained models to extract features that encode mouth movements, face parsing, facial expressions, head pose, gaze tracking, heart rate, audio emotion and speech activity. We further integrate both unimodal and multimodal cues via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone to detect deepfakes.
